  ledger row `ADMIN_ADJUSTMENT` (reference = the adjustment id). Never below 0 unless `allowNegative` (OWNER, a debit:
  a reversal; a negative coin balance freezes gifts as in D190). Per admin per day (`ADMIN_DASHBOARD_TIME_ZONE`), the
  amounts of `COINS` and of `CHERRIES` adjustments may not pass `ADMIN_ADJUST_DAILY_CAP_COINS` /
  `ADMIN_ADJUST_DAILY_CAP_CHERRIES` (10 000 000 each; 0 = none) → 409 `daily_cap`. The person gets
  `BALANCE_ADJUSTED` (target `BALANCE_ADJUSTMENT`: `currency`, signed `amount`). The CLI has no cap.
- **Deletion** ⚿: `requestAdminUserDeletion` runs D193's `requestDeletionIn` (grace period, sessions end, a live ends;
  409 `ACCOUNT_DELETION_BLOCKED` with the blockers); `cancelAdminUserDeletion` its cancel. Audited
  `account.deletion.requested|cancelled` with `via: panel`. As in D193, the person can still cancel by signing in.
- **Timeline** (`listAdminUserAudit`, OWNER): the rows about the account, the rows it did itself, and the team's
  content actions on its posts, stories and comments.
- **Privacy limit:** the panel never reads private direct messages; a DM is seen only as the snapshot attached to a
  report (§11.13). D208 adds no DM reading.
- **Purge (D193):** the account's `account_restrictions` are deleted; its balance adjustments stay with the ledgers
  (their reason text blanked when the ledgers' retention ends).

### 10.68 «كن مضيفاً مع الإدارة»: hosting directly with the Kabso team *(v1.73-social, DRAFT — D209)*

Owner decision (2026-10-31, Arabic, via the coordinator): «بالاضافة يجب ان يكون بالصفحة يمكن للشخص تفعيل حسابه مضيف مع
الإدارة» — on «الوكالة», next to «انضم إلى وكالة» and «افتح وكالة» (§10.46, §10.65), a third path: the person applies to
host **directly with the administration**, in no agency (so no agency commission, §10.46). Every number is server
config. Nothing in CP-010 (§10.8) changes: going live still needs a `live_hosts` row.

- **The source.** `LiveHostSource.IDENTITY` existed since CP-010 for «identity checks» (owner D93: agencies and identity
  checks in L1b) and no flow used it; it is **the permission given by approving an application here** (the person's ID
  card and selfie checked by the team). `ADMIN` stays the team's hand grant (`grantAdminLiveHost`, `lives.manage`),
  `AGENCY` is unused. No new value.
- **Who may apply** — `getMyHostingApplication.rule` says it before; `applyForHosting` refuses with 409
  `HOST_APPLICATION_NOT_ALLOWED`, `details[0] = {field: application, issue}`, checked in this order: `ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE`,
  `ALREADY_HOST` (a `live_hosts` row of **any** source — the app shows the host's status instead of the card),
  `HOST_OF_AGENCY` (an ACTIVE host of an agency), `OWNS_AGENCY` (an open agency), `PENDING` (**one open application per
  user**, also a partial unique index), `REAPPLY_COOLDOWN` (the latest application was rejected less than
  `HOST_APPLICATION_REAPPLY_DAYS` (30) ago — `application.reapplyAt`), and, from the form, `UNDER_MIN_AGE`.
- **The form** (`HostingApplicationRequest`): `displayName` — the name the person hosts under, the §6 display-name
  rules (the app fills in the profile's: the «display name check»; the profile is not changed); `country` (ISO alpha-2);
  `dateOfBirth` (a calendar day; the person must be at least `HOST_APPLICATION_MIN_AGE` (18, the site's minimum; the
  server refuses a lower setting) on the day of the request in UTC — the 18th birthday itself is accepted); `contact`
  (`WHATSAPP` / `TELEGRAM` / `PHONE` / `EMAIL` / `OTHER` + 3–100 characters); `bio` (10–300, what they will stream,
  line breaks allowed); `links` (optional, at most 3 `https` URLs of existing streaming accounts, ≤ 200 each); the
  **mandatory identity check** — pending private uploads of kinds `RECHARGE_AGENT_PHOTO` (the ID card) and
  `RECHARGE_AGENT_SELFIE`, consumed into `private/host-applications/{applicationId}/…` (`private, no-store`, never a
  public URL, never in a response or the audit trail), as D185 / D206 exactly; and `acceptRules: true` (the host rules,
  a short text in the app; the time is kept as `rulesAcceptedAt`). `Idempotency-Key`: the same key with the same body →
  200 (nothing new), with another body → 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Rate limit `RATE_LIMIT_HOST_APPLY_USER` (5 per
  24 h per user, refused attempts count). Audited `host.application.submit` (country and the number of links only).
- **States** (`HostApplicationStatus`): `PENDING` → `APPROVED` | `REJECTED` (the team) | `CANCELLED` (`cancelReason`
  `USER`: `cancelMyHostingApplication`, the person may apply again at once; `AGENCY`: they joined an agency or opened
  one — an agency host is not a direct host; `ACCOUNT`: the account was deleted). Every change is audited
  (`host.application.cancel` | `approve` | `reject`). `getMyHostingApplication.application` is the pending one if any,
  else the newest; it shows only the name, the country, the dates, the reason and `reapplyAt`.
- **Approval** (panel or `host-admin approve`): the applicant must still be ACTIVE and in no agency (else 409
  `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`). It writes the `live_hosts` row — source `IDENTITY`, `granted_by_id` the admin (null from the
  CLI), a room number as every grant — audited `live.host.grant` {source IDENTITY, application} and
  `host.application.approve`, and notifies `HOST_APPLICATION_APPROVED` (system, no target; pushed by the outbox, §11.12;
  the app opens «الوكالة», which shows «أنت مضيف مع الإدارة ✓» and «ابدأ البث»). A person who got the permission
  another way while pending keeps their row and its source (`existingSource` in the audit). Revoking later is the
  ordinary `revokeAdminLiveHost`; the application stays APPROVED and the person may apply again.
- **Rejection** (panel or `host-admin reject`): a reason (1–500) the person sees in the app; `HOST_APPLICATION_REJECTED`
  (the push never carries the reason); they may apply again `HOST_APPLICATION_REAPPLY_DAYS` after the decision.
- **With agencies.** (1) A direct host who **joins an agency later** keeps the permission: `joinAgency` never touches
  `live_hosts`, so the source stays `IDENTITY` (and leaving the agency leaves it too). (2) In a D206 probation such a
  host counts **exactly like any other host**: activation (§10.65) looks only at the agency link's window, the lives
  started and the gifts received in it — never at the permission's source. (3) Joining or opening an agency cancels a
  pending application (`AGENCY`), in the join's / opening's transaction.
- **The team** — panel «طلبات المضيفين» under the hosts group: the list (`listAdminHostApplications`, the v2 table:
  `status` filter, `q` the username / email prefix or part of the name, `sort` createdAt | decidedAt, CSV; no private
  field) and an application (`getAdminHostApplication`: the fields with the age, and the applicant's account summary —
  account age, status, open / all reports against them, bans and warnings from the panel, the hosting permission, an
  agency — and their other applications), each read audited `host.application.view`; its pictures one at a time
  (`getAdminHostApplicationPhoto`, streamed by the API, audited `host.application.photo.view`); approve / reject with
  the CSRF header and, for a rejection, the reason — **no authenticator code again** (it moves no money). Capabilities
  (§10.60.1): `hosts.applications` OWNER, SUPPORT, MODERATION (MODERATION may look); `hosts.applications.photos` and
  `hosts.applications.decide` OWNER, SUPPORT. CLI `host-admin applications | view [--save] | approve | reject
  --reason` (the migration role, `via: cli`, the same rules: `host-applications.core.ts`).
- **Privacy.** Account deletion cancels a pending application and purges the date of birth, the contact, the bio, the
  links and the pictures (the name, country, status and dates stay); the data export includes the person's
  applications and pictures (`host_applications`).

### 10.69 Live categories and the podcast live *(v1.47-live, DRAFT — D212)*

Owner (2026-10-31): «في البث المباشر اريد ان يكون هذه التصنيفات: بث مباشر، بث صوتي، بث بودكاست، بث متعدد، بث ستريمر»;
the podcast mockup (Clubhouse / Spaces style, built on the audio room's own elements) approved; «رسالة النظام في
جميع تصنيفات البث … تختفي عند الكتابة … ودخول الأشخاص الى البث يظهر في التكست كل واحد برسالة».

- **Five categories = modes.** The hub's category row is «الكل» + بث مباشر (`kind=solo`: SOLO and PK), بث صوتي
  (`kind=audio`: AUDIO), بث بودكاست (`kind=podcast`: PODCAST), بث متعدد (`kind=multi`: MULTI) and بث ستريمر (phone
  screen share, D213 — v1.56-live: `kind=streamer`, STREAMER, §10.86). A PODCAST is in no other kind (`audio`
  stays AUDIO only; `party` and `video` are unchanged). The hub's existing chips (القريبة / الرائج / المميزة / استكشاف)
  combine with the category: the chip picks the list (`scope=nearby`, `tab=popular`, `featured=true`, `tab=new`) and
  the category adds `kind` (AND); «الكل» sends no `kind`. Cursors are bound to `kind` as before (§10.4).
- **PODCAST.** Audio only (the host and every speaker publish the microphone only, like AUDIO, §10.9); the host and
  up to 3 speakers (`seatCount` 4, seats 1–3; `seatCount` in the start body → 400). `StartLiveRoomRequest.podcast`
  is required: `topic` (`business`, `tech`, `sports`, `religion`, `society`, `entertainment`, `other`),
  `questionsOpen` (default true), `questionSeconds` (60 / 120 / 180 / 300 or null = no limit; default 120). The
  **episode number** is per host: 1 + the host's highest so far (unique per host, `live_rooms_host_episode_key`).
  `LiveRoomSummary.podcast` carries the episode number, topic, the two settings and the seated speakers (the hub
  card's avatar stack). Themes: the room themes (§10.9) plus the owner's podcast backgrounds `podcast-studio`
  (the PODCAST default when `theme` is absent), `podcast-majlis` and `podcast-library` (appended to `LiveConfig.themes`;
  the art ships in the app, cover-fit from the top centre; a new background is an asset plus a theme slug).
  D212b (owner 2026-11-01, app only): the app offers a PODCAST only these three (setup, ≡, «إعدادات البث») and never
  offers them to the other modes; the server does not validate a theme per mode (any `LiveConfig.themes` slug is
  accepted in any mode) — unchanged, no contract change.
- **Raised hands = seat requests.** A podcast's `requestLiveSeat` is a hand: optional `question` (1–80 code points,
  the chat text rules), queued even while the 3 seats are full, refused 409 `LIVE_QUESTIONS_CLOSED` while the host
  has closed the hands (hands already up stay). Lowering = `cancelLiveSeatRequest`. The host's sheet lists
  `listLiveSeatRequests` in **queue order** — `COALESCE(deferred_at, created_at)`, then id — so «لاحقاً»
  (`deferLiveSeatRequest`, host or moderator, the seat-action bucket) sends a hand to the end of the queue and marks it
  `deferred`; «اصعد» is `acceptLiveSeatRequest` (409 `LIVE_SEAT_UNAVAILABLE` when the 3 seats are full: the host
  removes or waits). `LiveSeats.handsUp` (everyone, PODCAST only) lists the raised hands' user ids in that order, so
  every listener row puts them first with the ✋ badge. Rate limits: the existing seat buckets (ask, action).
- **Timed questions.** An accepted hand in a room with a question time gets `LiveSeat.demoteAt` = accept time +
  `questionSeconds`; the live media reconciliation (every `LIVE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`, 15 s) frees every seat past
  it (the seat row deleted, the speaker's permission back to a viewer's — they can no longer publish), so a speaker goes
  back within one sweep; the speaker's own app also leaves the seat at that moment. The host's guests (invitations)
  have no limit. Mute and remove are the CP-011 seat controls. Seat actions are not audited (as before); the host's
  `questionsOpen` / `questionSeconds` changes are (`live.room.podcast`, and they move `roomInfoVersion`).
- **Gifts, cherries, levels** work as in AUDIO rooms (the sender picks the speaker; `LiveSeat.points`). No recording.
- **Announced episodes.** `createLiveScheduleSlot` with `mode` PODCAST and `podcastTopic` (both or neither) announces an
  episode; the CP-016 C reminder is unchanged (the host's followers, 15 minutes before). `listScheduledPodcasts`
  (`GET /live/podcasts/scheduled`, guests too) lists the next 7 days' episodes, at most 20, soonest first, ACTIVE hosts
  with the hosting permission, none across a block; `reminder` is true when the caller follows the host. The hub's
  «🔔 ذكّرني» follows the host (so the existing reminder reaches them).
- **Chat rule (all categories).** The room's rules line (D118, local) shows in the chat until the first chat message
  of the visit (anyone's: posted, own pending, or a bullet; joins do not count); then it is gone for the visit. This
  replaces D135 / D199's «it rises with the lines and fades out at the top». D119's join strip is gone: joins are lines. Each join is its own chat line in every category — «فلان دخل البث» /
  «فلانة دخلت البث» by the `join` message's `gender`, else the neutral «انضم فلان» — at most 5 a second per room
  (server, §10.11); the recharge-agent / host-agent entrance bars stay.
- **Admin.** `GET /admin/lives?mode=SOLO|PK|MULTI|AUDIO|PODCAST` filters the lives on air (the panel's category chips).

### 10.70 PK friends who are waiting for a random match *(v1.48-live, DRAFT — D215)*

Owner, two Android phones on staging, both live and following each other: «لا يظهر صديق في بيكيه فقط بالعشوائي»
— the PK sheet's «الأصدقاء» did not show the other host; only «مطابقة عشوائية» found them. Reproduced end to end
(`d215-pk-friends`): two mutual followers, both live with fresh heartbeats, are each other's friend while idle;
once one of them waits in the random queue (they tapped «مطابقة عشوائية» first, or Auto Match keeps them
there), v1.43-live left them out of every candidate list and refused an invitation (409 `PK_HOST_BUSY`) — so
the other phone saw «لا يوجد أصدقاء» and the random match, which pairs exactly those two, was the only way.

- **Who is listed.** `listLivePkCandidates` (suggestions, `q`, `friends=true`) no longer leaves out a host
  because they wait in the random queue. Every other rule of §10.58 / §10.62 holds (eligible, invitations on,
  no open PK or invitation either way, no block; `recommendable`; friends = mutual follows).
- **Inviting a waiting host.** `inviteLivePk` checks the invited host as busy only for an open match or an open
  invitation. While the invitation is open the waiting host is not paired at random (as before: an open
  invitation makes a queued room busy for the matcher). Accepted → the battle starts and both hosts' waits are
  deleted (any match does that); declined, cancelled or expired → the waiting host keeps their wait until it
  expires (`PK_RANDOM_WAIT_SECONDS`).
- **Unchanged.** The caller's own wait still makes the caller busy: a host waiting for a random match cannot
  send an invitation (409 `PK_HOST_BUSY`; the app shows «جارٍ البحث…» with «إيقاف» instead of the list).
- **The app.** The sheet's list reloads every 10 s while it shows (and on pull), so a friend who goes live or
  becomes free appears without reopening it; a failed load is shown with «إعادة المحاولة» (never as «لا يوجد
  أصدقاء») and logged.

### 10.71 «دعوة الأصدقاء»: invite codes and referral rewards in cherries *(v1.74-social, DRAFT — D217)*

Owner (2026-11-01): «زر اربح المال يجب ان يفتح على هذه الصفحة الخاصة بالدعوة» — the Me hub's «اربح المال» opens an
invite page laid out like the owner's reference (a third-party app's «Invite friend»; layout only, Kabso art and
identity). Owner decisions: rewards are **withdrawable cherries** (real money: the cherry ledger and the existing
withdrawal rules); a reward for the friend's sign-up with the code and for the friend's **first** recharge (any
path, a percentage of its coin value); milestone bonuses at 1 / 5 / 15 qualified friends; **strong** fraud
protection; every amount a server setting the panel edits; switched off, «اربح المال» opens the cherry wallet.

- **Code and link.** Every person gets one invite code on the first `getMyReferral`: 8 characters from
  `23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ` (no look-alikes), unique, never changed. The link is `APP_PUBLIC_URL/i/<code>`;
  the website's `/i/<code>` page shows the code and how to get the app (no deep-link package in the app yet, so the
  code is typed or pasted). A typed code ignores spaces and dashes and is read in upper case; a pasted link works.
- **Applying.** At sign-up (`RegisterRequest.referralCode`; only its format is checked by `register`, whose answer
  stays the same 202 — the code is applied by `registerVerify` in its own transaction after the account's, so a
  referral problem never fails a sign-up), or later with `applyReferralCode` — **once** (one inviter per person,
  ever), within `applyWindowDays` (7) of the account's creation. An unknown or own code: 422 at the later entry, no
  referral at sign-up. Switched off: 503 later, no referral at sign-up.
- **Fraud rules (strong).** In order; the first that matches records the referral as **REJECTED** with
  `rejectReason` (no reward; the team may approve it): `SELF_EMAIL` — the same mailbox as the inviter after
  folding aliases (lower case; `+tag` removed at the big providers; Gmail dots removed, `googlemail.com` =
  `gmail.com`); `SELF_DEVICE` — the invitee's install id is one of the inviter's sessions' (or the inviter's own
  referral's); `SELF_IP` — the invitee's IP is an IP of one of the inviter's sessions used within
  `selfIpWindowHours` (24; 0 = off); `DUPLICATE_DEVICE` — the install id was already referred (one reward per
  device); `DUPLICATE_EMAIL` — the mailbox was already referred. The install id is `DeviceInfo.installId`, a random
  id the app keeps per install (until it is uninstalled) sent at sign-in, sign-up and later entry; the server had no
  device id before D217. There is no phone number in Kabso, so no phone rule. The mailbox is kept as the SHA-256
  of its canonical form, the IP until the account is purged (D193).
- **Rewards and the hold.** A referral that passes is PENDING until `holdUntil` = now + `holdHours` (24). Its
  rewards: `SIGNUP_INVITER` (`inviterSignupCherries`) and `SIGNUP_INVITEE` (`inviteeSignupCherries`, 0 = none),
  made PENDING with the same hold. The **daily cap**: an inviter's sign-up rewards in the last 24 hours (not void)
  at most `dailySignupCap` (20; 0 = no cap) — past it the reward is made VOID `DAILY_CAP` (the friend still counts).
  The friend's **first recharge** — a website top-up (`CARD_TOPUP`), an agent's sale (`RECHARGE_PURCHASE`) or a
  recharge order (`RECHARGE_ORDER`) — marks the referral once (in the recharge's transaction) and, when the
  referral is PENDING or QUALIFIED and the programme is on, makes a `FIRST_RECHARGE` reward of floor(coins ×
  CHERRIES_PER_COIN × `firstRechargeBps` / 10 000) cherries (500 = 5 %), held `holdHours`. A friend who recharged
  before entering a code later has no first recharge left. A reward keeps the amount it was made with.
- **The sweeper** (`REFERRAL_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`, 300; `referral-admin sweep`): each due PENDING referral is
  re-checked — the friend and the inviter must be ACTIVE (not banned, not deleted or being deleted) and not locked
  by the team (D208 LOCK): it becomes **QUALIFIED**, else **VOID** (`INVITEE_BANNED|DELETED|FLAGGED`,
  `INVITER_…`) with its pending rewards. Then each due reward: its referral still PENDING → later; VOID / REJECTED →
  VOID `REFERRAL_VOID`; a first-recharge reward whose friend is no longer in good standing → VOID, whose website
  top-up was taken back (refund, fraud warning, dispute: `coinsReversed` > 0) → VOID `RECHARGE_REVERSED`; the
  beneficiary not in good standing → VOID; else **CREDITED**: one cherry ledger row `REFERRAL_REWARD` (reference =
  the reward id, so once). **Milestones**: after a qualification, each `milestones[i]` whose `friends` ≤ the
  inviter's QUALIFIED referrals and not given yet is made and credited at once (their friends already passed the
  hold); a milestone is given once per person (unique). Credited cherries are ordinary cherries: the withdrawal rules
  of §10.46 apply (they are not task cherries, §10.46.1). Every step is audited (`referral.attach`,
  `referral.qualify`, `referral.void`, `referral.reward.create|credit|void`).
- **The page** (`getMyReferral`): the code and link; `rules` and the totals `upTo` (hero «اربح حتى N» = the sign-up
  reward × the last milestone's friends + every milestone; «ادعُ أصدقاء جدداً واربح حتى Z» = the milestones' total);
  `payout` (the cherry wallet's rate, for a money hint); `counts` (invited = every status, qualified, pending);
  `rewards` (pending and credited cherries); `milestones` with `LOCKED` / `UNLOCKED` (reached counting friends in
  their hold) / `CLAIMED`; the newest 20 `invitees` with masked names (first and last grapheme), status and whether
  they recharged; `invitedBy`, `canApply`, `applyUntil`. The app hard-codes no number.
- **The ticker** (`listRecentReferralRewards`, public): at most 20 rewards credited in the last 30 days to ACTIVE
  accounts, masked names, cherries and kind; real data only (empty → the app hides it); empty when switched off.
- **Settings** (`referral_settings`, one row, inserted by the migration): `enabled` (true), `inviterSignupCherries`
  (20 000 ≈ $0.02 at the default payout rate), `inviteeSignupCherries` (0), `firstRechargeBps` (500 = 5 %),
  `milestones` ([1 → 50 000, 5 → 300 000, 15 → 1 000 000] ≈ $0.06 / $0.33 / $1.10), `dailySignupCap` (20),
  `holdHours` (24), `applyWindowDays` (7), `selfIpWindowHours` (24). **Conservative defaults for the owner to
  confirm.** Changed in the panel (`updateAdminReferralSettings`: FINANCE or OWNER, the authenticator code again) or
  `referral-admin settings --set k=v --reason …`; audited `referral.settings.update` with before / after.
- **The panel «الدعوات»** (capabilities, added to §10.60.1): `referrals.view` (OWNER, SUPPORT, FINANCE) — the table
  (status filter, CSV), a referral with its rewards and signals (audited `referral.view`), the settings;
  `referrals.decide` (OWNER, FINANCE; the code again) — **approve** (a PENDING one skips its hold; a REJECTED or
  VOID one is overruled: QUALIFIED, its pending / void rewards and the missing sign-up rewards credited now, a
  REVERSED reward made again as a new reward and credited, then the milestones) and **void** (below);
  `referrals.settings` (OWNER, FINANCE; the code again). Every decision carries a reason and is
  audited `via: panel` (`via: cli` from `referral-admin`).
- **Void and claw-back** (owner 2026-11-01: «استرجاع تلقائي»). Voiding a referral (panel or `referral-admin void`)
  voids its PENDING rewards and **takes back at once** every reward it already CREDITED — to the inviter, and to the
  friend when `inviteeSignupCherries` > 0 — plus, for a QUALIFIED referral, each CREDITED milestone bonus whose
  `friends` is above the inviter's qualified friends without this one. Each such reward becomes **REVERSED**
  (`reversedAt`) with one cherry ledger row `REFERRAL_REVERSAL` (−cherries, reference = the reward, so never twice;
  a second void changes nothing). The whole amount is debited: a balance that does not cover it **goes below 0**, as
  a gift reversal's does (§10.46) — no separate block is needed: a withdrawal or a cherry sale (`holdCherriesIn`)
  needs the balance to cover it, so it answers `INSUFFICIENT_CHERRIES` until new cherries settle the debt.
  `reversalShortfall` on the reward (and `shortfall` in the answer and the audit) is the part the balance did not
  cover. Each person who lost cherries gets `REFERRAL_REWARD_REVERSED` (system, no target; the app opens the cherry
  wallet, whose history names the row). `AdminReferral.voidClawback` gives the amounts (per person: the cherries,
  the balance now, the shortfall) so the dialog shows them before the team confirms. Audited `referral.void` (with
  `reversedCherries`, `shortfall`) and `referral.reward.reverse` per reward. A REVERSED row frees its kind (and a
  milestone its threshold) for a new reward: a later approval makes and credits a new one, and a later
  qualification can earn the milestone again. The sweeper's own voids (a PENDING referral that fails its re-check)
  never have credited rewards, so they take nothing back.

### 10.72 The media storage from the admin panel «التخزين (R2 / S3)» *(v1.75-social, DRAFT — D222)*

Owner decision 2026-11-01: «Storage = Cloudflare R2» and «اجعل تفعيل من لوحة الادمن» — the OWNER enters and turns on
the object storage in the panel, not in server env files. It follows D196 (§10.53.1) and reuses its code: the same
`AdminSecretBox` with its own HKDF info, the same `Secret` wrapper, the same «panel over env, env as the fallback».

- **Who.** Capability `storage.settings`, OWNER only (§10.54.1). Operations `getAdminStorageSettings`,
  `updateAdminStorageSettings`, `testAdminStorageSettings`, `clearAdminStorageSettings` under the panel's cookie session
  + CSRF; every response `Cache-Control: no-store`. Without `ADMIN_TOTP_KEY` the section is 503
  `ADMIN_PANEL_UNAVAILABLE` (like the rest of the panel).
- **Fields.** `provider` `R2` (default) or `S3`. R2: `accountId` (32 hex) → the endpoint
  `https://<accountId>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`, region `auto`. S3: `endpoint` (empty = AWS), `region`,
  `forcePathStyle` (MinIO). `accessKeyId`, `secretAccessKey` (**write-only**); `publicBucket` with `publicBaseUrl`
  (the R2 public development URL or a custom domain such as `https://media.kabsolive.com`; every media URL is
  `<publicBaseUrl>/media/…`); `privateBucket` (must differ). There is no upload-size setting: the limits stay the
  §11.1 / §11.14 constants.
- **Two buckets.** With the panel's storage on, keys are routed by prefix: `media/` (processed images, videos, posters,
  voice clips, gift art, banners) → the public bucket; everything else — `uploads/` (raw client uploads, presigned PUT)
  and `private/` (ID photos and selfies D185 / D206 / D209, recharge-order pictures D204, data exports D198) → the
  private bucket, served only through the API's existing authorised / proxied reads, never a URL. The env layout
  (`S3_BUCKET`) stays one bucket with the prefix rules of §11.1 / DEPLOYMENT §5.3. A video's `uploads/` → `media/` copy
  is a server-side copy between the two buckets of the same account.
- **Secrets.** The two keys are sealed AES-256-GCM (`v1.<iv>.<tag>.<ct>`) with a key derived from `ADMIN_TOTP_KEY`
  (HKDF-SHA-256, info `storage-settings/v1`; a value bound to its column by AAD); only their last 4 characters are kept
  in clear. Responses (`StorageKeyInfo`: last 4, who, when) and audit rows (`…AbCd`) never carry more; logs redact
  `accessKeyId` / `secretAccessKey` fields. Keys sealed under another `ADMIN_TOTP_KEY` are ignored (`panelIgnored:
  unreadable`, the env applies) until entered again.
- **Every change** (`updateAdminStorageSettings`, `clearAdminStorageSettings`) needs `totpCode` again (403
  `ADMIN_TOTP_INVALID`, counted towards the lockout) and a `reason`; audited `storage.settings.update` (before / after
  without keys, `changed`, `connectionTest` `ok|skipped`, `reason`, `via: panel`) / `storage.settings.clear`
  (`fallback` `env|none`). Refusals are 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` with `details[0].issue`: `same_bucket`,
  `storage_incomplete` (one detail per missing field), `storage_test_failed`, `storage_test_required` (skip asked in
  production), `https_required` (production: both URLs https on a domain name, no IP literal or localhost),
  `storage_nothing_to_clear`.
- **«اختبار الاتصال»** (`testAdminStorageSettings`, no code: nothing but the result is saved; audited
  `storage.settings.test` with the target, `…last4` and the outcome). The values typed, the rest and the keys from what
  is saved; for each bucket under `_healthcheck/`: `put` a tiny text object, `head` it, `get` it back with the key; the
  public bucket: `public_read` it from `<publicBaseUrl>/_healthcheck/…` without a key (same bytes); the private bucket:
  `not_public` — neither the public base URL nor an anonymous GET to the S3 endpoint reads it; `delete` it (and check it
  is gone). Each step at most 10 s, one attempt. The report (`StorageTestReport`: per step `ok`, `ms`, `issue`
  `bad_credentials|access_denied|no_such_bucket|unreachable|mismatch|not_public|publicly_readable|http_status|error`,
  a short `detail`) is kept as the section's last test (who, when) and shown in Arabic.
- **«تفعيل».** `enabled: true` needs every required field (`accountId` for R2, both keys, both buckets, the public base
  URL) and runs the round trip first with the merged values (also whenever a connection field changes while on); a
  failed step saves nothing (409 `storage_test_failed`, the failed report becomes the last test).
  `skipConnectionTest` only when NODE_ENV is not production. Off → the server's env storage, or 503
  `MEDIA_UPLOADS_UNAVAILABLE` «التخزين غير مفعّل» as before.
- **Precedence, no restart.** `StorageSettingsStore` (global) resolves the panel's row (switch on, keys readable,
  complete) over `S3_*` / `MEDIA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` / `MEDIA_UPLOADS_ENABLED`; it is read at start, cached 5 s, re-read
  at once on this instance after a change (another instance within 5 s). One S3 client per settings: the production
  `OBJECT_STORAGE` (`ActiveObjectStorage`) takes the current one per call, so a call already running finishes on the
  client it started with (the old client is dropped, never destroyed mid-request). The upload switch
  (`MediaService.assertEnabled`) and every public media URL (posts, reels, stories, avatars, gifts, banners, DM / report
  snapshots, the panel's previews, the data export) read it. Changing the buckets does not move objects already stored
  (KNOWN_LIMITATIONS).
- **Status** (`AdminStorageSettings.status`): `active` (the panel's storage), `env` (the server's `S3_*` with uploads
  on), `off` (panel settings saved, switch off, no env storage), `not_configured`.
- **CORS.** Not needed: the mobile app uploads to the presigned URL directly (not a browser), and the admin panel's
  uploads (D207) go through the API. A future browser client uploading with a presigned PUT needs an R2 CORS rule
  allowing `PUT` from its origin with the `Content-Type` header (DEPLOYMENT §5.40).

### 10.73 The social redesign: the home feed, the profile cover and the profile's facts *(v1.76-social, DRAFT — D218)*

Owner, 2026-11-01, with a third-party marketing composite of three phones (kept out of git, D40): «بهذا التصميم حرفياً
مع اضافة ميزاتنا وجعلها مناسبة لنا». The app's posts page, story viewer and public profile take the reference's
layout; the server gives them what the layout needs. Nothing is copied from the reference but layout.

#### 10.73.1 The home feed `GET /feed/posts?tab=mixed`

- **The rule.** One entry from Following (§11.3: posts of followed accounts and posts they reposted, newest entry
  first, a reposted post with `repostedBy`), then two from Trending (§11.3: the global score over visible public
  posts of the last 7 days, authors spread), then one from Following, two from Trending, and so on (1 : 2).
- **Exhaustion.** When one source has nothing left its turns go to the other, so the feed ends only when both
  are empty. Following contributes its newest 500 entries; Trending its 500-entry snapshot.
- **Each post once.** A post that is in both lists is listed at its Following place only (with its reposter); the
  Trending copy is skipped and Trending's own order is kept.
- **Left out.** The caller's own posts (also when a followed account reposted them), muted authors and reposters,
  hidden posts, and authors who blocked the caller or whom the caller blocked (both sources already apply
  §11.2 / §11.7; every page re-checks visibility, so a post that stopped being visible since leaves the page).
- **Pagination.** The first page merges both sources into one frozen list (Redis, 10 minutes, per caller — the
  Trending snapshot of §11.3 with entries `[postId, reposterId]`); later pages read it by offset, so they never
  repeat or skip and new posts do not shift them. An expired, foreign or other-tab cursor → 400 `cursor` /
  `invalid_value`; the app reloads the first page once.
- **Why the server.** Doing it in the app would page two feeds in lock step and could repeat posts across pages;
  the server owns ranking (§11.3) and reuses it unchanged. The `following` and `trending` tabs stay as they were.

#### 10.73.2 `Post.viewerFollowsAuthor`

The caller follows the post's author (false on the caller's own post). The feed card shows «متابعة» only when it is
false (and the post is not the caller's), and «مقترح لك» under the name for such a post. One extra indexed read of
`follows` per page.

#### 10.73.3 The profile cover «صورة الغلاف»

- **Upload.** Media kind `PROFILE_COVER` (§11.1 pipeline; processed like a post image: the long side at most
  1 080 px, never cropped — the app covers the banner area with the picture). Set with `PUT /me/cover`
  (`{mediaId}`: a READY, unattached `PROFILE_COVER` asset of the caller from the last 24 hours, else 400 `mediaId`
  / `invalid_value`; uploads off → 503 `MEDIA_UPLOADS_UNAVAILABLE`), removed with `DELETE /me/cover` (idempotent;
  works while uploads are off). The replaced or removed asset is deleted in the same transaction, its objects
  after commit. Audited `user.cover.update` (`set` / `removed`, never the URL). Rate limit: §7.
- **Who sees it.** `Me.coverUrl` and `PublicProfile.coverUrl` — public like the photo (also on a private
  account's profile). Null: the app draws a Kabso brand gradient (never a stock photo).
- **Moderation.** The panel's «إزالة الغلاف» (`removeAdminUserCover`, capability `users.avatar`, reason required)
  and `profile-admin remove-cover <username> --reason <text>`: the cover goes, the user gets `COVER_REMOVED`
  (system), `admin.cover.remove` is audited with the reason, the files are deleted after commit. No cover → the
  panel answers 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`, the CLI changes nothing.
- **Account deletion** clears the cover with the photo (§10.56).

#### 10.73.4 The profile's facts row

`PublicProfile.country` — the country the user chose (D133 `Me.country`, never inferred), or null — and
`PublicProfile.joinedMonth` — the month the account was created, `YYYY-MM` in UTC, never the exact time. The app
shows «🌍 <country> · 📅 انضم في <شهر سنة>» under the bio. (Before v1.76-social the profile carried neither.)
`PublicProfile.blockedByMe` — the caller blocked this user (false on the own profile; the blocked user is never
told): the profile's main button is then «إلغاء الحظر» (`DELETE /users/{username}/block`) and no posts are shown.

#### 10.73.5 What the app does with them (no further API)

- **Posts page.** Its top bar is the person's avatar, name and handle (to Me), then Search, the notifications bell
  (with the unread count) and «ريلز» (the reels page). It lists `tab=mixed` only (the Trending / Following tabs
  are gone from posts; the reels page keeps its own). No messages icon: messages stay in the bottom bar.
- **Stories tray.** «قصتك» first (with «+»), then followed accounts that are **live now** (`GET /live/rooms?tab=
  following`; a red «LIVE» pill, a tap opens the room), then followed accounts with stories (a ring while unseen,
  grey once seen). It is drawn above every posts state (also when the feed is empty or failed) and hidden only
  when it holds nobody but an empty «قصتك» (no story of the caller's, no followed story, nobody live) or when the
  stories API fails.
- **Story viewer.** A reply «اكتب رسالة…» and the heart («❤️») go to the author as direct messages (§11.13,
  `POST /dm/messages`); the DM carries no reference to the story (a later contract can add one).

#### 10.73.6 The profile pages' centred layout *(D316, app only — no wire change; **superseded by §10.73.7, D335**, except where §10.73.7 keeps it)*

Owner (2026-11-08), from a third-party reference (a Dribbble composite; the middle phone only — its layout, never its
photos, names, icons or brand; the image stays out of git, D40): «التصميم الذي في المنتصف … لصفحات المستخدمين، نطبقه
100٪». Owner decisions: **1a** no cover on these pages *(first 1b, a faint dimmed cover; then, on the captures: «بدون
غلاف، واليوزر الذي أسفل الاسم أزله لأنه موجود بالأعلى»)*; **2a** the
page follows the device's light / dark theme (dark is the reference's; light is its adaptation); **3a** the reference's
icon row under the bio is the person's worn medals. Applies to every profile — the own «أنا» profile view, other people's
and staff accounts' — except the founder's page (D301 / D307 unchanged, §10.112).

- **Top bar** *(owner, on the captures: «اليوزر بجانب السهم، وأزل الثلاث نقاط من الأعلى لأنها موجودة بجانب مراسلة»)*:
  back at the reading start and the @username — or the premium special-ID plate (D146), or the staff ID (D283c) — right

- **Order, all centred:** the photo (88 dp with a
  2 dp ring in the secondary text colour and a 2 dp page-coloured gap; a worn frame, the live ring, a team frame keep

- **Buttons (36 dp, fully round):** another person's profile — «متابعة» (Kabso red; «تتابعه» / «تم الطلب» in the chip

- **Measured from the reference:** it is ≈ 207 px wide for a 393 dp phone (0.527 px/dp), so every size above is an

#### 10.73.7 The profile pages' cover layout *(D335, app only — no wire change; supersedes most of §10.73.6)*
