### 10.74 The person card's lifetime totals and their privacy switches *(v1.77-social, DRAFT — D220)*

Owner, 2026-11-01: the in-live person card «بطاقة التعريف» shows four numbers in one row — «المتابِعون | المتابَعون |
الكرز المستلم | الكوينز المرسلة» — and «يمكن له اخفائها هي والكوينزات التي ارسلها من الاعدادات فيصبح هناك ٣ ارقام».
(v1.74–v1.76-social are D217, D222 and D218 on their own branches.)

- **The totals.** `PublicProfile.cherriesReceived`: Σ of the user's cherry-ledger rows `GIFT_RECEIVED` and
  `GIFT_REVERSAL` (the cherries their received gifts credited, minus reversed gifts; never below 0). Agency and parent
  commissions, task rewards, sales to agents, withdrawals and team adjustments are not gifts and are not counted.
  `PublicProfile.coinsSent`: Σ `live_gifts.coins_charged` of the gifts the user sent (lives and direct messages,
  lucky gifts included; a gift sent from the bag charged nothing and adds nothing). Lifetime, aggregated only: no
  gift, counterpart or date is exposed. Read per profile request through existing indexes
  (`cherry_ledger_user_reason_idx`, `live_gifts_sender_room_idx`); no counter column, so they cannot drift.
- **Privacy, enforced by the server.** `PrivacySettings.hideCherriesReceived` and `hideCoinsSent` (default false =
  shown; `PATCH /me/privacy`). When a switch is on and the caller is not the user, `getPublicProfile` leaves the
  field out (it is not even computed); the app then shows the remaining numbers spread evenly (4 → 3 → 2). The
  user always gets both on their own profile. The admin panel's `AdminUserDetail.balances` carries both whatever
  the switches say (capability `users.balances`). The data export lists the two switches.
- **Who else.** The totals follow the profile's own rules: a private account's counts stay public (§10.47), and
  the profile answers callers the user blocked as before; nothing about a block is added here.
- **Not a change.** The follower counts, the rate limit (`users:profile`) and every other profile field are as
  before. The switches are not audited (like the other privacy choices except `isPrivate`).

### 10.75 At most 2 accounts created per device; signing in is not limited *(v1.78-social, DRAFT — D223)*

Owner (2026-11-01): «ملاحظة الجهاز الواحد لا يمكنه عمل غير حسابين لكنه يمكن فتح حسابات مختلفة» — one phone may
**create** at most two accounts, and may **sign in** to any number of existing accounts. Built on D217's device
fields (§10.71); the install id alone resets on reinstall or «clear data», so this rule has its own stable id.

- **The device key** (`DeviceInfo.deviceKey`, 64 lower-case hex). The app reads the platform's stable id over the
  `com.kabso/device_id` channel — **Android** `Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID` (per app-signing key, user and device on
  Android 8+; it survives a reinstall and «clear data», not a factory reset); **iOS** a UUID the app keeps in the
  Keychain (`kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly`; seeded from `identifierForVendor`, which alone
  changes when the last app of the vendor is removed; the Keychain item survives a reinstall, not erasing the
  phone) — and sends SHA-256(`kabso-live/device-key/v1|<platform>|<id>`). The raw id never leaves the phone. It is
  sent with `register` and `registerVerify` only (never at sign-in). No new package: a platform channel in
  `MainActivity.kt` / `AppDelegate.swift` (`device_info_plus` is not a dependency). The emulators' shared
  `9774d56d682e549c` and an empty id count as no id.
- **What the server keeps.** HMAC-SHA-256(key, deviceKey) — the key from HKDF(`SIGNUP_DEVICE_KEY` when set, else
  `RATE_LIMIT_KEY_SECRET`; info `signup-device/v1`) — on the pending registration (`device_hash`) and, once the
  account exists, in `device_signups` (one row per account: the hash, the platform, the time). Changing the key
  source makes every device start from 0. The panel never shows the hash.
- **The rule.** `register` counts the `device_signups` rows of the device — **every account status: ACTIVE,
  SUSPENDED, PENDING_DELETION and DELETED** (a purged account keeps its tombstone row, and its device row with it),
  so delete-and-recreate does not free a place; nothing else is excluded. When the count is at the limit
  (`SIGNUP_MAX_ACCOUNTS_PER_DEVICE`, default **2**, 1–100; or the device's exception) the answer is **409
  `DEVICE_ACCOUNT_LIMIT`**, `details[0] = {field: device, issue: '<the limit>'}`, before the username, the password
  hash and the email are looked at — the answer depends on the device only, so it reveals nothing about an address —
  and no code is mailed. `registerVerify` checks again inside the account's transaction, holding a per-device advisory
  lock, with the device key it is sent (else the one `register` stored): two pending sign-ups racing for the last place
  give one account and one 409; the refused pending registration is deleted (its username is free again). Audited
  `auth.registration.device_limit` `{stage: register|verify, count, max}` (no email, no hash).
- **No device key** (the website, an app older than D223, a platform without an id): the sign-up is allowed and not
  counted (documented gap: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS).
- **Signing in** is never limited: `login` accepts `device.deviceKey` (the shared `DeviceInfo`) and ignores it; only a
  sign-up writes `device_signups`.
- **The app.** On the sign-up screen (and on the code screen, when the limit was reached meanwhile) the 409 shows
  «لا يمكن إنشاء أكثر من حسابين من نفس الجهاز. يمكنك تسجيل الدخول إلى حساباتك الحالية.» / «You cannot create more
  than 2 accounts on the same device. You can log in to your existing accounts.» with a «تسجيل الدخول» / «Log in»
  button that opens Log in (from the code screen with the email filled in). With another limit in the detail (an
  exception) the number follows it (ICU plurals: «حساب واحد», «حسابين», «3 حسابات», «11 حسابًا»).
- **The panel** (user page, tab «الجهاز»): `getAdminDeviceSignups` (`users.device_view`: OWNER, SUPPORT; audited
  `admin.device_signups.view`) — whether the account has a device (`known`), the platform, the count, the limit, the
  exception and the accounts made on it (oldest first, at most 50; deleted ones shown as such). An **OWNER** may give
  that device a different limit — `grantAdminDeviceException` `{maxAccounts 1–100, reason, totpCode}` — or end the
  exception — `removeAdminDeviceException` `{reason, totpCode}` (`users.device_exception`; the authenticator code
  again; audited `admin.device_exception.grant` `{maxAccounts, before, defaultMax, reason, via}` /
  `admin.device_exception.remove` `{before, reason, via}`). Accounts already made stay. 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`
  when the account has no device or there is no exception to remove.
- **Privacy and retention.** The privacy policy names the device id (the hashed id, why, how long). The data export's
  `devices.json` says whether a device id was recorded for the account (`signupDevice: {deviceIdRecorded, platform,
  recordedAt}`), without the value (an internal anti-abuse signal, as the referral checks' are). Retention follows the
  install id's (§10.71): the referral keeps its install id after a purge, and `device_signups` keeps the hash with the
  account's tombstone (a sign-up without it would let a deleted account free its place).
- **Limits** (KNOWN_LIMITATIONS): a factory reset, erasing an iPhone, a rooted / jailbroken phone or an emulator can
  change or fake the id; a sign-up without a device key (an older app, the website, a modified client) is not
  counted. The rule raises the cost of mass sign-ups; it does not make them impossible.

### 10.76 «تسجيل الخروج من كل الأجهزة الأخرى»: sign out of all other devices *(v1.79-social, DRAFT — D226)*

Owner (2026-11-01, approved with the Settings cleanup): the full list of active sessions gets one action that ends
every other session at once. PHASE1_SCREENS §9.3 had left it out («No revoke all in Phase 1 — no endpoint»).

- **Operation.** `revokeOtherSessions` — `POST /api/v1/auth/sessions/revoke-others`, body
  `{password}` (the account's current password, NFC-normalised like `login`, at most 128 characters). Answer 200
  `{revoked: <int ≥ 0>}`.
- **Re-authentication.** Same pattern as `requestAccountDeletion` (§10.56) and `requestDataExport` (§10.61.1): a
  wrong password → 403 `REAUTH_FAILED`, audited `auth.sessions.revoke_others.reauth_failed`, nothing changes.
  Order after auth and the rate limit: 400 body → 403 → 200.
- **Effect** (one transaction). Every session of the caller with `revoked_at` null, except the calling session,
  gets `revoked_at = now`, `revoked_reason = USER_REVOKED`; their device push tokens are deleted (§11.12). The
  access tokens of those sessions fail on the next request (the guard checks the session) and their refresh
  tokens answer 401 `AUTH_REFRESH_INVALID`. The calling session keeps working. With no other session the answer is
  `{revoked: 0}`.
- **Audit.** `auth.sessions.revoke_others` (actor the caller, target the calling session, `metadata.count`), also
  for 0.
- **Rate limit.** 5 / 15 minutes per user, its own bucket `sessions_revoke_others:user` with the existing rule
  `RATE_LIMIT_ACCOUNT_DELETION_USER`, replacing the per-user default; failed passwords count.
- **Consent.** Allowed while consent is required (428 gate, §10.61), like the other session operations.
- **The app.** The full sessions list and the Settings preview show a red «تسجيل الخروج من كل الأجهزة الأخرى» /
  "Log out of all other devices" while another session exists; it asks for the password in a confirm dialog,
  then refreshes the list and says how many devices were signed out.

### 10.77 «تأكيد الهوية»: identity verification with Didit *(v1.80-kyc, DRAFT — D227)*

Owner (2026-11-01): the applicants «كن مضيفاً مع الإدارة» (§10.68), «افتح وكالة» (§10.65) and recharge agents (§10.48)
verify their identity with **Didit** (didit.me: the ID document, passive liveness and the 1:1 face match; 500 free
checks a month, then about $0.33 a check). Hosts who join an agency are NOT checked by this feature. The OWNER enters
the keys in the admin panel; never in env files, never in chat.

- **Didit's API** (docs.didit.me, read 2026-11-01; recorded in KNOWN_LIMITATIONS where the docs leave a doubt).
  Base `https://verification.didit.me`, header `x-api-key`. `POST /v3/session/` with `workflow_id`, `vendor_data`
  (we send the person's user id: Didit's «User», its duplicate checks and the reuse of an unfinished session),
  `callback` (`kabsolive://kyc/done`), `metadata` (`{purpose}`) and `language` (`ar` / `en`) → 201 `session_id`,
  `session_number`, `session_token`, `url` (the hosted flow), `status`. Didit returns the existing session instead of
  a new one while one of the same `vendor_data` is unfinished on the workflow's latest version. `GET
  /v3/session/{id}/decision/` → the decision (plural arrays `id_verifications[]`, `liveness_checks[]`,
  `face_matches[]` …; the media are presigned, short-lived URLs). `GET /v3/workflows/` → the application's workflows
  (`«اختبار الاتصال»`). A bad key → 401/403. The Didit client is one port (`DIDIT_API_FACTORY`); tests replace it.
- **Purposes.** `HOST_APPLICATION`, `AGENCY_OPEN`, `RECHARGE_AGENT`. Each runs on its own workflow when the OWNER
  sets one (`workflowIdHost` / `workflowIdAgency` / `workflowIdRecharge`), else on the default `workflowId`. An
  APPROVED check **counts** for a purpose when it was made for it, or ran on the workflow the purpose runs on now —
  with one workflow for all (the default), one approval serves the three applications.
- **Statuses.** Didit → ours: `Not Started` → NOT_STARTED; `In Progress`, `Awaiting User`, `Resubmitted` →
  IN_PROGRESS; `In Review` → IN_REVIEW; `Approved` → APPROVED; `Declined` → DECLINED; `Expired`, `Kyc Expired` →
  EXPIRED; `Abandoned` → ABANDONED; an unknown value changes nothing but `providerStatus`. **18+:** an Approved session
  whose document date of birth is under 18 is stored DECLINED with the reason `UNDER_MIN_AGE`; without a date of birth
  DECLINED `DATE_OF_BIRTH_MISSING`. `decided_at` is set for APPROVED / DECLINED / IN_REVIEW.
- **Person — `getMyKyc`, `startKycSession`, `syncKycCheck`.** A new session is refused (409 `KYC_NOT_ALLOWED`,
  `details[0].issue`) in this order: `ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE`, `ALREADY_APPROVED`, `IN_REVIEW` (the purpose's newest
  check is under review), `DAILY_LIMIT` (new sessions of the person in the last 24 h ≥ the OWNER's
  `maxSessionsPerDay`, 1–10, default 3). An unfinished session (NOT_STARTED / IN_PROGRESS) is opened again (Didit
  answers the same session: 200, the same check, not counted). A DECLINED / EXPIRED / ABANDONED check may be retried
  within the limit. Didit off → 503 `KYC_UNAVAILABLE`; Didit unreachable or refusing → 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`
  (nothing kept). `syncKycCheck` reads the decision now (after the hosted flow, for a late webhook) and applies it as
  the webhook does. The person never sees a personal field back; `reasons` only for DECLINED / IN_REVIEW.
- **Webhook — `receiveDiditWebhook`** (`POST /api/v1/kyc/didit/webhook`, public, raw body). The OWNER sets
  `https://api.kabsolive.com/api/v1/kyc/didit/webhook` in Didit (Settings › API & Webhooks). Verified with the panel's
  webhook secret: `X-Timestamp` (Unix seconds) within **300 s** of now (the replay window), then `X-Signature-V2` =
  hex HMAC-SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted recursively, compact separators, Unicode not escaped) or
  `X-Signature` = hex HMAC-SHA-256 of the raw bytes, constant-time; `X-Signature-Simple` (deprecated, envelope only) is
  NOT accepted. Failure → 401 `AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED` (`missing_timestamp` / `stale_timestamp` / `missing_signature` /
  `invalid_signature`), nothing changes. **Idempotent:** each `event_id` (Didit reuses it on retries) is applied once
  (`kyc_webhook_events`, kept 30 days); an event older (`created_at`) than the last one applied to the check is
  ignored; `status.updated` / `data.updated` are applied, other types acknowledged; an unknown session acknowledged and
  dropped. No secret saved → 503 (Didit retries twice).
- **Stored — the minimum.** `kyc_checks`: Didit's session id and number, the workflow, `providerStatus`, our status,
  `reasons` (the warnings' `risk` codes of a declined / reviewed session, ≤ 20, plus ours), the dates; from the first
  ID document only the full name, the date of birth, the issuing state (ISO alpha-3) and the document number as an
  **HMAC-SHA-256** under a key derived from `ADMIN_TOTP_KEY` (HKDF `kyc-document/v1`) over `<country>:<number>`
  (upper-case, letters and digits only) — never the number, an address, an image or an image link.
- **Duplicate documents.** A check whose document hash is on another account's check is flagged
  (`duplicateDocument`, both checks) and audited `kyc.check.duplicate_document`; the team sees the other accounts.
  Never an automatic decline.
- **The gates** (`kyc-core.ts`, shared by the API and the CLIs). While Didit is **ON**:
  - «كن مضيفاً مع الإدارة»: the application is sent without ID pictures; **approving** it (panel or `host-admin
    approve`) needs an approved check that counts for `HOST_APPLICATION` → else 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`
    `details[0] = {field: kyc, issue: kyc_required}`.
  - «افتح وكالة»: it opens at once (no approval), so the **opening** needs the approved check → else 409
    `AGENCY_OPEN_NOT_ALLOWED` `KYC_REQUIRED` (after the other refusals).
  - Recharge agents: the application is sent without ID pictures; the team may approve it; the **first top-up**,
    which activates the agent (§10.48), needs the approved check → else 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` `kyc_required`
    (nothing credited). Agents already ACTIVE are not affected. Chosen over «before the stock is credited» because
    the first top-up IS both the activation and the first credit; later top-ups of an active agent stay unchanged.
  While Didit is **OFF** the manual ID card + selfie (the D185 uploads) stay required (400 `required`) and are the
  check (the fallback); an approved check made earlier also counts. With Didit ON the two upload ids are ignored when
  sent (never consumed).
- **Notifications.** The person gets `KYC_APPROVED`, `KYC_DECLINED` or `KYC_IN_REVIEW` (system, pushed; the push
  never carries a reason) when the check's status becomes that value — once per change.
- **The OWNER's settings «التحقق من الهوية (Didit)»** (capability `kyc.settings`, OWNER only; D196 / D222's pattern):
  the API key and the webhook secret are **write-only**, sealed AES-256-GCM with a key derived from `ADMIN_TOTP_KEY`
  (HKDF `kyc-settings/v1`, AAD per column); only their last 4, who and when are shown. Workflows, the daily limit,
  the «تفعيل» switch, the webhook address (`API_PUBLIC_URL`, default `https://api.kabsolive.com`) and the callback.
  Every change: the authenticator code again + a reason (403 `ADMIN_TOTP_INVALID`), audited `kyc.settings.update`
  with the last 4 only. Turning on needs the key, the secret and the default workflow (409 `kyc_incomplete`) and a
  passing «اختبار الاتصال» (`GET /v3/workflows/`: the key works, each workflow exists, is published, not archived; 409
  `kyc_test_failed`; skippable only outside production). Read within 5 s on every instance (no restart). Clearing
  turns Didit off; the checks already made stay.
- **The team's view** (capability `kyc.view`: OWNER + SUPPORT). The three application pages show `kyc`
  (`AdminKycSummary`: required, satisfied, the approved and the newest check; without `kyc.view` — e.g. MODERATION on
  «طلبات المضيفين» — the state only, personal fields null). `getAdminKycCheck` (audited `kyc.check.view`): name, birth
  date, age, document country, reasons, Didit's session number, the duplicate accounts. The images: Didit's console
  (`https://business.didit.me`, search the session number) or `getAdminKycCheckMedia` — a fetch of Didit's decision
  now that answers only its presigned links (they expire within minutes), audited `kyc.check.media.view` per fetch,
  never stored.
- **Privacy.** Didit is a processor (privacy policy text in Arabic and English; the policy version is NOT bumped:
  the OWNER publishes it). The data export gains `kyc_checks` (status, decision, reasons, name, birth date, country;
  never the hash). The account purge deletes the person's checks and their webhook rows. Didit's own copy follows the
  retention the OWNER sets in Didit's console (DEPLOYMENT §5.44).
- **The app.** In the host-apply, agency-open and recharge-apply forms, while Didit is on, the ID step becomes
  «تأكيد الهوية»: the state (not started, in progress, approved, declined with the reasons and «إعادة المحاولة»,
  under review) and a button that opens Didit's hosted flow in an in-app WebView (camera granted to the page); the
  WebView closes when it reaches `kabsolive://kyc/done`, then the app calls `syncKycCheck`. Didit's Flutter SDK
  (`didit_sdk`, MIT) is not used: it wraps Didit's native iOS / Android SDKs (heavy, needs the owner's go-ahead), while
  the WebView is Didit's documented alternative and `webview_flutter` is already a dependency.

### 10.79 The app's camera effects engine: DeepAR or the free on-device engine *(v1.49-live, DRAFT — D228)*

The owner compares two engines for Magic's effects on Android (2026-11-01: «لا تستبدل لكن ضعهم لارى وان لم يعجبني
نقوم بازالتهم»): DeepAR (D144) and a free one (Google ML Kit selfie segmentation + MediaPipe Face Landmarker, GLSL on
the GPU, everything on the device). One server switch picks it for every host:

- `LiveConfig.cameraFxEngine` (`getLiveConfig`, required in answers): `DEEPAR` (default; no row) or `FREE`. A client
  reads any other value as `DEEPAR`; an older server sends nothing and the app keeps DeepAR.
- Stored as one `site_settings` row, key `cameraFxEngine` (migration `20270215090000_camera_fx_engine` adds the key to
  the table's CHECK); only the exact string `FREE` selects the free engine; a failed read serves `DEEPAR`.
- `getAdminCameraFx` / `updateAdminCameraFx` (`GET|PUT /admin/camera-fx`, panel session + CSRF, capability
  `site.settings`: OWNER only), body `{cameraFxEngine, reason?}`; audited `site.settings.update` (`metadata.key`
  `cameraFxEngine`, `before`, `after`, `reason`, `via: panel`). The public `getSiteSettings` does not carry it.
- Debug/profile builds of the app may override it on the phone (never a release build).
- What the free engine does and what is unverified: docs/AI_WORKFORCE_BOARD.md D228; how to remove it:
  docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md (D228).


### 10.80 «PK أحكام» — the loser of a PK does a dare *(v1.50-live, DRAFT — D229)*

Owner (2026-11-01): «ان يكون هناك في pk تصنيف بيكيه احكام بحيث الذي يخسر ينفذ احد ٣ احكام يقترحها تطبيق للخاسر ويراها
الفائز ايضاً… اكثر من ٢٠ الف حكم», with the owner's decisions of the same day (the first brief, then two changes: three
levels and a server draw; then the final flow: the loser accepts or refuses, the winner judges). Extends §10.58 and
§10.62; nothing there changes unless said here.

- **The type.** `PkType`: `NORMAL` («PK عادي», as before) or `DARES` («PK أحكام»). Video PK only: the SOLO video lives
  of §10.58 (never audio rooms, podcasts or multi-guest rooms). `inviteLivePk` takes `type` (default NORMAL); the
  invitation carries it (`PkInvite.type`, also in the `pk-invite` message) and the match keeps it (`PkMatch.type`).
  `joinLivePkRandom` takes an optional body `{type}`: a host waiting for DARES is paired only with another DARES
  waiter, a NORMAL waiter only with NORMAL; calling with the other type replaces the wait. Auto Match (§10.62)
  always waits for NORMAL. Best of three, round time and auto-start (§10.62) apply as usual; the dare follows the
  match's **final** result. `PK_DARES_ENABLED=false` refuses new DARES invitations and waits (409
  `PK_UNAVAILABLE`); running dares finish. The host never chooses a category or a level.
- **Lucky gifts give no PK points in DARES** (owner decision 8). In a DARES battle a lucky gift (`category` LUCKY:
  its coin value, its wins and their multipliers) adds 0 PK points and no supporter points; it is still a gift for
  money, the host's cherries, levels, charm, boards and tasks (all written with its real value in the send's
  transaction, as in §10.58). Normal PK is unchanged. Booster gifts are never lucky.
- **The draw.** When a DARES battle ends **with a winner** (TIME with a higher score, FORFEIT, DISCONNECT, AWAY — any
  reason but a draw, ADMIN or CANCELLED; the «effective PK» threshold of §10.62 is not required), the server, in the
  battle's end transaction, picks three active dares from the library — **one EASY, one MEDIUM, one HARD** — and
  draws one of the three (crypto random, uniform; logged in `live.pk.dare.draw` with the three ids and the drawn
  one). A draw (equal scores, both hosts absent) gives **no dare**. `PkMatch.dare` carries the three cards in that
  order, `drawn` (0–2) and `revealAt` (now + `PK_DARE_DRAW_SECONDS`, 4): both rooms animate the same shuffle and land on
  `drawn` at `revealAt` (status `DRAWING`; the animation only reveals the server's result). Every change is a
  `pk-match` message with event `dare` to both rooms.
- **No repeats per host.** `pk_dare_seen` keeps one bit per dare (`pk_dares.seq_no`; 2.5 KB for 20 000) for each host.
  Each card is one neither host has been shown yet; when none is left for the loser at a level, one the winner saw
  is allowed; when the loser has seen every active dare of a level, the loser's bits start again (`cycles` + 1). The
  three are then marked seen for both hosts (the winner and the viewers see them too).
- **The loser decides** (status `DECIDING`, owner's final flow). From `revealAt` until `decideBy` (`revealAt` + the
  panel's `decideSeconds`, 30) the losing host has «قبول» (`acceptLivePkDare`) and «رفض» (`refuseLivePkDare`); both
  rooms see that the loser is deciding. Before the reveal or after `decideBy`: 409 `PK_DARE_CLOSED`; the winning host:
  403 `PK_DARE_FORBIDDEN`. **No answer by `decideBy` counts as «رفض»** (cause `DECIDE_TIMEOUT`) — an assumption the
  owner may change (KNOWN_LIMITATIONS).
- **Refused** (`REFUSED`): the refusal's PK points (`refusePoints`, **−3**) and «dares refused» + 1 at once, in the same
  transaction; «رفض الحكم» in both rooms; the winner gets no buttons; the flow ends.
- **Accepted** (`ACTIVE`): the timer `PK_DARE_SECONDS` (**180**) starts (`startedAt`, `endsAt`) in both rooms; the loser
  no longer has «رفض». **During the timer the winning host judges** (`judgeLivePkDare` `{done}`): «نُفّذ ✅» → `DONE`
  («dares done» + 1); «لم يُنفّذ ❌» → `REFUSED` (cause `WINNER_NOT_DONE`: the refusal's points). Only the winner (the
  loser 403, viewers 404); idempotent (the same verdict again: 200), final (the other one: 409); audited. **No
  verdict by `endsAt` counts as done** (cause `TIMER`). There is no peer verification of the dare itself.
- **Leaving.** The loser's live ended, no heartbeat or away (the §10.58 absence rules, `PK_ABSENCE_GRACE_SECONDS`)
  while deciding or during the timer → refused (cause `LOSER_LEFT`, −3) unless the winner had already judged. The
  loser's End during the dare: the same. The winner leaving changes nothing (their room's absence does not end the
  dare; the timer's end counts as done); the winner's End: an accepted dare counts as done, one not yet answered is
  `CANCELLED` (no points either way, cause `WINNER_LEFT`). A moderator's end (`pk-admin end`): `CANCELLED` (`ADMIN`).
- **The PK stays open** in RESULT while its dare is open (`result_ends_at` is pushed to the dare's end); after the
  outcome it closes `PK_DARE_OUTCOME_SECONDS` (8) later (or at the result's own end, whichever is later). The rooms
  keep watching each other (`pk:` tokens stay valid until CLOSED).
- **PK points and the record** (owner decision 7). `PkHostRecord` gains `points`, `daresDone`, `daresRefused` (wins,
  losses, draws as before). Points, for every PK type: a counted («effective», §10.62) win **+3**, draw **+1**,
  loss **0**, a refused / not-done dare **−3** — the four values in the panel (`pk_dare_settings`, −100 … 100). The
  total may go below 0. Each value is written once per match, host and kind (`pk_point_events`, primary key match +
  host + kind: a retry or a second tick never counts twice) in the same transaction as the result (or the dare's
  end), audited `live.pk.points`. `PkHistoryItem` gains `type` and `dare` (the drawn dare, its status, `mine`: this
  host was the loser).
- **Reports.** `reportLivePkDare` `{dareId}` ⚠️: anyone signed in who may watch the room (viewers and both hosts), one
  of the room's three cards; one report per person per dare; at `reportsToDisable` (5) reports the dare is disabled
  (`disabledReason` REPORTS, audited `pk_dare.auto_disable`) and is first in the panel's «مُبلَّغ عنها» queue. 10 / 10
  min per user (§7).
- **The library** (`pk_dares`): `code` (unique, stable), `text_ar` (≤ 90 characters in practice), `text_en`, `category`
  (FUNNY, SINGING, ACTING, TALK, TRUTH, DANCE_LIGHT, IMITATION, QUIZ, DRAWING), `level` (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD — owner:
  about a third each), `requires_camera` (always true), `active`, `disabled_reason`, `report_count`, `created_by` (SEED |
  ADMIN), timestamps. The app shows the text of its own language. **Kabso's own content**: generated for Kabso,
  2026-11, from hand-written building blocks (`apps/api/prisma/seed/pk-dares/content.ts`, `generate.ts`,
  `PROVENANCE.md`); nothing copied from other apps or sites.
- **The safety rules** (`pk-dares/pk-dare-rules.ts`; every seed line, every panel add / edit / import): both languages,
  Arabic without Latin letters and English without Arabic ones, Arabic ≤ 90 and English ≤ 140 characters, no stated
  duration over 3 minutes, no `@` / `#` / links / long numbers, no gendered Arabic pronouns («أنتَ / أنتِ»), and a
  blocklist (Arabic and English) for: danger (fire, heights, sharp objects, electricity…), eating or drinking anything,
  nudity / sexual / romantic / flirting, insults (people, groups, bodies), alcohol / drugs / smoking / gambling,
  personal information, calling or messaging anyone and third parties or children, money and buying, breaking laws,
  mocking disabilities, religion, politics. Duplicates: the normalized text (no diacritics, one alef, ة → ه, no
  punctuation) of either language, and near-duplicates — a word-set Jaccard ≥ 0.8 in either language (MinHash LSH,
  confirmed exactly). The repo had no profanity list before D229; this blocklist is it.
- **Seeding** (DEPLOYMENT): the migration creates the tables and the settings row only. `pk-dares-admin import`
  (default the seed file; idempotent by `code`, never overwriting an admin's edit) loads the 20 000 dares on deploy;
  `export` (JSON lines or `--csv`), `stats`, `disable` / `enable <code> --reason`. The panel imports up to 2000 lines per
  upload (JSON or CSV with `code,category,level,textAr,textEn`), with a dry run.
- **The panel «أحكام PK».** D274 (owner): **OWNER only** — `pk_dares.view` and `pk_dares.edit` (were OWNER, MODERATION, SUPPORT / OWNER, MODERATION). `pk_dares.view`: the table (filters category / level / active /
  reported, search in both texts or a code prefix, CSV), the counts, the settings. `pk_dares.edit`:
  add, edit, disable / enable, import, the queue's «إبقاء» (clear the reports, optionally enable again), the PK points
  and `decideSeconds` / `reportsToDisable`. Every write takes a reason and is audited (`pk_dare.create`, `.update`,
  `.import`, `.reports_clear`, `.settings.update`, with before and after).

**10.80.1 D276 — «نقاط PK» on the stage, withdrawal −3, «جولة أخرى» after a dare *(v1.67-live, DRAFT — D276)*.**
Owner (2026-11-04, from a device): «زر اعادة بيكيه لا يظهر — يظهر فقط كتم الخصم، انهاء التحدي. ويجب ان يظهر لكل شخص
نقاط بيكيه الاخر», then «pk الاحكام: تعادل = نقطة، فوز = ٣ نقاط، خسارة = ٠، انسحاب = −٣».

- **Withdrawal — «PK الأحكام» only** (owner: «الاحكام فقط»). In a **DARES** match, a host who withdrew from the
  battle — «إنهاء التحدي» during it (`FORFEIT`), `DISCONNECT` or `AWAY` (the side in `loserCauseRoomId`) — gets the
  panel's `forfeitPoints` (**−3**, `pk_dare_settings.forfeit_points`, −100 … 100) **instead of** `lossPoints`; it still
  counts as a loss in the record (`losses` + 1; written as the match's `LOSS` event, so it is idempotent like the
  others). The other host wins as before (+3). Both withdrew: **both** get `forfeitPoints` and a loss (was a draw for
  both). A **NORMAL** match is unchanged: a withdrawal is a plain loss (`lossPoints`, 0), both withdrew is a draw.
  Ending in the RESULT phase (after the battle) is not a withdrawal. As every PK point, only a counted («effective»,
  §10.62) match writes it (unchanged). `PkMatch.forfeitPoints` says the value now for a DARES match (null for NORMAL):
  the app's «إنهاء التحدي» confirm shows it («الانسحاب يخصم 3 نقاط PK») in a DARES match only. Edited in «أحكام PK»
  with the other values (OWNER, D274; audited before / after).
- **«نقاط PK» on the stage.** `PkSideState.pkPoints`: each side's host's `PkHostRecord.points`, in every match payload
  (the snapshot and every `pk-match` message), so both hosts and every viewer of either room see both hosts' points —
  each on their half, under the battle bar. A finished match's own points are in from its RESULT.
- **«جولة أخرى» after a dare.** When a DARES match's dare finishes and a rematch is still allowed (§10.85,
  `PK_REMATCH_MAX`), the result now stays open **`PK_RESULT_SECONDS`** (60) more — the same time a normal PK leaves for
  «جولة أخرى» — instead of `PK_DARE_OUTCOME_SECONDS` (8, still used when no rematch is left). The host's PK controls
  sheet shows «جولة أخرى» (offer, waiting / cancel, accept / refuse) in the result next to «كتم الخصم» and «إنهاء
  التحدي»; while the dare runs it is shown disabled with «جولة أخرى بعد انتهاء الحكم».
- Migration `20270311090000_pk_forfeit_points` (the column; the `pk_dare_settings_shape` CHECK replaced under the same
  name with its range).

### 10.81 «صواريخ الزيارات»: the traffic card as a 4-stage rocket *(v1.51-live, DRAFT — D233)*

Owner (2026-11-01): «بطاقات الزيارات اجعلهم مثل الصاروخ ب ٤ مراحل واعد تسعيرهم حسب تسعير الكوينز الجديد ولا تظهر السعر
بالدينار فقط بالكوينز، واجعل لكل بطاقة أيقونة من البث بالخارج مختلفة وإطار متحرك للايف من الخارج بلون المميز». Everything
of §10.34 (slots, FIFO queue, one card per live, refunds, cards, the host earns nothing) is unchanged.

- **Stages** *(owner)*: `LIVE_BOOST_PRICES` holds **exactly 4** lengths; sorted shortest first they are the stages 1–4
  «صاروخ 1 · 2 · 3 · 4». Lengths stay **10 / 20 / 30 / 60 minutes**; default prices **200 000 / 550 000 / 1 500 000 /
  3 500 000 coins** *(owner; «1500 مليون» read as 1.5 million — to confirm)*. `LiveBoostOption`, `LiveBoost` and
  `LiveBoostedRoom` carry `stage` (1–4).
- **Prices in the panel:** table `live_boost_prices` (stage → coins, who and when). A stage with a row costs that;
  without one, the config's price. The length is always the server config. `getAdminLiveBoostPrices` (`catalog.view`:
  OWNER, SUPPORT, FINANCE) lists each stage's length, price now, config price and whether the panel set it;
  `updateAdminLiveBoostPrices` (`catalog.manage`: OWNER) sets all four (1 … 10^9, each strictly more than the stage
  before → else 400 `prices` `invalid_value`) with a reason and the authenticator code again, in one transaction with
  an audit row `live.boost_prices.update` (before, after, reason).
- **Old purchases:** a card stores its `stage` when bought (older rows backfilled from their length: 10 → 1, 20 → 2,
  30 → 3, 60 → 4, any other → 1) and keeps `coinsCharged`; a refund gives back `coinsCharged`, whatever the price now.
- **Savings:** `savePercent` stays the rounded saving per minute against stage 1 and is 0 when a stage saves nothing.
  The owner's prices save nothing (per minute 20 000 / 27 500 / 50 000 / 58 333), so no «وفّر» shows.
- **Coins only:** prices are shown in coins with the coin icon, never a currency; lengths in words («10 دقائق»,
  «20 دقيقة», …), never «د».
- **The hub:** a pinned «مميز» live shows its stage's small rocket **inside the «مميز» pill** at the reading start of the
  text (owner 2026-11-02: no separate round badge), the pill in the stage's own colours — 1 bronze, 2 silver-blue,
  3 gold, 4 royal purple → crimson with a gold edge (text ≥ 4.5:1 on every stop) — and an animated frame tinted to match
  (width, glow, speed and bright arcs grow with the stage); still with reduce motion. A featured live without a stage
  keeps the plain gold «مميز» pill and no frame. **Order** among the running ones is unchanged:
  the earliest started first (purchase order through the FIFO queue). Ranking a higher stage first was considered and
  not done: the queue is shared and stage-blind, and the paid slots show at most 3 lives; proposed to the owner as an
  option (D233).
- **Art:** Kabso's own vector rockets drawn in code (`live_rocket_art.dart`); no third-party art.

### 10.82 The author's medals on a live chat line *(v1.52-live, DRAFT — D234)*

Owner (2026-11-02, on a live chat screenshot): «لماذا الأيقونة التي ليفيلها ٢٧ بحجم مختلف؟ أريدهم بنفس الحجم. وتحت سطر
أيقونات الليفيل تكون الميداليات حتى ٥ ميداليات، وتحتهم النص».

- *(D258 lowered the cap to 3; D269 restored 5 — §10.94.10.)*
- **Wire:** `LiveChatAuthorBadges.medals` (`maxItems: 5`): the medals the author chose to show on their profile
  (`PUT /me/medals/showcase`, §10.21), the first five in their showcase order, each `{code, iconKey}`. Empty when the
  author chose none — never auto-filled from owned or latest medals (the profile's rule). No name is sent: the badges are
  cached per author for every language; the app draws the art from `iconKey` and labels the row generically.
- **Read:** in the same statement as the other badges (`user_medals.showcase_position IS NOT NULL` joined to `medals`,
  ordered, `LIMIT 5`), with the same 30 s per-author cache: a showcase change shows within 30 s. Send, the `chat`
  broadcast and `listLiveChatMessages` carry the same value.
- **App:** a chat line with the badge header is the name with the role pills and level emblems beside it (one row, one
  height; only the name shortens) / up to 5 medals (one row, hidden when empty) / the message (§10.24's bubble, else a
  translucent black box). Older servers: no medals row.

### 10.83 «القريبة» = a country the viewer chooses; the party page's kinds *(v1.53-live, DRAFT — D240)*

Owner (2026-11-02, on the party page): «اقترح بث صوتي بث بودكاست بث متعدد يكون فلتر في الاعلى، وازل البحث والاشعارات من
هنا، فقط احفظ زر تبديل بين الحفلة وبث حي على زاوية، باسفل ضع فلاتر نفس فلاتر البث الحي، واريد في البث الحي وصفحة الحفلة
عند الضغط على القريبة يظهر لايفات التي في نفس بلدي واسفله يمكن تغيير البلد».

- **Wire:** `listLiveRooms` takes `country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, any case, stored and compared upper case): only rooms
  whose host's profile country (`Me.country`) is that code; a host without a country is never in it. No token needed
  (guests may choose a country). It combines with every `tab`, `kind`, `category` and `featured`, wins over
  `scope=nearby` (the caller's country is then not read, `emptyReason` null) and binds the cursor (another country →
  400). Malformed or unknown → 400 `field "country"`.
- **App:** «القريبة» in the live hub (D239: `kind=solo`) and in the party page (the selected kind) sends `country`: the
  viewer's own choice, kept on the device, defaulting to their profile country; a country row «🇯🇴 الأردن ▾» under the
  filters opens the searchable country picker. No choice and no profile country: an honest empty state that opens the
  picker. The choice never changes the profile.
- **Party page** (`/live/voice`): the kinds «بث صوتي · بث بودكاست · بث متعدد» are its top tabs (audio first), the hub's
  filter row under them (the same filters and queries, combined with the kind); one corner button switches to the live
  hub (the hub's 🎉 switches back). No search, no bell, no tab or region rows of its own.

### 10.84 A room in a PK is flagged *(v1.54-live, DRAFT — D241)*

Owner (2026-11-02, the panel's «البث الآن» on staging): two lives in a PK battle with each other showed 0 under the «PK»
chip and no PK in the app. A D195 battle keeps both rooms `SOLO` and lives in `pk_matches`; only the pre-D195 preview
set `live_rooms.mode = 'PK'`.

- **In a PK** = an open match (`pk_matches.status <> 'CLOSED'`: CONNECTED, BATTLE or RESULT with its dare) has the room
  on either side, or the room's legacy mode is `PK`. Read in the same statement as the room (an `EXISTS` on the open
  match's room indexes), never per room.
- **Wire:** `LiveRoomSummary.inPk` (lists, boosts, the room); the app's hub card says «PK» for it instead of
  «بث مباشر». The panel: `listAdminLives` `mode=PK` lists the rooms in a PK; `mode=SOLO` («بث مباشر») is SOLO rooms
  not in a PK, so the chips partition the lives and their counts add up; `AdminLiveRow.pk` / `AdminLiveDetail.pk`
  name the opponent (its room, @username, name) and the cards show «PK · ضد @handle».
- Kinds and the hub are unchanged: `kind=solo` is still SOLO and PK, so a battle stays in the hub (D239).

### 10.85 «جولة أخرى» — a rematch with the same opponent *(v1.55-live, DRAFT — D242)*

Owner (2026-11-02): «لا يحتوي pk زر إعادة pk أو لعب جولة أخرى». Before, a match went RESULT → CLOSED and playing again
needed a new invitation or a random wait.

- **When:** in RESULT, once its dare is over (or with none), until it closes. Both lives on air as SOLO video lives with
  fresh heartbeats and their hosts present, both hosts ACTIVE and not blocked either way, and fewer than
  **`PK_REMATCH_MAX` = 5** rematches in a row (0 = unlimited; `PkMatch.rematchesLeft`). Else 409 `PK_REMATCH_UNAVAILABLE`.
- **Offer:** `offerLivePkRematch` by either host: `PkMatch.rematch` {byRoomId, expiresAt}, **`PK_REMATCH_ACCEPT_SECONDS` =
  15** to answer; the result is kept open at least that long. Event `rematch-offer`. The asking host may withdraw it
  (`cancelLivePkRematch`, event `rematch-cancelled`; the result then ends as usual). The other host's own tap while an
  offer is open is an acceptance (both tapped at about the same time → accepted).
- **Answer:** `acceptLivePkRematch` — a **new match row** (`rematchOf` the previous one, `rematch_root_id` the first of
  the chain, `rematchCount` + 1): BATTLE at once between the same rooms and sides, the previous battle's `mode` and
  `roundSeconds`, scores and boosters from zero, the same `type` (DARES: its own dare); the previous match closes
  quietly (no `closed`: the PK media connection stays — watcher identities of any match of the chain stay valid while
  the chain's match is open). Event `rematch` with the new match. A new row rather than more rounds on the old one:
  every battle keeps its own result, dare, PK points, records and history row as before (D199's best of three stays one
  match of up to three rounds). `declineLivePkRematch` (event `rematch-declined`) or no answer in time (event
  `rematch-expired`) closes the PK as usual (event `closed`); the asking host's app says so.
- **Apps:** both hosts see «جولة أخرى» in the result (the white card of D238); the other host gets «@A يريد جولة أخرى»
  with «قبول» / «رفض» and the countdown; the asking host «بانتظار @B…» with cancel; viewers a short «جولة أخرى تبدأ» banner
  when the new battle starts. Rate limit: the PK action bucket.

### 10.86 «بث ستريمر»: the streamer live — the phone screen with a camera bubble *(v1.56-live, DRAFT — D213)*

Owner (2026-11-02): the host's PHONE SCREEN (games or apps) plus a small round front-camera bubble in a corner, which
the host can hide or show and drag to another corner; viewers see the screen with the bubble where the host put it.
Audio: the microphone plus the game's / app's sound (Android 10+), each muted on its own. Android first (iOS: an
honest «قريباً على آيفون», no flow); viewers on any platform. The picture follows the screen: a landscape game is
landscape for viewers (letterboxed in the portrait room, with a fullscreen / rotate button), portrait stays portrait.

- **Mode.** `LiveRoomMode.STREAMER` (`StartLiveRoomRequest.mode`). No guest seats (`seatCount` → 400; the DB CHECK
  `live_rooms_seat_count_mode` keeps it null), no PK (PK stays SOLO only, §10.58), no host-away timeout (§10.44: the
  host is in another app on purpose, so `host-presence` `away: true` stores nothing for a STREAMER). Gifts, chat,
  taps, rankings, the wish list and the room tools that do not need a camera picture work as in a SOLO live.
- **Media.** The host's token may publish `camera`, `microphone`, `screen_share` and `screen_share_audio` (LiveKit
  sources). The screen is its own video track (`screen_share`); the camera bubble is the ordinary `camera` track,
  which every viewer composites over the screen (not drawn into the screen picture on the phone: the screen keeps its
  full resolution, the bubble can move or hide without re-encoding, and an older app that does not know STREAMER still
  shows the camera as a solo live). The Android app mixes the game audio into the published microphone track
  (flutter_webrtc's capture post-processing, as the D201 music); `screen_share_audio` is allowed for a later client
  that publishes it as a track of its own. A muted `screen_share` track = the screen is paused (the host is in Kabso,
  a call, the screen is off): viewers show «الشاشة متوقفة مؤقتاً» instead of a frozen picture.
- **Layout.** `LiveRoomSummary.streamer` (`LiveStreamer`, null for other modes): `orientation` (`PORTRAIT` /
  `LANDSCAPE`), `cameraOverlay` `{visible, corner}` (`TOP_LEFT`, `TOP_RIGHT`, `BOTTOM_LEFT`, `BOTTOM_RIGHT` — physical
  corners of the screen picture, never mirrored for Arabic) and `version`. Start: `StartLiveRoomRequest.streamer`
  (`StreamerSetup`, optional; defaults PORTRAIT, shown, TOP_LEFT; refused for other modes → 400 `streamer`
  `invalid_value`). Changes: `updateLiveStreamer` (`PUT /live/rooms/{roomId}/streamer`, the host only — anyone else 404;
  another mode 409 `LIVE_NOT_STREAMER`; ended 409 `LIVE_ROOM_ENDED`; at least one key, else 400 `too_few`). A real change
  increases `version` under the row's lock, writes `streamerVersion` into the media room's metadata (left out while 0,
  like `roomInfoVersion`) and broadcasts `{"type": "streamer", "roomId", "streamer": LiveStreamer}` on topic
  `streamer`. Apps keep the highest `version`; a metadata `streamerVersion` above it (a message missed, a late join)
  makes them re-read the room. Its own bucket `live:streamer` (`RATE_LIMIT_LIVE_TAPS_USER`, 120 / min): rotations and
  moved bubbles never use up the `PATCH` bucket (60 / h). Not audited (a layout).
- **Lists.** `listLiveRooms?kind=streamer` = STREAMER; a streamer is a video live, so `video` and `solo` (the main
  hub, D239) list it too; `audio`, `podcast`, `multi`, `party` never do. The hub card's tag is «ستريمر». Admin:
  `GET /admin/lives?mode=STREAMER` (the panel's «ستريمر» chip and card tag).
- **App (Android host).** Capture consent (MediaProjection) → the live's foreground service restarts with the types
  `microphone|mediaPlayback|camera|mediaProjection` (Android 14: after the consent, before the capture) → room, token,
  camera + microphone, then the screen track; Android 10+ then joins the game audio (`AudioPlaybackCapture` of media,
  game and unknown usages, on the same MediaProjection) — some apps forbid it (they come out silent: «بعض الألعاب تمنع
  التقاط صوتها»), protected (DRM) video is black; below Android 10 the microphone only, with a note. The notification
  carries «إنهاء», the microphone and the camera bubble (Android shows at most 3 actions; the game sound is in the app).
  Stopping the capture from the system (the status-bar chip, Android 14+) ends the screen and asks the host to share
  again or end. The screen pauses while Kabso itself is in front (so viewers never see the host's chat, wallet or
  messages; the window is also FLAG_SECURE), during a phone call and while the screen is off.

### 10.87 Automatic exchange rates for every country *(v1.81-social, DRAFT — D245)*

Owner (2026-11-02): «اجعل أسعار الصرف متاحة لجميع الدول بشكل أوتوماتيكي بحيث يقوم النظام بتحديث كل دقيقة». The
coordinator's decisions: a **free** source now for every country (hourly — polling a daily feed every minute is
pointless and abusive), a **paid** provider later from the panel (then every minute), the **manual** rate wins.

#### 10.87.1 Countries, currencies and the one resolver

- Every ISO 3166-1 country maps to its official ISO 4217 currency (`apps/api/src/modules/fx/fx-countries.ts`, 248
  codes; AQ has none; the 22 Arab League countries keep D150's table and decimals — IQD, LBP, SYP, YER, SOS 0).
  Multi-currency / de facto cases use the official ISO code (PA → PAB, BT → BTN, LS → LSL, NA → NAD, SZ → SZL, ZW →
  ZWG, CW / SX → XCG, BG → EUR since 2026-01-01, PS → ILS); the team sets a manual rate when another one is wanted.
- **The effective rate of a country** (one function, `resolveRate`; every reader goes through `FxRatesService` /
  `effectiveRateIn` — the recharge-order quote and creation, the panel, `recharge-admin rates`):
  1. the admin's **manual** rate of the country (`recharge_exchange_rates`, D204) — «يدوي»;
  2. a **USD** country (US, EC, SV, PR, …): rate 1 — the price has no second, identical line (`local` null);
  3. the **automatic** rate of the country's currency (`fx_rates`) — «تلقائي» — unless it is **stale**;
  4. otherwise none: USD only (D204's rule: the USD price always shows).
- **Stale data → USD only** (chosen over an «تقريبي» note: no app change, never a wrong local amount): an automatic
  value whose provider time (else its fetch time) is older than `FX_STALE_AFTER_HOURS` (48) is not used. Manual rates
  never go stale. The free feed changes once a day, so 48 h leaves a full day of failed fetches before USD only.
- An order still stores its price at creation (§10.64.1): a later rate never changes it.

#### 10.87.2 Fetching, checks and holds

- **Sources.** Free: ExchangeRate-API «open access» `GET https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD` (no key, ~160
  currencies, data updated once a day; its terms ask not to poll more than about hourly and to show
  «Rates By Exchange Rate API» linking to https://www.exchangerate-api.com where the rates are shown — the panel shows
  it; `AdminFxStatus.attribution`). Paid (§10.87.4): currencyapi.com `GET /v3/latest?base_currency=USD` (header
  `apikey`) or ExchangeRate-API `GET /v6/{key}/latest/USD`. All USD-based; `FX_*_URL` settings (https in production).
- **Every value is checked** against the last good one of its currency: not a finite number > 0 (zero, negative, NaN,
  a string) or > 10^12 → **rejected**; a move over `FX_MAX_JUMP_PERCENT` (50 %) → **held** for review (the last good
  value stays in force; `auto.held` in the panel; the next normal value clears it; OWNER / FINANCE accept it with a
  reason, `acceptAdminFxHeldRate`, audited `fx.rate.accept_held`). A held currency's last good value keeps its old
  time, so a real devaluation nobody reviews ends as USD only after 48 h, never as a wrong local price. USD itself is
  never stored. A fetch with no usable value is a failure (`no_rates`).
- **The poller** (`FxPoller`): every `FX_POLL_TICK_SECONDS` (30; 0 = off, tests) each API instance asks whether a fetch
  is due. One `fx_settings` row is the shared state: `next_fetch_at`, a **lease** `running_until` (2 min) claimed under
  `FOR UPDATE`, so N instances fetch once per period and never twice at once. The interval is
  `FX_FREE_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (3600, minimum 600) with the free feed, `FX_PAID_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (60, minimum 60) with
  a paid provider on.
- **Failures** (`unreachable`, `timeout`, `http_error`, `bad_api_key`, `quota_reached`, `rate_limited`,
  `bad_response`, `no_rates`): the last good rates stay; the error, its time and the failures in a row are stored and
  shown; the wait doubles per failure (free: 1 h, 2 h, 4 h, at most 6 h; paid: 1, 2, 4 … at most 60 min) and resets
  after a success. Logged without the key or the URL. Requests: GET only, 10 s timeout (`FX_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS`), no
  redirect, at most 1 MB.

#### 10.87.3 The panel «أسعار الصرف»

`listAdminRechargeExchangeRates` (`recharge.agents`): every country with currency, effective `unitsPerUsd`, `source`
(MANUAL «يدوي» / AUTO «تلقائي» / USD / NONE «دولار فقط»), `stale`, `updatedAt` «آخر تحديث», the manual and the automatic
value (source, fetch and provider times, a held value with its jump), and `status` (the source in use, the interval,
the last attempt / success, the next fetch, the last error and the failures, the counts, the attribution). Edit
(`setAdminRechargeExchangeRate`) sets a manual rate; «إعادة إلى التلقائي» (`clearAdminRechargeExchangeRate`) removes it
— both `recharge.rates` (OWNER, FINANCE) with a reason, audited as in D204 (no code: the D204 rate edits need none).
«تحديث الآن» `refreshAdminFxRates` (`recharge.rates`): one fetch under the same lease; refused within 60 s of the last
attempt (`fx_refresh_too_soon`); audited `fx.rates.refresh`.

#### 10.87.4 The OWNER's paid provider «مزوّد أسعار الصرف»

D196 / D222 / D227's pattern exactly: `/admin/fx-settings`, capability `fx.settings` (OWNER). The provider
(`CURRENCYAPI` — currencyapi.com, minute updates on its paid plans; or `EXCHANGERATE_API`) and the **API key, write-only**:
AES-256-GCM at rest with a key derived from ADMIN_TOTP_KEY (HKDF-SHA-256, info `fx-settings/v1`, AAD
`fx_settings.api_key`); only the last 4, who and when are ever shown or audited. Every change and the removal need the
authenticator code again + a reason (403 `ADMIN_TOTP_INVALID`), audited `fx.settings.update` / `fx.settings.clear`
(masked before / after, `changed`, `connectionTest`). «اختبار الاتصال» `testAdminFxSettings`: one real request with the
typed or saved key (`FxTestReport`, audited `fx.settings.test`). Turning on, or a new key / provider while on, runs it
first (`fx_test_failed`, nothing saved; `skipConnectionTest` outside production only). While on, the poller reads the
paid provider every minute (a switch is fetched at the next tick); off or cleared → the free feed hourly. A key sealed
with another ADMIN_TOTP_KEY is ignored (`paidIgnored: unreadable`, free feed). No key ever lives in env files or the
repository; tests use a local stub provider.

#### 10.87.5 Deployment

The API container needs **outbound HTTPS** to `open.er-api.com` (and, with a paid provider, `api.currencyapi.com` or
`v6.exchangerate-api.com`). Without it every fetch fails (`unreachable`), the panel shows the error, manual rates keep
working and the other countries are USD only. Migration `20270225090000_fx_rates`. DEPLOYMENT §5.46.

### 10.88 «استوديو البث»: the streamer's browser studio, OBS Virtual Camera *(v1.57-live, DRAFT — D247)*

Owner (2026-11-02): a streamer goes live from a laptop browser — the screen, a window or a tab with the camera bubble,
or OBS's whole scene through OBS Virtual Camera — into the same STREAMER live as §10.86. Phase 1 is the browser only:
no new server service (no LiveKit Ingress, no RTMP / WHIP).

- **Where.** `apps/studio` (React + TypeScript + Vite, like the admin panel), a static build served by Caddy at
  `https://studio.<domain>` with `/api/*` proxied to the API on the same origin (no CORS). A subdomain rather than
  `kabsolive.com/studio`: its own CSP (`connect-src` the media server, `worker-src 'self'`, `media-src blob:`) and
  `Permissions-Policy: camera=(self), microphone=(self), display-capture=(self)` stay off the public website, which
  keeps `camera=()` and no third-party connection (D198). livekit-client is bundled (no runtime third-party script).
  The website's `/studio` page explains the studio and OBS (D247's guide) and links to it.
- **Sign-in.** The app's user login (`POST /auth/login`, email or username + password, `device.platform: web`,
  `device.name` «Kabso Studio — <browser> on <OS>»); Kabso has no second factor for users. `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`
  asks for the new password (the same request with `newPassword`); `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` and `ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING` are
  said as they are (a deletion is cancelled in the app). The access token lives in memory; the refresh token in the
  tab's `sessionStorage` (a reload during a live resumes; another tab or a later browser session never sees it; sign-out
  removes it). The refresh is single-flight (§6), and a tab the browser duplicated — it copies `sessionStorage` — gives
  its copy up (a BroadcastChannel claim) instead of racing the original into `REFRESH_REUSE`.
- **Gate.** As the app's go-live: `getLiveConfig.hostingEnabled`, `Me.canHost` (else the honest refusal and how to
  become a host), and an own LIVE room (`getPublicProfile` → `liveRoomId`): a STREAMER one may be continued from the
  studio, any one may be ended. `startLiveRoom` refusals (`LIVE_HOSTING_NOT_ALLOWED`, `LIVE_HOSTING_UNAVAILABLE`,
  `LIVE_ROOM_ALREADY_ACTIVE`, `AUTH_FORBIDDEN` for an unverified email) are shown, never retried blindly.
- **Layouts → the contract.** «الشاشة + فقاعة الكاميرا» = `main: SCREEN`: `screen_share` (+ `screen_share_audio` when
  the browser gives sound), `camera` (the bubble at `cameraOverlay.corner`; no camera or hidden → `visible: false` and
  the camera track muted), `microphone`. «الكاميرا فقط (OBS)» = `main: CAMERA`: the `camera` track alone is the
  picture (OBS Virtual Camera is listed first and picked by default there), no screen track. `orientation` follows the
  main source's shape (wider than tall → LANDSCAPE) unless the host fixes it. Every change is sent with
  `PUT …/streamer` (only the keys that differ, debounced 0.5 s).
- **Why `main`.** With D213 alone a viewer waits for a `screen_share` track («بانتظار شاشة المضيف…») and draws the
  camera as the bubble; publishing OBS as `screen_share` instead would mislabel it and lose the solo-live fallback of
  older apps. One enum on the existing layout object is the smallest addition; the bubble keys stay and are unused
  while `main` is `CAMERA`. Viewers (the app's streamer stage): `CAMERA` → the camera fitted like a screen
  (letterboxed by `orientation`), no bubble; a muted camera → «الشاشة متوقفة مؤقتاً»; none yet → «بانتظار صورة
  المضيف…».
- **Media.** The screen: 720p30 at ≈ 2.5 Mbps or 1080p30 at ≈ 4 Mbps (the host picks), no simulcast, `contentHint`
  motion; its sound at music quality, no DTX; the camera with simulcast (as the whole picture at the chosen quality);
  the microphone with echo cancellation. Browsers decide the screen's sound: Chrome / Edge on Windows and ChromeOS —
  system sound with the whole screen and a tab's sound with a tab; on macOS and Linux — a tab's sound only; Firefox
  and Safari — none; phones cannot share a screen from a browser. The studio says which applies before sharing.
  OBS Virtual Camera carries no sound (the microphone the host picks does).
- **Robustness.** The browser's «Stop sharing» mutes the screen publication (viewers: «الشاشة متوقفة مؤقتاً») until the
  host shares again into the same publication (`replaceTrack`). Short drops are resumed by livekit-client; a session
  that is gone is joined again with a new host token (1, 2, 4, 8, then every 15 s) while the API says the room is
  LIVE. The heartbeat (`heartbeatIntervalSeconds`) runs on a worker's clock (not throttled in a background tab). A
  STREAMER is never «away» (§10.86), so the studio sends no host-presence. Closing the tab asks first
  (`beforeunload`); it then leaves the media room at once and stops the heartbeat, so the room ends with
  `HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT` after `heartbeatStaleAfterSeconds` — as when the app is killed; signing in again within that
  window offers to continue the same live.
- **Side panel.** The chat (`GET …/chat` once, the `chat` topic; the host's messages through `POST …/chat`), the
  incoming gifts (the `gift` topic; a combo is one line; names from the gift catalogue in the page's language), the
  viewer count (`LiveRoom.viewerCount`, read every 10 s: viewers are hidden participants on the media server), mute
  toggles and «إنهاء البث» with a confirmation.

### 10.89 The party page's room cards: level, «رائج» and the host's country *(v1.58-live, DRAFT — D246)*

Owner (2026-11-02, a party-page reference): the cards carry «Lv.N» and «Popular» like the reference, and the host's
flag. (§10.86–§10.88 are taken on other branches.)

- **`LiveRoomSummary.roomLevel`** — the host's charm (ATTRACTIVENESS) level, CP-016 D (§10.18): the same value and rule
  as `LiveRoom.roomLevel`, which now comes from the summary. Read in the same statement as the room (its existing
  `room_level` column), never per room. Null while the charm category is unavailable. The app shows it on the room
  cards in lists only (the party page; not inside the room, where the room bar already has it).
- **`LiveRoomSummary.popular`** («رائج») — the live is among the first **`LIVE_POPULAR_TOP_N` = 10** (1–100) listable
  lives (LIVE, fresh heartbeat, ACTIVE host) **of its kind** — audio (`AUDIO`), podcast (`PODCAST`), multi (`MULTI`),
  video (`SOLO`, `PK`) — in the `popular` order (score, startedAt, id, all descending: the «الرائج» tab's order).
  Computed per request in the same statement (one uncorrelated window subquery, `row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY
  kind)`, a hashed subplan: once per statement, not per row), so it follows the scores as they move. Global: the same
  for every viewer (blocks and filters do not change it). False for an ENDED room.
- **`LiveRoomSummary.hostCountry`** — the host's profile country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), public like
  `PublicProfile.country` (there is no country privacy switch); **absent** when the host set none. The party page's
  audio, podcast and multi cards show its flag.
- **Compatibility:** additive. Older apps ignore the fields; older servers send none (the app then shows no level,
  no «رائج», no flag).

Owner (2026-11-02): «اجعل التصميم مشابه للبيجو لايف بحيث بعد أول بثين هناك بنر متحرك، وفي الأسفل قليلاً بنر بحجم
اللايف». Extends §10.26; the rest of §10.26 is unchanged.

- **Carousel** (`placement=home`): in the hub's 2-column grid it now follows the
  **first row** (2 cells; after the last cell when there are fewer), full width, the cards' corner radius;
  *D248b (owner: «البنر كبير، خذ نفس حجم بنر البيجو»)*: **5:1** (ref 375 measured 690 × 138 px = 5.0, ≈ 37 % of a
  card's height) — pictures uploaded from the panel or `--image` for `home` are **1 500 × 300** (thumb 320 × 64);
  older 1 500 × 500 ones are centre-cropped (cover) to 5:1 by the app, never an error. Every `home` surface is 5:1:
  the hub grid, the Voice rooms list and the Creator Center; `tasks` and `wallet` stay 3:1 (1 500 × 500); it
  auto-advances every 4 s and swipes as before; the page indicator is a thin bar inside the picture's bottom edge. The
  Voice rooms list keeps it after its 4th row. Hidden when no banner is active (never a placeholder).
- **Card-size banner** (`placement=hub_card`, new placement `HUB_CARD`): one **grid cell**, exactly a live card (width
  : height 0.894, the app's `KLiveGrid.cardAspect`), its picture **720 × 805** WebP (thumb 288 × 322), cover-cropped
  around the centre by the server. `GET /home/banners?placement=hub_card` (signed-in only; 401 without a token) →
  `{data, cell}`: `cell` is the 0-based index of that cell in reading order over every cell of the grid (RTL: the first
  cell is the right one), from `HOME_HUB_CARD_CELL` (0–40, default **4** = the first cell of the third row; after the
  last room when there are fewer). Several active ones **take turns in that one cell** (a cross-fade every 5 s; not
  with reduce motion) rather than repeating every N rows. Its optional title shows as a live card's title. Tap = the
  banner's link (§10.26 allowlist; an unknown link is not a button).
- **Not lives:** neither banner is a room: the rooms' order, indices, the in-room swipe list, the cursor and the
  infinite scroll never see them. Pull to refresh reloads both lists. No impression or click tracking exists for

- **Adding from the panel** «البانرات والفعاليات» (`catalog.manage`, OWNER): `POST /admin/banner-uploads?placement=`
  (raw `application/octet-stream`, the CLI's `--image` checks and crop: home 1 500 × 300 (D248b), tasks / wallet 1 500 × 500, room 600 ×
  800, hub_card 720 × 805; 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` for a file that is not an image) answers `mediaId`; then
  `POST /admin/banners` with the `banner-admin add` fields and a reason (the same rules: the picture must have the
  placement's shape, unused, < 24 h old; audit `banner.add` with `via: panel`, the actor and the reason). The panel
  previews the picture cropped to the placement's shape. `banner-admin add --placement hub_card` does the same from the
  CLI (`--media` with a 3:1 upload is refused).
- Migration `20270303090000_banner_hub_card` (the CHECK only). DEPLOYMENT §5.49.

#### 10.90.1 Three banner categories, each may move *(v1.61-live, DRAFT — D248c)*

Owner (2026-11-02): «البنر في الصفحة الرئيسية الأساسي، وبنر بين اللايفات، وبنر داخل اللايفات صغير، جميعها يتم تحميلها من
لوحة الأدمن، كل فئة يمكن أن تكون متحركة». The app has no other banner at the top of the home / hub, so the carousel is
the main banner.

| Category | Placement | Stored size (thumb) | Where | Still (JPEG / PNG / WebP / GIF) | Animated (WebP / GIF) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Main home banner «البنر الأساسي» | `home` | 1 500 × 300 (320 × 64) | hub carousel after the first row; Voice rooms list; Creator Center | ✓ | ✓ |
| Between the lives «بنر بين اللايفات» | `hub_card` | 720 × 805 (288 × 322) | one hub grid cell (§10.90) | ✓ | ✓ |
| Inside a live «بنر داخل اللايف» | `room` | 600 × 800 (240 × 320) | the promo box at the top end of a live (82 × 109 pt; audio 64 × 85 pt, D137 / D141a) | ✓ | ✓ |
| Task Center / wallet | `tasks` / `wallet` | 1 500 × 500 (320 × 107) | their pages | ✓ | ✓ |

- **Upload** (panel `uploadAdminBannerPicture`, CLI `--image`): at most 15 MiB in. An animated WebP or GIF keeps its
  animation: every frame cover-cropped around the centre to the stored size, re-encoded as a looping animated WebP
  (metadata dropped). Limits: **≤ 150 frames, ≤ 10 s a loop, ≤ 3 MB stored** (one retry at a lower quality),
  frames ≤ 8 000 px a side and 50 MP; beyond them 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`, `details[0].issue`
  `banner_animation_too_many_frames` / `_too_long` / `_too_large` / `_unreadable`, nothing stored. A one-frame GIF is a
  still (stored as WebP). The thumbnail is always a still (the first frame). `AdminBannerUpload` gains `animated`,
  `frames`, `durationMs`. `HomeBanner` is unchanged: `imageUrl` is a `.webp` either way.
- **Not accepted:** MP4 / WebM video (the API has no video pipeline — reels are stored as uploaded, no ffmpeg), Lottie
  and SVGA (no banner renderer; SVGA is for gifts only).
- **App:** the pictures play through Flutter's `Image` (animated WebP natively): the hub carousel, the hub card cell and
  the in-room promo box. An animation pauses on its current frame when its widget is off screen (not built), when the
  route or tab is hidden (`TickerMode` off), when the app is in the background (no frames), and shows its **first frame**
  with reduce motion. Decoding is bounded by `cacheWidth` (the box's physical width) in the hub card and the promo box.
- **Panel:** «إضافة بانر» offers all five placements, each with its crop preview in its own shape; an animated file
  previews animated (the browser plays it, cropped like the server) with a «متحرك» mark; the refusals are translated.

### 10.91 «مراقبة البث» — live moderation from the panel *(v1.60-live, DRAFT — D250)*

Owner (2026-11-02, a screenshot of the panel's «البث الآن» showing only cover images): «هنا يجب أن يعرض البث لايف، بحيث
يمكن أن يكون موظف يراقب اللايفات من خلال اللوحة، وفي حال شخص قام بالإبلاغ عن لايف يظهر في خانة لايفات مبلّغ عنها وبجانبها
نقطة حمراء، ويراقب البث، وفي حال وجود أي مخالفة يمكن أن يغلق البث أو عمل حظر مؤقت أو حظر جهاز، ويضع في صندوق سبب ليصل
إشعار للمضيف بالسبب». Built on D197 (END LIVE with a reason), D208 (locks and restrictions), D223 (the device key), the
CP-010 `LIVE_ROOM` reports, the notifications and push (§11.10, §11.12) and the panel's session, capabilities, TOTP and
audit (§10.54, §10.60).

#### 10.91.1 Watching: the hidden observer

- `createAdminLiveWatchToken` (`lives.watch`: OWNER, MODERATION, SUPPORT — owner answer D250b) issues a LiveKit token for the live's media room with
  identity **`staff:<adminId>:<nonce>`** (a 12-hex nonce, so a card preview and the watch view of the same admin never
  replace each other), `canSubscribe` only — no publishing, no data — and **`hidden`**, so neither the host nor the viewers
  see it in their participant list. TTL **120 s** to join (a joined session is renewed by the media server). `purpose`
  `PREVIEW` (a card's muted preview: this room) or `WATCH` (the watch view: also the other room of an open PK as
  `opponent`, the same identity). Only for a LIVE room (409 `LIVE_ROOM_ENDED`). Every token is audited
  `admin.live.watch` {purpose, identity, hostUserId, opponentRoomId} — who watched which live and when.
- **Never a viewer:** the media webhook and the reconciliation return early for a `staff:` identity — no
  `live_room_viewers` row, no `viewer_count`, no audience visit, no «joined» chat line; it is removed only when the room is
  no longer LIVE. Its `participant_left` changes nothing.
- The watch view's chat is `listAdminLiveChat` (`lives.watch`): the last 50 lines, oldest first, deleted ones marked;
  `after` for polling. Read-only: staff never write to a live.
- The panel (`apps/admin`, `livekit-client` 2.22.4 — the version of `apps/studio`): «البث الآن» cards play a **muted
  live preview** (the lowest video layer, adaptive stream, no audio subscribed) only while the card is on screen, **at
  most 6 at once** (the rest show the cover with a play button; leaving the screen disconnects); clicking opens the
  watch view: the large video with audio and every published track (a PK's two sides, an audio / podcast / multi live's
  seat videos and voices, a streamer's screen and camera), the chat, the room's facts (host, viewers, started, mode, PK
  opponent), its reports and the actions.

#### 10.91.2 Reported lives «لايفات مبلّغ عنها»

- A live's reports are its room's (`LIVE_ROOM`) and its host's as a user made **since the live started** (older apps
  report the host from the ≡ menu). A report is **open** until a moderator resolves it — an action on the live (§10.91.4,
  ACTIONED) or «تمت المراجعة — لا مخالفة» (DISMISSED). Reports themselves are §11.7's: one open report per reporter and
  target (a repeat returns it, 200), the reasons SPAM, NUDITY, VIOLENCE, HATE, HARASSMENT, ILLEGAL, OTHER, an optional
  note (≤ 500), the per-user limit `reportUser`.
- `getAdminLiveReportsSummary` (`lives.reports`) {rooms, reports}: the reported lives on air and their open reports — the
  red dot and count on the «لايفات مبلّغ عنها» chip and the red dot on the sidebar's «البث الآن» (polled every 15 s).
  `listAdminLives?reported=true` lists only them; every `AdminLiveRow` has `openReports`.
- `listAdminLiveReports` (`lives.reports`): newest first, at most 50, with the **reporter** (staff only), reason, note,
  status and time, and `chatBefore` — the last 5 chat lines at the report's time (no snapshot table: the chat is kept).
  `listAdminLiveModerations`: what the team did on the live.

- **Owner answers (D250b, 2026-11-02):** SUPPORT may watch and read the reported lives (`lives.watch`, `lives.reports`)
  but takes no action — no `lives.moderate`, no `devices.ban`; the panel shows SUPPORT no action buttons. Kept as built:
  the push shows the reason; a permanent device ban is OWNER + MODERATION; «تعليق الحساب» needs no code.

#### 10.91.3 The app's «الإبلاغ عن البث»

The live's ≡ menu (viewers, not the host) gains «الإبلاغ عن البث»: the report reasons, then an optional note, then
`createReport` `{targetType: LIVE_ROOM, targetId: <roomId>, reason, note?}`. «الإبلاغ عن المضيف» (a USER report) stays.

#### 10.91.4 Actions (`moderateAdminLive`, `dismissAdminLiveReports`)

Every action needs a **reason** (1–500, «يظهر للمضيف») and is refused on the admin's own live (409) and, for a host who
is a panel team member, unless the admin is an OWNER (403) — D208's rule.

| `action` | What it does | Duration | Code again |
|---|---|---|---|
| `END` «إغلاق البث» | ends the live (end reason ADMIN, D197's rule); 409 when not on air | — | no |
| `NO_LIVE` «منع من البث» | ends the live; D208's NO_LIVE restriction: `startLiveRoom` → 403 `ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED` with the end and the reason | `hours` (panel: 1 h, 24 h, 3 d, 7 d, 30 d) or `until` («مخصّص»), ≤ 365 d | no (as D208's restrictions) |
| `SUSPEND` «تعليق الحساب» | ends the live; D208's LOCK: every session ends, `login` → 403 `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` with the end and the reason | as NO_LIVE | no (as D208's lock) |
| `DEVICE_BAN` «حظر جهاز» | ends the live; bans every device seen for the host (§10.91.6) | `hours` / `until`, or `permanent` | **yes** (`devices.ban` too) |

- The bans **end by themselves**: "active" is read with the clock on every check (D208's rule), so nothing has to run
  at the end; the panel shows them expired. They can be lifted early: a restriction from the user page (D208), a device
  ban from the device-ban list.
- Each action ends the host's live when on air (a ban also frees the host's seats elsewhere), closes the live's open reports as
  **ACTIONED** with the reason as their note, writes `live_moderation_actions` and **one** `LIVE_MODERATED` notification
  to the host (the D208 restriction is created without its own `ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED` notification), and is audited
  `admin.live.moderate` {kind, reason, endsAt, endedLive, reportsClosed, devicesBanned, sessionsEnded, restrictionId,
  before, after, via: panel}. The media session closes after the commit.
- `dismissAdminLiveReports` (`lives.moderate`): the open reports become **DISMISSED** with the reason; the host is not
  told; 409 when none is open; audited `admin.live.reports_dismiss`.

#### 10.91.5 The host is told

`LIVE_MODERATED` (system) with target **`LIVE_MODERATION`**: `moderation` (END, NO_LIVE, SUSPEND, DEVICE_BAN), `reason`
(full; `text` its 80-character excerpt), `endsAt` (absent for END; absent with `permanent: true` for a permanent device
ban) and `roomId`. The push (the general channel, the account's language) carries the reason: «أنهى فريق Kabso بثك.
السبب: …» / «The Kabso team ended your live. Reason: …» (the reason clipped to 80). A suspension or a device ban ends the
host's sessions and drops their push tokens, so that push may not arrive — the sign-in screen then shows the end and the
reason (`ACCOUNT_LOCKED`, `DEVICE_BANNED`), and the inbox row is there after signing in.

#### 10.91.6 Device bans

- The device is D223's `DeviceInfo.deviceKey` (the app's salted SHA-256 of Android `ANDROID_ID` / the iOS Keychain id),
  kept only as its HMAC (D223's key). **`login` now reads it too** and the session keeps it (`sessions.device_hash`); the
  devices "seen for an account" are its sign-up device (`device_signups`) and its sessions' devices (at most 20, newest
  first). The install id (D217) is not used: a reinstall changes it while `ANDROID_ID` survives, so it adds nothing.
- A ban (`device_bans`: hash, reason, the account it came from, the action, the creator, `ends_at` NULL = permanent,
  lifted by / why) replaces an open ban of the same device; it **ends every session of the device for every account**
  (revoked `ADMIN_DEVICE_BANNED`, push tokens deleted), and while active refuses, for every account: `register` (before
  anything else; no code mailed), `registerVerify` (the pending sign-up is deleted), `login` (after the right password)
  and `startLiveRoom` (the session's device) — 403 **`DEVICE_BANNED`** `[{until: ISO | permanent}, {reason}]`; audited
  `admin.device_ban.create` and, refused, `auth.device_banned` {stage: register | verify | live} / `auth.login.failure`
  {reason: device_banned}.
- `listAdminDeviceBans` / `liftAdminDeviceBan` (`devices.ban`: OWNER, MODERATION; a reason; audited
  `admin.device_ban.lift`): the list names the device by its account — the hash is never shown.
- **Honest limits** (KNOWN_LIMITATIONS): a factory reset (Android) or deleting the app with its Keychain item (iOS) gives a
  new id; a rooted / jailbroken phone can send any key; the website and apps older than this version send no key, so
  nothing is checked for them (their sign-in and going live are not refused); a ban is per device, not per person.

#### 10.91.7 Deployment

The admin's CSP (Caddy) gains `connect-src` for the media server — `wss://live.<domain> https://live.<domain>` and
`KABSO_ADMIN_MEDIA_ORIGINS` when `LIVEKIT_URL` is elsewhere (as D247's studio) — and `media-src 'self' blob:` for the
video elements; nothing else changes (DEPLOYMENT §5.50).

### 10.92 «شريط ترقية المستويات» — the level-up banner in every live *(v1.62-live, DRAFT — D254)*

Owner (2026-11-03, with a reference screenshot of a live: a dark translucent pill with a thin gold border under the top
row, a level emblem at its start and the text scrolling): «شريط متحرك لاعلان عن ترقية الحسابات وصعود ليفيلات لليفيلات
المرتفعة» — «🎉 تهانينا لـ {name} على الترقية إلى المستوى {level} في غرفة البث المباشر الخاصة بـ {host}». Answers: (1) the
**support** level (`SUPPORT`, gift senders) and the **charm** level (`ATTRACTIVENESS`, hosts receiving gifts) — not
`WIZARD`, not `GAMING`; (2) a threshold set in the panel, one number, default **30**: a level-up is announced when the
level went up (`previousLevel` < `level`; no level before counts as 0) and the new level is at least the threshold, and
every level from there is announced (30, 31, 32 …); (3) in every live, a tap opens the room where it happened (as the
gift strip, §10.27 D178).

#### 10.92.1 What is announced

- **Gift sends in a live** (`sendLiveGift`, every gift kind, PK sends included; §10.23): the sender's support and each
  recipient's charm (the host or a seated guest — D128 a gift to oneself too), after the send's transaction commits.
  A lucky gift raises support only when the published SUPPORT version counts lucky gifts (CP-005); a free quip credits
  nothing. A person credited twice in one send (a gift to several people) is one announcement: the level before the
  send and the highest level after it. A retried send (`clientId` replay) announces nothing again.
- **Taps** (`tapLiveRoom`, §10.18): the host's charm from counted taps (1 point per 10 taps).
- **Not announced:** gifts in a conversation (§11.13 D155 — there is no live room to open), the panel's and the
  `levels-admin` adjustments, recomputes after a ladder change, Wizard and Gaming levels.
- **Once per person, level system and level** (Redis `level:ticker:seen:<user>:<category>:<level>`, 7 days): a level
  lost by a fraud deduction and reached again is not news.

#### 10.92.2 The data message

Topic **`level`**, sent to **every LIVE room — its own first** (at most 5 000, newest first), best effort:

| `type` | Payload |
| ------ | ------- |
| `level-ticker` | `{"type":"level-ticker","levelUp":{"id":"<userId>:<category>:<level>","user":UserSummary,"category":"SUPPORT"\|"ATTRACTIVENESS","level":31,"previousLevel":30\|null,"roomId","createdAt"},"room":{"id","title","host":UserSummary}}` |

At most **one banner per 8 s** for the whole service (a Redis gate shared by every API instance, `level:ticker:gate`);
a level-up offered inside the gap **waits in line**, oldest first (`level:ticker:pending`, at most **20** waiting, none
older than **120 s**; more are dropped). The instance that queued one flushes it when the gap ends (any instance may).
The live that ended meanwhile, or an account that is gone, is skipped. Redis, the database or the media server down →
no banner, never a failed gift or tap. Older apps ignore the type.

#### 10.92.3 The threshold

`getAdminLevelTicker` / `updateAdminLevelTicker` (`GET` / `PUT /admin/level-ticker`, panel session + CSRF, capability
`site.settings`: **OWNER** only; a bearer token → 401, other roles → 403): `LevelTickerSettings` `{minLevel}`, an integer
**1–100**, **30** while unset (a stored value out of bounds reads as 30). Stored as one `site_settings` row (key
`levelTickerMinLevel`; migration `20270305090000_level_ticker` widens the key CHECK). Anything else → 400
`VALIDATION_FAILED`, nothing changed. Audited `site.settings.update` with `metadata.key` = `levelTickerMinLevel`, before,
after, `reason`, `via: panel`. Read at every level-up offer (no cache): it takes effect at once.

#### 10.92.4 The app

Every live screen that shows the global gift strip (the host's and the viewer's, audio and video) shows the banner right
under the header row, over its second row and above the side cards (393 × 852 pt with 59 pt inset: 8 pt to 384 pt,
21 pt tall, its top 46.5 pt under the header row's top; Arabic mirrors it): a dark pill (`#141018` at 88 %) with a thin gold
border, the person's support badge (`KLevelBadge`) or charm badge (`CharmLevelBadge`) at the start, a 🎉 icon and the
text «تهانينا لـ {name} على الترقية إلى المستوى {level} في غرفة البث المباشر الخاصة بـ {host}» / "Congratulations to
{name} on reaching level {level} in the live room of {host}". Text wider than the pill scrolls in the reading direction
(a 1 s pause, 40 pt/s, looping); reduced motion: still, with an ellipsis. One at a time for 8 s; up to 3 wait (oldest
first); a person or host the viewer blocked is not shown; it steps aside while this live's own lucky-win banner shows.
A tap opens the room (`pushReplacement`, as D178) — on the viewer's screen, for another live; the host on air and the
banner of this very live take no taps.
