### 10.93 «شراء VIP» — VIP tiers from the panel, bought with coins *(v1.82-social, DRAFT — D252)*

Owner (2026-11-03): «اصنع صفحة شراء vip واجعلها بنفس التصميم مطابق ١٠٠٪ واضافة الفي اي بي وترتيبه يكون من لوحة كل في اي بي
له ميزات وامتيازات مختلفة». CP-024 §3 left VIP «قريباً» because its business rules were the owner's to set; the owner now
answers that the tiers, their order and their perks are set **in the admin panel**. The values below that were not given
are conservative defaults, each changeable without an app release. SVIP (§10.41, earned by gift spending) is a different
programme and is unchanged.

#### 10.93.1 Tiers and perks

- A tier is a row of `vip_tiers`: `code` (`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,39}$`, never changes), `nameAr` / `nameEn` (1–30), the
  **order** `sortOrder` (1 … n, set by the panel — it is both the order the app shows and the **rank**: the higher, the
  higher the tier), `color` (`#RRGGBB`), an optional hosted **BADGE** (`badgeAnimation` = SVGA, `badgeStill` = still; both
  https, else the app draws a token placeholder in the colour), `priceCoins` (1 … 10^12), `durationDays` (1 … 365) and
  `enabled`. At most 20 tiers. **VIP 1 is seeded** enabled (1 000 000 coins / 30 days) with six perks, its art URLs null
  until the owner uploads them (D252b); other tiers are added from the panel (CP-024's 3 000 / 8 000 / 20 000 placeholders
  predate D194's coin price and are not used).
- Each tier has **its own perks** (`vip_tier_perks`, at most 20, in order): `code` (unique in the tier), `titleAr` /
  `titleEn` (1–40), optional descriptions (≤ 200), `enabled` (shown or hidden) and its own hosted art (`animation` = SVGA,
  `still`, `artWidth` / `artHeight` — all https, from the panel; D252b). The panel suggests SVIP's vocabulary (`BADGE`,
  `AVATAR_FRAME`, `PROFILE_CARD`, `CHAT_BUBBLE`, `CHAT_NAME_COLOR`, `ENTRY_BANNER`, `ENTRY_EFFECT`, `MIC_SOUND_WAVE`,
  `DAILY_BULLET`, `VIEWER_LIST_PRIORITY`, `MONTHLY_GIFT`); any other code is allowed.
- **Honest perks:** `available` is **not** an admin field: it is true only for a code in the server's list of perks the
  app really does (`VIP_BUILT_PERKS`, empty today). Every perk is therefore `available: false` and the app shows it as
  listed «قريباً», never as active — as SVIP's perks (§10.41). Building a perk (art by the owner, a change in the live
  room) adds its code to the list.
- Tiers are never deleted (memberships and purchases point at them). One switched off is no longer listed, bought or
  renewed; people holding it keep it to its end (`onSale: false`). A new price or length applies to purchases from then
  on; memberships keep their end.

#### 10.93.2 Buying (`buyVip`)

Coins only, from the wallet balance; one transaction per purchase, serialized per person (advisory lock), the tier row
held `FOR SHARE`, the coins taken with a `wallet_ledger` row `VIP_PURCHASE` whose reference is the `vip_purchases` row,
and an audit row `vip.purchase`. `Idempotency-Key` (24 h, as premium usernames): the same key and body answer 200 with the
first result; another body 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. `priceCoins` must be the tier's price now (else 409
`VIP_PRICE_CHANGED`). At most one membership per person (`vip_memberships`):

| Caller holds (active) | Buys | Result |
|---|---|---|
| nothing, or it ended | any tier on sale | **NEW**: the tier for its `durationDays` from now |
| tier A | tier A | **RENEW**: the end moves by `durationDays` (no day lost); refused 409 `VIP_UNAVAILABLE` `renewal_limit` when the end would be more than `VIP_MAX_AHEAD_DAYS` = 400 days from now |
| tier A | a higher tier B | **UPGRADE**: B at once, `durationDays` from now, at B's **full price**; A's days left are **not** carried over or refunded (the app says so before paying) |
| tier B | a lower (or equal-rank) tier A | refused 409 `VIP_UNAVAILABLE` `downgrade` — A can be bought once B ends |
| anything | a tier switched off | refused 409 `VIP_UNAVAILABLE` `tier_off` (also as a renewal) |

- **Renewal is manual** (CP-024 §3): nothing is ever charged on its own. A reminder notification before the end is a
  follow-up (not built).
- Ending needs no job: a membership is active while `expires_at` is in the future; an ended one reads as none.
- Upgrade pricing is the conservative of CP-024's two options (no pro-rata arithmetic that a later price change could be
  played against); the owner may choose pro-rata later.

#### 10.93.3 The app

`getMyVip` and `listVipTiers` (names and perks in the language of `Accept-Language`, else the caller's locale) feed the
«شراء VIP» page: the tier tab row in the panel's order, the selected tier's badge, price, length and the perks grid with
each perk's state, the member's status and end, and a sticky buy / renew / upgrade button with a confirm card (price, balance,
the new end; an upgrade warns that the days left are not carried) and, when the balance is short, the way to the wallet's
recharge. The wallet history names `VIP_PURCHASE` «شراء VIP».

#### 10.93.4 The panel «VIP»

`listAdminVipTiers` (`catalog.view`: OWNER, SUPPORT, FINANCE) lists every tier with its perks and active members;
`createAdminVipTier` (added last in the order, off unless `enabled: true`), `updateAdminVipTier` (any of names, colour,
the badge art, price, length, the whole perks list with each perk's art), `enableAdminVipTier` / `disableAdminVipTier`
and `reorderAdminVipTiers` (every id exactly once, lowest first) need `catalog.manage` (OWNER), the CSRF header and a
reason, and write `vip.tier.add | update | enable | disable | reorder` with before / after, the actor, the IP and
`via: panel`. A code that exists or a 21st tier → 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`. Prices are coins only (no currency). All art
is a hosted https URL for now (SVGA + still per badge / perk); an in-panel binary upload is a follow-up (D252b).

#### 10.93.5 The reference layout and the tier / perk art *(D252b v2, owner «طبق هذا التصميم ١٠٠٪», reference `REFERENCE_vip_design_v2`)*

The owner replaced the earlier reference. The «شراء VIP» page matches the new reference composition: a centred «VIP» app
bar (back chevron at the start, **no store icon**), a **horizontal tier tab row** (VIP1…VIPn, the selected one gold with
a short gold underline, the others muted; tap to select, the held tier marked), the selected tier's **large centred
BADGE**, a **gold crown divider** drawn in code, **category section headers with a count** («التعريف» / «امتياز حصري»,
matching the reference's «Identification (6/6)»), a **3-column perks grid** (each cell a thumbnail, a bold title and a
one-line grey subtitle, a lock for «قريباً»), and a **sticky bar** with the coins price / length at the reading start and
the gold **activate** button at the end — in Kabso's dark purple + gold identity, RTL-correct. (The earlier v1 curved tier
arc, hanging crest banners, status/upgrade bars and store entry were removed.) The reference's third-party ornate art
(crest, gold frames, winged crown) is **not** copied: the badge and perk art are the owner's own uploaded SVGA, and the
crown divider is drawn in code. The grid's two sections are grouped by perk code (privilege perks `DAILY_BULLET` /
`VIEWER_LIST_PRIORITY` / `MONTHLY_GIFT` vs appearance), so adding perks stays row-only.

- **Each tier has a BADGE** (the central crest «بدج / ميدالية»): `badgeAnimation` (a hosted SVGA) and `badgeStill` (a
  hosted still). **Each perk** carries its own `animation` (SVGA), `still` and the art's intrinsic `artWidth` / `artHeight`
  (not all square: the profile-card frame is 720×1280, the entrance bar 660×150). All are **hosted https URLs** uploaded
  from the admin panel — **nothing is bundled** in the app (the entry-effect SVGA alone is 13 MB), so the binary stays
  light. The app fetches and loops the SVGA (buffer-decode, the gifts `animationUrl` pattern, D126) and shows the still
  until it decodes; widget tests and screenshots show the still.
- **VIP 1 is seeded** enabled (1 000 000 coins / 30 days) with six perks (BADGE, AVATAR_FRAME, PROFILE_CARD, ENTRY_BANNER,
  CHAT_BUBBLE, ENTRY_EFFECT); its art URLs are null until the owner uploads them (a token placeholder shows meanwhile).
- `available` stays the server's list (`VIP_BUILT_PERKS`, empty): a perk shows its art as a preview with «قريباً» and is
  not yet rendered in the profile / live / DMs (separate features).

## 11. Social content — posts, comments, search and safety *(v1.5-social, DRAFT — CP-006 M1, D87)*

Additive; no earlier rule changes. Reels and video (M2), stories (M3), notifications (M4),
personalised ranking (M5), places (M6) and sharing in messages (M7) come later and extend
these rules. *(v1.41-social, D162)* Video posts and reels (M2, without server-side transcoding)
are §11.14.

### 10.94 The VIP perks *(v1.83-social, DRAFT — D258)*

The owner chose VIP 1's perks (owner: «vip1: 1,3,4,8,10,14,16,18=3,22,26=من لوحة,27=1%,30»), and a tier holds every lower
tier's perks (owner: «كل مستوى يحمل امتيازات ما قبله»). This section says what the server and the app do for each perk
code; §10.93 stays the tier / purchase rules. The perks land in phases (each phase moves its codes into
`VIP_BUILT_PERKS`, so `VipPerk.available` turns true for them).

#### 10.94.1 Perk codes and amounts

| Code | What the member gets | `amount` |
| ---- | -------------------- | -------- |
| `BADGE` | The VIP badge beside the name: chat lines, the viewers list, seats, the person card, the profile header, the Me hub. The perk's art, else the tier's crest, else a «VIPn» pill in the tier's colour. | — |
| `AVATAR_FRAME` | The animated avatar frame (the perk's SVGA, its still until it plays) around the picture on seats, the person card and the profile; an agent's or a worn bag frame keeps its own art. | — |
| `CHAT_NAME_COLOR` | The name in chat lines in a bright tint of the tier's colour. | — |
| `CHAT_BUBBLE` | The chat line drawn in the perk's still (stretched), else a bubble in the tier's colour; a worn CP bubble wins. | — |
| `PROFILE_CARD` | The person card's sheet drawn over the perk's art. | — |
| `ENTRY_BANNER`, `ENTRY_EFFECT` | On joining a live: the banner with the name, and the entry effect (the owner's car) once. | — |
| `MIC_WAVE` | The perk's SVGA around the member's seat while they speak. | — |
| `DAILY_BULLET` | Free public messages a day. | 1–100 |
| `PROFILE_VISITORS` | «من زار ملفي»: who visited the member's profile. | — |
| `DAILY_COINS` | Coins a day while the membership is active. | 1–10^9 |
| `LEVEL_SPEEDUP` | The level points earned raised by this percent. | 1–100 |

`VipPerk.amount` / `AdminVipPerk.amount` carry the number (null for other codes or not set); `AdminVipPerkInput.amount`
on another code, or out of its range → 400 `perks.N.amount` `not_allowed` / `out_of_range`. VIP 1's other six perks
are added by migration `20270306090000_vip_perks` (`DAILY_BULLET` 3, `LEVEL_SPEEDUP` 1, `DAILY_COINS` unset until the
owner sets it in the panel).

#### 10.94.2 Inheritance

A member of the tier ranked *r* holds every **enabled** perk of the tiers ranked up to *r* (`sortOrder`), by code; for a
code several tiers list, the highest-ranked tier's perk (its art and amount) wins. A perk the app does not do yet
(`available: false`) gives nothing. The server applies it for the perks it does (amounts); the app applies it from
`listVipTiers` for what it draws.

#### 10.94.3 `UserSummary.vip` and `PublicProfile.vip`

While a person's membership is active (and the account is active), every `UserSummary` (chat messages, joins, seats,
viewers, followers, a live room's `host` — D265, …) and `PublicProfile` carry `vip: {tier, rank, color}`; absent otherwise. The app keeps
`listVipTiers` for the session and draws a member's perks from it by `tier`; a tier no longer on sale shows only the
«VIPn» pill in its colour.

#### 10.94.4 Free public messages (DAILY_BULLET) and the level speed-up (LEVEL_SPEEDUP)

- **DAILY_BULLET** (VIP 1: 3): a member's first *n* `sendLiveBullet` of the day (in `LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE`) cost
  nothing — stored with `cost` 0 (the `live_bullets` CHECK is `cost >= 0`), no wallet entry. The answer carries
  `free` (this one was free) and `freeLeft` (free ones left today); both absent for someone without the perk. After
  that a bullet costs its usual coins.
- **LEVEL_SPEEDUP** (VIP 1: 1 %): the points a member's live gift earns on their own (sender) level get +*n* %
  (rounded down; `points + points·n/100`), the ledger entry's reason `VIP level speed-up +n%`. A one-point batch
  (taps' charm) rounds to nothing and is left as is.

#### 10.94.5 Daily coins (DAILY_COINS, `claimVipDailyCoins`)

`POST /me/vip/daily-coins` credits the perk's `amount` once a day (in `LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE`), wallet reason
`VIP_DAILY_COINS`; a second claim the same day answers `coins: 0` with `dailyCoins.claimedToday: true`, never a second credit.
Without the perk (or an active membership) 409 `VIP_UNAVAILABLE` `{field: "perk", issue: "no_perk"}`. `getMyVip`
carries `dailyCoins` (`amount`, `claimedToday`, `nextAt`) for a member holding the perk with an amount (VIP 1's is
seeded empty: the owner sets it in the panel). The app claims from «الخاص بي VIP» («الكوينز اليومية: 500» ·
«استلام»; «تم الاستلام اليوم» after); the wallet history shows «كوينز VIP اليومية». A free bullet's toast says how many
free ones are left today.

#### 10.94.8 How the app draws the art (owner's VIP 1 templates)

Every perk's hosted SVGA plays through one engine: downloaded once (the gift art cache), decoded once, each frame
drawn once at the size it is shown (bucketed 64…1024 px) and shared by every widget on one clock; reduced motion
shows the still (or the first frame). D272: read on another isolate, pictures decoded at their drawn size, and a clip over 12 M
pixels drawn live from a one-second window instead of kept as frames (§10.94.7). D272b: this is the app's one SVGA engine
(`lib/core/svga/svga_engine.dart`) — the gifts, the PK battle emoji and the profile headers read through it too
(§10.66). The stretchable arts follow the owner's templates (fractions of the canvas):
**CHAT_BUBBLE** (`svip_text_bubble`, 990 × 720) 9-sliced to the message (it scales with the line's height up to one
text line, 32 pt, and stretches sideways between x 620 – 760 and, for more lines, downwards between y 340 – 380 —
D265: the ornaments and the edge keep their one-line size; never narrower than its fixed parts, 529 / 457 × 32 pt; the
ornaments overflow it) over an opaque deep shade of the tier colour (D265: under the art only its fill, inside the
art's edge, no edge of ours); the name and badges sit **above**
the bubble, which holds only the message (owner). D265: in **every** chat (the host's flat chat, the audio, podcast and
video rooms of host and viewers), a text line by a member holding CHAT_BUBBLE takes this layout — line 1 the name in
the special colour, the VIP name badge right after it (D268), the tags and the levels; line 2 up to 5 medals (D269; no
line without medals); line 3 the message alone in the bubble — with the author's picture at the start where that chat shows pictures; a VIP without the bubble perk
gets the badge right after the name and the name colour in that chat's own row. **PROFILE_CARD** (`svip_box`, 720 × 1280) 9-sliced to the sheet
(scales with its width, stretches downwards; the crest rises above it); no white panel: the art's inside is measured
over a white backdrop and the text turns dark green on a light inside (≥ 4.5:1) or white on a dark one (black
backdrop); the white panel shows only while it loads. **AVATAR_FRAME** (`svip_frame`): the window is measured on the
device from the decoded art — D265: the **smallest circle holding the whole transparent opening** (rays from the
centre to the first covered pixel, alpha ≥ 40, the farthest across the frames; a ray that leaves the canvas is a gap
in the art and is left out), so the picture (1.02 × that circle) leaves no gap even where the opening is not round
(the owner's `svip_1_frame`: Ø 0.685 of the canvas, centred; D258's widest-row 0.584 left its corners open). One
geometry wherever the frame is worn: the person card, guest **and host** seats, the profile header (the bare picture,
no ring of its own; while live, the live ring wins as over every frame), the visitors list. **ENTRY_BANNER** (`svip_name`, 660 × 150): the member's picture (white ring) in the art's circle, «{name} دخل
الغرفة» in white bold with a dark 1 pt outline and a soft shadow in its bar (no plate; owner), the name ellipsized.

#### 10.94.9 «من زار ملفي» (PROFILE_VISITORS, `listProfileVisitors`)

Every `getPublicProfile` by someone else records a visit (`profile_visits`: one row per owner × visitor; the last visit
moves, `visits` grows only for an opening ≥ 10 minutes after the last; never for oneself, never while either blocked
the other; best effort — it never fails the read). Visits are recorded for everyone, so a new member sees the last 30
days at once. `GET /me/profile-visitors` (member holding PROFILE_VISITORS, else 409 `VIP_UNAVAILABLE` `no_perk`): the
visitors of the last 30 days, the latest first, at most 100 (server-bounded, §5), only ACTIVE accounts with no block
either way, `total` counting them all. The app opens it from «الخاص بي VIP» › «من زار ملفي».

#### 10.94.10 The special text colour (CHAT_NAME_COLOR, `VipTier.nameColor`)

A tier's `nameColor` (`#RRGGBB`, set in the panel next to its theme `color`; VIP 1: `#FFC928` since D268 — owner «لون
خط vip1=#FFC928», migration `20270309090000_vip1_name_color_ffc928` moves a VIP 1 still on D258's `#FFD12E`) is
the colour of its members' text: the app draws their name (chat line, person card, profile, Me hub), their chat
message (in the VIP bubble) and their entry banner line in that one solid colour — no gradient, outline, shadow or
animation (owner). Null: no special colour. The theme `color` stays for tabs, borders and the bubble's shades.

**The chat row (owner; D269 «اجعل الميداليات حدها ٥ وفي اسطر اسفل الاسم وثم سطر اسفله لتكست»).** In every chat mode,
VIP or not: line 1 the **role tag** (fixed colours: host «المضيف» red, room moderator «مشرف» orange, Kabso Team «فريق
كابسو» blue — `LiveChatRoleTag`; D273's staff line (`LiveChatAuthorBadges.kabsoTeam`) wears the blue tag here instead of its badge among the others), the name, the VIP name badge, the other tags
(«جديد», family) and the levels, every emblem one height — only the levels fade at the line's end, never the name (it
keeps its least room) or the VIP badge; line 2 up to 5 of the chosen medals on their own row (no fade, sized so 5 fit
at 360 pt; no line without medals); line 3 the message (alone in the VIP bubble for a member holding CHAT_BUBBLE). The
one-line rows (the host's flat chat, the video live's viewer rows) keep their one flowing line in the same order —
role tag, name, VIP badge, tags and levels, «:», the text — and show no medals, as before.
**One chat text size (D269, owner «ووحد حجم الخط في جميع البثوث سواء بث حي او صوتي او ستريمير او اي كان» and «اريد حجم
التكست بحجم الايف … يمكن تكبيره كم نقطة»).** A single token, `KChat` (message 14.5, name and joins 14 — the video live's
13.5 rows one point larger), read by every chat line of every live type (video / solo, multi-guest, audio, podcast,
streamer, PK; host and viewer); no per-mode sizes. The viewer's own «حجم خط الدردشة» preference still scales it. The
one-line rows' role tag is 16 pt; line-1 emblems 23 pt (≈ 1.6 × the name), medals and the VIP badge 21 pt.
D269c (owner, audio room on the phone: «حجم الخط هنا لم يتغير»): the boxed line of the audio / podcast rooms (picture,
name, badges, medals, message) is scaled down with the text so it reads like the video live's rows — a 26 pt picture
(was 32), 6 pt to the column (was 8), 6 / 5 pt padding (was 8 / 8), 12 pt corners (was 14), emblems 20 pt and medals
18 pt (were 23 / 21), the rows 3 pt apart. The text itself is `KChat` (checked by a test for the Kabso Team line too).

**The VIP name badge (D268, owner: «ايقونة vip دائماً تأتي بعد الاسم وازل الميدالية التي قبل الاسم»).** Wherever a
VIP member's name shows with their badge (every chat mode, the person card, the profile header, the Me hub, the
viewer and visitor lists, the plain entry banner) the badge comes **right after** the name; nothing VIP comes before
it. Its art is the **BADGE perk's own** still / SVGA (the panel labels that perk «شارة بجانب الاسم»; the owner's VIP 1
art is a wide pill, peacock + «VIP1», 1943 × 634), drawn at the row's emblem height and at its natural width (the
perk's `artWidth` / `artHeight`, else 1943 : 634; never squeezed into a square), its transparent sides trimmed
(measured once per still on the device). Without that art: a small «VIPn» pill in the tier's colour. The tier's
central medal (`VipTier.badgeStill` / `badgeAnimation`) is **not** used beside a name any more; it stays on the VIP
page.
**Medals cap.** D269 (v1.84-social, owner «اجعل الميداليات حدها ٥»): the profile showcase holds at most **5** medals
(`SetMedalShowcaseRequest` `maxItems` 5, 400 `too_big` beyond; 3 in D258, 6 before); a longer showcase saved before is
read as its first 5 (trimmed on read, no migration); chat lines carry at most 5 (`LiveChatAuthorBadges.medals`); the
app's picker, person card, profile and chat show up to 5.

#### 10.94.11 The «شراء VIP» page (owner, reference 38)

Text tier tabs (the chosen one brighter over a small ornament line); the tier's big badge on a stage with a glow in the
tier's colour; a panel with a curved top holding «التعريف» and a 3-column grid of square tiles — each a live preview of
the perk (the frame around a sample picture, the banner, the special-coloured sample name, the card, the car, the mic
wave, the bubble) or, without art, its icon and value («٣ يومياً», «+1%») — the perk's title under it. The purchase panel
(full width, curved top, gold edge) shows the price in gold «… كوينز / 30 يوماً» (a renewal's list price struck
through), the package's value from real tier data («إجمالي استرجاع … كوينز (… يومياً)»، «+1٪ تسريع المستوى»), «خصم 15٪
عند التجديد» when a discount is set, and one gold button (no VIP gifting exists). Tiles have no fill, only the border. The page's background is a deep
gradient of the tier's colour in both modes (supersedes D252c's white / black), cross-fading as the tabs change.

#### 10.94.12 The renewal discount (owner: «نعم أضفه وفعّله»)

Each tier has `renewalDiscountPercent` (0 – 90, whole; 15 by default and on a new tier; 0 = none), set in the panel
(`updateAdminVipTier`, audited). Buying the **same tier** again while the membership is active (RENEW) or up to
`VIP_RENEWAL_GRACE_DAYS` = **7** days after it ended (a new term, `kind` NEW) is charged `priceCoins × (100 − d) / 100`,
rounded down; a first purchase and an UPGRADE pay the list price. `VipTier.renewPriceCoins` quotes the renewal price;
`MyVip.renewal` (`tierId`, `priceCoins`, `discountPercent`, `until`) is present while the discount applies, and the app
sends that `priceCoins` — any other price is 409 `VIP_PRICE_CHANGED` (the idempotency hash covers it as before). The
purchase records the charged `priceCoins`, `listPriceCoins` and `discountPercent` (also in `VipPurchaseResult` and the
audit). Migration `20270306090500_vip_renewal_discount`.

#### 10.94.6 Uploading the art (`uploadAdminVipArt`)

`POST /admin/vip/uploads?kind=animation|still&tier=CODE` (catalog.manage, CSRF): the raw bytes; `animation` an SVGA 2.x
(≤ 25 MB, the gifts' checks), `still` a PNG / WebP (≤ 2 MB, 16 … 4 096 px a side, any shape, its size answered). Stored
content-addressed under `media/vip/<tier>/`; the answer's `url` goes into the tier's badge / perk fields
(`updateAdminVipTier` is the audited step). The panel's tier form has «رفع صورة» / «رفع SVGA» per perk.

#### 10.94.7 Entry banner, entry car and mic wave (app)

- **ENTRY_BANNER**: a `join` whose `user.vip` holds it shows the perk's art (its `artWidth` / `artHeight`
  proportions, 62 % of the screen's width, 16 lp from the edges, the agents' bar place and 3.2 s timing) with
  «دخل … البث» on a 70 % black plate (white text ≥ 7:1 on any art); without art, a bar in deep shades of the tier's
  colour with the VIP badge. An agent's own bar (§10.48, §10.52) wins over it.
- **ENTRY_EFFECT**: the perk's SVGA plays **once**, centred across the room, then leaves (at most 10 s; reduced
  motion or a broken file: nothing). Downloaded once through the gift art cache (D126) and kept on the device.
  *(D331, §10.125: its whole length, at most 15.5 s, and a portrait or square car covers the whole screen.)*
- D272 (owner: «مؤثر الدخول يتوقف يعلق ولا يحتوي على صوت»): the owner's car (`peacock`, 13.8 MB: 75 full-canvas
  563 × 1000 PNG frames at 12 fps, 6.25 s, and a 6.75 s MP3) froze the room — the file was inflated, parsed and every
  picture decoded **full size** (169 MB) on the UI isolate, then all 75 frames drawn at once (177 MB, over the whole
  24 M-pixel cache, evicting every badge and bubble), and the 10 s limit counted from the `join`, so a slow download
  cut the car mid-way; its MP3 was dropped. Now: the file is read on **another isolate** into plain data
  (`VipSvgaDoc`); each picture is decoded by the engine at the size it is drawn (never bigger); a clip whose frames
  would take more than 12 M pixels is drawn **live** from about a second of decoded pictures (the ones behind
  released; ≈ 32 MB for the car); the frames of the others are drawn one at a time without holding the UI. The art
  is read ahead as the `join` is queued (and the host's own at start); the car **starts only when ready** (the first
  second decoded; at most 8 s to get there, else it is skipped and stays read for the next time) and then has its
  own length + 1 s (at most 10 s; an MP4 car, D270, keeps the 10 s from its start). A late picture keeps the last frame a moment; the clock (and the sound) go on.
- D272 **sound**: the SVGA's own sound (`MovieEntity.audios`: from `startFrame`, `startTime` ms into it) plays with
  the **car** — or the **banner** when there is no car — through the gifts' player (§10.66: media volume, no audio
  focus on Android so the live keeps playing, the live's iOS audio session untouched), only while «المؤثرات
  الصوتية» is on and the app is in the foreground. One entrance's sound at a time (a new one stops the one before);
  it stops when the car ends (the art's last 0.5 s of sound is cut with it), is removed, or the app leaves the
  foreground. Reduced motion: the still and **no sound** (a sound without its motion; reduced-motion viewers asked
  for less). The device's silent switch is not read, as for the gifts' sounds. Badges, frames, bubbles, cards and
  mic waves never play sound.
- D265: a VIP member's `join` is never dropped by the one-a-second join window (like an agent's, §10.48); the host
  is never a viewer (no `join`), so a VIP host's own banner and car play once on their own screen when the live goes
  on air.
- **MIC_WAVE**: while the member speaks on a guest seat, the perk's art plays behind the picture (1.7 ×) in place of
  the plain glow; the Couple Mic Effect wins.
- All three follow «إخفاء تأثيرات الدخول» (D225) where entrances do; one at a time, at most 5 waiting.


### 10.95 The live's real host cherries *(v1.63-live, DRAFT — D259)*

The owner saw «50 coins → 5,000 🍒» in the host pill: the pill drew the live **score** (CP-012 points: 100 per gift
coin, 1 per tap) beside the cherry icon, so it read as cherries. Owner decision: the pill shows the cherries the host
really received; the score stays for ranking and PK, never with the cherry icon.

- **`LiveScore.hostCherries`** — the cherries the host's balance was credited for gifts received in this live: for
  each send, the host's recipient row `floor(coins × host_share_bps × CHERRIES_PER_COIN / 10 000)` (the D179 cherry
  ledger's `GIFT_RECEIVED` credit, §10.46; normal gifts 65 %, quips 50 %, lucky gifts their stored host share; a free
  quip credits nothing). Only the **host's** share counts (gifts to seated guests credit the guests, not the host's
  pill); a host's gift to themself counts when the ledger credits it. Kept in `live_room_scores.host_cherries`, added in
  the send's own transaction right after the ledger credit, so it is exactly what the balance received.
- Returned in `LiveRoom.scoreParts`, `LiveTapsResult.score` and `LiveRoomStats.score` (host data page «كرز جديد»).
- **Live updates:** the media room metadata carries `hostCherries` next to `score` (written with the score's 2-second
  throttle, §10.10; left out while 0, so rooms without gifts keep their metadata unchanged). Apps read a missing key
  as 0.
- **The score is points:** apps never draw `total`, `supportPoints` or contribution points with the cherry icon.
- Lives before v1.63-live are backfilled from their stored sends at the default CHERRIES_PER_COIN (10); a deployment
  with another rate keeps the backfill's approximation for old lives only.
### 10.96 «فريق كابسو» — staff presence in lives *(v1.64-live, DRAFT — D260)*

The owner asked for staff accounts that watch every live (owner: «حسابات موظفين تدخل البثوث لمراقبتها»; answers 2026-11-04:
**visible** with a «فريق كابسو» badge, **every new live assigned automatically**, **real employee accounts** — the panel's
OWNER / MODERATION / SUPPORT staff, each action audited per person). No fake viewers: staff are never counted as viewers.
Builds on §10.91 (D250).

**10.96.1 The shift «في المناوبة».** A watch staff member (OWNER, MODERATION, SUPPORT — `lives.watch`) switches their own
shift: `getAdminMyShift` / `setAdminMyShift` (`GET` / `PUT /admin/me/shift`, `{onShift}`; `AdminShift {onShift, since,
assignedLives}`). Idempotent; a change is audited `admin.shift.on` {assigned} / `admin.shift.off` {released}, `via: panel`.
`listAdminShifts` (`GET /admin/shifts`, capability `staff.shifts`: OWNER) lists every watch staff member (on shift first) with
their roles, shift and the lives they watch now, plus `onShift` and `unassignedLives`. FINANCE has no shift. Table
`admin_shifts` (one row per staff member).

**10.96.2 Assignment.** Every LIVE room is assigned to one staff member on shift (`live_room_assignments`, one row per room):

- **Spread by load**: the staff member with the fewest assigned lives on air; ties go to the one assigned least recently,
  then the earliest shift. Never one's own live.
- **Reported lives first** (§10.91.2's open reports): the pending lives are assigned most-reported first, then oldest; a
  reported live goes to OWNER / MODERATION (who may act on it) whenever one is on shift — a live already held by SUPPORT
  moves to them when it is reported (audit reason `reported`, `previousAdminId`). With nobody but SUPPORT on shift, SUPPORT
  watches it.
- **When**: after a live starts (best effort, after the reply), when someone goes on or off shift, and at the stale-room
  sweeper's cadence (`LIVE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`: newly reported lives, ended lives released).
- **Handing on**: going off shift, losing every watch role or the ADMIN role, or the account no longer ACTIVE releases one's
  lives to the others on shift; nobody on shift → they wait unassigned (the OWNER's list shows how many).
- One pass at a time (an advisory lock); each new assignment is audited `admin.live.assign` (no actor) {adminId, reason
  `live_start | shift_on | shift_off | sweep | reported`, reports, previousAdminId}.

«بثوثي»: `listAdminLives?assigned=me`; each `AdminLiveRow` gains `assignedTo {id, displayName}` (null: nobody on shift) and
`staffWatching` (staff watching it visibly now).

**10.96.3 The visible watch.** `createAdminLiveWatchToken` gains `visibility` (`VISIBLE | HIDDEN`). A WATCH is **VISIBLE by
default**: identity `team:<adminId>:<nonce>`, subscribe-only (no publishing, no data) but **not hidden** (the media server's
participant list shows it). It is recorded in `live_room_staff_watchers` — never in `live_room_viewers`, never counted in
`viewerCount` / the peak, no «joined» chat line, no statistics visit. Leaving, the room finishing, `closeMedia` and the
reconciliation remove it; a join to a room not LIVE, or a malformed `team:` identity, is disconnected. HIDDEN is the D250
observer (`staff:`) and needs `lives.watch.hidden` (OWNER, MODERATION — undercover checks); SUPPORT asking for it → 403
`AUTH_FORBIDDEN`. A PREVIEW and the PK opponent's room are always hidden. The response and the audit gain `visibility`.

**10.96.4 What the app shows.** `LiveViewerPage.staff` (first page only; absent from an older server): `[{displayName,
avatarUrl, since}]`, one per staff member (earliest first) — their panel account's name and picture, no id or username.
The viewer list shows them above the viewers with the «فريق كابسو» / «Kabso Team» badge; the tab's number counts viewers
only; a tap opens a short «فريق كابسو» note (no person card, no action). By the top viewers, a blue shield while staff
watch — never one of the faces, never in the TOP 1 / 2 / 3 support ranking (the Contribution list is gifts and taps; staff
neither). Older apps ignore `staff`.

**Compatibility.** Additive for the apps. Panel: a WATCH without `visibility` is now visible (D250's panel always watched
hidden); the panel sends `HIDDEN` from its «مراقبة خفية» switch. Media load: one extra subscriber per watched live.

**10.96.5 «الموظفون والصلاحيات» — the OWNER manages the staff from the panel *(v1.66-live, DRAFT — D271)*.** Owner:
«اجعل امنحهم صلاحية من لوحة الأدمن» — the staff of §10.96 get their role from the panel, not only from the CLI. The page is
D197's team page (§10.60.6, `team.manage`: **OWNER only**, checked on every request), renamed and extended:

- **The list** (`listAdminTeam`): every panel admin — name, `@username`, email, roles, authenticator set up or not, lock,
  last sign-in, and the shift (`onShift`, `shiftSince`; FINANCE: «لا مناوبة لهذا الدور»).
- **Grant** (`grantAdminTeamRole` `{account, role, reason, totpCode}`): an existing app account by **email or username**
  (`@` optional; D197's `email` field still accepted, exactly one of the two). Refused (409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`,
  `details[0] = {field: rule, issue}`): `team_no_account`; `team_not_active` (SUSPENDED = banned, PENDING_DELETION,
  DELETED); `team_locked` (an active D208 lock). The answer's `account` drives the panel's **next steps** for the new staff
  member: sign in at `admin.<domain>` with the app account's email and password, enrol the authenticator (or «already set
  up»), open «البث الآن» and turn on «في المناوبة» (FINANCE: no shift). Granting OWNER shows a warning in the dialog.
- **Revoke** (`revokeAdminTeamRole`; the CLI's `revoke` the same, except the self rule): never one's own OWNER
  (`team_self_owner`), never the last OWNER who can sign in
  (`team_last_owner`: no other OWNER that is ACTIVE with `users.role = ADMIN`; a banned OWNER's role may go). The check
  holds a transaction advisory lock, so two OWNERs revoking each other at once cannot both pass. `team_not_held` for a
  role the person does not hold. The last panel role ends the person's panel sessions (as the CLI). **No watch role left**
  (OWNER / MODERATION / SUPPORT) → the person goes off shift in the same transaction (audit metadata `shiftEnded`), and
  the API runs an assignment pass at once (reason `shift_off`), handing their lives on (§10.96.2). This applies to the CLI
  too.
- **Reset the authenticator** (`resetAdminTeamTotp`): a lost phone — the secret, recovery codes and lock go and the
  person's panel sessions end; never one's own (`team_self_reset`), only a team member (`team_not_member`).
- **Step-up.** Each change needs the reason and **a fresh code from the OWNER's own authenticator**, verified by the server
  before any rule runs (the session's TOTP, single use per 30 s step; a wrong code is 403 `ADMIN_TOTP_INVALID` and counts
  towards the lockout, which ends the OWNER's sessions — a hijacked panel session alone cannot change the team). Missing
  code or reason: 400.
- **Audit.** `admin.role.grant` / `admin.role.revoke` / `admin.totp.reset` with the OWNER as the actor, the IP, `via:
  panel`, the reason, and the role / `madeAdmin` / `before` / `left` / `shiftEnded`.
- **Limits.** On top of `admin:ip`, the three changes count in `admin-team:ip` (`RATE_LIMIT_ADMIN_TEAM_IP`, 20 / 15 min per
  IP; 429 `RATE_LIMITED`).
- **One rule.** The panel and `admin-admin` run the same functions (`admin-roles.ts`: `grantRoleIn`, `revokeRoleIn`,
  `resetSecondFactorIn`), and the role rows are written only through `kabso_admin_panel_role`. The account is found by id,
  email or username with its `users` row locked FOR NO KEY UPDATE. **The last active OWNER is refused in the CLI too**
  (owner 2026-11-04): `admin-admin revoke <email> OWNER` exits 1 with «This is the last OWNER: grant OWNER to another
  active account first, then revoke this one.» (nothing changes, no audit row); only the self-OWNER refusal is panel-only
  (the CLI has no actor). The CLI stays the bootstrap of the first OWNER.

**10.96.6 «فريق كابسو» from the app — the badge, the tools and the shift *(v1.68-live, DRAFT — D273)*.** Owner: staff are
always visible from the app, have the panel's live powers on the phone («بعض الموظفين ليس لديهم لابتوب»), keep their shift
there, may watch hidden «كما في اللوحة», and roam freely.

- **Who.** An account holding OWNER, MODERATION or SUPPORT now (ACTIVE, `users.role = ADMIN` — the panel's `rolesOf`, read on
  every request; a revoked role or a suspension applies at once). `Me.kabsoTeam` (the Me tab's «فريق كابسو» entry);
  `getStaffStatus` (`GET /staff/me`, any account) gives roles, the tools' capabilities, the authenticator, the lockout, this
  session's step-up and the shift. FINANCE is not «فريق كابسو» in lives (an ordinary viewer) but is protected (§10.96.7).
- **Entering a live (no step-up).** From the app, `createLiveMediaToken` for such an account (not the host) always answers
  `staff: VISIBLE` with the D260 `team:<id>:<nonce>` identity: listed in `LiveViewerPage.staff` with the badge, never counted
  in `viewerCount` / the peak, no join line, no statistics visit — exactly the panel's visible watch. **Any live** (free
  roaming): staff are never kept out by a kick, a block either way (§10.96.7) or a chat mute; the assignment (§10.96.2) only
  decides who is responsible. A losing of the role drops the badge at once (the list reads the roles now) and the API
  disconnects the person's `team:` / `staff:` connections (`dropStaffPresence`, the reconciliation repeats it); their next
  token is an ordinary viewer's.
- **Hidden «مراقبة خفية».** `LiveMediaTokenRequest.staffVisibility: HIDDEN` → the D250 `staff:<id>:<nonce>` observer (not
  listed, not counted, no chat) — `lives.watch.hidden` (OWNER, MODERATION; SUPPORT 403 `AUTH_FORBIDDEN`); *(D286: no
  step-up code any more)*; any other account 403. The app asks «دخول ظاهر (فريق كابسو)» or «مراقبة
  خفية» once per app run and switches from the staff sheet (it joins again). Every staff token from the app is audited
  `admin.live.watch` {visibility, identity, `via: app`}.
- **In the live.** Chat lines carry `LiveChatMessage.authorStaff` (read live): the app shows «فريق كابسو» instead of levels,
  family, VIP / store wear, agent badges and the CP bubble (`authorBadges` empty, `cpBubble` false). **No economy** (owner's
  suggestion, decided): no gifts, taps or bullets and no seat (request or accept) while staff — 403 `LIVE_STAFF_REFUSED`
  (`details[0].issue` `gifts` / `taps` / `bullets` / `seat`; a hidden observer's chat `hidden_chat`), so no conflict of
  interest and no points from the team. DMs and gifts outside a live are unchanged.
- **The step-up — deprecated in v1.76-live (D286, §10.96.14): no tool and no hidden watch needs it any more; the routes
  are kept for older apps (which never call them: `StaffStatus.stepUp` is always set for watch staff). As it was:**
  `createStaffStepUp` `{code}` — the staff member's **panel authenticator** (the same secret, the same
  single-use step, **the same lockout**: a wrong code is 403 `ADMIN_TOTP_INVALID` and counts; at `ADMIN_LOCKOUT_ATTEMPTS` the
  admin account locks, every panel session **and every app grant** ends, 429 `ADMIN_LOCKED`). Not enrolled yet → 409
  `STAFF_TOTP_NOT_ENROLLED` (the app: «فعّل تطبيق المصادقة أولاً من لوحة الإدارة: admin.kabsolive.com»). A grant
  (`admin_app_grants`) is bound to the user **and this app session**, lasts `STAFF_APP_GRANT_SECONDS` (12 h), replaces the
  session's previous one, and ends with sign-out / the session's revocation (the bearer guard refuses the session; the row
  cascades), `endStaffStepUp` «إنهاء», **any** revoked role (`ROLE_REVOKED`; a re-grant needs a new code), a lockout
  (`LOCKED`), a reset authenticator (`TOTP_RESET`). Audited `admin.app.step_up` / `admin.app.step_up_end`. Badge visibility
  never needs it; every tool does.
- **The tools** (tag `staff`, bearer session; every route checks the role and the panel capability on every request —
  `StaffAppGuard`; D286: no step-up; the panel's rule functions run with an `AdminContext` of `via: app`):

  | Route | Capability | OWNER | MODERATION | SUPPORT |
  |---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|
  | `getStaffShift` / `setStaffShift` (`/staff/shift`, the panel's shift rule, audited `via: app`), `listStaffLives` «بثوثي» | `lives.watch` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
  | `listStaffLiveReports` (the room, its host, its chat and users reported inside it, with the reporter), `listStaffLiveModerations` | `lives.reports` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
  | `moderateStaffLive` (the panel's END / **WARN** / NO_LIVE / SUSPEND; DEVICE_BAN also `devices.ban` + the code), `dismissStaffLiveReports` | `lives.moderate` | ✓ | ✓ | |
  | `kickFromStaffLive`, `muteInStaffLive`, `removeStaffLiveMessage` (the room's rules as «فريق كابسو») | `lives.moderate` | ✓ | ✓ | |

  Every action takes a reason (400 without) and is audited with the actor, IP, request id, the reason and `via: app`
  (`admin.live.moderate`, `admin.live.reports_dismiss`, `live.kick` {staff, reason}, `admin.live.chat_mute`,
  `admin.live.chat_remove`). The host learns «فريق Kabso» and the reason, never a name: `LIVE_MODERATED` has no actor (WARN
  reads «تنبيه من فريق Kabso على بثك»), and a staff kick's data message has `by: null`, `byTeam: true`. A hidden observer uses
  the tools too. Kicking or removing a message closes that person's / message's open reports made in the live as ACTIONED.
  **WARN** is new for the panel's `moderateAdminLive` too (the same rule; the live goes on). The live's reports (panel and app)
  now include its chat messages' reports and USER reports made inside it (`CreateReportRequest.liveRoomId`, kept as
  `reports.context_live_room_id`; counted for «لايفات مبلّغ عنها» and the assignment priority); an action on the live closes
  them all.
- **Limits.** Every staff route counts in `staff:user` (`RATE_LIMIT_STAFF_APP_USER`, 300 / 15 min per user, replacing the
  default); the step-up also in `staff-step-up:user` (`RATE_LIMIT_STAFF_STEP_UP_USER`, 10 / 15 min) on top of the lockout.

**10.96.7 Nobody acts on «فريق كابسو» from the app *(v1.68-live, DRAFT — D273)*.** An account holding **any** panel role
(OWNER, MODERATION, SUPPORT, FINANCE) cannot be acted on by a user: a live kick (`kickFromLive`), a live chat mute, removing
their live chat message (host or room moderator), a seat mute or removal, a family member removal, a family chat mute or a
family chat message removal → 403 `STAFF_PROTECTED` («لا يمكن اتخاذ إجراء ضد فريق كابسو»); one staff member cannot remove
another's message from the staff tools either. `PublicProfile.kabsoTeam` lets the app hide those buttons. Not "against" and
kept: making them a room moderator and taking it back, a family role change, the PK opponent mute (it mutes a host's audio in
one's own room), lifting an old mute. **Blocks (decided):** a user may block a staff account — it still applies to DMs,
follows, comments and the rest of the app — but it never keeps staff from finding, entering or moderating a live (the live
discovery, `visibleRow` and the token ignore a block either way, a kick and a chat mute for watch staff). Reporting a staff
account stays possible (the report goes to the queue).

**10.96.8 Reports reach the responsible staff member's phone *(v1.68-live, DRAFT — D273)*.** A new report about a live —
`LIVE_ROOM`, a `USER` report of its host while on air, a `LIVE_CHAT_MESSAGE` of its chat, or a `USER` reported with
`liveRoomId` — alerts (best effort, after the report is stored): the live's assigned staff member if on shift; else an
assignment pass runs first (D260: a reported live goes to OWNER / MODERATION when one is on shift) and its holder; still
nobody → every OWNER / MODERATION on shift; none → every OWNER. Never the reporter or the live's host. Each recipient has one
unread `LIVE_STAFF_REPORT` notification per live (target `LIVE_ROOM`: `id` the live, `text` the host's name, `thumbUrl` their
picture, `live`); a new report moves it up and pushes it again. The push says only «بلاغ جديد على بث» and the host's name
(`New report on <host>'s live`) — no reporter, reason or note. It is a system notification (always on); a staff member **on
shift** gets it even within the general gap between pushes (`PUSH_GENERAL_GAP_SECONDS`) and the per-row minute; off shift (the
OWNERs' fallback) the usual push rules apply. Audited `live.staff_report.alert` {reportId, recipients, route `assigned` |
`actors` | `owners`} and `live.staff_report.push` {recipientId, sent, onShift}. A tap (inbox or push) opens the live as staff
with «أدوات فريق كابسو» on its reports (`/home/room/<id>?staff=reports`).

**10.96.9 «تحذير المضيف» in the panel *(D273b — panel only, no contract change)*.** Owner-approved: the panel gets the
D273 WARN the app's staff tools already have. On the live card's ⋯ menu («البث الآن») and the watch view's actions
(`/lives/<id>`), next to «إغلاق البث», while the live is on air, for the roles with `lives.moderate` (OWNER, MODERATION —
the capability `moderateAdminLive` requires; SUPPORT and FINANCE never see it). The dialog asks for a written message
(«رسالة التحذير (تصل للمضيف)», required, up to 500) — no scope, duration or code — and sends
`POST /admin/lives/{roomId}/moderate {action: WARN, reason}`, the same shared rule (`AdminLiveModerationService.moderate`)
and body as `moderateStaffLive`: the live goes on, the open reports are ACTIONED, the host gets one `LIVE_MODERATED`
(«تنبيه من فريق Kabso», never a staff name), audited `admin.live.moderate` {kind: WARN, via: panel}. The live's moderation
history («إجراءات الفريق على هذا البث») names each kind instead of the raw value: WARN «تحذير للمضيف» / "Host warned",
END «إغلاق البث», NO_LIVE «منع من البث», SUSPEND «تعليق الحساب», DEVICE_BAN «حظر جهاز» (an unknown kind shows as is).

**10.96.10 The Kabso Team's accounts are limited *(v1.72-live, DRAFT — D283)*.** Owner: «الشخص الذي بفريق الادارة لدينا
لا يمكنه فتح لايف وليس لديه ليفيلات — فقط سوف يكون له ايقونة التي وضعناها وإطار، بالاضافة لاعداداته وصفحته الشخصية فقط،
يمكن ان يقوم بتنزيل بوست اعلان فقط او ريلز اعلان»; then the fixed picture («وهذه الصورة الشخصية الخاص بالادمن والمشرفين
بحيث لا يمكن تغييرها»), the locked frame («لا يمكنه وضع اطار غيره ويبقى مثبت») and covers, and a staff-only Me tab.

- **Who.** A **limited staff account** holds MODERATION, SUPPORT or FINANCE and **not** OWNER (ACTIVE, `users.role = ADMIN`,
  read on every request like `rolesOf`: `live-staff.ts` `limitedStaffAmong` / `refuseLimitedStaff`). **The OWNER's
  account stays a normal account** (it goes live, has levels, posts anything); an account holding OWNER and another role
  is the OWNER's. `Me.staff` and `PublicProfile.staff` (`KabsoStaffIdentity {role, regions}`: the role its line names —
  MODERATION, else SUPPORT, else FINANCE — and §10.96.11's regions, none for FINANCE) are present only for them.
- **No live.** `startLiveRoom` (solo, audio, podcast, streamer, multi-guest: one operation) → 403 `STAFF_ACCOUNT_LIMITED`
  `live` before any other rule after the hosting switch; so are announcing a live (`createLiveScheduleSlot`) and applying
  to host (`applyForHosting`). D273's in-live rules still hold (no gifts, taps, bullets or seat for watch staff).
- **No levels.** `getUserLevels` answers `{data: []}` for them (a profile and a person card show none);
  `LiveChatAuthorBadges` of their chat lines is empty (no levels, family, medals or newcomer tag). Their points still
  accrue (nothing is deleted); nothing shows them. The app also hides the own levels page and badges (`Me.staff`).
- **Picture, frame and cover are the team's, locked.** Their `avatar_url` **is** the team picture
  (`GET /api/v1/staff/team-avatar.png`, public, the owner's Kabi-in-a-suit art bundled with the API): the API sets it on a
  grant and at its start, and gives the person's own photo back (`staff_saved_avatar_url`) when the last limited role
  goes or OWNER is granted — so every surface (profiles, chat, viewers, seats, DMs, comments, posts, the panel; older apps
  too) shows it with no other change. `setMyAvatar` / `removeMyAvatar` → 403 `avatar`; `setMyCover` / `removeMyCover` →
  403 `cover`; `updateMe` with `bio` → 403 `bio` (D283b: «اجعل بايو ملفت واجمل»; the other fields of the same request
  are not applied either); equipping an `AVATAR_FRAME` from the bag → 403 `frame`. `PublicProfile.coverUrl` and `avatarFrame` are null
  and `vip` / `wear` absent for them; a `UserSummary` carrying the team picture has no `avatarFrame`, `vip` or `wear`.
  The app draws the team frame (`assets/staff/kabso_team_frame.png`, its photo window measured from the art) around the
  picture everywhere, and the region's team cover (`assets/staff/covers/`: `ARAB_WORLD` → `arab_world.webp`, any other
  region or none → `international.webp`).
- **Announcements only.** `CreatePostRequest.announcement: true` makes an official announcement post or reel
  (`Post.announcement`, required in responses, never changes) — the feeds label it «إعلان رسمي — فريق كابسو» /
  "Official announcement — Kabso Team". Only a panel role may send it (the OWNER too; anyone else 403 `{field:
  announcement}`), and a limited staff account must (403 `post_kind` without it). No stories (`story`) and no reposts
  (`repost`; undoing one is allowed). Comments, likes, follows and DMs stay.
- **The rest (decided).** Families: neither create nor join (`family`; a membership from before the role is kept until
  they leave). VIP: no purchase (`vip`). Store: no purchase (`store`). Tasks and targets: none listed, check-in and claims
  refused (`tasks`). Gifts outside a live (DMs) are unchanged; in a live D273 already refuses them for watch staff. The
  wallet's top-up and withdrawal are not changed server-side (the Me tab no longer shows them).
- **The entry car (decided with the owner: «سيارة دخولية للمشرفين والإدارة»).** A visible entry «فريق كابسو» of a limited
  staff account sends the chat topic's `staff-join` data message (§10.11) — never for a hidden watch or the OWNER. The
  apps play the team's bundled entry car (`assets/staff/kabso_team_entry.svga`, bottom-anchored full width like the VIP
  car, once per join, not again after minimize / restore, with its sound); a FINANCE account joining as a viewer (its
  `join` carries the team picture) gets the same car. It is their only entrance: no VIP or store car, banner or effect.
- **The app.** For `Me.staff` the Me tab shows only the profile header (team badge, frame), «فريق كابسو»
  (D273's shift, «بثوثي», tools), the announcement composer and settings; go live, levels, VIP, family, earn money, store,
  wallet, bag, agency, recharge agent, creator / event / task centres, medals, rankings and CP are hidden, and their
  routes show a short «غير متاح لحسابات فريق كابسو» note. **The official bio (D283b, owner: «اجعل بايو ملفت واجمل لانه
  هذه شركة بالعربي والانجليزي»):** a staff profile and the staff Me tab never show the stored `bio`; the app shows a
  fixed card «الحساب الرسمي» / "Official account" (red-to-dark gradient, thin gold border, shield, the region line)
  — *(v1.74-live, D283d)* the **only** place of the region line: it is no longer shown under the name / ID line of the
  staff profile header or of the staff Me tab
  with the company's text in the viewer's language; edit profile shows the bio row locked.

**10.96.11 Regions «تجزئة الإشراف» *(v1.72-live, DRAFT — D283)*.** Owner: «ان كان مشرف عربي يكتب في صفحته مشرف للوطن
العربي، وان كان صيني يكتب كذلك، وان كان اجنبي يكتب مشرف لـ…. قم بتجزئة الاشراف كل مشرف مسؤول عن دول معينة بما يناسب».

- **The catalogue** (`staff-regions.ts`, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, each country in at most one region; CHECK
  `admin_staff_regions_code`): `ARAB_WORLD` الوطن العربي (the 22 Arab League members), `GREATER_CHINA` الصين الكبرى (CN HK
  MO TW), `TURKEY` تركيا, `IRAN` إيران, `SOUTH_ASIA` جنوب آسيا (AF BD BT IN LK MV NP PK), `SOUTHEAST_ASIA` جنوب شرق آسيا (BN
  ID KH LA MM MY PH SG TH TL VN), `EAST_ASIA` شرق آسيا (JP KP KR MN), `EUROPE` أوروبا, `NORTH_AMERICA` أمريكا الشمالية (BM
  CA GL PM US), `LATIN_AMERICA` أمريكا اللاتينية (Mexico, Central and South America, the Caribbean), `SUB_SAHARAN_AFRICA`
  أفريقيا جنوب الصحراء, `RUSSIA_CENTRAL_ASIA` روسيا وآسيا الوسطى (AM AZ BY GE KG KZ RU TJ TM UZ), `OCEANIA` أوقيانوسيا.
  `listAdminStaffRegions` lists them with both names and their countries. A country in none (e.g. IL) or a host with no
  country falls back to the load rule.
- **Assigning** (`setAdminTeamRegions`, `PUT /admin/team/{userId}/regions {regions, reason, totpCode}`; `team.manage`:
  OWNER only, the OWNER's code again, `admin-team:ip`): the whole set (0–13, no duplicates). Only for an account holding
  MODERATION or SUPPORT (else 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` `team_regions_role`). Audited `admin.team.regions` {before,
  regions, reason, via}. `listAdminTeam` rows gain `regions`.
- **The profile line.** The app writes the role and the region names in the viewer's language: MODERATION «مشرف للوطن
  العربي» / "Moderator — Arab World", SUPPORT «دعم — الصين الكبرى» / "Support — Greater China", two regions joined («مشرف
  للوطن العربي وتركيا»), three or more «… وأكثر» / "… and more"; no region: the role word alone; FINANCE «المالية» /
  "Finance".
- **Assignment (§10.96.2) and report alerts (§10.96.8).** A live goes to an on-shift staff member whose region covers the
  host's country (`user_profiles.country_code`) first — among them the D260 load order — and only when none is on shift
  (or the country has no region) to the whole pool by load, as before. A reported live still goes to OWNER / MODERATION
  first. The report alert's `actors` fallback keeps the region's actors when any.
- **Filters.** «بثوثي»: `listStaffLives?scope=regions` — every live on air whose host's country is in my regions (at
  most 200; `assignedAt` null when it is held by someone else); `scope=assigned` (default) as before. The panel's «البث
  الآن»: `listAdminLives?region=<code>|mine`. `AdminLiveRow` and `StaffLive` gain `hostCountry` and `region`.

**10.96.12 The official staff ID «Kabso01» *(v1.73-live, DRAFT — D283c)*.** Owner: «ايدي للمشرفين والادارة بحيث ايدي
الموظفين يبدأ Kabso01». Every account given a panel role gets an official staff ID; the apps show it where they show the
@username.

- **Who.** Every panel role — MODERATION, SUPPORT, FINANCE **and the OWNER** (decision: «الادارة» includes the OWNER).
  The OWNER's account otherwise stays a normal one (§10.96.10).
- **The primary OWNER is «Kabso»** *(v1.74-live, D283d; owner correction: «المالك… لا، kabso»)*: number 0, shown as plain
  `Kabso` (no digits). It goes to the **earliest OWNER grant** — the account that takes OWNER while nobody ever held 0
  (normally the OWNER bootstrapped with the CLI); a person who already had a staff number then gives it up (retired).
  **Any other OWNER** (decision) gets the next number like the staff (`Kabso07`). «Kabso» is retired like every number:
  if the primary OWNER's role ends it stays theirs (shown again on a re-grant) and no other OWNER ever gets it.
- **Format.** `Kabso` for the primary OWNER; otherwise `Kabso` + the number, two digits until 99 (`Kabso01` …
  `Kabso99`), then as many as needed (`Kabso100`); the staff numbering starts at `Kabso01` with the first staff member
  who is not the primary OWNER. Schema `StaffId`, pattern `^Kabso(0[1-9]|[1-9][0-9]{1,8})?$`.
- **Assignment.** Given in the grant's own transaction by `kabso_admin_panel_role` (panel `grantAdminTeamRole` and the
  `admin-admin grant` CLI alike) through `kabso_assign_staff_id(user, isOwnerGrant)`: under the transaction advisory lock
  `kabso:staff-id`, 0 for the primary OWNER (above), else `MAX(number) + 1` — concurrent grants queue, so numbers are never duplicated and never skipped (a rolled-back or refused
  grant gives nothing away, unlike a sequence). Table `staff_ids` (`number` PK, CHECK `staff_ids_number_nonnegative`,
  `user_id` UNIQUE `staff_ids_user_id_key`, FK `ON DELETE SET NULL`); **read-only for the runtime role** (only the
  SECURITY DEFINER functions write it). A second role keeps the person's number.
- **Revoke and re-grant — retired, never reused** (decision). A revoke keeps the row: the ID is no longer shown (nor
  searchable in the app) while the person holds no panel role or the account is not ACTIVE, but nobody else can ever get
  it, so old reports and audit rows stay unambiguous. A re-grant shows the same number again. A purged account leaves
  its number behind with `user_id` NULL. `admin.role.grant` audit rows carry `staffId`.
- **Where it appears.** `Me.staffId`, `PublicProfile.staffId`, `UserSummary.staffId` (live viewers and chat, the person
  card, search, lists — every summary built with the shared summary select), and `KabsoStaffIdentity.staffId` inside
  `Me.staff` / `PublicProfile.staff`; absent for everyone else. The app shows «ID: Kabso01» on the profile header and bar,
  the person card's ID line and the Me tab, and the bare `Kabso01` instead of `@username` in rows and handles (it wins
  over a premium username's display). The staff member cannot change it. The **username stays** the person's for login
  and links (`/users/{username}`); it is not replaced.
- **Sign-in with the staff ID** *(v1.84-live, D302; owner: «المشرفين يدخلون من خلال وضع الايدي المميز والباسورد»)*. `login`'s
  `identifier` and the panel's `adminLogin` `email` field also take the staff ID, read like the search (any case, an
  optional `@`, leading zeros: `Kabso01`, `kabso1`, `@KABSO01`; `Kabso` = the primary OWNER). It stands **only for the
  account that holds it now** — ACTIVE, `role = ADMIN`, a panel role, the same rule as showing it. A retired number (a
  revoked role, a purged account) or a suspended holder resolves to nobody: the identifier is then read exactly as
  before (an email when it has `@`, else a username), which normally gives 401 `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS` — the same
  answer and the same work (a dummy Argon2 check) as a wrong password or an unknown name, even with the person's right
  password. The username, the email and the base username keep signing in. A held staff ID **wins over an older
  username spelled like it** (such usernames are reserved since D283c, §6; an old account named so signs in with its
  email). Every other rule applies unchanged: the login rate limits (the holder's account bucket, shared with their
  email and username), deletion pending, the team's lock, the device ban, the required password change; on the
  panel the lockout (the holder's email bucket) and the mandatory authenticator. Audit `auth.login.*` metadata
  `identifierType` gains `staff_id`. The apps' sign-in field says so («البريد أو اسم المستخدم أو ايدي الموظف»; the
  panel «البريد الإلكتروني أو ايدي الموظف»).
- **Search.** `search?type=users&q=Kabso01` (any case, `@` and leading zeros ignored: `kabso1`) finds the account that
  shows that ID now, first; `q=Kabso` finds the primary OWNER first (D283d). The panel's `searchAdminUsers` finds the holder by it (also after a revoke), the team page
  lists `staffId` on each card and filters by it, and `grantAdminTeamRole.account` / the CLI accept a staff ID (a former
  staff member is found by the number kept for them).
- **Reserved usernames.** §6's reserved list adds every name that looks like a staff ID, for everyone (registration,
  availability, premium usernames, the panel's username change): `kabso` itself and `kabso` followed by digits in any
  case, with `.` / `_` / `-` ignored, and their ASCII look-alikes — `4` for `a`, `8` for `b`, `5` for `s`, `0` for `o`
  (`kabs0`, `k4b5o`, `kabs001`), with `o` / `i` / `l` among the digits (`kabsoO1`) as long as a digit is present
  (`USERNAME_TAKEN`). *(D283d)* the bare look-alikes of «Kabso» (`kabs0`, `k4bso`) too.
- **Migration** `20270318090000_staff_ids_owner` *(D283d)*: CHECK `>= 0`, `kabso_assign_staff_id(uuid, boolean)` (the
  one-argument version dropped), `kabso_admin_panel_role` passes the OWNER flag, and a renumber — the account holding
  OWNER with the earliest OWNER grant gets 0, every other row 1, 2, … in its order.
- **Migration** `20270317090000_staff_ids`: the table, the functions and a backfill of today's holders numbered in the
  order of their first panel grant (ties by user id).

**10.96.13 Recruitment by staff «الاستقطاب» and the role BD *(v1.75-live, DRAFT — D285)*.** Owner: staff recruit
agencies, recharge agents, hosts and content creators; each recruit is attributed to its recruiter for good and the
recruiter earns an automatic share of the platform profit the recruit generates; a new role «للاستقطاب فقط».

- **The recruiter field.** The four application forms — «افتح وكالة» (`openMyAgency`), «كن وكيل شحن»
  (`applyForRechargeAgent`), «كن مضيفاً مع الإدارة» (`applyForHosting`) and the new creator programme «انضم كصانع محتوى»
  (`applyForCreatorProgramme`) — take an optional `recruiter` (`RecruiterField`, ≤ 64): «إن كنت تابعاً لمشرف، ضع معرّفه
  هنا» / "If a Kabso Team member referred you, enter their ID" — a staff ID in any form (`Kabso01`, `kabso1`,
  `@Kabso01`) or the staff member's username (`@` optional). Empty = none. The apps check it live with
  `lookupStaffRecruiter` (`GET /staff-recruiters/lookup?q=`, per-user default limit; 400 ms after the last keystroke):
  the recruiter's name and «فريق كابسو» badge with the staff ID and role, or «غير موجود»; the form is not sent while the
  text names nobody. The server checks it again: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` `{field: recruiter, issue: not_found | self}`.
  Stored on the application (`recruiter_user_id`, FK `ON DELETE SET NULL`, CHECK `…_recruiter_not_self`).
- **Who can recruit (decision).** An ACTIVE account (`users.role` ADMIN) holding **MODERATION** «مشرف» or **BD** «تطوير
  الأعمال» now. Not SUPPORT, FINANCE nor the OWNER (the owner's suggestion: the people in the field; SUPPORT decides
  applications and must not be judge and party). Anyone else is «غير موجود» exactly like an unknown ID (no role leak).
- **Attribution at the ACTIVATION.** When the application is activated — host: approved (`approveAdminHostApplication`
  / `host-admin approve`); recharge agent: approved (`approveAdminRechargeApplication` / `recharge-admin approve`; the
  later first top-up is not needed); creator: approved in «طلبات صناع المحتوى»; **agency: at its opening** (a
  self-opened agency has no approval, D206) — the recruit is attributed to the named recruiter for good: one
  `staff_recruitments` row (type, recruiter, recruit, application, agency, `activated_at`), audited
  `staff.recruit.attribute`. The recruiter is checked again in that transaction: a recruiter who lost the role meanwhile
  attributes nothing (`staff.recruit.skip` `recruiter_inactive`). One recruitment per (type, recruit); **a person is a
  HOST or a CREATOR recruit, not both** (partial unique `staff_recruitments_one_gift_recruit`: the same gifts are not
  paid twice); a second attribution is skipped (`already_attributed`, audited); a reopened agency keeps its first one.
  No field → nothing. The recruit's profile and person card do not show the recruiter.
- **Changing it.** Only the OWNER, in the panel: `reassignAdminRecruit` (`recruits.manage`; the authenticator code and
  a reason; audited `staff.recruit.reassign` {before, after, reason}; refusals `recruiter_not_found`,
  `recruiter_self`, `recruiter_same` under 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`). Days already paid stay with the former recruiter;
  the next days go to the new one.
- **The commission (automatic).** A daily job (`RECRUIT_COMMISSION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`, default 3600; 0 = off for
  tests, refused in production) pays every finished programs' day (`LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE`) not paid yet, from the
  activation day (or `RECRUIT_COMMISSION_CATCH_UP_DAYS` = 7 back after a pause) to yesterday, one transaction per
  (recruitment, day): `staff_recruit_commissions` (primary key = idempotency; append-only for the runtime role) and a
  `cherry_ledger` credit `STAFF_RECRUIT_COMMISSION` (reference `SR:<recruitment>@<day>`, once). The profit is D281's
  exact money units (`platformProfitUnits`: a coin = `COIN_RETAIL_USD_PER_MILLION`, a cherry = `CHERRY_PAYOUT_RATE`),
  counted from `max(day start, activatedAt)`:
  - **HOST / CREATOR**: the live gifts the recruit received (sender ACTIVE) — coins paid − the recruit's cherries (net
    of reversals) − the agency and parent commissions paid on those sends − for a lucky gift the expected payout to the
    sender (`LUCKY_GIFT_RTP_PERCENT` × the coin value);
  - **AGENCY**: the same over the gifts received by its hosts while linked to it (its `agency_earnings` rows; its own
    and its parent's commissions are costs);
  - **RECHARGE_AGENT**: the wholesale top-ups recorded that day (the money actually paid, in `CHERRY_PAYOUT_CURRENCY`) −
    the payout value of the cherries those coins become (coins × `CHERRIES_PER_COIN` × the highest normal host share).
  `cherries = floor(profit × bps / 10 000 / cherry value)`; 0 for no or negative profit. **Owner defaults:** 1 % (100
  bps) for hosts, content creators and host agencies, **0.75 % (75 bps)** for recharge agents; OWNER-editable
  (`updateAdminRecruitSettings`, 0–2000 bps each, the code and a reason, audited `staff.recruit.settings.update`). **The
  guard**: the cherries never exceed the share of the ACTUAL profit counted — in code and as CHECK
  `staff_recruit_commissions_guard` (`cherries × rate_minor × 10⁶ × 10⁴ ≤ max(profit, 0) × bps`). A day whose recruiter
  cannot recruit any more is written with 0 and `skipped = RECRUITER_INACTIVE` (the OWNER reassigns).
  *Worked example* ($12.50 per 1 000 000 coins, 1 000 000 cherries = $1.10, 10 cherries per coin, 65 % host share): a
  host receives 1 000 000 coins of normal gifts → 6 500 000 cherries ($7.15) → profit $5.35 → 1 % = $0.0535 = **48 636
  cherries**; the same through an agency paying 15 % (975 000 cherries, $1.0725) → profit $4.2775 → 1 % = **38 886**; a
  recharge agent's top-up of 30 000 000 coins paid $360 → 195 000 000 cherries owed ($214.50) → margin $145.50 → 0.75 %
  = **992 045 cherries**.
- **Withdrawable (decision).** `STAFF_RECRUIT_COMMISSION` is earnings, not a task reward: not in the task-cherry lock
  (§10.46.1). The staff account's wallet stays hidden (D283); «أرباحي» is its way in and «سحب الأرباح» uses the existing
  `requestCherryWithdrawal` (paid by FINANCE as any withdrawal).
- **The role BD «تطوير الأعمال»** («دور جديد للاستقطاب فقط»): a panel role (`AdminPanelRole` BD), granted on «الموظفون
  والصلاحيات» (`grantAdminTeamRole`) or `admin-admin grant … BD`, with its staff ID (§10.96.12). A **limited staff
  account** like D283 (the team picture, frame and cover, no live, no levels, announcements only;
  `KabsoStaffIdentity.role` BD); regions label it: «تطوير الأعمال — الوطن العربي» / "Business development — Arab
  World" (no shift, so no live is ever assigned to it). **No moderation power**: its only capability is `recruits.mine`
  — no lives, reports, users, hidden watch or shift; `getStaffStatus.isStaff` false (no staff tools in the app).
- **«استقطاباتي» / «أرباحي».** App, staff Me tab (MODERATION / BD): `getMyStaffRecruits` (by type with status ACTIVE /
  INACTIVE, the profit counted and the commissions; 403 `AUTH_FORBIDDEN` for anyone else) and `getMyStaffEarnings` (the
  wallet, the totals, the shares, per recruit, the last 60 days). Panel: `getAdminMyRecruits` (`recruits.mine`: the
  caller's own recruits only; `getAdminMyRecruitCommissions` 404 for anyone else's). The OWNER (`recruits.view`):
  `listAdminRecruitStaff` (per staff member: recruits by type, profit, commissions), `listAdminRecruits` (each recruit with
  its recruiter, status, profit, commissions), `getAdminRecruitCommissions` (the days paid); `AdminTeam` rows carry
  `recruits` counts.
- **The creator programme.** There was no creator application: `getMyCreatorApplication`, `applyForCreatorProgramme`
  (country, category `VIDEO|PHOTO|MUSIC|GAMING|COMEDY|EDUCATION|LIFESTYLE|OTHER`, 1–5 http(s) links, bio ≤ 300, the
  recruiter; 409 `CREATOR_APPLICATION_NOT_ALLOWED` `ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE | MEMBER | STAFF | PENDING`; limit
  `creator:apply`), `cancelMyCreatorApplication`; panel «طلبات صناع المحتوى» (`creators.applications` /
  `creators.decide`: OWNER, SUPPORT) approves (`creator_members`) or rejects with a reason. Entry: the creator centre's
  «برنامج صناع المحتوى».
- **Migrations** `20270319090000_staff_recruits_enums` (`admin_permission` BD, `cherry_ledger_reason`
  STAFF_RECRUIT_COMMISSION) and `20270319090100_staff_recruits` (the columns, tables, CHECKs, the ledger sign rule,
  `kabso_admin_panel_role` accepting BD).

**10.96.14 Staff work without a code, and the automatic shift *(v1.76-live, DRAFT — D286)*.** Owner: «لاحظت ان كل
ما اراد المشرف عمل شيء قام بإدخال رمز تحقق ثنائي من جوجل، ازله لتسهيل العملية. وعندما يقوم المشرف بالعمل يتم تفعيل زر
مناوبة».

- **No code for moderation.** The app's staff tools (§10.96.6: «بثوثي», the reports and history, WARN, END, NO_LIVE,
  SUSPEND, dismiss, kick, chat mute, message removal) and the hidden watch «مراقبة خفية» work as soon as the account holds
  the role. Protection is what it was without the code: the role and the capability are read on **every** request (a
  revoked role or a suspended account stops at once), the bearer session (sign-out / «sign out everywhere» ends it),
  `staff:user` (300 / 15 min per user), and the full audit of every action (actor, IP, request id, reason, `via: app`).
  SUPPORT still only reads (403 `AUTH_FORBIDDEN` on actions and on the hidden watch); FINANCE and BD have no staff tool;
  any other account 403. The panel's live moderation never asked for a code except for the device ban (unchanged).
  `createStaffStepUp` / `endStaffStepUp` are **deprecated** (kept; the code check and lockout as before; no tool reads the
  grant); `StaffStatus.stepUp` is always set for watch staff (a rolling `STAFF_APP_GRANT_SECONDS` ahead) so an app before
  D286 opens its tools without asking; `STAFF_STEP_UP_REQUIRED` is no longer returned. A panel lockout (wrong codes) no
  longer closes the app's tools (they no longer depend on the code); it still locks the panel sign-in.
- **Where the authenticator code stays** (security, money, permissions or a permanent action — not moderation):

  | Action | Why |
  |---|---|
  | Panel sign-in (password + authenticator) | the panel's second factor |
  | `grantAdminTeamRole`, `revokeAdminTeamRole`, `resetAdminTeamTotp`, `setAdminTeamRegions` (D271 / D283) | permissions |
  | Device ban — `moderateAdminLive` / `moderateStaffLive` `DEVICE_BAN`, device sign-up exceptions | shuts out every account on a device |
  | Recharge dispute resolution (`resolveAdminRechargeDispute`), top-ups to agents, withdrawals paid / rejected, refunds, balance adjustments | coin / cherry movement |
  | Agencies (extend probation, close, reopen), referrals (approve, void, settings), live boost prices | money |
  | Payment, FX, KYC and storage settings (update / clear keys) | secrets and money |
  | ~~Permanent account ban (`banAdminUser`)~~, ~~account deletion~~, ~~permanent content deletion~~, temporary password, e-mail change | permanent or account-takeover risk (a timed SUSPEND / NO_LIVE, hiding content and the live actions need none) |

  *(v1.78-live, D288, §10.101.1)* Owner «يلغي» then «نعم»: the **permanent account ban**, the **permanent content
  deletion** and **starting an account's deletion** no longer need the code. The temporary password and the e-mail
  change keep it, as does everything else in the table.

- **The automatic shift.** Staff work by a watch staff member (OWNER, MODERATION, SUPPORT — never FINANCE or BD)
  switches «في المناوبة» on when it is off: **entering a live as staff** (the app's `createLiveMediaToken`, visible or
  hidden; the panel's `createAdminLiveWatchToken` `WATCH`, not the cards' `PREVIEW`), **any staff tool** (every `staff`
  route but `getStaffStatus`, `getStaffShift` / `setStaffShift` and the deprecated step-up; the panel's live reports,
  `moderateAdminLive`, `dismissAdminLiveReports`, `endAdminLive`) and **opening «بثوثي»** (`listStaffLives`;
  `listAdminLives?assigned=me` unless `background=true`, the panel's 15 s refresh). It is the shift rule of §10.96.1: an
  assignment pass runs at once (reason `shift_on`), audited `admin.shift.on` {assigned, `via: auto`, `trigger`
  `live_join | staff_tool | my_lives`, `from` `app | panel`}; already on shift → only the activity time moves (at most
  once a minute). A conditional write: concurrent work switches it once (one audit row). Best effort: a failure never
  fails the live join or the tool. The apps show it at once (the app's switch and the tools sheet; the panel's switch
  after «بثوثي»).
- **Turning off** stays by hand (`setStaffShift` / `setAdminMyShift`) and automatic on role loss (§10.96.5). **Decided:
  the idle switch-off** — a shift switched on *automatically* goes off after `STAFF_SHIFT_IDLE_OFF_SECONDS` (default
  7200 = 2 h; 0 = never) without staff work, unless the person is in a live as visible staff right now
  (`live_room_staff_watchers`); it runs at the sweeper's cadence (`LIVE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`), audited
  `admin.shift.off` {released, `via: auto`, `reason: idle`, idleSeconds} with no actor request, and the lives are handed
  on (reason `shift_off`). A shift turned on **by hand** never goes off by itself (turning ON by hand an automatic shift
  makes it a manual one). The app's «بثوثي» does not read the list again after the switch is turned off by hand (that
  read would be staff work).
- **Table** `admin_shifts` gains `started_via` (`panel | app | auto`, CHECK) and `last_activity_at`. **Fix** in the same
  migration: `account_restrictions_shape` accepts `via = 'app'` (the app's timed NO_LIVE / SUSPEND failed the CHECK).
  Migration `20270320090000_staff_auto_shift`.

### 10.97 A VIP member's tier items in the bag — one worn item per kind *(v1.65-live, DRAFT — D264)*

Owner: «ويجب عند تفعيل في اي بي ان تظهر العناصر في الحقيبة حتى وان لم يرتديه الشخص المدة تنقضي وتعد» — once a VIP
membership is bought or renewed, the tier's items show in the bag (§10.22), and their time counts down from then whether
worn or not. Owner, same day: every VIP item can be worn and taken off like any bag item, and **a person never wears two
items of the same kind at once** (two frames, two profile cards, two bubbles, two entry effects). Builds on §10.93 /
§10.94.

- **Which items.** Every *wearable* perk the active membership holds (its tier's or a lower tier's, enabled; the highest
  tier's art for a code, §10.94.2), listed with or without art: AVATAR_FRAME and PROFILE_CARD (the VIP card art — in the
  bag's own `AVATAR_FRAME` / `PROFILE_CARD` categories, the same kinds as the bag's frames and header cards), CHAT_BUBBLE,
  ENTRY_BANNER, ENTRY_EFFECT (the entry car) and MIC_WAVE (VIP-only categories). The badge and the name colour are
  identity, not bag items.
- **Derived, never copied.** `getMyBag` builds them from the membership on every read: code `vip:<PERK>`, `source: VIP`,
  `acquiredAt` = the membership's start, `expiresAt` = its end, `transferable: false`, `giftedBy: null`, `assetKey`
  `vip_<perk>` (the art is in `BagItem.vip {tier, tierName, color, perk, animation, still}`). So the time is exactly the
  membership's: a renewal moves it, an upgrade shows the higher tier's items (with the lower tiers'), the end removes them
  — no grant to keep in step, nothing for the sweeper. Copied rows would need the bag's per-item expiry, transfer and
  sweep rules to follow every purchase, upgrade and the panel's perk changes; none of that is needed to list and wear
  them. The VIP item comes first in its category; VIP-only categories follow the stored ones.
- **One worn item per kind.** In AVATAR_FRAME and PROFILE_CARD, wearing the VIP item takes off the bag item worn, and
  wearing a bag item (or `code: null`) takes the VIP one off; a VIP item also reads not worn whenever a bag item of its
  kind is worn (whatever put it on). The other kinds have only the VIP item.
- **Start, renewal, upgrade, end.** A **new** membership (none, or the last one ended) wears every tier item: its frame and
  card take off the bag's worn ones. A renewal or an upgrade keeps the member's choices (an upgrade's frame / card replace
  a bag one only where the member had not taken the VIP one off). When the membership ends the VIP items leave the bag
  and those slots are simply empty — the bag item replaced at the start is not put back. Members active when this ships
  are moved to the same state (migration: their bag frame / card give way where their tier holds that perk).
- **Wearing.** `setMyBagEquipped {category, code: 'vip:<PERK>'}` wears one, `{category, code: null}` takes it off; only
  what the member took off is stored (`vip_memberships.off_perks`). A VIP code the membership does not hold (none, ended,
  another perk) or in the wrong category → 409 `BAG_ITEM_NOT_OWNED`; `sendMyBagItem` refuses them the same way.
- **Everyone sees the one worn item.** `UserVip.off` (absent when empty) lists the tier items not worn — taken off, or a
  bag frame / card worn instead; `UserSummary.avatarFrame` and `PublicProfile.profileCard` / `avatarFrame` stay the bag's
  worn items. So every renderer (person card, profile, live seats, chat, entry) draws exactly one item per kind: the
  apps leave the `off` perks out of the member's look.
- `getBagCatalogue?category=<VIP-only category>` → an empty list (VIP items come with a membership, not the catalogue).

**Compatibility.** Additive. An older app shows the VIP-only categories under «other items» with a plain tile and can
wear or take them off; it ignores `UserVip.off` (a taken-off VIP item still shows there until it updates). Migration
`20270308090000_vip_bag` (`vip_memberships.off_perks`, default empty; the active members' bag frame / card taken off).

### 10.98 «المتجر» — the store: timed bag items for coins or cherries *(v1.84-social, DRAFT — D270)*

Owner (2026-11-04): the Me tab's «المتجر» card (D267) becomes a real store. It sells, for now, avatar frames «إطارات
الصور», profile cards «بطاقات تعريفية», chat bubbles «فقاعات الرسائل», entry banners «لافتات الدخول» and entry cars /
effects «سيارات الدخول» — more kinds later. Prices are in **coins and / or cherries**, per duration (**7, 14, 30 days**),
set in the panel; a duration without a price is not offered. Store items are never permanent. Economy context (owner):
1 000 000 coins = $12.50, 1 000 000 cherries = $1.10 — the panel sets each price; the server does not convert.

#### 10.98.1 Items

- A store item is a `store_items` row **and** a bag catalogue row (`bag_items`, code `store_<12 hex>`, its category = the
  item's `kind`): once bought it is an ordinary bag item (§10.22 / §10.45) — listed, worn, timed, swept, and (timed, not
