  free) sendable from the bag (D171; D266's permanent rule never applies). `kind` is one of `StoreKind` (AVATAR_FRAME,
  PROFILE_CARD, CHAT_BUBBLE, ENTRY_BANNER, ENTRY_EFFECT); a new kind is a `bag_category` value, a `StoreKind` value, the
  `store_items_shape` CHECK and the apps' renderer. CHAT_BUBBLE, ENTRY_BANNER and ENTRY_EFFECT were VIP-only categories
  (§10.97); they are stored categories now. MIC_WAVE stays VIP-only.
- Fields: names ar / en (1–40), the art (`StoreArt`, §10.98.4), prices (`StorePrice` `{currency, days, amount}`, amount
  1 … 10^12, at most one per currency and duration), `sortOrder` (the order in its tab), `isNew` («جديد»), `enabled`.
  Items are never deleted (purchases and bag rows point at them); one switched off is no longer listed or bought, and
  what was bought runs to its end. At most 500 items.
- `listStoreItems` lists the items switched on **with at least one price**, by `sortOrder`; `kinds` the tabs that have
  items; per item the prices, the lowest per currency (`fromCoins` / `fromCherries`, the grid's price), `ownedUntil` (the
  caller holds it until then) and the caller's `balances` (coins, cherries).

#### 10.98.2 Buying (`buyStoreItem`)

- `{itemId, currency, days, price, recipient?}`: `price` must be the item's price for that currency and duration now
  (else 409 `STORE_PRICE_CHANGED`); a duration not priced in that currency → 409 `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` `days`
  `not_priced`; an item switched off → `item` `item_off`.
- **Coins** are debited from the wallet (`wallet_ledger` `STORE_PURCHASE`, guarded: never below 0, else 409
  `INSUFFICIENT_COINS`). **Cherries** — the hosts' earnings (§10.46) — are debited from the cherry wallet (`cherry_ledger`
  `STORE_PURCHASE`, the same guarded debit as a withdrawal hold, else 409 `INSUFFICIENT_CHERRIES`). **Only unlocked
  cherries are spent** (owner, 2026-11-04: «هل يُصرف كرز المهام المقفل في المتجر؟ لا»): the debit takes the task cherries
  still locked (§10.46.1) out of the balance exactly as a withdrawal does, computed in the purchase's transaction; a
  person whose cherries are all locked task cherries gets 409 `INSUFFICIENT_CHERRIES`. `StoreBalances.cherries` is that
  spendable amount and `lockedCherries` the locked part, so the app's balance and affordability use what can be spent
  (and says «كرز المهام المقفل لا يُصرف في المتجر» when some are locked). Either ledger row's reference is the
  `store_purchases` row.
- **Frozen accounts.** While the person's coin balance is below 0 (a reversed website purchase, §10.53) nothing is
  bought, in either currency: 403 `TOPUP_ACCOUNT_FROZEN`.
- **The item lands in the bag**: a new item counts from now; one the recipient holds gets the days **added to its end**
  (`extended: true`), never past 3 650 days from now (`days` `too_far`); a permanent copy (an admin grant) is refused
  (`item` `owned_permanent`). Bought items are not worn: the result offers «ارتدِ الآن» (the bag's `setMyBagEquipped`).
- **A gift** (`recipient` = a username): the item lands in their bag as `source: GIFT` with `giftedBy` = the buyer, and
  they get the bag's `BAG_ITEM_RECEIVED` notification. As the bag send (D171): 404 for no ACTIVE account with that name or
  a block either way (no hint which), 400 `recipient` `invalid_value` for oneself, 403 `ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED` while the
  team's «منع إرسال الهدايا» stands (D208). For oneself the source is `STORE`.
- **Atomic, idempotent, audited**: one transaction, serialized per buyer (advisory lock), the item row `FOR SHARE`, the
  holder's bag row locked as a bag send locks it; `Idempotency-Key` (24 h): the same key and body → 200 with the first
  result, nothing charged again; another body → 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. An audit row `store.purchase` (item, currency,
  days, price, gift, recipient, the new end). A refused request charges and changes nothing.

#### 10.98.3 The app

The Me tab's «المتجر» card opens the store: tabs by kind (`kinds`), a grid of items — the animated preview, the name,
«جديد», the lowest price (coins first) — and a sheet per item: a big preview (the frame around the person's own picture,
the bubble around sample text, the banner / car playing), duration chips (only the durations priced), a currency toggle
(only the currencies priced), the price, the balance, «شراء» and «إهداء» (a username, or someone from their following).
Short coins → the wallet's recharge; short cherries → an explanation (cherries are earned from gifts). After a purchase
for oneself: «ارتدِ الآن». Kabso's design system, red action buttons, light and dark.

#### 10.98.4 The art and every renderer

- `StoreArt` `{still, animation, format, alpha, width, height}`: a hosted PNG / WebP still and an animation — an **SVGA**
  (as the VIP perks) or an **MP4** (as gift effects, D207: `alpha` NONE plays as is, SIDE_BY_SIDE is composited — the
  left half colour, the right half the alpha mask). The still shows while the animation loads, with reduced motion and in
  tests. Nothing is bundled.
- Worn store items travel as `UserSummary.wear` / `PublicProfile.wear` (`StoreWear`: `avatarFrame`, `profileCard`,
  `chatBubble`, `entryBanner`, `entryEffect`, each `StoreWornItem` = code + art; only the kinds worn). A store frame is
  in `wear`, not in `avatarFrame` (which stays the bundled frames); a store card likewise not in `profileCard`.
- **One worn item per kind** with the VIP items (§10.97): a store item worn covers the VIP item of its kind
  (`UserVip.off` lists it), and wearing the VIP item takes the store one off. The apps draw the worn store item exactly
  where the VIP one goes — the frame around the photo, the person card's art, the chat bubble, the entry banner and car
  (a join of someone wearing a store banner or car is never dropped by the 1 / s join window, as a VIP's).

#### 10.98.5 The panel «المتجر»

`listAdminStoreItems` (`catalog.view`: OWNER, SUPPORT, FINANCE) lists every item (on and off) with its prices, the people
holding it now and the purchases of it; `listAdminStoreSales` the latest sales (≤ 200) of all items or one, with the
totals (purchases, gifts, coins, cherries). `uploadAdminStoreArt` (raw bytes; a still, or an animation — SVGA 2.x or MP4,
told by its bytes, the gifts' checks; content-addressed under `media/store/`), `createAdminStoreItem`,
`updateAdminStoreItem` (names, art, the whole price list, order, «جديد»; the kind never changes),
`enableAdminStoreItem` / `disableAdminStoreItem` need `catalog.manage` (OWNER), the CSRF header and a reason, and write
`store.item.add | update | enable | disable` with before / after, the actor, the IP and `via: panel`.

**Compatibility.** Additive. Nothing is on sale until the OWNER adds items. An older app lists a store item in the bag with
a plain tile and ignores `wear` (a store item worn shows nothing there until it updates). Migrations
`20270310090000_store_enums` (the bag categories, `bag_item_source.STORE`, both ledgers' `STORE_PURCHASE`,
`store_currency`) and `20270310090100_store` (the tables; both ledgers' sign CHECKs extended in place).

### 10.99 Profile tags «منشنات» *(v1.85-social, DRAFT — D278b)*

The owner (2026-11-05, on the D278 profile cover): «ثم منشنات يضعها الشخص معاه لغاية ١٠ بسطرين فقط». Short labels the
person chooses for themself (what they do, a group, a slogan), shown as chips on their profile cover under the
numbers and the buttons.

- **Set** with `PATCH /me` `tags`: the whole set in the person's order; `[]` clears them; leaving `tags` out keeps
  them. Each tag is normalised like a link label (CRLF → LF, NFC, trimmed) and must then be **one line of 1–24 code
  points** with the §6 free-text hygiene (`tags.<i>`: `too_short`, `too_long`, `invalid_format`). The same tag twice,
  ignoring case (`toLocaleLowerCase('en')`), → `tags.<i>` / `invalid_value` on the later one. **At most 10** →
  `tags` / `too_many`. Emoji are allowed. Tags are plain text: no links, no mentions parsed, no notifications.
- **Read** in `Me.tags` and `PublicProfile.tags` (in order), also on a private account's profile (as the links,
  §10.47). Stored in `user_profiles.tags` (`varchar(24)[]`, CHECK `user_profiles_tags_count`: at most 10).
- **Audit**: a change adds `tags` to the `profile.update` row's `fields` (never the values, §10.42). Tags follow the
  bio's moderation: reported with the account (`reportUser`); no separate queue.
- **App**: chips on the profile cover, wrapping to **at most two lines**; what does not fit shows as a «+n» chip.
  Edited in «تعديل الملف الشخصي» (add, remove).

### 10.100 Employees act for the agent: cherry purchases and the orders inbox *(v1.87-social, DRAFT — D287)*

Owner (staging, 2026-11-02): «موظف وكيل الشحن لا يمكنه شراء كرز ولا تصله طلبات الشراء، يرجى تفعيل شراء الكرزات من خلال
الموظف إلى حساب الوكيل». Extends §10.48 (employees, cherry sales) and §10.64 (orders); nothing else changes.

- **Who is the agent's side.** The agent, and each **active** employee of the agent (`removed_at` null). A removed
  employee is nobody's side (404). An employee always acts **for the agent**: stock, money, caps and the agent's name
  are the agent's; the employee is recorded as the one who acted.
- **Never a Kabso Team account** *(owner's decision, 2026-11-06)*. The team here is D283's limited staff account
  (an ACTIVE `ADMIN` user holding MODERATION, SUPPORT, FINANCE or BD, and not OWNER — `limitedStaffSql`). Adding one
  (`addMyRechargeEmployee`) is 403 `RECHARGE_EMPLOYEE_IS_STAFF`, after the D185 checks (409
  `RECHARGE_EMPLOYEE_NOT_ALLOWED`); nothing is stored. An employee who **becomes** one stays in the agent's list but
  cannot act for the agent: selling (`sellRechargeCoins`, before `RECHARGE_OFF_SHIFT`), the cherry purchases and every
  order action answer 403 `STAFF_ACCOUNT_LIMITED` with `details: [{field: staff, issue: recharge_employee}]` (D283's
  code: the caller is a Kabso Team account), before the permission, the claim and the hours; they still read, with
  `viewerBlock` `STAFF` and `RechargeEmployment.kabsoTeam` true, and are not notified of offers or orders. The agent
  sees `RechargeEmployee.kabsoTeam` on «الموظفون» and may remove them. Losing the role gives the ability back. The
  OWNER's account stays a normal one (D283), so an OWNER is not refused.
- **«On shift» is the employee's weekly hours** (§10.48: `recharge_employees.schedule` in its `time_zone`), unchanged.
  It is not the Kabso Team's «في المناوبة» (`admin_shifts`, §10.96: D260, and since v1.76-live D286 switched on by
  staff work): a recharge agent's employee is an ordinary app user added by the agent, not a panel staff member, and
  the automatic staff shift neither starts nor ends their hours. *(This section is the port onto `staging` of the
  earlier local-only branch `claude/kl-252-agent-employees`, numbered D252 / v1.82-social / §10.92 there.)*
- **Permissions** (per employee, set by the agent on «الموظفون»; both **ON** by default — for every employee that
  existed before, who were all added to sell): «يمكنه شراء الكرز» (`canBuyCherries`) and «يستقبل طلبات الشراء»
  (`receivesOrders`). `addMyRechargeEmployee` and `updateMyRechargeEmployee` (`RechargeEmployeeUpdate`; a permission
  left out is unchanged) take them; `recharge.employee.add` / `.update` audit them (before / after). Direct selling
  (§10.48) is not a permission: it stays as it was.
- **Acting** needs, in this order: the permission (403 `RECHARGE_EMPLOYEE_NOT_PERMITTED`), for an order that nobody
  else of the agent's side owns (409 `RECHARGE_ORDER_CLAIMED`), and «now» inside the employee's weekly slots (409
  `RECHARGE_OFF_SHIFT`). The agent is never refused for these. A person who may not act still **reads**: the
  responses carry `viewerBlock` (`RechargeAgentSideBlock`: `STAFF`, `NOT_PERMITTED`, `CLAIMED`, `OFF_SHIFT`) and an empty
  `actions`, so the app shows the honest reason instead of buttons that fail.
- **Cherry purchases «شراء كرز».** An employee with the permission creates a request with a host's username
  (`createRechargeCherryRequest` `host`) and confirms, declines or cancels the agent's requests
  (`answerRechargeCherryRequest`) exactly as the agent: the request's `agent` is the agent; the same minimum, step, TTL,
  one open request per host and agent, withdrawable-cherries check and **daily cap** — the agent's day counts every
  confirmed request of the agent, whoever acted — and a confirmation moves the host's cherries and adds the coins to
  the **agent's** stock (`CHERRY_PURCHASE`). `actedBy` (column `acted_by`) is the employee who last acted for the agent
  (created it or answered it; null when the agent or the host did), `decided_by` who answered; the audit rows carry the
  employee as the actor with `byEmployee` and `actedBy`. The employee cannot be the host of the request themselves
  (400 `host`); a block between the employee and the host is 404. The host is notified with the **agent** as the
  actor and always sees the agent (no «عبر …» line: the orders have no such pattern). The creator's side cancels, the
  other side confirms or declines (`actions`); of two answers at once the row lock lets exactly one win, the other gets
  409 `RECHARGE_CHERRY_REQUEST_CLOSED`. `listMyRechargeCherryRequests` also lists the agent's requests to an employee
  with the permission (off shift: read only).
- **Who is told.** A host's offer to the agent (`RECHARGE_CHERRY_REQUEST`) and a buyer's new order
  (`RECHARGE_ORDER_UPDATE` `CREATED`) go to the agent and every employee with the matching permission who is **on
  shift now**; an employee off shift sees them in the inbox later. Once a person of the agent's side owns an order,
  its later events go to the agent and that person only (D204 notified every employee for every event).
- **The orders inbox «طلبات الشراء».** `listMyRechargeOrders?role=agent` for an employee without «يستقبل طلبات
  الشراء» is 403. The **first person of the agent's side to act** on an order — the payment details, a chat message,
  «استلمت», «نزاع», a cancel — **owns it**: `claimedBy` / `claimedAt` (columns `claimed_by`, `claimed_at`) are set under
  the order's row lock (`FOR UPDATE`), so of two employees acting at once exactly one wins and the other gets 409
  `RECHARGE_ORDER_CLAIMED` (or `RECHARGE_ORDER_STATE_CHANGED` when the status moved). The others read it as taken
  («تم استلامه بواسطة موظف آخر»); the agent can always act on it.
- **Statistics.** Per employee, next to the sales: `cherryPurchases` (confirmed requests they acted on; coins into the
  stock, by the decision time) and `orders` (COMPLETED / COMPLETED_BY_ADMIN orders they owned; coins to buyers, by the
  closing time) — today (LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE), 7 and 30 days, on the agent's «الموظفون» and in the panel
  (`listAdminRechargeAgentEmployees`, capability `recharge.agents`: the current employees and those removed in the last
  30 days).
- Migration `20270321090000_recharge_employee_acts` (additive columns with defaults, two partial indexes, and the
  request's shape CHECK now also allows `created_by` = `acted_by`: an employee who created it for the agent).
  DEPLOYMENT §5.68.

### 10.101 «البلاغات المشتركة» — the shared report queue, and no code for the ban and content deletion *(v1.78-live, DRAFT — D288)*

Owner: «ان البلاغ يصل كل المشرفين والدعم والذي يقوم بحله يضغط تم حله» — a report reaches every moderator and support
member, and whoever resolves it presses «تم حله». And, asked whether the code should also go from the permanent ban and
the permanent content deletion: «يلغي». (§10.100 is left free for another branch.)

#### 10.101.1 No authenticator code for the permanent ban and the permanent content deletion

- `banAdminUser` (`POST /admin/users/{userId}/ban`), `moderateAdminContent` with `op = delete` (a post, reel or story
  for good; a comment is only ever removed) and `requestAdminUserDeletion` no longer call the step-up. `totpCode` is **deprecated**: still
  accepted (6 digits) and ignored, so a panel built before D288 keeps working; it is never checked, never counted
  towards the lockout. The report queue's `BAN` (`actOnAdminPanelReport`) never asked for it.
- Kept on every request: the session, the capability (`users.ban` OWNER / MODERATION; `users.content` OWNER /
  MODERATION), the target rules (an account holding a panel role only by an OWNER, never one's own), the reason (400
  without), the panel's `admin:ip` limit, and the full audit (`admin.user.ban` {reason, before, after, via};
  `admin.content.delete` {reason, authorId, before, after, reportsClosed, via}, with the actor, IP and request id).
- **Account deletion too (owner, asked separately because D286 listed it apart: «نعم»).** `requestAdminUserDeletion`
  needs no code: `users.delete` (OWNER) on every request, the reason (400 without), `admin:ip` and the audit
  `account.deletion.requested` {reason, via}; `totpCode` deprecated the same way; the D193 grace period still lets it be
  cancelled. The code stays for the panel sign-in, the team's roles / regions / 2FA resets, the device ban, every money
  action, the settings, the temporary password and the e-mail change (§10.96.14's table).
- The app's staff tools have no permanent ban or content deletion (§10.96.6); nothing changes there.

#### 10.101.2 Every report reaches the moderators and the support

- **Who sees the queue.** `reports.view` is OWNER, MODERATION **and SUPPORT** (SUPPORT was not in it): the panel's
  «البلاغات» (`listAdminPanelReports`) and, in the app, the Me tab's «بلاغات» (`listStaffReports`) — the same list, the
  same preview, the reporter, the DM / link snapshots. The actions on a target (`actOnAdminPanelReport`: dismiss,
  remove, warn, ban — `reports.act`) stay OWNER / MODERATION; SUPPORT reads and resolves.
- **Lists.** `status=OPEN` (default) oldest first, as before; `status=RESOLVED` every closed report (ACTIONED or
  DISMISSED, «تم حله» included) **newest resolution first** (cursor on `resolved_at`, index `reports_resolved_idx`);
  ACTIONED / DISMISSED alone still work. Each `AdminPanelReport` carries `resolvedBy` (`ReportResolver` {id, username,
  displayName}; null while OPEN) and `resolutionNote`.
- **The counter.** `getAdminPanelReportsSummary` / `getStaffReportsSummary` → `{open}` (every OPEN report). The panel
  shows it on the «البلاغات» nav item (read every 30 s and after each change; hidden at 0; «99+» above 99); the app on the
  «بلاغات» row (read when the Me tab shows, after «تم حله», when a `STAFF_REPORT_NEW` arrives, and every 60 s while the
  tab is on screen). The staff summary is not staff work (§10.96.14): the badge never switches the shift on; the list
  and «تم حله» are staff work.

#### 10.101.3 The alert `STAFF_REPORT_NEW`

- **When.** Every new report (`createReport` that stores a row; a repeat of one's own open report does not).
- **Who (decided).** Every ACTIVE ADMIN account holding **MODERATION or SUPPORT** now, **on shift or not** — reports are
  not assigned like lives, so the shift does not filter; it only lets the push skip the general gap (as D273). If there
  is none, every OWNER. Never the reporter or the reported user. Every report type goes to all of them (every one of
  them can resolve any report). *Confirmed by the owner.* SUPPORT seeing every report, DM and link snapshots included, is
  **accepted by the owner**. A report on a live first runs the D273 alert (§10.96.8, the live's responsible staff
  member gets `LIVE_STAFF_REPORT`); those recipients are not told twice.
- **The row.** System type (always on; there is no per-type switch in the notification settings — system types are not
  listed there), target `REPORT` (`id` the report, `reportTargetType`, `reportOpen`; no text, no picture). **One unread
  row per staff member** (`group_key = STAFF_REPORT_NEW`): a newer report moves it up and points it at the newest report,
  and the dispatcher pushes it again. Resolving a report marks the rows pointing at it read for everyone. Stored in
  `notifications.report_id` (cascade with the report).
- **The push.** Its own Android channel **`kabso_staff`** («بلاغات فريق كابسو» / "Kabso Team reports", created by the app;
  the staff can set its sound apart — owner: **no separate sound**, it plays the general one), title «بلاغات فريق كابسو» / "Kabso Team reports",
  body «بلاغ جديد بانتظار الحل» / "A new report is waiting to be resolved" — never the reporter, the reason, the note or
  the target. An app before D288 has no such channel: Android shows it on the manifest's default channel. On shift →
  sent even within the general gap; off shift → the usual push rules. Audited `moderation.report.alert` {reportId,
  recipients, route `staff` | `owners`, liveRecipients} and `moderation.report.push` {recipientId, notificationId, sent,
  onShift}.
- **The tap** (inbox or push) opens «بلاغات» on that report (`/me/staff/reports?report=<id>`).

#### 10.101.4 «تم حله»

- `resolveAdminPanelReport` (panel) / `resolveStaffReport` (app, `via: app`) — `reports.resolve`: OWNER, MODERATION,
  SUPPORT. Body `{note?}` (1–500). The report becomes **ACTIONED** with `resolved_at`, `resolved_by_id` (the caller) and
  `resolution_note` — the existing columns, no migration for them. Only this report closes (another person's report on
  the same target stays in the queue; the actions of §11.7 still close them all). Nothing is done to the target.
- **For everyone.** The report leaves «غير محلولة» for every staff member and shows under «تم حلها» with «حلّه
  <displayName> · <time>» and the note.
- **Concurrency.** The row is locked (`FOR UPDATE`): of two presses the first wins; the second gets **409
  `REPORT_ALREADY_RESOLVED`**; the panel and the app then reload and show «تم حله بالفعل» with who resolved it.
- **Decided (owner):** «تم حله» closes **only the pressed report**; the reporters' other open reports on the same target
  stay in the queue.
- **Audit.** `moderation.report.resolve` {reportId, note, via} with the actor, IP and request id.

#### 10.101.5 Reopen

- `reopenAdminPanelReport` `{reason}` — **`reports.reopen`: OWNER and MODERATION** (owner's answer, option B: the
  moderators; SUPPORT cannot reopen). Back to OPEN; the resolution is cleared (the audit keeps it); nothing done
  to the target is undone. An OPEN report → 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` `report_open`; the same reporter already has
  another open report on the same target (one open report per reporter and target, §11.7) → 409 `report_duplicate`.
  Audited `moderation.report.reopen` {reportId, reason, before, resolvedById, via}. Panel only.

#### 10.101.6 Compatibility

Additive. Older panels: the ban and delete dialogs still send a code (ignored). Older apps: `STAFF_REPORT_NEW` is a type
they do not know (skipped in the inbox; the push shows on the default channel and opens the inbox); `StaffStatus`'s two
new capabilities are ignored. Migration `20270322090000_shared_reports`: `notification_type` gains `STAFF_REPORT_NEW`,
`notifications.report_id` (FK, cascade, partial index), `reports_resolved_idx`. No server setting.

### 10.102 Gift and store badges «شارات الهدايا والمتجر» *(v1.79-live, DRAFT — D289)*

Owner (2026-11-06): «كل شارة لها أيقونة خاصة في النظام كاملاً» — a gift or a store item carries a **set** of badges
(it was one value: `GiftBadge` NONE / NEW / EVENT on gifts, `isNew` on store items), each with **one icon used
everywhere** (the gift box, the store, the item's details, the panel). «بمؤثرات صوتية» and «بدون مؤثرات صوتية» cannot both
be chosen; the panel pre-selects the sound badge and «شاشة كاملة» when the uploaded file shows it, and the owner can always
change the choice; a small gift-box tile shows one or two badges (the icon alone when the label does not fit) and never
covers the price; opening the gift or item shows all of them with their names; lucky gifts keep their current mark. From
the store message: «جديد» goes away by itself after 14 days (or on another date the owner sets), «عرض لفترة محدودة» has
an end date after which only the badge goes and the item stays on sale; colours: offer red, new green, most wanted gold,
sound blue with a speaker; at most two badges on the item's image corner; the item's sheet shows all of them and the days
left of an offer.

#### 10.102.1 The badges

| `ItemBadgeCode` | Arabic | English | Icon (one glyph everywhere) | Colour | End |
| --------------- | ------ | ------- | --------------------------- | ------ | --- |
| `LIMITED` | لفترة محدودة | Limited time | hourglass | red `#E50914` = `brand.red500` (owner: offer red), white text | required |
| `NEW` | جديد | New | sparkle | green `#137A43` = `light.success` (owner), white text | optional: 14 days from when it is set |
| `SEASONAL` | موسمي | Seasonal | calendar | amber `#F5A623` = `dark.warning`, ink `#0B0B0D` text | required (see migration) |
| `EXCLUSIVE` | حصري | Exclusive | crown | ink `#0B0B0D` with gold `#F5C451` (`brand.gold`) text and edge | — |
| `MOST_WANTED` | الأكثر طلباً | Most wanted | flame | gold `#F5C451` = `brand.gold` (owner), ink text | — |
| `FEATURED` | مميز | Featured | diamond | violet `#7B4DFF`, white text | — |
| `FULLSCREEN` | شاشة كاملة | Full screen | expand (four corners) | teal `#00796B`, white text | — |
| `SOUND` | بمؤثرات صوتية | With sound | speaker | blue `#1A64BF` = `light.info` (owner), white text | — |
| `NO_SOUND` | بدون مؤثرات صوتية | No sound | muted speaker | grey `#666671` = `light.textTertiary`, white text | — |

- The colours and the order were approved by the owner (D289-Q5).
- The table's order is the **display priority** (time-limited and fresh first, the file's properties last): a tile shows
  the first one or two **running** badges in it, the details all of them. The API lists `badges` in this order.
- The owner's four colours and most others are design tokens (`design-tokens.json`); violet and teal are the only new
  hues, picked to stay apart from the owner's four. One fill per badge in light and dark (a pill on the art, not on the
  page), so it reads the same in the dark gift box and the light store; the label is bold on a fill with ≥ 4.5 : 1
  contrast (gold and amber take the ink text).
- The icons are drawn for Kabso (24-unit, round strokes, the app's icon style); the same SVG paths are in the app
  (`assets/icons/badges/`) and the panel (`ui/badge-icons.tsx`). No third-party art.

#### 10.102.2 Rules (server)

- The panel sends the whole set: `badges: [{code, until?}]` (an empty list takes every badge off) — 400
  `VALIDATION_FAILED` for the shape (an unknown code, more than nine, a bad date), then 400 **`ITEM_BADGES_INVALID`**:
  `badges` `sound_exclusive` (SOUND with NO_SOUND), `duplicate_value`; `badges[i].until` `until_required` (LIMITED or
  SEASONAL without a date), `until_not_allowed` (a date on a badge without an end), `until_past`, `until_too_far` (more
  than 366 days ahead). Nothing changes. The database holds the same rules (CHECKs `gifts_badges_sound`,
  `store_items_badges_sound`, `*_badge_new_until`, `*_badge_limited_until`, `*_badge_seasonal_until`).
- **Ends.** NEW without `until` ends 14 days after the save that set it (the panel shows and may change the date); a later
  save keeps the date the panel sends back. LIMITED and SEASONAL end on the owner's date. **At the end only the badge
  stops showing**: the gift stays in the catalogue, the store item stays on sale (a seasonal item too — the owner hides it
  with «إيقاف» if wanted). The end is compared **when the list is read** (no sweeper): `Gift.badges` / `StoreItem.badges`
  carry the running ones; the stored set (with ended ones, `active: false`) is the panel's. `GiftCatalogue.version`
  includes the running badges, so it changes when one ends and the app reloads. The apps also hide a badge whose `until`
  has passed by the device clock.
- **Lucky gifts** may carry badges (the panel and the details sheet show them); their gift-box tile keeps the mark it had
  before D289 (§10.102.4). (Owner, D289-Q3.)
- **«موسمي» is always time-bound** (owner, D289-Q2: «نضعها محددة بوقت وتختفي عند الانتهاء»): a new or changed SEASONAL needs
  its date (`until_required`). The only SEASONAL without an end is one migrated from EVENT; it shows until the owner sets
  a date, and the panel's gift and store lists mark it «حدد تاريخ الانتهاء» (with the count and a «عرضها فقط» filter). The
  form does not save the item again until that date is set.
- **Older clients.** `Gift.badge` (deprecated) is the single value an older app reads: NEW while «جديد» runs, else EVENT
  while «موسمي» runs, else NONE. `StoreItem.isNew` (deprecated) is true while «جديد» runs. The panel's and the CLI's old
  inputs still work: `badge` (gift) NONE / NEW / EVENT and `isNew` (store) set or take off «جديد» / «موسمي» only (NEW gets
  14 days; EVENT a «موسمي» without an end), never both with `badges` (400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` `conflict`). The columns
  `gifts.badge` and `store_items.is_new` are written in step for a rollback and dropped in a later release.
- Audit: `gift.add` / `gift.update` and `store.item.add` / `store.item.update` record the set as text (`CODE@end`, in
  priority order) in before / after.

#### 10.102.3 Detection in the panel

- `uploadAdminGiftFile` (`kind=animation`) and `uploadAdminStoreArt` (`kind=animation`) answer what the file says:
  `hasAudio` (an MP4 with an audio track — `hdlr` `soun` in `moov`, read with the D162 box parser; an SVGA whose
  `MovieEntity` has `audios`) and `fullscreen` (the effect's picture — an MP4's display size, half the width of a
  side-by-side one; an SVGA's `params.viewBox` — is portrait at least 1.5 : 1, a phone screen's shape). The gift upload
  also answers an SVGA's `width` / `height`; `kind=sound` answers `hasAudio: true`. WebM is not an accepted format (gift
  and store effects are SVGA or MP4), so it is not probed.
- The panel then **pre-selects** (owner, D289-Q4: both): SOUND when the effect has audio or the gift has its MP3 sound;
  NO_SOUND when there is an effect without either; FULLSCREEN when `fullscreen`. Pre-selected badges are marked «تلقائي» and can be changed; the
  two sound badges are one choice (choosing one clears the other), so the panel never sends both. Editing a gift does not
  re-run the detection until a new file is uploaded.

#### 10.102.4 The apps

- **Gift box** (the live and conversation gift sheet): up to **two** running badges per tile, in the priority order, in
  the tile's top end corner, as small pills (icon + label); a pill whose label does not fit its share of the tile shows its
  icon alone; the corner area stops above the name and the price row, so the price is never covered (checked at 360 × 800,
  text scale 1.3, Arabic and English). A **lucky** gift's tile is unchanged (its earlier single corner chip, from
  `Gift.badge`). A long press on a tile opens the gift's details: its picture, name, price and **all** its badges with
  icon and name, and the days left of a timed one.
- **Store**: up to two badge pills on the image's top start corner (the «تملكه» chip keeps the top end); the item's sheet
  lists all the badges with icon and name, and the days left of LIMITED / NEW / SEASONAL.

#### 10.102.5 «حذف» a store item in the panel *(D289b)*

Owner (2026-11-06): «عند اضافة عنصر الى متجر من لوحة الادمن لا يمكن حذفه، فاريد منك اضافة زر الحذف». Before this, an item
could only be switched off (§10.98.5); nothing removed it, because purchases and bag rows point at it.

- `deleteAdminStoreItem` (`DELETE /admin/store/items/{itemId}`, `catalog.manage`, CSRF; the reason optional; no
  authenticator code — not a money action) decides on one rule, in the item's transaction:
  - **nobody ever bought it** (no `store_purchases` row) **and nobody holds it now** (no unexpired `user_bag_items` row):
    **DELETED** — the store row and its prices, its bag catalogue row (expired bag rows and bag notifications of it go
    with it; `bag_transfers` keep the code as history) and, after the commit, its uploaded art when no other store item
    uses the same file. Audited `store.item.delete` (`case: deleted`, the item before).
  - otherwise **HIDDEN** — `hidden_at` set and `enabled` false (CHECK `store_items_hidden_off`): gone from
    `listStoreItems`, the bag catalogue and the panel's grant list, never sold (409 `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` `item_off`), and
    still working for the people who hold it — listed in their bags, worn, shown in `wear`, sendable — until their items
    end; its sales stay. Audited `store.item.hide` (`case: hidden`, owners, purchases, whether it was on). Hidden already:
    200 HIDDEN, nothing written.
  The answer `AdminStoreItemDeleted` says which (`result`, `owners`, `purchases`, the item now or null).
- `restoreAdminStoreItem` («إرجاع للمتجر»): `hidden_at` cleared and the item switched on; audited `store.item.restore`.
  `enableAdminStoreItem` refuses a hidden item (409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`). `AdminStoreItem.hiddenAt` is the state.
- The panel: «حذف» on each item row and in the item's form; one confirm dialog that says which case applies («سيُحذف
  نهائياً» or «سيُخفى من المتجر؛ يبقى عند N مستخدمين يملكونه»), from `sold` and `owners`; a «مخفية (N)» filter in the list with
  «إرجاع للمتجر». The apps need no change: hidden items are simply not listed, and owned ones keep their art.
- Migration `20270323090100_store_item_delete` (the column and the CHECK).

**Migration** `20270323090000_item_badges` (expand only): the `item_badge` type; `badges item_badge[]` and three
`badge_*_until` columns on `gifts` and `store_items`; backfill — a gift's NEW and a store item's `is_new` become «جديد»
**ending 14 days after the migration** (owner, D289-Q1), a gift's EVENT becomes «موسمي» **without an end** (it shows until the owner sets
a date in the panel; the panel asks for one at the next save); the CHECKs above.

**Compatibility.** Additive for the apps (`badges` is a new required response field; `badge` / `isNew` keep their
meaning while «جديد» runs, so an older app stops showing «جديد» after 14 days instead of never). The panel's request
fields are additive (`badges`); the old ones still work.

### 10.103 «طلب رفع ليفيل» — level-raise requests for supporters from other apps *(v1.89-social, DRAFT — D290)*

Owner (2026-11-06, spec Q2): «المشرفون والدعم يستقطبون داعماً جديداً من تطبيق آخر ويرسلون طلباً للإدارة العليا لرفع ليفيل
حسابه» — with a video of the source profile, the source app, the account ID there; the supporter must have recharged
≥ 1 000 000 coins in Kabso; on approval the level is raised automatically by a formula of the 7-day recharge, the support
level, the charm level and the source level; **never above 40, never below the current level; the owner may lower the
proposal before approving**. The conversion is **by money** (owner's choice), with data prepared for every app and the
panel proposing the level with its reasoning. The label is in the social series because the levels are (D194,
v1.63-social); the staff side reuses the live series' staff tools (D273 / D286) without changing them.

**10.103.1 Who.** Capabilities (`admin-permissions.ts`): `levels.raise.request` — OWNER, MODERATION, SUPPORT (make a
request in the app's staff Me tab «أنا» or the panel, see one's own, the source-app list); `levels.raise.decide` — OWNER
only (every request, the proposal, approve / reject, the source-app data, the weights). The app routes (`/staff/level-raises…`)
go through the D273 staff guard (role + capability on every request; creating is staff work, D286; reading is not). A
Kabso Team account (any panel role but OWNER, D283: no levels) cannot be the supporter (`level_raise_staff_account`), nor
the staff member themself (`level_raise_self`). Recruitment D285 is separate: a level raise pays no commission and
needs no recruiter attribution.

**10.103.2 The request.** `{username, sourceApp (a code; OTHER + sourceAppName for an app not in the list),
sourceAccountId (≤ 64), sourceLevel (1–999), videoId, note? (≤ 500)}`. One PENDING request per supporter (partial unique
index; `level_raise_open_exists`). **The video** is required: media kind `LEVEL_RAISE_VIDEO` — MP4 / QuickTime, H.264 /
HEVC, **1–90 s, ≤ 200 MiB** with the app's presigned upload (a poster like any video, §11.14), **≤ 100 MiB** with the
panel's raw upload (`POST /admin/level-raise-videos`, held in memory once; stored without a poster). It is the caller's
own unattached asset younger than 24 h and is attached to one request only (unique `video_media_id`); an unattached
video is swept after 24 h like any upload. The OWNER plays it through the API (`getAdminLevelRaiseVideo`, byte ranges ≤
2 MiB a response: the panel's CSP allows no storage origin). **Choice (documented): a request may be created before
the supporter reaches the recharge threshold; it cannot be approved until then** (`level_raise_not_eligible`) — the
staff member can send the request as soon as the supporter joins.

**10.103.3 The evidence.** Read live at every view of a PENDING request (and frozen into `proposal` at the decision):
`totalRechargeCoins` = Σ `wallet_ledger.delta` of the recharge reasons `CARD_TOPUP`, `CARD_TOPUP_REVERSAL`,
`CARD_TOPUP_RESTORE`, `RECHARGE_PURCHASE`, `RECHARGE_ORDER` (net, ≥ 0); `firstDaysRechargeCoins` = the same with
`created_at` < the account's `created_at` + `firstDays` days (default 7; **"activation" = the account's creation**:
accounts are ACTIVE from sign-up — owner question); the current SUPPORT and ATTRACTIVENESS («الجاذبية» / charm) levels
(`user_level_states.current_level`, 0 = none). Eligible ⇔ `totalRechargeCoins ≥ minRechargeCoins` (default 1 000 000).

**10.103.4 The proposal (exact formula, `level-raise-math.ts`).** Integers throughout except the two logarithms.

1. *Source level → XP* from the app's known table points (`xp_table`): on a point, that point; between two points
   geometric interpolation `xp = xpₐ × (xp_b / xpₐ)^((L − a) / (b − a))` (linear when xpₐ = 0), floored; below the lowest
   point `xp = xp₀ × (L / L₀)^belowTableExponent` (default 3); **above the highest point the highest point's XP (never
   extrapolated upwards)**. A FACTOR app skips steps 1–3: `S = floor(L × factor)`.
2. *XP → money*: `sourceCoins = floor(xp × coinsPerXp)`; `usd = sourceCoins × usdPerMillion / 1 000 000`.
3. *Money → Kabso*: `kabsoCoins = floor(sourceCoins × usdPerMillionCents × 80 000 / 10⁸)` (Kabso's retail price
   1 000 000 coins = $12.50, D188 / D194, i.e. 80 000 coins per $), `kabsoPoints = floor(kabsoCoins × the published
   SUPPORT multiplier)` (0.1 = 1 point per 10 coins), **S = the level those points reach on the published SUPPORT
   ladder** ("source-equivalent level").
4. *Kabso evidence*: `cap(c, base) = clamp(floor(base + levelsPerDoubling × log₂(c / anchorCoins)), 0, 40)` (0 when
   c = 0); `firstDaysCap = cap(firstDaysRechargeCoins, firstDaysBaseLevel)`, `totalCap = cap(totalRechargeCoins,
   totalBaseLevel)`, **`rechargeCap = max(firstDaysCap, totalCap)`**. Bonuses `supportBonus = min(floor(support / 10) ×
   supportBonusPer10Levels, supportBonusMax)`, `charmBonus` the same with the charm level. **`beforeClamp = min(S +
   supportBonus + charmBonus, rechargeCap)`** — the recharge cap is the result's ceiling, so a big source level with
   little Kabso recharge cannot reach 40.
5. *Clamp*: `proposed = min(beforeClamp, 40)`, then `max(proposed, current support level)`. `limitedBy` says which
   bound decided: SOURCE, RECHARGE, MAX_LEVEL or CURRENT_LEVEL.

**Defaults (conservative; reproduce the owner's examples; all OWNER-editable in `level_raise_settings`, audited):**
`minRechargeCoins` 1 000 000, `firstDays` 7, `anchorCoins` 1 000 000, `firstDaysBaseLevel` 20, `totalBaseLevel` 15,
`levelsPerDoubling` 4, support and charm bonus +1 per 10 levels, at most +2 each, `belowTableExponent` 3. Then 1 000 000
recharged in the first week → 20 and later → 15 (owner: «≈ 15–25»); 2 000 000 → 24; 32 000 000 in the first week → 40
(owner: 40); the 40 cap is fixed. **Worked Zafa example, checked against the published D194 ladder:** level 32 =
27 742 536 XP × 10 = 277 425 360 coins = **$5 548.5072** (shown floored to the cent, $5 548.50; the spec's "≈ $5 550") → 443 880 576 Kabso coins → 44 388 057
points → **Kabso level 58** (level 58 starts at 41 440 500 points, 59 at 44 640 500), the spec's "≈ 58" confirmed; with
1 000 000 recharged in the first week the proposal is **20** (limited by the recharge), with 32 000 000 it is **40**.

**10.103.5 Deciding.** `approveAdminLevelRaise {level, reason?}`: refused unless PENDING, eligible, and `current ≤
level ≤ min(proposed, 40)` — or `level = current` (nothing changes; also the only approval for someone already above
40). Issues: `level_raise_not_pending`, `level_raise_not_eligible`, `level_raise_levels_unavailable` (field `rule`);
`level_raise_above_proposal`, `level_raise_below_current`, `level_raise_above_max` (field `level`); all 409
`ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`. **The raise goes through the levels engine (D72 / D169 / D194):** one `points_ledger` ADJUSTMENT
(`sourceType` ADMIN, `created_by_id` the OWNER, idempotency key `level-raise:<request>`, reason «D290 level raise …»)
of `required(level) − (total + carried)` points, applied by `LevelProgressService.apply` in the decision's transaction
— the level, the history row (ADJUSTED), the support frames of the tiers reached (D169) and the never-down rule follow
from the engine; nothing writes `current_level` directly. The DB CHECK `level_raise_requests_approved_level` repeats the
rule. Not announced on the D254 ticker (like panel adjustments). `rejectAdminLevelRaise {reason}`. Audited
`level.raise.request`, `level.raise.approve` {approvedLevel, proposedLevel, before, after, ledgerEntry, the two
recharges, reason}, `level.raise.reject`, `level.raise.app.create` / `.update` {before, after, reason},
`level.raise.settings.update` {before, after, reason}. **The video is deleted after the decision** (owner 2026-11-06,
approve or reject): the decision's transaction sets `video_deleted_at`; right after it, and on every media sweep for
any left over (`MEDIA_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`; a storage failure never undoes the decision), `purgeLevelRaiseVideos`
deletes the objects (video, poster, thumb) and then the asset row (`video_media_id` → NULL; idempotent). The evidence
stays on the request (`video_asset_id`, length, size, display size) and in the decision's audit row
(`video: {mediaId, durationMs, byteSize, width, height, sha256: null, deletedAt}` — the media module keeps no checksum
of an upload, the bytes go straight to storage). `getAdminLevelRaiseVideo` answers 404 from the decision on; the review
page shows «حُذف الفيديو بعد القرار». **Notifications** (system, target `LEVEL_RAISE`): the staff
member gets `LEVEL_RAISE_APPROVED` (with `level`) or `LEVEL_RAISE_REJECTED`; the supporter gets `LEVEL_RAISED` (with
`level`) **only on approval and only when the level rose** (owner default «tell them only on approval»; owner question).

**10.103.6 Source-app data** (`level_raise_source_apps`, OWNER-editable from the panel, audited; new apps addable
there). MONEY: `usdPerMillion`, `coinsPerXp`, `xpTable` (points with their own confidence); FACTOR: `factor`.
`confidence` CONFIRMED only with a cited source (`sourceNote` required; the owner or a page and its date), else
ESTIMATE; the panel shows the label everywhere. Seeded 2026-11-06: **Zafa (زفة) CONFIRMED by the owner** (1M = $20,
10 coins = 1 XP, level 32 = 27 742 536 XP — the only known point; other Zafa levels are derived and the reasoning says
so); Bigo Live, MICO, Yalla, Ahlan, Tango, Poppo Live, SoulChill, Jaco, Lami, Hala, Yoho, Sugo: **ESTIMATE, FACTOR
× 0.5** — no level table could be cited (web search 2026-11-06 found only reseller pages and app-store snippets for
coin prices; those snippets are kept in the note, never used); **OTHER** (exactly one, `is_other`, always an enabled
FACTOR): × 0.5. Pending requests use edits at once.

**10.103.7 Tables.** `level_raise_requests` (one PENDING per supporter; `proposal` JSON as decided),
`level_raise_source_apps`, `level_raise_settings` (one row), `notifications.level_raise_request_id`, enum
`level_raise_status`, `notification_type` +3, media kind `LEVEL_RAISE_VIDEO`, `level_raise_source_apps.aliases`,
the request's video evidence columns and source keys with `level_raise_requests_source_once` (migrations
`20270324090000_level_raise_enums`, `20270324090100_level_raise`).

**10.103.8 Source names and duplicates** (owner follow-up, 2026-11-06). *Canonical source:* a listed app is
`APP:<code>`; "other" is `NAME:<key>` of the typed name — unless the key is a listed app's code, name or alias, then
that app (typing «زفه» as "other" files it under Zafa). *Name key* (`level-raise-names.ts`): lower case, no Latin
diacritics (NFKD), no Arabic tashkeel / superscript alef / tatweel, أ إ آ ٱ → ا, ى → ي, ة → ه, ؤ → و, ئ → ي, Arabic-Indic
digits as Latin, no spaces or punctuation. *Suggestion «هل تقصد: …؟»* (`suggest…LevelRaiseSourceApps?q=`, app and
panel, the staff / panel rate limits): the listed apps by any spelling and the first spelling of each name typed for
"other" in earlier requests; equal (3) > prefix (2) > contained (1, two letters or more), apps first, at most 5;
tapping one selects that app or that name. Aliases are seeded for every app (e.g. Zafa: زافا, زفه, Zafa Live, زفة لايف)
and edited with the app in the panel. *Duplicate check — before anything else:* the same canonical source and account
ID (`source_account_key` = trimmed, lower case) with a PENDING or APPROVED request, across all supporters → 409
`LEVEL_RAISE_DUPLICATE` (status, date, the staff member's display name; the app and the panel word it). Concurrent
requests: unique partial index `level_raise_requests_source_once (source_app_key, source_account_key) WHERE status IN
(PENDING, APPROVED)` — the loser of the race gets the same 409. Only REJECTED ones → allowed; the new request points at
the latest (`previous_rejected_id`, `previousRejection`) and is flagged «سبق رفض طلب بنفس الحساب»; the review page
shows that rejection's date and reason. **Owner decision (2026-11-06):** a new request is allowed when the only earlier
matches were REJECTED (flagged, the rejection shown); PENDING or APPROVED stays 409 `LEVEL_RAISE_DUPLICATE`. The one-PENDING-per-supporter rule
stays.

**10.103.9 Owner answers (2026-11-06).** (1) the weights approved as built; (2) the 7 days count from the account's
creation; (3) the supporter is told only on approval when the level rose; (4) no app data given: ×0.5 for apps without
data stays; (5) the unguessable-link storage is fine, and the video is deleted after the decision (§10.103.5); (6) no
authenticator code for approval; (7) no level-ticker announcement.

### 10.104 Medal levels and the medals page *(v1.81-live, DRAFT — D291)*

Owner (2026-11-06): «ما رأيك ان نصمم صفحة التي تعرض الميداليات بحيث يمكن ان يكون للميدالية ايضاً ليفيلات. حاول ان تأخذ
الفكرة», with a screenshot of **another app's** medals page. The screenshot is a third-party reference for the layout idea
only (a stage with the worn medal, two tabs, a two-column grid of medal cards with the level numeral); it stays out of git
(D40) and none of its art, ornaments or medal artwork is used — Kabso's tokens and its own medal art.

**10.104.1 The level model.**
- Each medal has a **metric** (`medals.metric`, `MedalMetric`): `LIVES_HOSTED` (ended lives hosted), `LIVE_HOURS`
  (hours of all ended lives hosted, `ended_at − started_at`), `CHARM_LEVEL` (CP-005 `ATTRACTIVENESS` level reached),
  `FAMILY_JOINED` (0/1), `CP_FORMED` (0/1), `BULLETS_SENT` (bullet messages sent). Null = a medal without levels.
- Its **levels** (`medal_levels`, 1 … 20 per medal): level *k* is reached when the metric is at least its `threshold`
  (whole numbers 1 … 10¹², strictly rising). **Level 1 is the medal's original award rule** (CP-018), so nothing earned
  before changes meaning. A 0/1 metric (and a medal without a metric) has exactly one level at 1.
- A person's level (`user_medals.level`, `level_reached_at`) is the highest level their metric reaches **at an event**
  — every path that ends a live (lives and hours), a charm level change, a family created or joined, a couple formed, a
  bullet message — in that event's transaction (`raiseMedalLevelsIn`, one set-based statement for a batch). **A level
  never goes down**: a lower value (the charm level can drop), a raised threshold or a repeated event changes nothing.
  Several levels can be reached at once (straight to the level the value reaches).
- Every change gets a `MEDAL_AWARDED` notification with `NotificationTarget.medalLevel` (1 = earned, more = a level-up;
  the push says «ارتقت ميداليتك إلى المستوى n» / "Your medal reached level n"), and every level above 1 an audit row
  `medals.level_up` (system; target the user; `{medalCode, from, to, metric, value, via: event | backfill}`).
- **Art.** Optional per-level hosted art (`medal_levels.icon_url`, https) and names (`name_ar`, `name_en`). Without
  them the app draws the medal's own art (`iconKey`) and writes the level as text next to it (owner 2026-11-06: «لا تضع رقم
  تحت الميداليات» — no number on the art), so the owner can add levels
  without new art.

**10.104.2 Default thresholds** (CTO proposals, **provisional** — owner 2026-11-06: «سيكون لكل ميدالية عدة أشكال وكيفية احتساب، لنؤجل ذلك لمرة أخرى»: per-level shapes and each medal's own way of counting come later; editable in the panel): FIRST_LIVE lives 1 / 10 /
50 / 100 / 500; LIVE_HOURS_10 hours 10 / 25 / 50; LIVE_HOURS_100 hours 100 / 500 / 1000 (together the owner's example
10 / 100 / 500 / 1000 runs across the two live-hours medals, which stay separate so nobody's medal disappears);
CHARM_10 charm 10 / 20 / 30 / 40; CHARM_50 charm 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90; CHARM_100 charm 100 (the top of the charm
scale); FIRST_FAMILY 1; FIRST_CP 1; BULLET_FIRST bullet messages 1 / 10 / 100 / 1000. **Tabs** (owner decision):
«النشاط» ACTIVITY — FIRST_LIVE, LIVE_HOURS_10, LIVE_HOURS_100, BULLET_FIRST; «الإنجازات» ACHIEVEMENT — the charm
medals, FIRST_FAMILY, FIRST_CP.

**10.104.3 The wire.** `GET /medals` (`Medal`) adds `category`, `metric` (the app words the thresholds with it), `level` (0 = not earned), `maxLevel` (1 when `levels`
is empty), `levels` (`MedalLevel` `{level, threshold, name, iconUrl}`, lowest first; `name` in the request's language
or null), `progress` (`{value, next}`: the caller's metric now — whole numbers, hours rounded down — and the next
level's threshold, null at the top), `iconUrl` (the shown level's art or null) and `showcasePosition` (1 … 5 when worn,
in the showcase's order, else null). `UserMedal` adds `category`, `level`, `maxLevel`, `iconUrl`; `ProfileMedal`
(profile `latest` / `showcase`, `MedalShowcase`) adds `level` and `iconUrl`. Apps read a missing `level` as 1. The live
chat line's medals (§10.82) are unchanged.

**10.104.4 The panel «الميداليات».** `GET /admin/medals` (`catalog.view`: OWNER, SUPPORT, FINANCE) → every medal in
catalogue order with its tab, metric, levels and holders (in total and per level). `PUT /admin/medals/{code}`
(`catalog.manage`: OWNER; a reason and the authenticator code again; CSRF) replaces the tab and the whole levels list,
lowest first. 400 `levels` `invalid_value`: thresholds not rising or out of range, a 0/1 medal with anything but one
level at 1, or a list shorter than the highest level somebody holds (levels are never taken away); an art URL that is
not https is a 400 too; 404 unknown medal. Audited `medals.levels.update` (`{before, after, reason, via}`). A new
threshold applies from each person's next event; `medals-admin backfill` applies it to past activity.

**10.104.5 Migration and backfill.** `20270325090000_medal_levels` adds the types, columns and table, sets the tabs and
metrics of the nine medals and seeds the defaults; every medal held before stays **level 1** (correct: level 1 is the
old rule) with `level_reached_at = awarded_at`. `medals-admin backfill [--notify]` (DEPLOYMENT §5.72, PP-50) then raises
each holder to the level their current totals reach (and awards any medal an event missed), in chunks of 200 people per
transaction; idempotent, never lowers; prints `Awarded n medals.` and `Raised n medal levels.`; one `medals.backfill`
audit row with `{awarded, levelUps}`. Without `--notify` it sends nothing.

**10.104.6 The medals page (app).** `/medals` uses **the owner's own art** (2026-11-06, «استخدم هذول في صفحة الميداليات
للدارك مود ولايت مود»; `apps/mobile/assets/medals/PROVENANCE.md`) and follows the app theme: the owner's light or dark
page background (cover, top-aligned, fixed behind the scroll; text colours ≥ 4.5:1 on both). The stage «الميداليات التي
أرتديها» is the owner's pedestal (the dark one in the dark theme, the owner's gold-and-white one in the light theme),
scaled to the width, with **exactly one earned medal** on its top surface (owner: «عرض الميدالية يكون للميداليات التي تم
فتحها وتعرض على المنصة ميدالية واحدة فقط»), large, with its level chip and its name and level under it: by default the
first worn medal, else the highest-level earned one. **Tapping an earned card puts it on the stage** (a short scale-in;
the page scrolls back to the stage); tapping the stage's medal, tapping an earned card that is already on the stage, or a
long press on any card opens its sheet; tapping a locked card opens its sheet with the requirement only (locked medals
never go on the stage). The choice is page-local (no API, not saved). With no earned medal: a dashed hexagon on the
pedestal, the pill «غير مرتدية» and «لا ترتدي أي ميدالية». The line under it counts what the profile shows: «على ملفك: x من 5»
(the separate wear / take off of the sheet).
Under it the tabs «الإنجازات» / «النشاط» and a two-column grid of cards in the owner's frame (its own 3:4 aspect): the art
(no number on it), the name (the level's own name when set) and the status — «لم تُحصَّل» (art greyscale, frame
desaturated), «المستوى n» with a thin bar and «x / y» toward the next level, or «مرتدية»; the card's text scale stops at
× 1.3 and its content scales down rather than overflow. A card opens a sheet with every level and its threshold, the
progress and «ارتداء» / «خلع» for an earned medal (owned only, at most 5; the 6th asks to take one off first). Other
people's profiles and medal lists show their worn medals as before, the level in the row's spoken label and in
the list's «المستوى n».

**10.104.7 «ملوك الثروة» / Wealth Kings — the first real levelled medal** (owner 2026-11-06). One medal
(`WEALTH_KINGS`, tab ACHIEVEMENT), metric `GIFTS_SENT_COINS`: the coin value of **every gift the person sent to anyone,
except the lucky-gift category** (owner: «اي هدية مرسلة لاي مستخدم الا هدايا فئة الحظ») — gifts in a live (video or
audio; to the host or seat guests), gifts in a direct conversation, and CP gifts; there is no other gift path (posts and
profiles have none). A send counts at its `total_coins` (unit price × quantity × recipients; a BAG send at its coin value
too), **once**, in the send's own transaction (`medal_metric_totals`, `addGiftsSentIn`): a failed send rolls back, a retry
with the same `clientId` never reaches it, gifts are never refunded. Six levels with the **owner's thresholds (not
provisional)**: 50 M / 150 M / 300 M / 500 M / 1 B / 3 B coins, each with the owner's own art bundled in the app
(`medal_levels.icon_asset` `medal_wealth_l1` … `_l6`: lion, silver wolf, violet wolf, gold-violet lion, eagle, dragon;
`apps/mobile/assets/medals/PROVENANCE.md`). The app shows the **current level's art** on the stage, the card, the profile
row and the picker; the sheet's ladder shows each level's art, unreached ones greyed. `MedalLevel.iconAsset` (and
`iconAsset` on `Medal`, `UserMedal`, `ProfileMedal`, `AdminMedalLevel`, the panel input): a bundled art key
(`^[a-z0-9_]{1,60}$`); `iconUrl` wins when both are set; an app without the key draws the medal's `iconKey`. Migrations
`20270325090100_medal_wealth_metric` (the enum value, alone) and `20270325090200_medal_wealth_kings` (the column, the totals
table, the medal and its levels); `medals-admin backfill` sets the totals from `live_gifts` (lucky excluded) plus
`cp_gifts` and raises the levels. Description: «مجموع قيمة الهدايا التي أرسلتها لأي مستخدم، عدا هدايا الحظ.» / "Total
value of gifts you sent to anyone, except lucky gifts." The other medals' thresholds stay provisional.

**10.104.8 The charm and live-hours codes are name-side icons, not medals** (owner 2026-11-06: «هذه بالأصل ليست
ميدالية يمكن ارتداؤها، فقط تكون أيقونة بجانب الاسم»). `CHARM_10`, `CHARM_50`, `CHARM_100`, `LIVE_HOURS_10` and
`LIVE_HOURS_100` are retired (`medals.retired`, migration `20270325090300_medal_retire_name_icons`): left out of `GET
/medals` (and its `total` / `owned`), `GET /users/{username}/medals`, `PublicProfile.medals` (owned, total, latest,
showcase), `GET /me/medals/showcase` and the live chat line's medals; never awarded again and no `MEDAL_AWARDED` for them
(the charm and live-end events still raise FIRST_LIVE and the other medals); `PUT /me/medals/showcase` with one → 400
`medalCodes` / `invalid_value`; the panel lists them with `retired: true`, read-only (`updateAdminMedal` → 409
`ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`). Their `user_medals` rows are kept as history; the migration clears their showcase positions and
renumbers each affected person's remaining worn medals 1, 2, … in order. The name-side icon for charm is the existing
charm level badge (CP-005, from `user_level_states`, not from medals) — unchanged. **No name-side icon for live hours**
— decided by the owner: the charm icon is enough («تكفي»). Their default levels (§10.104.2) are moot.

**10.104.8a The four «first» medals retired too** *(D313; owner 2026-11-08: «ميداليات موجودة: أول لايف، وأول رسالة
عامة، وأول عائلة، وأول ثنائي — ازلها»)*. `FIRST_LIVE` «أول لايف», `BULLET_FIRST` «أول رسالة عامة», `FIRST_FAMILY` «أول
عائلة» and `FIRST_CP` «أول ثنائي» are retired exactly as §10.104.8 (migration `20270407090100_medal_retire_firsts`; the
same SQL): left out of the medals page, its totals, the lists, the profile, the showcase and the live chat line; never
awarded again, no `MEDAL_AWARDED` (the live-end, bullet, family and couple events now raise no medal: no medal is left
on `LIVES_HOSTED`, `BULLETS_SENT`, `FAMILY_JOINED` or `CP_FORMED`); wearing one → 400 `medalCodes` / `invalid_value`; the
panel lists them read-only with `retired: true` and their holders. Copies already earned: their `user_medals` rows are
kept as history and shown nowhere but the panel's holder counts; the migration clears their showcase positions and
renumbers each affected person's remaining worn medals. The wearable medals left: `WEALTH_KINGS`, `LUCKY_MASTER`,
`CONTENT_SCHOOL`, `DARES_PLAYER`. No wire change (no contract version).

**10.104.9 «سيد الحظ» / Lucky Master** (owner 2026-11-06). One medal (`LUCKY_MASTER`, tab ACHIEVEMENT, sort 110),
metric `LUCKY_GIFTS_SENT_COINS`: the coin value of the **lucky-category gifts the person sent** — what was sent, **not**
what was won back (winnings are not counted). The exact complement of `GIFTS_SENT_COINS` (§10.104.7) on the live and
direct-message paths: every gift send counts for exactly one of the two medals (CP gifts have no lucky category). A send
counts at its `total_coins`, **once**, in the send's own transaction (`addLuckyGiftsSentIn`, `medal_metric_totals`), with
the same rules as §10.104.7. Four levels with the **owner's thresholds (not provisional)**: 500 M / 1.5 B / 3 B / 10 B
coins, each with the owner's own art bundled in the app (`medal_lucky_l1` … `_l4`: blue gift in a silver frame, violet /
lilac, red / gold, crystal-opal / gold; `PROVENANCE.md`). Totals and thresholds are BIGINT end to end (10 B is above
2^32; JSON numbers stay exact below 2^53; the app parses them as 64-bit `int`). Migrations
`20270325090400_medal_lucky_metric` (the enum value, alone) and `20270325090500_medal_lucky_master` (the medal and its
levels); `medals-admin backfill` sets the totals from `live_gifts` of the LUCKY category. Description: «مجموع قيمة هدايا
الحظ التي أرسلتها.» / "Total value of lucky gifts you sent."

### 10.105 Automatic verification badges «شارة التوثيق» *(v1.90-social, DRAFT — D293)*

Owner (2026-11-06): a verification badge beside the name, **granted automatically by conditions** over the **last 30
days** (rolling, recomputed regularly — daily is enough); a person shows **one** badge, the highest of the order below
when several apply (the owner also expects a person to qualify for one at most; the order makes an overlap
deterministic). The thresholds are the OWNER's, editable in the panel.

**10.105.1 The badges, highest first** (`VerificationBadge`; every one needs an ACTIVE account — a ban, a lock to
SUSPENDED or a deletion removes it at the next recompute).

| # | Value | Colour, icon | Who (as read by the server) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `OWNER` | black seal, gold rim and gold check | an account with `users.role = ADMIN` holding the panel role **OWNER** (every OWNER, the primary «Kabso» and any other) |
| 2 | `STAFF` | red | the **Kabso Team**: an ADMIN account holding MODERATION, SUPPORT, FINANCE or BD (D283's limited staff roles, `LIMITED_STAFF_ROLES`) |
| 3 | `RECHARGE_AGENT` | gold | an **ACTIVE** recharge agent (the `rechargeAgent` tag's rule) whose **coins sold** in the window are more than `rechargeMinSalesCoins` **and** whose **cherries bought from hosts** in the window are more than `rechargeMinCherries` |
| 4 | `HOST_AGENT` | green | a **host agent** — the owner of an OPEN agency the team has not suspended, with its host code (the `hostAgent` tag's rule) — whose agency has more than `hostAgentMinHosts` **active hosts now** **and** whose hosts **received** more than `hostAgentMinCherries` cherries in the window |
| 5 | `CREATOR` | purple | a member of the creator programme (D285 `creator_members`; the membership has no end today) |
| 6 | `VERIFIED_HOST` | blue | never a creator member (D295, owner: a person is never both a host and a creator — not through an agency link either); a **host** — a hosting permission (`live_hosts`, any source but `CREATOR` — the permission a creator membership gives, §10.108, is not a host's: the team, an agency, «كن مضيفاً مع الإدارة») or an ACTIVE agency link — whose identity was **approved**: an APPROVED Didit check (`kyc_checks`, §10.77: the document, passive liveness and the 1:1 face match; any purpose), **or** (owner's decision 2026-11-06, «نعم») an APPROVED «كن مضيفاً مع الإدارة» application (`host_applications`, D209 §10.68) — the team's manual review of the ID card and the selfie while Didit is off (with Didit on, that approval itself needs an approved check). Pending, rejected and cancelled applications do not count |

**10.105.2 The measures** — the gold measures below are the **owner's decision** (2026-11-06: sales = coins sold to
buyers, direct sales plus completed orders, the employees' included; withdrawals = confirmed cherry purchases from
hosts) (the window is `[now − 30 days, now]`; every comparison is **«more than»**: a value equal to
its threshold does not qualify; sums are BIGINT / NUMERIC in PostgreSQL and compared there, exact at any size).
- **Coins sold** (gold) = the agent's direct sales (`recharge_sales.coins`, `created_at` in the window — the agent's
  and every employee's sale, D287: `agent_user_id` is the agent's account) **plus** the coin orders closed
  `COMPLETED` or `COMPLETED_BY_ADMIN` (`recharge_orders.coins`, `closed_at` in the window — whoever of the agent's side
  owned them). Orders cancelled, expired or refunded to the agent do not count. No sale is counted twice (a completed
  order writes no `recharge_sales` row).
- **Cherries bought from hosts** (gold, the owner's «سحوبات») = the agent's **confirmed** cherry purchases
  (`recharge_cherry_requests.cherries`, status `CONFIRMED`, `decided_at` in the window — made or answered by the agent
  or an employee). Pending, declined, cancelled and expired requests do not count.
- **Active hosts** (green) = the agency's `agency_hosts` rows `ACTIVE` now whose host account is ACTIVE (members who
  left, were released or moved do not count). This is **not** the agency ranks' «active host» live-time test
  (§10.46: ≥ 7 live days and ≥ 10 live hours in 30 days).
- **The agency's target** (green) = the cherries the agency's hosts received from gifts while linked to it
  (`agency_earnings.host_cherries`, not reversed, `created_at` in the window) — the ledger behind the agency's month
  totals. The agency module's own monthly concepts (`agency_months.host_cherries` per calendar month, the rank
  exception and the commission tier) are **not** used: the owner chose the rolling 30 days.

**10.105.3 Computing.** The result is stored: `user_verification_badges` (one row per person with a badge: `badge`,
`since` = when this badge was granted, `computed_at` = the last recompute that kept it; no row = no badge). Written
only by `verification-badges.ts`:
- the **sweeper**, every `VERIFICATION_BADGE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (default 3600 — hourly; 1 … 86 400; 0 = off for
  tests, **refused in production**), recomputes everyone, so badges appear and disappear as the window moves;
- **at once**, in the change's own transaction, for one person: a panel role granted or revoked (CLI and «الموظفون
  والصلاحيات»), a creator application approved, an agency's creator activation or a creator membership revoked (the
  team's revoke or an agency ban, §10.108), an identity check that becomes or stops being APPROVED, a «كن مضيفاً
  مع الإدارة» application approved, a hosting permission revoked by the team (cause `host`);
- a **settings change** recomputes everyone in its transaction;
- the CLI `verification-admin recompute` (the first-run backfill, DEPLOYMENT §5.73).
One recompute at a time (an advisory transaction lock). Each difference is audited **`verification.badge.change`**
(system; target the user; `{before, after, change: granted | changed | removed, cause: sweep | backfill | settings |
role | creator | kyc | host}`) — never an amount. A kept badge only moves `computed_at`.

**10.105.4 The panel «شارات التوثيق».** `GET /admin/verification-badges/settings` (`verification.view`: OWNER,
MODERATION, SUPPORT, FINANCE) → `AdminVerificationSettings` (`settings`, `defaults`, `windowDays` 30, `holders` per
badge, `lastRunAt`, `updatedAt`). `PUT` the same path (`verification.settings`: OWNER; any of the four thresholds, a
reason and the authenticator code again; CSRF) → the same body after the recompute; 400 for nothing to change
(`rechargeMinSalesCoins` / `required`), a negative, fractional or too-large value (≤ 10¹⁵; hosts ≤ 100 000). Audited
`verification.settings.update` `{before, after, reason, via}`. **Defaults (the owner's):** 300 000 000 coins sold,
300 000 000 cherries bought, 30 hosts, 300 000 000 cherries received. `getAdminUser` → `AdminUserDetail.verification`
(`{badge, since, computedAt}` or null).

**10.105.5 The wire (public-safe).** `Me.verification` and `PublicProfile.verification`: the `VerificationBadge` or null
— **only the badge type**, never a sum, a threshold or a host count; also on a private account's profile. An unknown
value is shown as no badge. **`UserSummary.verification`** (owner 2026-11-06, «نعم»: beside the name **everywhere** the
name appears): present only while the user holds a badge (an active account), read with the summary's own query
(`USER_SUMMARY_SELECT`'s one-to-one relation, a LEFT JOIN in search, a subquery on the primary key in live room cards —
never one query per row). So it reaches live chat lines and join lines (`LiveChatMessage.author`), the viewers list,
seats, the person card, follow lists, search, post / reel and comment authors, DM lists and headers
(`DmConversation.peer`), live room cards (`LiveRoomSummary.host`) and every other list that carries a `UserSummary`.

**10.105.6 The apps.** `ProfileVerificationBadge`: a rosette seal with 8 soft, rounded lobes (the generic
"verified" silhouette, drawn in Flutter from r(θ) = R·(1 + 0.075·cos 8θ) — no copied art) in the badge's colour with
**the same check mark in every seal** (owner 2026-11-06: «اجعلها كلها بصح لكن الألوان مختلفة التي حددناها»; white,
the OWNER's black seal with a gold rim and a gold check); about the name's line height (1.15 × its font size: 23 lp in
the profile header, 21 lp in the Me tab's name row), vertically centred, right after the display name; in every other place where a person's name is shown (chat
lines, lists, search, authors, DMs, the person card, the viewers list) the same seal sized to that text
(`VerificationSeal`, ≈ 1.15 × the font size). Since the check
is the same, the spoken label and the tooltip / long press say which one: «موثّق: وكيل شحن» / "Verified: recharge
agent" (and the five others) with «شارة تُمنح تلقائياً حسب الشروط». The admin panel shows the badge on the user page
and the thresholds page.

### 10.106 Profile tag icons *(v1.91-social, DRAFT — D292)*

The owner (2026-11-06, after his own mock of the profile: rounded tag chips with a leading icon) chose **option 1**:
tags stay free text (§10.99) and the **person picks the icon** of each tag.

- **The icons** (`ProfileTagIcon`): a closed set the apps draw with their own icons — never emoji glyphs:
  `default` (the plain chip, no icon), `crown`, `fire`, `trophy`, `gamepad`, `music`, `mic`, `moon`, `heart`, `star`,
  `gem`, `camera`, `book`, `sport`, `palette`, `globe`; and **`flag:<country>`** with an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
  (the countries of §10.28; stored upper case), drawn with the app's bundled flag art (`assets/flags/`, OFL). A bare
  `flag` is not an icon. An app that meets an icon it does not know draws `default`.
- **Set** with `PATCH /me` `tagIcons`: one entry per tag of `tags`, in the same order, **only together with `tags`**
  and exactly as many (else `tagIcons` / `invalid_value`); each entry an icon or null (= `default`); anything else
  → `tagIcons.<i>` / `invalid_value`. The 10-tag limit and the tag rules (§10.99) are unchanged.
- **Older apps**: `tags` without `tagIcons` keeps, for each tag, the icon it had (the same text ignoring case,
  `toLocaleLowerCase('en')`); a new tag gets `default`. `tagIcons` without `tags` is refused (above), so an icon
  never drifts to another tag.
- **Read** in `Me.tagIcons` and `PublicProfile.tagIcons`: always one per tag, `default` where none was chosen.
  Stored in `user_profiles.tag_icons` (`varchar(24)[]`, empty for rows before v1.91-social — read as `default` —
  or one per tag: CHECK `user_profiles_tag_icons_len`; CHECK `user_profiles_tag_icons_values` as a backstop for
  the set).
- **Audit**: a change adds `tagIcons` to the `profile.update` row's `fields` (never the values, §10.42).
- **App**: the chips on the profile are small hollow pills (≈ 24 dp; a thin Kabso-red outline, red text, no fill;
  owner: «اجعلها أصغر وبصف واحد، والأيقونة فقط بإطار مفرّغ») with the icon before the text, on **one line** — what does
  not fit shows as «+n» (this replaces §10.99's two lines). In «تعديل الملف الشخصي» each tag shows its icon; a tap
  on it opens a grid of the icons (and, for `flag`, the country list). Each icon has an Arabic and an English name for
  screen readers.

### 10.107 The reels page: one feed and the posts page's header *(v1.92-social, DRAFT — D294)*

Owner, 2026-11-06, from screenshots of the app's own reels page and posts page: the reels page's header must look like
the posts page's; «اجعل فلتر فقط منشورات وريلز» — the only switch is Posts / Reels; Nearby «القريبة» goes from the app;
and «لماذا الخط أسفل البوست؟ أزله» on the posts feed.

#### 10.107.1 `GET /feed/reels?tab=mixed`

- **The rule** is the posts home feed's (§10.73.1) over reels: one entry from reels Following (§11.14: reels of
  followed accounts, **the caller's own reels**, reels reposted by followed accounts; newest entry first, a reel once at
  its newest entry, a repost with `repostedBy`), then two from reels Trending (§11.3's score over visible public reels
  of the last 7 days, never the caller's own, at most 2 per author in any 10), then 1, 2, … (1 : 2).
- **Exhaustion, each reel once, caps.** When one source is empty its turns go to the other; the list ends when both
  are. A reel in both is listed at its Following place only. Following contributes its newest 500 entries, Trending its
  500-entry snapshot.
- **Left out** as in both sources: muted authors and reposters, hidden reels, private accounts in Trending, blocks both
  ways; every page re-checks visibility. *Difference from the posts mix:* the posts mix leaves the caller's own posts
  out (§10.73.1); reels Following has always held the caller's own reels (D162), so the reels mix keeps them (at their
  Following place, never in Trending).
- **Pagination.** The first page merges both sources into one frozen list (Redis, 10 minutes, per caller, its own list
  name `reels-mixed`); later pages read it by offset — never a repeat or a skip, and new reels do not shift it. An
  expired snapshot, another caller's cursor, or a cursor of another list (reels `following` / `trending`, the posts
  `mixed`) → 400 `cursor` / `invalid_value`; the app reloads the first page once.
- **One implementation.** The server reuses the posts mix unchanged (`FeedService` `mixed` with the reels format:
  the same interleave, Following query, Trending ranking and snapshot paging). `following`, `trending` and `nearby`
  answer exactly as before; `GET /feed/posts` has no `nearby` (still 400). Same `social:feed` bucket.

#### 10.107.2 What the app does (no further API)

- **The reels page's header is the posts page's bar** in the reels page's dark theme, floating over the video on
  D202's scrim: Search at the reading start, the words «المنشورات | الريلز» in the middle — the same words in the same
  order as on Posts — with «الريلز» selected (the red indicator under it) and «المنشورات» the switch back, the bell
  at the end. Removed: the tabs «متابَعون / لك / القريبة» and the «المنشورات» chip under the bar. The video's speaker
  button sits under the bar at the reading end.
- **One reels feed:** the page lists `tab=mixed` only. Nearby — and its «اختر بلدك» prompt, which only Nearby used — is
  gone from the app; the API keeps `nearby` (additive contract; an older app still uses it).
- **The posts feed has no line between posts:** D218's hairline under the action row is gone from the posts feed and
  16 dp of air separates two posts (it was 4 dp + the line + 8 dp). The single-post screen keeps its closing line.
  The red indicator under the selected «المنشورات» / «الريلز» is unchanged.
- **The live hub's brand** (owner, the same day: «إن كان التطبيق بالعربية، كلمة كابسو لايف تكون على اليمين بالعربية،
  وإن كان إنجليزي تكون على اليسار بالإنجليزي، واجعلها بخط غامق وأكبر قليلاً»): the hub's top bar reads «كابسو لايف» in
  Arabic and "Kabso Live" in English (was "Kabso" in both), at the reading start (right in RTL, left in LTR; the bar
  follows the app's direction), in the language's own bundled font at its heaviest face (700), 21 sp (was 18),
  ellipsized, never clipped. The auth screens' `KLogo` wordmark is unchanged.

### 10.108 Content creators go live «صانع محتوى» *(v1.82-live, DRAFT — D295)*

Owner 2026-11-06: a member of the creator programme (§10.96.13) goes live like a host, with no host application and no
agency; a person is never both a host and a creator; the lists alternate one host's live and one creator's live; a
purple «صانع محتوى» badge; a creator's live pays 70 % (owner, int16: «اجعل نسبة صانع المحتوى 70%»; was 72 %); an agency owner may activate a member as a creator, under a
warning; the team may ban an agency that activated a fake creator.

#### 10.108.1 The hosting permission

- A creator-programme membership (`creator_members`) **grants** the hosting permission: a `live_hosts` row with source
  **`CREATOR`**, written in the same transaction as the membership (the panel's approval of «انضم كصانع محتوى», or an
  agency activation, §10.108.6) and removed when the membership ends (§10.108.7, §10.108.8). `Me.canHost` is true while a member;
  go-live, the room number, the cover and the blocked words work as for any host.
- Audited `live.host.grant` (source CREATOR) and, at the end, `creator.member.revoke` (+ `live.host.revoke`).
- Existing members without a permission get one from the migration (backfill). A member who already held a permission
  of another source keeps it untouched: the migration and the trigger never fail on such rows (the trigger guards new
  writes only). Owner 2026-11-06 (decided): a person can never be both and there is NO automatic rule — the team
  resolves each such row by hand in the panel by revoking one role: the host revoke (`revokeLiveHost` / «سحب البث»)
  removes the host permission and gives the membership's `CREATOR` permission back at once (audited
  `live.host.grant` `resolvedBothRoles`); or «إلغاء العضوية» ends the membership and the host permission stays.
  DEPLOYMENT §5.76 has the query that lists them.

#### 10.108.2 Host and creator are mutually exclusive

A **host** is a person holding a hosting permission of any source but `CREATOR` (`ADMIN`, `AGENCY`, `IDENTITY`). A
**creator** is a creator-programme member. Nobody is both; every path refuses it and the database backs it:

| Path | Refusal |
| ---- | ------- |
| `applyForCreatorProgramme` by a host | 409 `CREATOR_APPLICATION_NOT_ALLOWED` `{field: application, issue: HOST}` (also `rule.refusal`) |
| the panel's approval of a creator application whose applicant became a host meanwhile | 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` `{field: application, issue: HOST}` |
| `applyForHosting` by a creator | 409 `HOST_APPLICATION_NOT_ALLOWED` `{field: application, issue: CREATOR}` (also `rule.refusal`, right after `ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE`) |
| the panel's approval of a host application whose applicant became a creator | 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` `{field: application, issue: CREATOR}` |
| an admin grant (`grantLiveHost`, the panel's «منح البث») of a creator; the admin revoke of a creator's `CREATOR` permission | 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` `{field: user, issue: CREATOR}` (a creator's permission ends only with the membership; a pre-D295 both-roles person's HOST permission can be revoked, §10.108.1) |
| the agency activation of the opposite type | 409 `AGENCY_ACTIVATION_NOT_ALLOWED` `HOST` / `CREATOR` |
| any other write (CLI, SQL) | the trigger `kabso_creator_host_exclusive` on `live_hosts` and `creator_members` (`creator_host_exclusive`, SQLSTATE 23514) |

D285's recruitment is consistent: one HOST *or* CREATOR recruitment per person (`staff_recruitments_one_gift_recruit`).
A member of an agency (`agency_hosts`) without a hosting permission is neither yet: the agency activates them as one or
the other (§10.108.6), or they apply themselves.

#### 10.108.3 The live lists: one host, one creator

- **Popular «الشائع», New / Explore «الجديد» and Nearby «القريب»** (`tab` `popular` or `new`, with or without
  `scope=nearby` / `country`, with any `category` and `kind`) interleave **1 : 1**: one host's live, then one
  creator's live, alternating, starting with a host. Each group keeps the tab's own order (§10.4: Popular = score,
  startedAt, id; New = startedAt, id). When one group runs out, the other continues alone.
- **Following «المتابَعين»** keeps its single order (startedAt). **Featured** (`featured=true`) keeps its rank order
  (the team's curation) — not interleaved.
- **Cursor.** The lists do not freeze, so each group is its own keyset query and the merge is deterministic: the
  cursor's payload carries `x = {h, c, g}` — the host group's last position, the creator group's last position (null:
  none of that group taken yet) and the group of the last row taken (`H` / `C`); the next page continues each group
  after its own position and starts with the other group than `g`. Over an unchanged set of rooms no room repeats or is
