  skipped; drift between pages behaves as §10.4 says for every list (the client dedupes by id). `x` is refused outside
  the interleaved lists (400 `cursor` `invalid_value`). A cursor **without** `x` on those lists (issued before
  v1.82-live: the single order of §10.4) stays valid — the same signature, scope and SEC-038 bounds as before, 400
  beyond them — and continues **both** groups after its position (`h` = `c` = that position), starting with a host
  (integration int16: backward compatible, KL-045 / CP-012 cursors keep working).

#### 10.108.4 The badge

`LiveRoomSummary.hostIsCreator` (so also `LiveRoom`): the host is a creator-programme member now. Public (the
membership is public, like D293's creator seal). The app shows a purple «صانع محتوى» / "Creator" badge (the D293
creator colour `#7B3FC4`) on the live card and next to the host's name in the room (the host pill / room bar).

#### 10.108.5 The share and the agency commission

- **70 %.** A non-lucky gift sent in a creator's live, when **every recipient is a creator member**, stores
  `live_gifts.host_share_bps` = `GIFT_CREATOR_SHARE_PERCENT` (70 → 7 000 bps): 1 000 000 coins → 7 000 000 cherries
  (1 coin = 10 cherries). **Quips** take `GIFT_CREATOR_QUIP_SHARE_PERCENT` (owner 2026-11-06: **60 %**, not 70 %,
  not the hosts' 50 %).
- The share is stored per send (D154), so a send that also reaches someone who is not a creator (a seated host or
  guest) keeps the category share: the creator rate is never paid to a host through a creator's live. A creator seated
  in a host's live gets the category share (it is the host's live).
- **Unchanged:** lucky gifts keep `LUCKY_GIFT_HOST_SHARE_PERCENT`; direct-conversation and CP gifts keep their own
  shares (`GIFT_DM_RECIPIENT_SHARE_PERCENT`, D155 / D179). Everything reading the stored share (the cherry ledger, the
  host cherries pill, the data center, the history, the D281 targets' actual profit) follows by itself.
- **Agency commission (owner 2026-11-06: YES, decided).** An agency earns its usual commission (and its parent's) on
  the gifts its creator members receive, exactly as with its hosts — from the platform's part, on top of the creator's
  70 %, never out of it. Config `CREATOR_AGENCY_COMMISSION` (default `true`; `false` stops it for creators only).
- **D285.** A CREATOR (or HOST) recruit's profit reads the cherries actually credited (net of reversals) and the
  commissions actually paid, so the recruiter's share follows the 70 % without change; there is one credit per
  recipient and one commission per agency on a send (no double pay). The D285 shares stay 1 % hosts, 1 % creators,
  1 % agencies, 0.75 % recharge agents, and the RECHARGE_AGENT formula's cautious share stays the highest *host*
  category share (65 %; the 992 045 example unchanged) — owner 2026-11-06, decided.
- *(v1.106-social, D341, §10.140)* A creator in **no agency** (a direct creator) takes `GIFT_DIRECT_CREATOR_SHARE_PERCENT`
  (**75 %**, 1 000 000 coins → 7 500 000 cherries) instead of the 70 % above, when every recipient of the send is
  direct; the 70 % stays the share of a creator who is an agency member. Quips keep 60 %.

#### 10.108.6 The agency activation «تفعيل كمضيف / كصانع محتوى»

`POST /me/agency/hosts/{userId}/activate` (`activateMyAgencyMember`): the owner of an OPEN agency activates one of its
ACTIVE members (`AgencyHost.hosting` `NONE`) as:

- **«مضيف»** `{as: HOST}` — the hosting permission, source `AGENCY`, `granted_by_id` the agency owner;
- **«صانع محتوى»** `{as: CREATOR, country, category, links (1–5), bio?, confirmCreator: true}` — the creator
  programme's fields, the note «نسبة صانع المحتوى 70%» and the warning «إن قمت بتفعيل شخص على أنه صانع محتوى ولم يكن
  كذلك، سيتم حظر الوكالة وخسارة أرباحك.», which the owner must tick (`confirmCreator`; anything else → 400). The person
  becomes a member at once: a `creator_applications` row written APPROVED with `source = AGENCY`, `agency_id`, the
  owner as `decided_by_id` («فعّله وكيل: …» in the panel's «طلبات صناع المحتوى»), the membership and the permission
  `CREATOR`. A pending «انضم كصانع محتوى» of the member is cancelled.

No identity check (KYC) is required for either choice (owner 2026-11-06, decided; unlike «كن مضيفاً مع الإدارة»).
Order: 404 (no OPEN agency of the caller, or not its ACTIVE member) → 400 → 409 `AGENCY_ACTIVATION_NOT_ALLOWED`
(`AGENCY_SUSPENDED`, `ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE`, `STAFF`, `HOST`, `CREATOR`) → 200 with the member's `AgencyHost` row (also
when already activated as asked: nothing changes). Audited `agency.member.activate` (the member, the type, the
application, `warningConfirmed`) and `live.host.grant`. Leaving or being released from the agency later does not end
either role (the team ends a creator membership; a host keeps the permission as in D209).

#### 10.108.7 The team ends a membership

`POST /admin/creator-members/{userId}/revoke {reason}` (`creators.decide`: OWNER, SUPPORT): any membership (own
application or agency). The membership goes, its application becomes `REVOKED` (`revokedAt`, `revokeReason`, kept),
the `CREATOR` permission is removed and a running live ends (`ADMIN`). The person may apply again. 404 not a member.

#### 10.108.8 «حظر الوكالة — تفعيل صانع محتوى وهمي»

Owner 2026-11-06 (decided): a panel action on an agency and from a creator's record («فعّله وكيل: …»). **OWNER only**
(`agencies.ban`), with the authenticator code again and a reason. `GET /admin/agencies/{agencyId}/ban` gives the
confirmation's figures and the creators this agency activated first; `POST …/ban {reason, totpCode,
fakeCreatorUserIds}` does, in one transaction:

1. **The agency is banned**: closed with the reason `BANNED` through the existing closing (its ACTIVE members are
   released, any open complaint resolved, the owner told and the host-agent perks removed). A banned agency is never
   reopened: the owner's «افتح وكالة» answers `AgencyOpenRule.refusal` `BANNED` (409 `AGENCY_OPEN_NOT_ALLOWED`
   `BANNED`), the team's reopening 409. An agency already closed is marked `BANNED`.
2. **The owner loses the agency earnings still in the balance**: the agency's commission to its owner (`agency` +
   `parent` commission of this agency in `agency_earnings`, net of reversals) is forfeited up to what the balance holds
   beyond the locked task cherries — `forfeit = min(commission, max(0, balance − locked))` — as **one** cherry-ledger
   debit `AGENCY_FORFEIT` (reference: the agency; never a silent deletion).
   - **Not touched (owner, decided 2026-11-06):** money already withdrawn — including the cherries held by a pending
     withdrawal — is NOT clawed back and the balance never goes below 0; the hosts' and creators' own earnings are NOT
     touched.
   - Nothing is pending: an agency's commission is credited with each gift (D179); a closed agency earns none
     afterwards (`creditGiftCherriesIn` reads OPEN agencies only), so no sweeper credits the forfeited amount again. A
     later reversal of an earlier send does not take the forfeited commission a second time (the owner's commission
     rows are not mirrored once a ban exists).
3. **Only the FAKE creators are revoked** (owner 2026-11-06, decided): the dialog lists every creator this agency
   activated with a checkbox, NONE pre-selected; the OWNER ticks the fake ones and only those
   (`fakeCreatorUserIds`, required, may be empty) lose the membership and the hosting permission it gave (their
   running lives end). The agency's other creators stay creators and are released from the closed agency like its
   hosts. A ticked id that is not an active creator this agency activated → 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` (nothing
   changed). An empty list bans and forfeits without revoking any creator.

One `agency_bans` row per agency (append-only): a second call changes nothing and answers `alreadyBanned: true` with
the first ban's figures. Audited `agency.ban` (owner, reason, commission, forfeited, balance, locked, held,
`fakeCreators` — the creators revoked as fake — with their `applications`, `keptCreators`, released members).

#### 10.108.9 Creators are not hosts for host-only features *(owner, integration int16)*

Owner (2026-11-07, «لا، تختفي من عنده فعاليات المضيفين فقط، فعاليات صناع المحتوى»): a creator member's hosting
permission (`live_hosts` `CREATOR`) is for going live only. **Host-only events** (`audience` `HOSTS`): a creator does
not see them (`listEvents` leaves them out for a creator member) and is never counted or ranked on their boards (the
rank needs a hosting permission of another source and no membership). **The host targets** (`GET
/live/hosts/{username}/targets`, host tasks) answer 404 for a creator, as for anyone who is not a host. **The task
metric `NEW_HOST_GIFTS`** does not count a gift to a creator. Kept for creators, because they are about the hosting
permission itself: going live and the room tools (cover, blocked words, programme, schedule, stickers). Creators get
their own events («فعاليات صناع المحتوى») later, as a separate change.

### 10.109 Reports open their content for the staff, with actions; message reports fixed *(v1.93-social, DRAFT — D296)*

Owner: «عند شخص يقوم بالإبلاغ على بوست أو ريلز، يصل إلى المشرف، لكن لا يمكن للمشرف الدخول إلى البوست. يجب عند الضغط عليه
الدخول إلى البوست، ويكون له أزرار صلاحية للتحذير والحظر ومنع النشر … كذلك الرسائل: عند الإبلاغ، عندما يضغط على البلاغ يدخل
إلى الشات المبلغ عنه ويكون عنده إجراء. ولاحظت خلل في رسائل الإبلاغ غير فعّال.» Then (2026-11-06, answers relayed by the
coordinator): an action resolves the report automatically — **only the pressed report**; a DM report shows **the whole
conversation** «مثل طريقة نزاع وكيل الشحن»; SUPPORT keeps «تعليق مؤقت»; the permanent deletions in the app too; the
notification opens the report itself. (§10.105–§10.108 belong to other branches.)

#### 10.109.1 One report opened from «بلاغات» — `getStaffReport`

- `GET /staff/reports/{reportId}` — `reports.view` (OWNER, MODERATION, SUPPORT; anyone else 403, a missing report 404),
  staff work (§10.96.14). Answers `StaffReportView` {report (`AdminPanelReport`), target (`StaffReportTarget`), actions,
  restrictions, canResolve}.
- **The target whatever its visibility.** The reported item is read for the staff with no viewer rule — hidden by
  moderation, deleted, a private account, a block either way, another region — and `target.state` says which:
  `VISIBLE`, `HIDDEN` (moderation), `DELETED`, `EXPIRED` (a story or a DM past its life), `LIVE` / `ENDED` (a live), `GONE`
  (no row any more). POST → `post` (the `Post`, a reel included: `format: REEL`); COMMENT → `comment` {id, text,
  createdAt, parentId, postId} and the `post` it is on; STORY → `story` {id, text, media, createdAt, expiresAt}; USER /
  PROFILE_LINK → `author` (and the link's `text`); LIVE_ROOM / LIVE_CHAT_MESSAGE → `live` {roomId, title, status} (and the
  message's `text`); CP_CONFESSION / FAMILY_CHAT_MESSAGE → `text`. `author` is the item's author (the reported user for
  USER, the sender for a DM). The staff view counts no view and writes nothing.
- **Direct messages: closed until opened (§10.109.5).** DM_MESSAGE → `dm` {snapshot (`DmReportSnapshot`, the reported
  message, as the queue already shows it), recipient (the reporter), threadSummary (`DmReportThreadSummary`: messages
  kept, total, truncated, capturedAt — no content; null for an older report or once purged)}; a USER reported from a
  conversation → `dm` {snapshot: null, recipient, threadSummary}. **No audit here.** *D296 follow-up (owner: «عند وصول
  الإبلاغ عن محادثة يجب أن يكون الإبلاغ مغلقاً، لا يعرض المحادثة على طول، وعندما يضغط الموظف عليه تفتح الشات»):* the
  conversation itself comes only from **`getStaffReportDmThread`** (`GET /staff/reports/{reportId}/dm-thread`,
  `reports.view`; any other report → 404; staff work): {reportId, reported, recipient, snapshot, thread
  (`DmReportThread`, null for an older report or once purged)}, and **every** call is audited
  `moderation.report.dm_read` {reportId, purged, threadMessages, via} with the actor, IP and request id. The live
  conversation is **never** read (the live message's existence only decides `state` VISIBLE / EXPIRED). The lists
  (`listStaffReports`, the panel's) never carry the thread.
- `actions`: the actions the caller may take now (below; empty once the report is closed); `restrictions`: the kinds
  RESTRICT offers the caller; `canResolve`: «تم حله» without an action (`reports.resolve`, OPEN).

#### 10.109.2 Actions from a report — `actOnStaffReport`

`POST /staff/reports/{reportId}/actions` `{action, reason, restriction?, days?, confirm?}` — every action is an **existing**
panel rule, with the panel's capability (checked on every request; 403 without):

| Action | What it does (the existing rule) | Capability | OWNER | MODERATION | SUPPORT |
|---|---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| `WARN` «تحذير» | the report queue's WARN: `MODERATION_WARNING` to the author (§10.54.5) | `reports.act` | ✓ | ✓ | |
| `RESTRICT` «تقييد» | D208's restriction for `days` 1–365: `NO_POSTING` «منع النشر», `NO_LIVE` «منع البث» (a current live ends), `CHAT_MUTE` «منع الرسائل» (DMs, comments, live chat); the person is told with the reason (`ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED`) | `users.restrict` | ✓ | ✓ | |
| `SUSPEND` «تعليق مؤقت» | D208's `LOCK` for `days` 1–365 (no sign-in, every session ended, a current live ends) — SUPPORT too: **decided by the owner** | `users.lock` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `BAN` «حظر دائم» | the report queue's BAN: the account SUSPENDED (no code since D288) | `users.ban` | ✓ | ✓ | |
| `REMOVE_CONTENT` «إخفاء المحتوى» | the report action `REMOVE_TARGET` (§11.7): a post / reel / story hidden (restorable in the panel), a comment, a live chat / CP / family message removed, a DM expired now, a profile link removed, a live ended; not for USER (409) | `reports.act` | ✓ | ✓ | |
| `DELETE_CONTENT` «حذف نهائي» | the panel's `moderateAdminContent` `delete`: a post / reel or a story deleted for good, the author told (`CONTENT_REMOVED`); POST and STORY reports only (else 409 `not_deletable`; a comment is only ever removed) | `users.content` | ✓ | ✓ | |
| `DELETE_ACCOUNT` «حذف الحساب» | the panel's `requestAdminUserDeletion`: the D193 deletion with its grace period (cancellable from the panel), every session ended, a current live ended | `users.delete` | ✓ | | |

- `days` only with RESTRICT and SUSPEND (required there), `restriction` only with RESTRICT (required there), **`confirm:
  "DELETE"` only with the two deletions (required there)** — the owner's strong confirmation: the app makes the staff
  member type the word («حذف» in Arabic, `DELETE` in any language) and gives the reason; no authenticator code (D288).
  A reason (1–500) always; else 400. The author must not be the caller; an account holding a panel role only by an OWNER
  (403).
- **The report resolves automatically — only the pressed report (owner, as D288's «تم حله»).** In the same transaction
  the report becomes ACTIONED with the caller as `resolvedBy`, the reason as `resolutionNote` and **`resolutionAction`**
  (new); the staff's `STAFF_REPORT_NEW` rows about it are read for everyone, exactly as after «تم حله» (§10.101.4).
  Other people's reports on the same target stay OPEN in the queue. The report is locked (`FOR UPDATE`): one action per
  report — a second press, or two staff members at once, → **409 `REPORT_ALREADY_RESOLVED`** and nothing is done or sent
  twice. «تم حله» without an action still works (`resolutionAction` null). Reopen (§10.101.5) clears `resolutionAction`
  (the audit keeps it) and undoes nothing.
- **The panel's own actions are unchanged:** `actOnAdminPanelReport` (DISMISS, REMOVE_TARGET, WARN, BAN) and
  `moderateAdminContent` hide / delete still close every OPEN report on the target (§11.7); they now record
  `resolutionAction` and read the staff's alerts too. The live tools (`moderateStaffLive`, the kick and the chat removal,
  §10.96.6) also still close the live's / person's / message's reports.
- **Audit.** The rule's own row (`admin.user.warn`, `admin.user.restrict`, `admin.user.lock`, `admin.user.ban`,
  `admin.content.delete`, `account.deletion.requested`, or `moderation.report.action` for REMOVE_CONTENT) with `via: app`,
  and `moderation.report.action` {reportId, action, authorId, reason, kind/days/endsAt for a restriction, contentType /
  contentId for a deletion, reportsClosed: 1, via: app}.
- `StaffStatus.capabilities` gains `reports.act`, `users.restrict`, `users.lock`, `users.ban`, `users.content`,
  `users.delete`. The app shows only `StaffReportView.actions`, each confirmed in a dialog (red for anything but WARN)
  with the reason; the two deletions also need the typed word.

#### 10.109.3 The app

A report in «بلاغات» (its card or «فتح») and the `STAFF_REPORT_NEW` notification / push open the report
(`/me/staff/reports/<id>`; owner: confirmed): the «محتوى مُبلّغ عنه» banner with the type, the reason and the state; the
content (the post or reel read-only; the comment highlighted above its post; the story; the profile with «فتح الملف
الشخصي» — and the conversation when reported from it; the live with «دخول البث كفريق كابسو» while LIVE, else its summary;
a DM as «المحادثة كاملة — للقراءة فقط»: every frozen message, the reported person at the start and the reporter at the
end, the reported message outlined in red — *follow-up:* shown **closed** on the report as a card «المحادثة كاملة —
للقراءة فقط» with the lock, «من @x إلى @y», «الرسائل المحفوظة: n» and «اضغط لفتح المحادثة»; a tap pushes the read-only
chat screen `/me/staff/reports/<id>/chat`, which calls `getStaffReportDmThread`; the same card for a person reported
from a conversation); «المحتوى محذوف» with what the report kept when the item is gone; then the
report's details and the action bar. A closed report shows «حُلّ بإجراء: …» when an action closed it. The conversation's ⋮
«الإبلاغ عن الشخص» sends `dmConversationId`.

#### 10.109.4 The bug «رسائل الإبلاغ غير فعّال» (fixed)

`createReport` with `targetType: USER` looked the target up **by username only**, while the app has always sent the
user's **id** — the conversation's ⋮ «الإبلاغ عن الشخص», the profile, the follow lists, the live person card and the live
host. Every such report answered **404** («غير موجود»), so it never reached the queue or the staff. `targetId` for USER
now accepts the user's id **or** the username (an ACTIVE account; one's own → 400; unknown → 404). A message report
(`DM_MESSAGE`, the long press) worked and reaches the queue; the e2e covers both.

#### 10.109.5 The whole conversation frozen with the report *(owner's privacy decision)*

Owner (2026-11-06): «مثل طريقة نزاع وكيل الشحن» — the staff see the whole conversation between the two people, as the
panel's recharge dispute shows every message between the buyer and the agent. **This widens D155's snapshot by the
owner's decision.**

- **When.** A `DM_MESSAGE` report, and a `USER` report with `CreateReportRequest.dmConversationId` (USER only, else 400;
  it must be the reporter's own conversation with that user, else 404) — the conversation's ⋮ «الإبلاغ عن الشخص».
  A person reported from anywhere else keeps no conversation.
- **What.** Every message of that conversation that **still exists at that moment** (`expires_at > now`: D155 deletes
  messages 24 h after they are sent, and a message deleted for everyone is gone), both directions, oldest first:
  id, sender, kind, text, pack token, gift code / quantity, time, and a **copy of the picture or voice clip**
  (`reports/dm/<reportId>/<messageId>.<ext>`, `private, no-store`; the reported message reuses D155's
  `reports/dm/<reportId>.<ext>`). Kept in `reports.dm_snapshot.thread` (no new table: the JSON stays bounded).
- **Bounds.** At most the newest **300** messages (`DM_REPORT_THREAD_MAX_MESSAGES`; `truncated` and `total` say when more
  existed) and files for the newest **20** pictures / voice clips (`DM_REPORT_THREAD_MAX_FILES`; the others show
  «ملف لم يُحفظ», `mediaMissing`). Taken **once**, when the report is filed: later messages are never added; a repeat
  of one's own open report keeps the first copy.
- **Life.** It survives the 24-hour purge of the messages. The sweeper clears it — thread and files — with the rest of
  the snapshot **30 days after the report is resolved** (§11.13; now also for USER reports carrying a thread); under a
  D193 legal hold its files go with the hold.
- **Who.** Only `getStaffReportDmThread` returns it (`reports.view`: OWNER, MODERATION, SUPPORT), when the staff member
  opens the closed card — every opening audited `moderation.report.dm_read`; `getStaffReport` gives only its summary;
  never the lists, never the people in the conversation.

#### 10.109.6 Compatibility

Additive: three operations (`getStaffReportDmThread` added by the follow-up), `AdminPanelReport.resolutionAction` (new required field, null when none),
`CreateReportRequest.dmConversationId`, `DmReportThread`, new `StaffStatus.capabilities` values. **Behaviour changes:** an
action from the app resolves only its report; the panel's report actions record `resolutionAction` and read the staff's
alerts; a USER report by id works; DM reports keep the whole conversation (owner). Migration
`20270330090000_report_resolution_action` (`reports.resolution_action`, a CHECK: null while OPEN). No server setting.

### 10.110 Tasks for content creators «مهام صانع المحتوى» *(v1.94-social, DRAFT — D297)*

Owner (2026-11-06): «مهام خاصة بصناع المحتوى، وقيمتها كمهام المضيف» — Task Center tasks only for content creators,
valued like the host tasks. The Task Center's rules stay (§10.41, §10.41.1, §10.41.3, §10.51, §10.41.4); this adds an
audience, a pool group, five metrics and four weekly tasks. Every value is a `task-admin` default (no release).

- **Who.** Audience `CREATORS` (`task_definitions.audience`, enum `program_audience`): only creator-programme members —
  a `creator_members` row (D285), checked on every read and claim, as `HOSTS` tasks are only for hosting-permission
  holders (`live_hosts`). **A member never gets `HOSTS` tasks**, even with a hosting permission: the membership decides
  (`role = creator` when a member, else `host` when a permission holder). A membership that ends ends the creator tasks
  from the next read (a day's assignment already made keeps its creator rows hidden: their audience no longer matches).
  Anyone else: 404 on a creator task's claim, as on a host task.
  - *With D295 (v1.82-live, another branch):* D295 gives every member the hosting permission (`live_hosts.source =
    CREATOR`, `Me.canHost` true) and keeps host and creator mutually exclusive (a member never holds a permission of
    another source). Merged together, a member has `canHost` and still gets **only** the creator tasks — never the host
    daily pool tasks, the weekly host tasks or «هدف هدايا الحظ» — and a host (any other source) never gets creator
    tasks. Nothing in D297 reads `live_hosts.source`, so the merge needs no code change; the e2e gives a member an
    `ADMIN` permission to stand for D295's. Whether a live-streaming creator should *also* get host tasks is an owner
    question (PP-56), not built.
- **The daily pool.** Group `CREATOR` (templates `P_CR_…`, audience `CREATORS`) and `task_pool_bands.creator_count`
  (default = `host_count`: 2 · 2 · 2 · 3): a member gets that many creator tasks first, then everyone's tasks fill the
  band's daily count as §10.41.1 (one per group, then two). Same in the smart assignment (§10.41.4; ladders: views and
  likes the hearts ladder, the others the actions ladder; rewards `variantReward`). A day never holds an everyone task
  whose metric one of the day's creator tasks counts (no «انشر منشوراً» next to «انشر منشورات»: one post never completes
  two tasks). Non-members' lists are unchanged (the creator templates are filtered out before the shuffle).
- **Metrics** (per read from stored data; never the creator's own actions; counterparts ACTIVE; content published,
  not removed, not deleted):
  - `REELS`, `POSTS`, `STORIES` — as §10.41.1 (their own production).
  - `REEL_VIEWS_RECEIVED` — §11.4 views of the creator's reels whose counted view falls in the period, one per viewer and
    reel (`post_views` keeps the last counted view and moves it after 24 h, so a viewer counts once a day and, in a week,
    once per reel).
  - `LIKES_RECEIVED` — likes on the creator's posts and reels made in the period that still stand (an unlike deletes the
    row).
  - `COMMENT_REPLIES` — different comments by other people (not deleted) on the creator's own posts that the creator
    replied to in the period (the reply not deleted): ten replies under one comment count once.
  - `NEW_FOLLOWERS` — follows of the creator made in the period that still stand. *Unfollow rule:* an unfollow deletes the
    row, so a follower who leaves within the week no longer counts; one who follows again counts once (from the new
    follow). A follow made before the period never counts, and a claim already paid is kept.
  - `SHARES_RECEIVED` — outside shares (`post_share_events`, at most one per person, post and **UTC day**; counted for the
    UTC days from the one the period starts in up to, not including, the one it ends in, so each day is in one period
    only) plus reposts made in the period that still stand. An outside share is reported by the *sharer's* app (the
    server cannot see a link leave the phone) — never by the creator, whose own shares are excluded.
- **Defaults** (migration `20270331090100_creator_tasks`, `task-admin seed-defaults`; rewards in cherries mirror the host
  tasks the Task Center still offers, band by band; targets scale per band as the host tasks' do):

  | Task | Metric | Targets (bands 1 · 2 · 3 · 4) | Rewards (cherries) | Mirrors |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `P_CR_REEL` «انشر مقاطع ريلز» (daily) | `REELS` | 1 · 1 · 2 · 2 | 4 000 · 6 000 · 8 000 · 10 000 | `P_HOST_LIVE_30` |
  | `P_CR_POST` «انشر منشورات» | `POSTS` | 1 · 1 · 2 · 3 | 2 000 · 3 000 · 4 000 · 6 000 | `P_HOST_GUEST` |
  | `P_CR_STORY` «انشر قصصاً» | `STORIES` | 1 · 2 · 3 · 5 | 2 000 · 3 000 · 4 000 · 6 000 | `P_PK_BATTLES` |
  | `P_CR_VIEWS` «مشاهدات ريلزك اليوم» | `REEL_VIEWS_RECEIVED` | 100 · 250 · 500 · 1 000 | 3 000 · 4 000 · 6 000 · 8 000 | `P_PK_WINS` |
  | `P_CR_LIKES` «إعجابات على محتواك» | `LIKES_RECEIVED` | 20 · 50 · 100 · 200 | 3 000 · 4 000 · 6 000 · 8 000 | `P_PK_WINS` |
  | `P_CR_REPLIES` «ردّ على تعليقات منشوراتك» | `COMMENT_REPLIES` | 3 · 5 · 10 · 20 | 2 000 · 3 000 · 4 000 · 6 000 | `P_HOST_GUEST` |
  | `CREATOR_WEEKLY_REELS` (weekly) | `REELS` | 5 · 6 · 8 · 10 | 180 000 · 190 000 · 220 000 · 250 000 | `HOST_LIVE_MINUTES` |
  | `CREATOR_WEEKLY_VIEWS` | `REEL_VIEWS_RECEIVED` | 5 000 · 6 000 · 8 000 · 10 000 | 180 000 · 190 000 · 220 000 · 250 000 | `HOST_LIVE_MINUTES` |
  | `CREATOR_WEEKLY_FOLLOWERS` | `NEW_FOLLOWERS` | 50 · 60 · 80 · 100 | 220 000 · 270 000 · 290 000 · 430 000 | `HOST_GIFT_COINS` |
  | `CREATOR_WEEKLY_SHARES` | `SHARES_RECEIVED` | 20 · 24 · 32 · 40 | 220 000 · 270 000 · 290 000 · 430 000 | `HOST_GIFT_COINS` |

  The weekly figures the owner proposed (5 reels, 5 000 views, 50 followers, 20 shares) are band 1, scaled ×1 · ×1.2 ·
  ×1.6 · ×2 like the weekly live minutes (300 · 360 · 480 · 600). The weekly host tasks have no flat 300 000 any more
  (§10.41.3's value was replaced by D188's bands, §10.51): the creator weekly tasks take the bands' values. `P_HOST_GIFTS`
  is not mirrored: since D281 it is the targets engine's (§10.62.2), not a Task Center task.
- **Caps — the host tasks' own, shared.** Owner: «كمهام المضيف». Daily creator tasks count toward
  `TASK_DAILY_CAP_CHERRIES` (50 000) with every other daily task of the person; daily and weekly creator tasks count
  toward `TASK_MONTHLY_CAP_MINOR` ($5 = 4 545 454 cherries) with every other task claim; weekly creator tasks are
  outside the daily cap, like the weekly host tasks. The claim code does not look at the audience: one cap per person,
  whatever mix of tasks they have. A band-4 creator who completes all four weekly tasks (1 360 000 a week) reaches the
  monthly cap sooner than a band-4 host (680 000 a week): the monthly cap is what keeps both at $5 (PP-56).
- **Claim, credit, history, withdrawal** as §10.41.3 / §10.51: `task_claims_once`, `cherry_ledger` `TASK_REWARD`
  (reference `<code>@<period start>`), locked until the §10.46.1 unlock.
- **`task-admin`:** `set <CODE> --targets … --rewards …` / `--enabled` on every creator task (as host tasks);
  `band <n> --creator-count <n>` (≤ `--count`); `bands` and `list` print the creator count and the `CREATORS` audience;
  `seed-defaults` adds missing creator tasks. The panel's read-only «المهام» lists them with their audience.
- **Events.** The audience type is shared with the Event Center; events stay `EVERYONE` / `HOSTS` (CHECK
  `events_audience_not_creators`).
- **Wire (additive).** `ProgramTask.audience` `CREATORS`; the five metrics (an older app shows an unknown metric with the
  generic icon and a creator task among the other tasks); `MyTasks.band.creator` (`band.host` is now "host tasks are
  offered": false for a member).
- **The app.** The Task Center shows a member's creator tasks in their own card «مهام صانع المحتوى» (daily, with the
  cap's note) and «مهام صانع المحتوى الأسبوعية» (weekly), each metric with its own icon and «اذهب» to where it is done
  (new reel, create a post, new story, the creator's own profile for views, likes, replies, followers and shares).

#### 10.110.1 Owner answers; six / four weekly tasks; the generated catalogue by charm level *(v1.94-social, DRAFT — D297 follow-up)*

Owner (2026-11-06, answers to PP-56):

- **Defaults approved for now** («نرى فيما بعد، الآن اعتمدها»): §10.110's table is the owner's; every value stays
  changeable with `task-admin`.
- **No anti-fake rule (decided):** no minimum account age or level for the counted counterparts — only ACTIVE people,
  never the person themself.
- **Weekly counts:** a creator has **6** weekly tasks, a host **4**. Fixed tasks added (migration
  `20270331090200_task_generator`): `CREATOR_WEEKLY_LIKES` (`LIKES_RECEIVED` 200 · 240 · 320 · 400 → 220 000 · 270 000 ·
  290 000 · 430 000), `CREATOR_WEEKLY_STORIES` (`STORIES` 5 · 6 · 8 · 10 → 180 000 … 250 000), `HOST_WEEKLY_LIVE_DAYS`
  (new metric `HOST_LIVE_DAYS`: different days of the period, on the programs' clock, on which the person started a
  live that lasted ≥ 10 minutes; 3 · 4 · 5 · 6 → 180 000 … 250 000) and `HOST_WEEKLY_PK_BATTLES` (`PK_BATTLES` 5 · 6 · 8
  · 10 → 180 000 … 250 000). Same caps as every task. They are what a person gets while the generator is **off** for
  their audience; with it on, the same counts come from the generator.
- **The generated catalogue** («قم بتوليد 300 ألف مهمة لصانع المحتوى و300 ألف مهمة للمضيف، بحيث يعطي النظام المهام حسب
  المستوى وتدريجياً»; the level: «مستوى الشخص للجاذبية»):
  - **Design:** a deterministic procedural generator (`task-generator.ts`), not 600 000 rows. A generated task is
    ENTRY (one metric and one period of one audience: 8 daily + 8 weekly per audience) × **charm level** 0 … 100 ×
    difficulty **step** 0 … 12 (factor 2^((step − 6) / 6), ×0.5 … ×2) × **wording** 0 … 14 (5 openings × 3 endings,
    ar/en, e.g. «هدفك: انشر مقاطع ريلز اليوم» / "Your goal: publish reels today"). Code
    `G.<CR|HO>.<METRIC>.<D|W>.<level>.<step>.<variant>`. **315 120 distinct tasks per audience** (16 × 101 × 13 × 15),
    stable across runs (a pinned fingerprint of every code in the unit tests).
  - **Entries:** creators — `REELS`, `POSTS`, `STORIES`, `REEL_VIEWS_RECEIVED`, `LIKES_RECEIVED`, `COMMENT_REPLIES`,
    `NEW_FOLLOWERS`, `SHARES_RECEIVED`, daily and weekly; hosts — `HOST_LIVE_MINUTES`, `HOST_LIVE_DAYS`, `HOST_GUESTS`,
    `PK_BATTLES`, `PK_WINS`, `HOST_GIFTS_RECEIVED`, `HOST_GIFT_COINS`, `NEW_FOLLOWERS`, daily and weekly. Each has a target
    and a reward at level 0 (= band 1's) and at level 60 (= band 4's): daily values from the creator / host pool
    templates, weekly ones from the weekly host ladders (180 000 → 250 000; audience or money 220 000 → 430 000).
  - **The level curve (gradual, «تدريجياً»):** the level is the person's own **CHARM** level (`ATTRACTIVENESS`, CP-005;
    none = 0; above 100 = 100) — not support, not a host tier, not an agency level. target = t0 × (t60 / t0)^(level / 60)
    × the step's factor — rising with every level, not in four bands — rounded (whole below 100, two significant digits
    from 100, e.g. 413 519 → 410 000), ≥ 1, never above an entry's maximum (1 live day a day, 7 a week). reward = r0 → r60
    linearly over levels 0 … 60, then flat, × the step's factor kept within ¾ … 1½, in tens; a coin-valued task
    (`HOST_GIFT_COINS`) pays at most 0.1 cherry a coin (D188's ≈ 1 % of the value); a daily reward is at most
    `TASK_DAILY_CAP_CHERRIES`, a weekly one at most the monthly cap. Both never fall when the level rises.
  - **The template rows:** one `task_definitions` row per entry (`G_CR_<METRIC>_<D|W>`, `G_HO_…`; 32; not pool, no
    band values; target / reward = the level-0 values for `task-admin list`). It holds the entry's switch (`enabled`) and
    keys the claims: one claim per person, template and day or ISO week, `cherry_ledger` reference
    `<template>@<period start>` — idempotent as every task. Codes `G_…` are reserved; never offered as fixed tasks.
  - **The assignment** (with the generator on for the person's audience — a creator-programme member: CREATORS, else a
    hosting-permission holder: HOSTS):
    - **Daily**, at the day's first read: the band's `creator_count` / `host_count` (§10.110; band by §10.41.1's level)
      generated tasks replace the creator / host pool templates; the pool (D176 or D281's smart engine) fills the rest
      of the band's daily count with everyone's tasks; the generated ones never take a metric one of those counts.
    - **Weekly**, at the week's first read: **6** (creators) / **4** (hosts) generated weekly tasks, stored on the ISO
      week's first day, replacing the audience's fixed weekly tasks.
    - **Which:** the enabled entries of the period in an order seeded by the person and the period (FNV-1a + mulberry32,
      like §10.41.1), the previous period's metrics last, one task per metric; each at the person's charm level **at
      that read**, a step 5 … 7 (seeded; the curve does the rising) and a seeded wording — never the previous period's
      exact task (the wording moves on). Stored in `task_assignments` (`variant` = the generated code, its target,
      reward and names, `reason` {generated, charmLevel, step, variant}); fixed for the day / week.
    - The everyone tasks, the check-in, the targets engine and «هدف هدايا الحظ» are unchanged. With the generator **off**
      for an audience, §10.110's pool and the fixed weekly tasks apply (six / four).
  - **Coexistence — the generator replaces the small pools while on.** Chosen over running both: one source of creator /
    host tasks per person and period (never two tasks for one action), the same caps, and the hand-made pool stays as
    the fallback the team switches back to (`task-admin generator off`). **Seeded ON for both audiences** (owner).
    While on, the day's pool leaves out every everyone task whose metric one of the audience's enabled generated DAILY
    templates counts (as §10.110's creator pool does), so the generator's share of the day is always full and never sits
    next to «انشر منشوراً» (integration int16: the pool was drawn first and could take the metric, the generator then
    dropped its own template — the creator's share came up one short at random).
  - **`task-admin generator`:** `status` (on / off, enabled templates, catalogue sizes), `on|off CREATORS|HOSTS`
    (audited `task.update`, target `task_generator`), `count [--verify]` (≥ 300 000 per audience; `--verify` enumerates
    every code), `sample CREATORS|HOSTS [--level n] [--n k]`, `preview <username> [--day YYYY-MM-DD]` (a person's
    generated tasks, nothing stored). One template: `set G_CR_REELS_D --enabled false`.
  - **Wire (additive):** `ProgramTask.metric` `HOST_LIVE_DAYS`; generated tasks are ordinary `ProgramTask`s (`code` = the
    template, `name` = the generated wording, `pooled` true for daily ones). The app shows creator tasks in their cards
    and host tasks with the host tasks.

### 10.111 «مدرسة المحتوى» / Content School — a medal with several requirements per level; «لاعب الأحكام» / Dares Player *(v1.83-live, DRAFT — D300)*

Owner (2026-11-07): a medal «مدرسة المحتوى» with four levels, each with the owner's own art, reached when the **content
creator** has **all three** of its followers, likes and views. **Interpretations owner-confirmed (2026-11-07, via the
coordinator):** (1) content creators only, and a level already earned is kept if the membership ends; (2) current
followers, plus all-time likes and views, from ACTIVE accounts, never self; (3) views (and likes) count posts **and**
reels.

**10.111.1 The model (an extension of §10.104; single-metric medals unchanged).**
- `medal_level_requirements(medal_code, level, metric, threshold)` (PK the three keys; FK → `medal_levels` ON DELETE
  CASCADE; threshold 1 … 10¹²; `metric` never `ALL_REQUIREMENTS`): the several thresholds of one level.
- A multi-requirement medal has the metric **`ALL_REQUIREMENTS`**: its value for a person is the highest level *k* such
  that every requirement of levels 1 … *k* is met (`levelByRequirements`), and each level's `medal_levels.threshold` is
  *k* itself. So the D291 raise (`raiseMedalLevelsIn`, now optionally limited to one medal code) works unchanged: a level
  is reached when all of its requirements are, several levels at once (a jump straight to level 3), **never lowered**,
  each change notified `MEDAL_AWARDED` with `medalLevel`, levels above 1 audited `medals.level_up` (now with
  `requirements: {CREATOR_FOLLOWERS, CREATOR_LIKES, CREATOR_VIEWS}` — the values that reached it).
- Requirement metrics (`MedalMetric`), counted only for **content creators** (`creator_members`, D285 / D295) whose
  account is ACTIVE:
  - `CREATOR_FOLLOWERS` — followers now whose account is ACTIVE (exactly the profile's `followerCount`, D121);
  - `CREATOR_LIKES` — all-time likes on the creator's posts and reels — **including posts later deleted or removed by
    moderation** (owner decision 2026-11-07, «لا» to leaving them out; their like rows stay) — from **other** accounts
    that are ACTIVE now (a self-like never counts);
  - `CREATOR_VIEWS` — all-time §11.4 views (once per viewer and rolling 24 h, ≥ 1 s) of those posts and reels (deleted
    or removed ones too), from
    **other** accounts that are ACTIVE now (the author's own views are never recorded). Summed from the new
    `post_views.counted_views` (each viewer row counts its views; `recordViews` adds 1 in the same statement that
    moves `viewed_at` and `posts.view_count`); `posts.view_count` itself cannot tell who viewed. Rows from before the
    migration start at 1 — a viewer's earlier repeat views cannot be recovered (a lower bound, never more than real;
    **accepted by the owner, 2026-11-07**).
- **Who:** a non-creator is never evaluated: they never earn it and their requirement values are 0 (`Medal.eligible`
  false, «لصنّاع المحتوى فقط»). A person whose membership ends keeps the level reached (D291: medals never go down) and
  stops progressing.

**10.111.2 When levels rise.** Follows, likes and views are the app's hottest writes and the exact counts (ACTIVE
accounts only, never self) are counts over up to millions of rows, so they are **not** counted on each event; a
denormalised counter could not follow accounts suspended or deleted later either. Instead:
- **The sweeper** every `MEDAL_CREATOR_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (default 600; 1 … 86 400; 0 = off, tests only — refused in
  production): for every ACTIVE creator below the top level, three indexed **upper bounds** (all follows; the standing
  posts' `like_count` and `view_count` sums) are compared with their next level; only the creators whose bounds reach
  it are counted exactly and raised (chunks of 200 per transaction). Idempotent; two replicas at once never notify twice
  (the raise is per row, `WHERE level < new`).
- **At a creator's activation** (`activateCreatorIn`: an approved application or an agency's activation): exact, in
  that transaction — a popular account gets the level it already reaches at once.
- **`medals-admin backfill`** (exact, no pre-filter; DEPLOYMENT §5.79): history, and after the panel lowers a threshold.

**10.111.3 The medal.** `CONTENT_SCHOOL`, «مدرسة المحتوى» / "Content School", tab ACHIEVEMENT, sort 120, iconKey
`medal_content_school`. Description: «لصنّاع المحتوى: المتابعون والإعجابات والمشاهدات معاً.» / "For content creators:
followers, likes and views together." The owner's thresholds (not provisional):

| Level | Followers | Likes | Views | Art (`icon_asset`) |
| ----- | --------- | ----- | ----- | ------------------ |
| 1 | 2 000 | 10 000 | 20 000 | `medal_content_school_l1` — blue and silver shield, clapperboard and camera, a star |
| 2 | 10 000 | 50 000 | 100 000 | `medal_content_school_l2` — violet and silver, clapperboard, camera and mic |
| 3 | 100 000 | 200 000 | 500 000 | `medal_content_school_l3` — red and gold with a crown |
| 4 | 1 000 000 | 2 000 000 | 5 000 000 | `medal_content_school_l4` — red and gold with a crown and crystal wings |

The art is the owner's own (2026-11-07, `apps/mobile/assets/medals/PROVENANCE.md`), bundled per level through the D291
key mechanism; the app shows the **current level's art** (stage, card, profile, picker), never a number on it. One
category, one medal (D291): the level rises in place; wearing it twice → 400 `medalCodes` / `invalid_value`.

**10.111.4 The wire (additive).** `MedalMetric` + `ALL_REQUIREMENTS`, `CREATOR_FOLLOWERS`, `CREATOR_LIKES`,
`CREATOR_VIEWS`, `PK_DARES_POINTS` (§10.111.7; first added as `PK_POINTS` and renamed by `20270401090300`). `MedalLevel.requirements` (`MedalLevelRequirement {metric, threshold}`, followers / likes / views order;
empty for single-metric medals). `MedalProgress.requirements` (`MedalRequirementProgress {metric, value, next}`: each
value now against the next level's threshold; the top level's metrics with `next` null at the top); `MedalProgress.value`
of such a medal is the level the requirements reach now and `next` the next level number (an older app shows «1 / 2»).
`Medal.eligible` (false: a creators-only medal and the caller is not a creator now; true for all others; missing = true).
`UserMedal`, `ProfileMedal` unchanged (their `iconAsset` is the level's art). The app: the card's bar is the **lowest** of
the three ratios; the sheet shows three bars «المتابعون / الإعجابات / المشاهدات» with «x / y» and every level with its
three thresholds; a non-creator sees «لصنّاع المحتوى فقط».

**10.111.5 The panel.** `AdminMedalLevel.requirements`; `updateAdminMedal` levels take `requirements` for a medal on
`ALL_REQUIREMENTS` only: one threshold per metric, the same metrics on every level, each strictly rising, the level's
`threshold` = its number (400 `levels` `invalid_value` otherwise, and for requirements on any other medal); the D291
rules stay (OWNER, the code again, a reason, never shorter than the highest level held). Audited `medals.levels.update`
with each level's `requirements` as `METRIC:threshold,…`. «الميداليات»'s editor shows the three thresholds per level for
this medal.

**10.111.6 Migrations.** `20270401090000_medal_requirement_metrics` (the five enum values — the four above and
`PK_POINTS` — alone: a new value cannot be used in the transaction that adds it), then
`20270401090100_medal_content_school` (`medal_level_requirements`, `post_views.counted_views` with CHECK ≥ 1, the medal,
its levels and requirements), `20270401090200_medal_dares_player` (§10.111.7) and `20270401090300_medal_dares_only_points`
(the owner's answers, §10.111.8: `PK_POINTS` renamed `PK_DARES_POINTS`, `pk_host_records.dares_points` filled from the
history, both medals moved to ACHIEVEMENT). Runtime role: default privileges, no GRANT. DEPLOYMENT §5.79, PP-57.

**10.111.7 «لاعب الأحكام» / Dares Player** (owner 2026-11-07: «عندما يكون نقاط PK تحدي = 1500 / 3000 / 5000 / 20000»;
the owner wrote «المستوى الأول» on the last two lines — clearly levels 3 and 4). A **single-metric** medal (the D291 model
unchanged): `DARES_PLAYER`, tab **ACHIEVEMENT** (owner, §10.111.8), sort 130, iconKey `medal_dares_player`; metric
**`PK_DARES_POINTS`** — the host's PK points now **from «PK أحكام» (DARES) matches only** (owner decision 2026-11-07):
`pk_host_records.dares_points`, the part of `PkHostRecord.points` (D229 / D276, §10.80) whose `pk_point_events` belong to
DARES matches — the same once-per-match events (+3 a counted win, +1 a draw, −3 a refused or not-done dare, the forfeit,
…; one row per match, host and kind); NORMAL-match points never count. The owner's thresholds (not
provisional): **1 500 / 3 000 / 5 000 / 20 000** points, each level with the owner's own art (`medal_dares_player_l1` …
`_l4`: blue and silver shield with crossed gavels; violet with a crown; gold and emerald with a lion and wings; gold and
ruby with a lion and wings; PROVENANCE). **When:** in the very transaction that writes a positive points event of a
DARES match (`addPkPointsIn`, the only writer of `pk_host_records.points` and `.dares_points`, adds both in one
statement), at the new DARES total (`raiseMedalLevelsIn`). The total can
fall (a refused dare) but **a level never goes down** (D291). **Who:** anyone with a PK record — hosts and creators who
play «PK أحكام»; no creator gate. `medals-admin backfill` reads `pk_host_records.dares_points` (totals ≤ 0 reach nothing).
`progress.value` (the medal sheet) shows the DARES total from 0 (never negative); `PkHostRecord.points` on the PK screens is
unchanged (every type). Description: «نقاط PK التي
جمعتها في التحديات.» / "PK points you earned in battles." One category, one medal (D291): wearing it twice → 400.
The sheet words each threshold «1,500 نقطة PK» / "1,500 PK points".

**10.111.8 The owner's answers (2026-11-07, via the coordinator) — decisions.**
1. «لاعب الأحكام» counts **only «PK أحكام» (DARES) matches** — `PK_DARES_POINTS` / `dares_points` (§10.111.7).
2. Views recorded before the migration count once per viewer and post (a lower bound) — **accepted**.
3. Likes and views on posts and reels **later deleted or removed by moderation still count** (owner: «لا» to leaving them
   out); ACTIVE accounts only and never self still apply. The sweeper's upper bounds sum every post of the creator.
4. Both medals sit in the **same tab as the other medals** (Wealth Kings, Lucky Master): «الإنجازات» ACHIEVEMENT (owner:
   «هذه ميداليات»).
Earlier: content creators only, a level kept when the membership ends, current followers plus all-time likes and views
from ACTIVE accounts never self, posts and reels both — owner-confirmed.

### 10.112 The app owner's profile «صفحة صاحب البرنامج» *(v1.95-social, DRAFT — D301)*

Owner (2026-11-07), after five mock-ups: a combination of features — the video cover of «المسرح» (4), «رحلة Kabso» of
«الإنجازات» (5), «إعلانات رسمية» of «البطاقة الرسمية» (3), «لوحة المؤسس» of «هوية كابسو» (2), «متابعة المؤسس» and «اقترح
ميزة / أبلغ عن موظف». Owner, the same day: the milestones are managed **in the app**, from his own profile (no panel
page); «صندوق المؤسس» is a panel page.

- **The owner.** An ACTIVE account holding the OWNER panel role (`user_admin_permissions`, §10.54.1). Every such account's
  profile gets the layout; nobody else's profile changes. `PublicProfile.kabsoOwner` and `Me.kabsoOwner` are `true` for
  it (absent otherwise). Every operation marked *owner* below refuses anyone else with 403 `OWNER_ONLY` (nothing changed);
  revoking the role ends the powers at once, and the stored data stops showing (the profile is a plain one again).

#### 10.112.1 The video cover «فيديو الغلاف»

- **Media kind `PROFILE_COVER_VIDEO`** — a video like a reel's (§11.14): MP4 or QuickTime, H.264 / HEVC, ≤ 100 MiB,
  1–60 s, stored unchanged (no transcoding), with its poster (`VIDEO_POSTER`, the first frame made on the phone; `complete`
  needs `{posterId}`). Only the owner gets an upload slot of this kind (`createMediaUpload` 403 `OWNER_ONLY`).
- **Two videos**, Arabic and English: `PUT /me/cover-video/{lang}` (`setMyCoverVideo`, *owner*, `lang` `ar` | `en`, body
  `{mediaId}`: the caller's READY, unattached `PROFILE_COVER_VIDEO` of the last 24 hours, else 400 `mediaId` /
  `invalid_value`; 503 `MEDIA_UPLOADS_UNAVAILABLE` while uploads are off) replaces that language's video — the old asset
  is deleted in the transaction, its objects after commit; the same video again changes nothing.
  `DELETE /me/cover-video/{lang}` (`removeMyCoverVideo`, *owner*, idempotent, uploads may be off). Both answer
  `OwnerCoverVideo` (what is left) and are audited `owner.cover_video.set` / `owner.cover_video.remove` (`{lang}`).
- **Wire:** `PublicProfile.coverVideo` and `Me.coverVideo` = `OwnerCoverVideo {ar?, en?}`, each `CoverVideoVariant {url,
  posterUrl, durationMs, width, height}`; present only on an owner's profile with at least one video. The server never
  picks: **the app** shows `ar` when its own language is Arabic, else `en`; when only one exists, everyone sees it; with
  none, the cover picture (`coverUrl`, else the Kabso gradient) as before.
- **The app.** The cover plays the chosen video looping, only while at least half of it is on screen (paused
  off-screen, in another tab or with the app in the background), with a mute button. *(v1.98-social, D307, owner: «ازل
  ايقونة فيديو والوقت اجعله يعمل تلقائي بصوت عند دخول الشخص للصفحة»)* it starts by itself **with sound** when the page
  opens (own view and visitors), with no «فيديو» pill (no icon, no length); the mute button silences it for that visit;
  it pauses — sound included — when the page is left, covered by another page or sheet, scrolled away, or the app goes
  to the background, and resumes when back. With the system's reduce-motion setting it does not start by itself: the
  poster stays with a round play button beside the mute button (that setting only). The app has no
  data-saver setting today (none to respect). The owner sets or removes each language's video in «تعديل الملف»
  (shown only to the owner).

#### 10.112.2 Official announcements «إعلانات رسمية»

- `posts.official_at` (null = not official). `PUT /posts/{postId}/official` (`markPostOfficial`) and
  `DELETE /posts/{postId}/official` (`unmarkPostOfficial`): *owner*, the caller's own PUBLISHED post or reel (404
  otherwise), idempotent, audited `owner.post.official` / `owner.post.unofficial`; they answer the `Post`. Pins are
  separate (§11.2, at most 3): an official post may be pinned or not — pinning alone was not enough (the list keeps more
  than three, and a pin is not an announcement).
- `Post.official` (`true`, absent otherwise) — the post's card shows «رسمي».
- `GET /users/{username}/official-posts` (`listUserOfficialPosts`, `PostPage`, §5 cursor): the user's official posts that
  the caller may see (the rules of `GET /users/{username}/posts`), **the pinned ones first** (newest pin first, first page
  only), then newest published first. Empty unless the user is an owner (a former owner's flags stay stored, unshown).
- **The app** lists the first three on the owner's profile (an icon, the post's first line, the relative time, «عرض
  الكل» to the full list); the post's ⋯ menu has «تعيين كإعلان رسمي» / «إزالة من الإعلانات الرسمية» for the owner only.
  *D307 follow-up (owner, 2026-11-08: «تُعرض الإعلانات كاملة أسفل رحلة Kabso»):* the summary card is gone; after «رحلة
  Kabso» the page shows «إعلانات رسمية» in full — each announcement as the feed's post card (the caption in the app's
  language from `Post.texts` when bilingual, else `Post.text`; pictures or video, time, likes, comments), in this
  list's order, page by page (10 at a time, the next page when the list reaches its end), with loading, empty (the
  owner's hint; nothing for a visitor) and error (a retry for the owner; nothing for a visitor) states. The owner's
  own view adds «+» (the composer) and «تعديل» under each bilingual announcement; delete and un-mark stay in the
  card's ⋯ menu. The full list screen remains for the founder's «أنا» tab (§10.112.12).

#### 10.112.3 «رحلة Kabso» — the journey timeline

- Table `owner_journey_milestones`: per owner, at most **30** (a 31st: 409 `OWNER_JOURNEY_LIMIT`). Each: `titleAr` and
  `titleEn` (1–60 characters, trimmed, both required), `lineAr` / `lineEn` (0–120, empty = null), `year` (2020–2100) and
  `month` (1–12), `icon` from the closed set `rocket`, `users`, `agency`, `globe`, `sparkles`, `star`, `trophy`,
  `heart`, `gift`, `live`, `crown`, `flag` (else 400 `icon` / `invalid_value`), `latest` («الأحدث»: at most one per owner —
  setting it clears the others) and `position` (the display order, 0-based).
- `GET /users/{username}/journey` (`listUserJourney`) → `{data: JourneyMilestone[]}` in order; empty unless the user is
  an owner; 404 as the profile. Every signed-in viewer reads it; the app shows the viewer's language (`ar` → the Arabic
  texts, else English).
- *Owner:* `POST /owner/journey` (`createOwnerJourneyMilestone`, appended last, 201), `PATCH /owner/journey/{milestoneId}`
  (`updateOwnerJourneyMilestone`, any of the fields), `DELETE /owner/journey/{milestoneId}` (`deleteOwnerJourneyMilestone`,
  204, the rest renumbered), `PUT /owner/journey/order` (`reorderOwnerJourney`, `{ids}`: exactly the owner's milestones,
  each once, else 400 `ids` / `invalid_value`) → `{data}`. Another owner's milestone is 404. Audited
  `owner.journey.create` / `.update` / `.delete` / `.reorder`.
- **The app** (owner's choice: in the app, no panel page): the vertical timeline (coloured icon nodes, a gradient line,
  date chips, «الأحدث»); on his own profile «تعديل» opens the editor: add, edit (a sheet form in both languages), delete,
  and reorder by drag or ▲ / ▼.

#### 10.112.4 «لوحة المؤسس» — the founder dashboard

- `GET /owner/dashboard` (`getOwnerDashboard`, *owner*): `OwnerDashboard {onlineNow, onlineWindowMinutes, liveRoomsNow,
  income {day, timeZone, currency, amountMinor, websiteMinor, agentsMinor}, generatedAt}`:
  - `onlineNow` — ACTIVE accounts whose last authenticated request is under 5 minutes old (presence, §10.25:
    `users.last_active_at`, written at most once a minute; index `users_last_active_idx`);
  - `liveRoomsNow` — LIVE rooms;
  - `income` — **only money Kabso itself receives** today (owner, PP-58: «كيف له دخل!!»; the panel's day,
    `ADMIN_DASHBOARD_TIME_ZONE`, §10.60.1), in **USD** minor units: the store's card top-ups credited today
    (`topup_orders.amount_minor` minus what was refunded, D190) plus what recharge agents pay Kabso for their coin stock
    (`recharge_topups.paid_minor`, the wholesale top-up `recharge-admin topup`, D185). An agent's resale of coins to users
    (`recharge_sales`, paid to the agent in local money) is never counted. Money received in another currency is listed
    per currency in `otherCurrencies` (never converted). The app's fuller view says this in a line.
- Cached for **60 s** in Redis (one value for every owner), so a refresh is cheap; `generatedAt` says when it was
  computed. Never in any public response.
- **The app:** a red card only the owner sees on his own profile, marked «خاص»; the income is blurred until tapped; a tap
  on the card opens the fuller view (the three numbers, the breakdown and the time).

#### 10.112.5 «اقترح ميزة / أبلغ عن موظف» and «صندوق المؤسس»

- `POST /owner/feedback` (`createOwnerFeedback`, any ACTIVE signed-in account) → 201 `OwnerFeedbackReceipt {id, kind,
  createdAt}`:
  - `{kind: FEATURE, text, imageUploadIds?}` — «اقتراح ميزة»: `text` 1–1 000 characters, at most **one** picture;
  - `{kind: STAFF_REPORT, staffUserId, category, text, imageUploadIds?}` — «الإبلاغ عن موظف»: `staffUserId` a Kabso Team
    account (an ACTIVE MODERATION, SUPPORT, FINANCE or BD account — never an OWNER), else 400 `staffUserId` /
    `invalid_value`; `category` one of `RUDENESS`, `ABUSE_OF_POWER`, `UNFAIR_ACTION`, `NO_RESPONSE`, `CORRUPTION`,
    `OTHER`; at most **four** evidence pictures.
  - Pictures are uploads of the private kind `OWNER_FEEDBACK_IMAGE` (an image, ≤ 15 MiB), never completed (404) and
    consumed into `private/owner-feedback/{id}/{n}.webp` (re-encoded, metadata stripped, never public); an upload that
    is not the caller's pending one is 400 `imageUploadIds` / `invalid_value` and nothing is kept.
  - **At most 3 per account in any 24 hours** (counted in the database; a 4th: 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`).
  - Audited `owner.feedback.create` (`{kind}`; never the text).
  - **Notification** `OWNER_FEEDBACK_NEW` to every ACTIVE owner (target `OWNER_FEEDBACK`, `feedbackKind`; never the
    sender, the staff member or the text). **Confidential:** the reported staff member is never notified and never sees
    it; no staff route (app or panel) reads it.
- `GET /owner/feedback/staff?q=` (`searchOwnerFeedbackStaff`) → `{data: OwnerFeedbackStaff[]}` (≤ 20): the Kabso Team
  accounts above whose @username starts with `q`, whose staff ID is `q` («Kabso01», D283c) or whose name contains it —
  the id, username, name, photo and staff ID only (already public, D273).
- **The panel «صندوق المؤسس»** (capability `owner.inbox`, **OWNER only** — the session's authenticator sign-in as
  every panel page; no code again: nothing moves money): `GET /admin/owner-inbox` (`listAdminOwnerInbox`, `status`,
  `kind`, cursor; newest first; with the counts per status), `GET /admin/owner-inbox/{feedbackId}`
  (`getAdminOwnerInboxItem`; a NEW item becomes READ; audited `admin.owner_inbox.view`), `PUT
  /admin/owner-inbox/{feedbackId}/status` (`updateAdminOwnerInboxStatus`, `{status: NEW | READ | DONE}`, audited
  `admin.owner_inbox.status`), `DELETE /admin/owner-inbox/{feedbackId}` (`deleteAdminOwnerInboxItem`: the row, its
  notifications and its private pictures in storage; a confirm dialog; audited `admin.owner_inbox.delete`) and
  `GET /admin/owner-inbox/{feedbackId}/images/{index}` (the picture, `image/webp`, `private, no-store`). Items and their
  pictures are kept until the owner deletes them (owner, PP-58). Staff roles get 403 like any capability they lack.

The D299 header stays (the photo on the cover, the name with the D293 seal, the @handle in the bar), the cover playing
the video when there is one. Under it: the actions — visitors «متابعة المؤسس» (the follow of §10.6, styled for the page)
and «اقترح ميزة / أبلغ عن موظف», the owner «تعديل الملف»; the owner's «لوحة المؤسس»; «إعلانات رسمية»; «رحلة Kabso»; then
the posts as on any profile. *D307 (2026-11-08) order:* cover → numbers → buttons → bio → joined → (the owner's «لوحة
المؤسس») → «رحلة Kabso» → «إعلانات رسمية» in full; no posts tabs (§10.112.12). The regular-user parts that do not fit — the tags, the family / relationship / medals tiles
and the worn medals row — show only when they hold data (as before for every profile); the empty «add» tiles of the bond
block are not shown on an owner's profile.

#### 10.112.7 Bilingual announcements, first in the feed, told to everyone *(D301 follow-up)*

Owner (2026-11-07): «اعلان التي يقوم المؤسس نشرها تكون دائماً في اول منشور ويتم نشرها بلغتين تظهر عند من اعدادته بالعربي
بالعربي ومن اعدادته بالإنجليزي بالإنجليزي ويصل اشعار لكل المستخدمين لها حتى المشرفين»; answers the same day: the
announcement stays the first post of every user's posts feed until a newer official announcement replaces it (only the
latest is on top; the older ones stay in «إعلانات رسمية»); staff get the notification like everyone, in their language.

- **Bilingual (the model).** An official announcement is one official post with two captions: `posts.text` (Arabic) and
  `posts.text_en` (English), the same pictures for both. `POST /owner/announcements` (`createOwnerAnnouncement`, *owner*,
  `Idempotency-Key` as `createPost`) takes `{textAr, textEn, mediaIds?}` — both captions required, 1–2 200 characters —
  and publishes it at once with `official_at` set (the posts rules otherwise: media, mentions and hashtags from the Arabic
  caption, rate limits). `PATCH /owner/announcements/{postId}` (`updateOwnerAnnouncement`, *owner*, his own official post,
  404 otherwise) changes either caption; editing never notifies again. Audited `owner.announcement.publish` /
  `owner.announcement.update`.
- **Which caption.** `Post.texts {ar, en}` carries both (bilingual announcements only); `Post.text` is the caller's
  language's — the account's `locale` (the app's language, saved by `PATCH /me`): `ar` → Arabic, anything else →
  English; a post marked «رسمي» with one caption (§10.112.2) reads the same for everyone. The app shows `texts` in its
  current language when present.
- **First in the feed.** `GET /feed/posts`, every tab (`mixed`, `following`, `trending`): the first page starts with the
  latest official announcement — the greatest `official_at` among the `POST`-format posts of an ACTIVE OWNER that the
  caller may see (blocks, mutes and hides still apply) — and that post is left out of every page of the list. It is read
  live, not from the frozen snapshots: a newer announcement replaces it, un-marking removes it, at once. Reels feeds are
  unchanged.
- **Told to everyone, once.** The first time a post becomes official (`createOwnerAnnouncement`, or «تعيين كإعلان رسمي»,
  §10.112.2) a fan-out row (`owner_announcement_fanouts`, keyed by the post: un-marking and marking again never queues a
  second one) is written in the request's transaction; nothing per user is. A background sweeper (every 5 s, and right
  after the publish) writes `OWNER_ANNOUNCEMENT` notifications to every ACTIVE account but the owner who published it —
  staff included — 1 000 accounts per step in `users.id` order with a saved cursor (`FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`: several
  API instances share the work; resumable after a restart), idempotent through the unique index
  `notifications_owner_announcement_once`; audited `owner.announcement.fanout_done` with the count. The target is the
  POST with `texts` (both excerpts); the inbox shows its language's, the push (the D152 outbox, the recipient's account
  language, its usual per-person gap) reads «إعلان رسمي: …» / "Official announcement: …". The row shows only while the
  recipient may see the post (§11.10 rules); a system type, always on.

#### 10.112.10 «الربح»: before and after every share, and the fixed costs

Owner (2026-11-07): «اريد عند حساب الارباح على صفحتي كمؤسس ان تزيل نسب الجميع لكون ربح نهائي وضعها قبل وبعد. بالاضافة
هناك تكاليف ثابتة مثلاً اشتراك كلاود و لايف كيت والفلاتر والسيرفرات، هذه التكاليف الشهرية يتم تقسيمها على الشهر».

- **`GET /owner/profit?day=YYYY-MM-DD`** (`getOwnerProfit`, owner only — 403 `OWNER_ONLY`; cached 60 s per day, dropped
  when a fixed cost changes): the local day (`ADMIN_DASHBOARD_TIME_ZONE`, default today, from 2026-01-01 to today; 400
  `day` / `out_of_range` or `invalid_value` otherwise) and its month — a past month whole, the current month from its
  1st to today (`partial`: the fixed costs count their elapsed share, today included).
- **«الدخل قبل»** (`before`, US cents) = the PP-58 definition: the card top-ups credited in the period
  (`cardChargedMinor`) − their refunds (Stripe's or the team's, the larger) − their held chargebacks (an open or lost
  dispute; never more than what is left; a won dispute gives back) + what agents paid Kabso for their coin stock.
  Refunds and chargebacks are shown inside «قبل», not again as deductions.
- **Deductions** (`deductions`, every line, zeros included, in this order) from the real ledgers of the period. Every
  cherry credited to someone is money Kabso owes, valued at the payout rate `CHERRY_PAYOUT_RATE` (owner D179:
  1 000 000 = $1.10, confirmed 2026-11-07: «كل مليون كرزة يأخذ المضيف ١.١ دولار») and counted when credited, net of its reversals: **GIFTS** (`GIFT_RECEIVED` − `GIFT_REVERSAL`: the
  hosts' and creators' share of gifts), **AGENCY_COMMISSIONS** (agency + parent commissions − their reversals −
  `AGENCY_FORFEIT`), **REFERRAL_REWARDS** (− `REFERRAL_REVERSAL`), **TASK_REWARDS** (task and host-target cherries),
  **STAFF_COMMISSIONS** (recruiters' commissions), **TEAM_ADJUSTMENTS** (the team's cherry adjustments, net — may lower
  the costs); **COIN_REWARDS**, the coins Kabso gives away (event prizes, task and check-in coins; *v1.100-social,
  D312:* the custom gift owners' coin shares `GIFT_OWNER_ROYALTY`, net of their claw-backs `GIFT_OWNER_ROYALTY_REVERSAL`,
  §10.118) valued
  conservatively at the lowest price an agent pays Kabso (owner 2026-11-07: «وكيل الشحن اقل سعر يحصله منا لل ١٠ مليون
  كوينز هو ١٢٠ دولار» — `OWNER_PROFIT_COIN_VALUE_MINOR_PER_MILLION`, default 1200 = $12 a million; read only here);
  and **CARD_FEES**, the estimated card fees of the period's card orders (`ADMIN_REPORT_CARD_FEE_BPS` +
  `_FIXED_MINOR` per order, owner CP-039 Q3: 2.9 % + $0.30; the store amount is recorded gross). Never counted:
  withdrawals (the cherries were counted when credited), cherries sold to agents or spent in the store (handed back).
  Recharge agents get no separate margin: their wholesale discount is already in what they paid.
- **Owner decisions (2026-11-07, «موافق»):** (a) the given-away coins are deducted when given, and the gift cherries they
  later become are deducted again — a conservative double count, by decision; (b) the agents' discount stays inside what
  they paid, with no separate line; (c) the card fees stay the estimate 2.9 % + $0.30 per order (labelled so) — pending
  only the payment provider's real rate.
- **For information only** (`info`, never deducted): the coins agents bought, at the retail price
  `COIN_RETAIL_USD_PER_MILLION`. Agents' purchases count in «قبل» at what they really paid (`recharge_topups.paid_minor`),
  never at a rate.
- **Fixed costs** (`owner_fixed_costs`: a name, a monthly amount in US cents, active from one local day to another or
  open-ended): a period's share of a cost = monthly × its active days in the period ÷ the days of that month, rounded
  half up ($300 a month in a 30-day month = $10 a day; the whole month = $300).
- **«الربح النهائي بعد»** (`after`) = before − every deduction − the fixed costs; it may be negative.
- **Other currencies:** money received in another currency is its own line (`otherCurrencies`: before, its card fees,
  after), never converted; if `CHERRY_PAYOUT_CURRENCY` is not USD, the cherry lines move to that currency's line.
- **The fixed costs** are managed by the owner in the app (`listOwnerFixedCosts`, `createOwnerFixedCost`,
  `updateOwnerFixedCost`, `deleteOwnerFixedCost` under `/owner/fixed-costs`; 403 `OWNER_ONLY` for anyone else) and in the
  panel (`/admin/owner-fixed-costs`, capability `owner.costs`, OWNER only). At most 100 (400 `too_many`); USD only;
  `activeTo` ≥ `activeFrom`. Audited `owner.fixed_cost.create` / `.update` (before / after) / `.delete`, `via: app` or
  `panel`.
- **The app:** on «لوحة المؤسس» the income stays blurred until tapped, then shows «قبل» and «بعد» for today; the
  details sheet shows today and this month (a day can be picked), «قبل» with its parts, each deduction (expandable, with
  its cherries), the fixed costs and «بعد» (red when negative), and «تكاليف ثابتة» with add / edit / delete.

### 10.114 Gift events «فعاليات الهدايا» and animated / video banners *(v1.97-social, DRAFT — D303)*

> *v1.101-social (D325):* extended by **§10.127 Events v2** — drafts, recurrence, the scoring method, counted gifts,
> gifts and prizes uploaded inside the event, gift pieces, milestones, audiences AGENCIES / CP and the start notification.
> *v1.102-social (D334):* §10.127.11 — content creators count as hosts on events made after it, banners for every
> audience, free gift pieces credit nothing, «عدد المعروضين» per board (D303's boards included).

Owner (2026-11-07), from a third-party event page («ملك الكنوز»; the look and the idea only — none of its art, names or
brand; the screenshot stays out of git, D40): an event of **its own gifts**, points per gift, ranks and prizes (items,
cherries or coins), and an animated promo banner as the first thing in the Live home that is either an ad or an event.
Owner decisions are marked *(owner)*; the rest are CTO defaults, changeable by the owner (PP-60).

#### 10.114.1 The event

- `events.metric = EVENT_GIFTS` (new value). The D166 metrics, their boards, the review window and `event-admin` are
  unchanged. A gift event has 1–12 **event gifts** (`event_gifts`), 1–5 **boards** (`event_boards`, one per kind), an
  end (never permanent), at most **92 days** long, starting at most **365 days** ahead, and an optional IANA
  `time_zone` (shown dates; null = `LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE`). The instants are stored as given (`timestamptz`), so a
  date typed in any zone is correct; the apps show them in `EventDetail.timeZone`.
- `audience` EVERYONE, HOSTS or *(owner)* **CREATORS** (shown to content-creator members only, D295); a creator member
  does not see HOSTS events (D295). CHECK `events_audience_not_creators` now allows CREATORS for EVENT_GIFTS only.
- `regions` keep D166's meaning: entrants whose profile country is listed (AGENCIES: the owner's; CP: either partner).

#### 10.114.2 Scoring *(owner: points only from sending the event's gifts)*

- Every recipient of a send of an event gift adds **`coins × points_per_coin + quantity × points_per_gift`** points
  (`points_per_coin` 0–1000, default 1 — the reference's «points per coin»; `points_per_gift` 0–10^6, default 0; not
  both 0). `EventGift.pointsEach` = `priceCoins × pointsPerCoin + pointsPerGift` (one gift, one recipient).
- Counted from the stored sends (`live_gifts`, `live_gift_recipients`) of the window `[startsAt, endsAt)` only, never
  through a separate counter: **each send counts once by construction** (idempotent per gift transaction), lives and
  direct-message gifts alike (posts and reels take no gifts). Never a send to oneself; the sender ACTIVE; a send whose
  cherries the team reversed (`GIFT_REVERSAL`: fraud, a refunded payment) **does not count** — the D166 events never
  looked at reversals; the gift events do (the tasks' rule, D277). A gift not in the event's list scores nothing.

#### 10.114.3 Boards and prizes

| Kind | Who is ranked | Score | Who wins the bundle |
|---|---|---|---|
| SENDERS «ترتيب الداعمين» | the sender | points sent | the sender |
| RECEIVERS «ترتيب المضيفين» | the recipient who is an **approved host** (a hosting permission) **or a content-creator member** *(owner follow-up: «ان كانت للمضيفين تشمل صناع المحتوى» — overrides D295 for gift events only)*; a guest on a seat counts when they are one; anyone else never enters | points received | the recipient |
| CREATORS «صناع المحتوى» *(owner)* | content-creator members (`creator_members`) only | points received | the creator |
| AGENCIES «الوكالات» *(owner)* | the agency the receiving host belonged to **at the time of the gift** (`agency_earnings`, not reversed); the host ACTIVE; the agency OPEN and not suspended now | points its hosts received | **the agency's OWNER** *(owner, decided)* |
| CP *(owner)* | a CP couple (`cp_couples`, CP-018) | points of the event gifts **the two partners sent each other** while a couple (from `since` to `ended_at`: a breakup ends further scoring; what came before stays) *(owner, decided)*; both partners ACTIVE | **both partners**, each the full bundle *(owner)* |

A creator member is on both RECEIVERS and CREATORS (owner follow-up); a non-host is on neither. AGENCIES are host agencies
(agency earnings exist for agency hosts only). Ranks: score descending, then the entrant key; ties never share a
rank. Each board has a **qualification minimum** `minPoints` (0–10^12) *(owner: «حد أدنى للتأهل»)*: a rank below it wins
nothing (lower ranks have lower scores, so no prize moves down). Prize lines: up to 20 rank ranges within 1–100, in
order, not overlapping (e.g. 1, 2, 3, 4–5, 6–10 as in the reference), each a **bundle** of 1–6 items, an item at most once:

- **The money of each board** *(owner, decided)*: SENDERS → `COINS`; RECEIVERS and CREATORS → `CHERRIES`; AGENCIES →
  `COINS` or `CHERRIES` (the event's creator chooses per line); CP → `CP_MONEY` {`cherries`, `coins`}, two amounts set by
  the creator: each partner who is an approved host or a creator member **at payout time** gets the cherries, another
  partner the coins — never converted (both ≥ 0, at least one > 0). Another money on a board → 409. Items, medals and
  VIP on every board.
- `COINS` 1–10^8 → wallet ledger `EVENT_PRIZE` (existing), reference the payout row.
- `CHERRIES` 1–10^8 → cherry ledger `EVENT_PRIZE` (new), reference `EVP:<payout>`; **withdrawable as soon as won**
  *(owner, decided — not in the task-cherry lock)*.
- `BAG_ITEM` code + 1–365 days **or `null` = permanent «دائم»** *(owner)* (the bag's existing no-expiry row) → the bag's grant path (`addItemTimeIn`, D171): a new item counting from the payout, or
  the days added to the one owned; never worn by itself; source **`EVENT`** (new), **not transferable** (like a level
  reward). Frames, entry vehicles (ENTRY_EFFECT), entry banners, chat bubbles, profile cards — every bag category.
- `VIP` tier code + 1–365 days (**never permanent**: a membership always has an end, `vip_memberships.expires_at`) → none or ended: the tier from now; the same tier: the end moves; a higher tier held:
  that membership gets the days (a prize never lowers a tier); a lower tier held: the prize tier from now.
- `BADGE` medal code + `level` + 1–365 days or `null` = permanent → an event medal «وسام فعالية» (§10.114.8).
- The bag kinds a `BAG_ITEM` can be (all grantable, all with days or permanent): `AVATAR_FRAME` (frame), `ENTRY_EFFECT`
  (the entrance vehicle), `PROFILE_CARD` («بطاقة تعريفة»), `ENTRY_BANNER` («شريط دخول»), `CHAT_BUBBLE`.

#### 10.114.4 Freeze and automatic payout *(owner: automatic at the end; the hold stays)*

- The events sweeper (`EVENTS_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`) freezes an ended gift event: each board's top 100 into
  `event_results` (`board`, `entrant_key` = user / agency / couple id, `agency_id`, `couple_id` + `partner_id`, `score`,
  the rank's bundle in `prize` when qualified, `prize_coins` its coins); `payout_due_at = frozen_at` (**no review
  window**, unlike D166's `EVENT_PRIZE_REVIEW_HOURS`). The same pass pays it unless **held**.
- **Hold:** `holdAdminEvent` / `changeStaffEvent hold` — before or after the end, until paid — stops the payout;
  `release` resumes it; once paid → 409. Audited (`event.hold` / `event.release`, via panel or app).
- **Payout** (one transaction per event, the event row locked): for each pending result and each winner (CP: both) one
  `event_prize_payouts` row — UNIQUE (result, user): **once per winner per board**, whatever runs again. An account not
  ACTIVE at payout time → `FORFEITED` (nothing given); otherwise every item, `granted` listing what was given (a bag item
  or tier gone from the catalogue is listed `skipped`), a notification **`EVENT_PRIZE_WON`** (system, target `EVENT`, no
  text; pushed «مبروك، وصلتك جائزة فعالية»), then `event.payout` audited (system) with the counts.

#### 10.114.5 Reading

- `getEvent`: `timeZone`, `gifts` (`EventGift`), `boards` (`EventBoard` with the bundles' display fields: names in the
  request's language, bag category and asset key, VIP colour and still); `prizes` stays D166's (empty here).
- `getEventLeaderboard?board=<kind>` (default the first board; another kind or any board on a D166 event → 400
  `board` / `invalid_value`): live top 100 until frozen, then the results; per row `qualified`, `prize`, `prizeCoins`;
  CP rows `user` + `partner`, AGENCIES rows `user` = the owner + `agency` {id, name}; blocked people hidden (ranks stay);
  `me`: the caller (AGENCIES: the agency they own; CP: their best couple), `qualified`, `pointsToQualify`, `prize`.

#### 10.114.6 Banners *(owner)*

- `home_banners.kind`: **IMAGE**, **ANIMATED** (the stored picture is an animated WebP — D248c's processing — and keeps
  a full-size first frame `poster_key` and its loop length `duration_ms`) or **VIDEO** (`video_media_id`, a
  `BANNER_VIDEO`: MP4 / MOV, H.264 or HEVC, **1–30 s, at most 30 MiB**, checked from the container and stored unchanged —
  the reels' path, D162; `media_id` is its **poster**, required). VIDEO only for `placement=home`. A banner may open an
  **event** (`event_id`; the link becomes `/events/<id>`, allowlisted). The panel uploads the video with
  `uploadAdminBannerVideo` (raw bytes) and names it in `createAdminBanner`.
- `HomeBanner` adds `kind`, `posterUrl` (the still), `videoUrl`, `durationMs`, `eventId`. Older apps keep showing
  `imageUrl` (a video's poster). **App:** the carousel is the **first block** of the Live home; ANIMATED plays the WebP;
  VIDEO plays **muted, looping, only while visible** (paused off screen, when the app is in the background and while
  another page is shown), the poster until the first frame; with **reduced motion** only `posterUrl` (no animation, no
  video, no auto-advance). Existing still banners are unchanged.
- Removing a banner deletes its video and poster objects too.

#### 10.114.7 Creating and editing *(owner: from the panel and from the app)*

- One rule set (`gift-events.ts`), one body (`GiftEventInput`): shape errors → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`; rules (dates,
  length, lead, zone, duplicates, zero points, overlapping ranks, an unknown gift / bag item / VIP tier) → 409
  `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` with the message. A full edit (`PUT`): before the start anything; while running only the
  texts, banner URL, calendar style, «رائج» and a **later** end (gifts, boards, prizes, start, audience and regions
  unchanged, else 409); after the end → 409. Audited `event.create` / `event.update` {metric, gifts, boards, reason, via}.
- **Capability `events.manage`** (new; **OWNER** by default, PP-60): the panel's gift-event routes and the event
  commands (end / hold / release, before `catalog.manage` — also OWNER only); the app's staff routes `/staff/events`,
  `/staff/event-options`, `/staff/gift-events[/{id}]`, `/staff/events/{id}/{command}` — the D273 staff guard (the role
  held now, every request), not staff work (no shift). `StaffStatus.capabilities` lists it for the app.

#### 10.114.8 Event medals «وسام فعالية» with levels *(owner, D303 follow-ups)*

- `event_badges` (code `^[a-z0-9_]{2,40}$`, names) with `event_badge_levels` (1 … 10, each its own art, a `badge`
  upload) — reusable across events; made from the panel or the app (`createAdminEventBadge` / `createStaffEventBadge`,
  `events.manage`, audited `event.badge.create`).
- A prize line gives one level for N days or permanently; held in `user_event_badges` (one row per person and medal: a
  new prize adds its days — a permanent prize or row stays permanent — and keeps the higher level while it lasts).
- Shown with the medals (`ProfileMedals.eventBadges`, `UserMedalList.eventBadges`: the held level's art) until
  `expiresAt` (null = permanent); rows a day past their end are deleted by the events sweeper.

#### 10.114.9 Event art: the published specs, uploads and the interactive page *(owner, D303 follow-ups)*

One source of truth: `event-media.ts` `EVENT_MEDIA_SPECS` — the server enforces it on every upload
(`uploadAdminEventMedia` / `uploadStaffEventMedia`, raw bytes, `kind=`), `EventOptions.specs` returns it, and the
panel / app editor show it beside each field. A file outside it → 409 `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED` with
`{field: file, issue}` (`event_media_format | _size | _bytes | _duration | _transparency | _codec`) and a message.
