- **Who:** the app owner only — an ACTIVE account holding the OWNER panel role, read now (`isKabsoOwner`, the D301 check);
  anyone else → 403 `OWNER_ONLY` (a MODERATION / SUPPORT / FINANCE member too). Never on the owner's own account (409
  `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`, detail `rule` / `self`) or on an account that holds OWNER (`owner_target`); an unknown or
  DELETED account → 404.
- **Actions — each the panel's own rule, no second copy:** `WARN` «تحذير» — the report queue's warning (system
  notification `MODERATION_WARNING`, never the owner's name; audited `admin.user.warn`); `SUSPEND` «حظر مؤقت» — the
  account controls' `LOCK` for `days` (1–365, required here and refused elsewhere; sessions revoked, the person told
  `ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED`, their live ended and seats released; audited `admin.user.lock`); `BAN` «حظر دائم» — the panel's ban
  (`SUSPENDED`; lives ended, seats released; audited `admin.user.ban`; an account not ACTIVE → 409); `DELETE_ACCOUNT`
  «حذف الحساب» — the D193 deletion with its grace period (`ACCOUNT_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS`; still cancellable at sign-in
  until `purgeAfter`; the blockers → 409 `ACCOUNT_DELETION_BLOCKED`; already pending → 409; audited
  `account.deletion.requested`).
- **Audit:** every reused row carries `via: app`; one more row `owner.moderation.action` {actionId, action, reason, days?,
  endsAt?, purgeAfter?, via: app} with the actor and the target; the action itself in `owner_moderation_actions`.
- **Limits:** `RATE_LIMIT_OWNER_MODERATION_USER` (30 / 15 min, bucket `owner:moderation`) on top of the default.
- **The app:** «إجراءات المؤسس» in a profile's ⋯ menu and the person card's ⋯ (in a live), shown only when the signed-in
  account is the owner (`PublicProfile.kabsoOwner` of their own profile) and the person is someone else who is not an
  owner. A sheet of the four actions (what each does), then a confirmation: the duration chips for a timed ban (1, 3, 7,
  30, 90 days), the required reason, «تأكيد» (red for a ban or a deletion); errors stay in the dialog (one `clientId` per
  intent, so a retry never acts twice); success closes with a message.

### 10.118 Custom gifts «مُخصَّص» *(v1.100-social, DRAFT — D312)*

Owner (2026-11-08): «هدايا من فئة مُخصَّص تستند الى مستخدم. يأخذ المضيف 60٪ … 100 ألف → 600 ألف كرزة بدل 650 ألف، وصاحب الهدية
يأخذ 3٪ لكن كوينزات يعني 3 آلاف كوينزة، ونفس الشيء صانع المحتوى في هذه الفئة فقط».

- **Category:** the special kind `CUSTOM`, seeded as the category `CUSTOM` «مُخصَّص» / Custom (sort 60); like LUCKY and
  QUIPS it is renamed, reordered and given an icon only (§10.66). Every gift in it names its owner `gifts.owner_user_id`
  (CHECK `gifts_custom_owner`: set exactly for CUSTOM, never a PK booster); the panel takes the owner's **Kabso ID**
  (`owner`: the username, a leading @ and any case accepted), which must be an existing **ACTIVE** account (409
  `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`, detail `owner` / `owner_not_found` | `owner_not_active`); a gift moved out of «مُخصَّص» loses its
  owner. Audited with the gift's fields (`ownerUserId`).
- **The app:** `Gift.owner` (`GiftOwner` {id, username, displayName, avatarUrl}) on a custom gift; the gift panel's
  «مُخصَّص» tab (only when it has gifts), the owner's picture on the tile, «هدية {name}» in the details. A custom gift is
  listed and sendable only while its owner is ACTIVE (otherwise 409 `GIFT_UNAVAILABLE`); it is sent with **coins only**
  (a bag send → 400 `source` / `invalid_value`; never listed in the bag).
- **Money (per send, in the send's transaction):** the recipients' share is `GIFT_CUSTOM_SHARE_PERCENT` (**60**) wherever
  it is sent — any live (a host's or a content creator's: the creator 70 % does not apply to this category) and a direct
  conversation (decided: the same 60 %, not the DM share; CP gifts are not catalogue gifts) — stored as the send's
  `host_share_bps`, so the cherry ledger credits 100 000 coins → 600 000 cherries at CHERRIES_PER_COIN 10. The **owner**
  gets floor(coin value × `GIFT_CUSTOM_OWNER_PERCENT` (**3**) / 100) **coins** (`GIFT_OWNER_ROYALTY`, reference the send;
  100 000 → 3 000) — **none when the owner sends his own gift**. The owner's and the sender's wallets are locked in id
  order. Agency commissions stay as for a normal gift (from the platform's part, on the host's cherries). Levels, score,
  room cherries (§10.116), PK and medals count the send like any normal gift.
- **Spendable only:** coins are never withdrawn (only cherries are), so the owner's coins are spendable only by nature.
  «الربح» (§10.112.10) counts them as a cost in **COIN_REWARDS**, net of claw-backs.
- **Reversal:** `reverseGiftCherriesIn` (the `economy-admin` reversal) also takes the owner's coins back
  (`GIFT_OWNER_ROYALTY_REVERSAL`, once per send), even when spent — the balance may go below 0, a debt (as a reversed
  website purchase, §10.53: no gift while in debt).
- **Settings:** `GIFT_CUSTOM_SHARE_PERCENT` (default 60), `GIFT_CUSTOM_OWNER_PERCENT` (default 3); the share of each send is
  stored, so a change applies to later sends only.

### 10.119 The boards' month and year «هذا الشهر / هذه السنة» *(v1.87-live, DRAFT — D314)*

Owner (2026-11-08): the ranking page «التصنيف» offers **هذه الساعة / اليوم / هذا الأسبوع / هذا الشهر / هذه السنة** on every
tab (popularity, and «مجنون اللعب» §10.120; «الأغنى» still waits for its board).

- **Periods:** `LiveRankingPeriod` = `HOUR` | `DAY` | `WEEK` | `MONTH` | `YEAR` (default `HOUR`; anything else → 400
  `period`). The same zone and reset rules as §10.15, in `LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE` (IANA, default UTC):
  - **MONTH** starts at **00:00 local on the 1st** of the current month and ends at 00:00 local on the 1st of the next
    (28–31 days; a DST change inside the month makes it 1 h shorter or longer — `endsAt` is the true instant).
  - **YEAR** starts at **00:00 local on 1 January** and ends at 00:00 local on the next 1 January.
  - `startsAt` / `endsAt` give the window; the app's countdown runs to `endsAt` (days shown) and the board reloads when
    it ends; a new month / year starts empty. One region for everyone (D99).
- **Storage (efficient for a year):** every point written to `live_host_points_hourly` (UTC hour) is also added, in the
  same statement's transaction, to `live_host_points_monthly` (host, **local** month start in the ranking zone) — by the
  gift send and the taps. HOUR / DAY / WEEK keep reading the hourly rows; **MONTH reads 1 monthly row a host, YEAR at most
  12** (`month_start` in [year start, now], index `live_host_points_monthly_month_idx`). Points ≥ 0 (CHECK). Monthly rows
  older than **400 days** are removed by the live sweeper (the hourly ones still after 15 days).
- **The zone is part of the data:** a monthly row is keyed by the local month of the zone in force when it was written.
  Changing `LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE` mid-month misfiles the points written around midnight of the 1st until the next
  month (DEPLOYMENT §5.92) — set it once.
- **History:** the migration fills the monthly rows from the hourly rows still kept (the last 15 days), in **UTC**
  (a migration cannot read the API's zone); older points no longer exist, so the first month / year boards hold only those.
  A server on another zone re-runs the backfill with its zone (DEPLOYMENT §5.92).
- **App:** five pills in the order above (they scroll sideways when they do not fit, the chosen one brought into view);
  «هذا الشهر» / "This month", «هذه السنة» / "This year".

### 10.120 «مجنون اللعب» — the game tickets board *(v1.88-live, DRAFT — D315)*

Owner (2026-11-08): a third tab «مجنون اللعب» / "Game Crazy" on the ranking page: players ranked by the game **tickets
they SPEND in games**, the same five periods (§10.119), the ticket count beside each player like the coins on «الأغنى».
Hidden until at least one game is on — never an empty or «قريبًا» tab.

- **No game exists yet** (D173, D305's game hook): there is no ticket wallet and no game in this build. The board stands on a
  documented **ledger and hook** that the first game calls: `recordGameTicketSpendIn(tx, {userId, gameCode, tickets,
  reference, at}, LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE)` (`apps/api/src/modules/live/game-ticket-spends.ts`), **inside the game's own
  transaction that debits the tickets** (a rolled-back round counts nothing). It writes:
  - `game_ticket_spends` — one row per spend: player, `game_code` (`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]{0,39}$`), `tickets` (> 0, whole),
    `reference` (the game's own id of the round / bet, 1–64 characters), `created_at`; **unique `(game_code,
    reference)`**: a replay adds nothing (returns false).
  - `game_ticket_spends_hourly` (player, UTC hour) and `game_ticket_spends_monthly` (player, local month in the ranking
    zone) — the rollups the board reads, exactly as the points of §10.15 / §10.119. Only spends count (winnings, refunds and
    purchases never do); a refunded round is the game's to never record, or to record only once settled.
  - Retention: the ledger is kept; hourly rollups 15 days, monthly 400 days (the live sweeper).
- **API:** `GET /live/rankings?period=…&board=GAMES` (`LiveRankingBoard`, default `POPULARITY`; anything else → 400
  `board`): up to 50 **ACTIVE players** with tickets spent in the window, highest first (ties by user id); the entry's `host`
  is the player and `points` the tickets; `liveRoom` the player's live now, if any. The same block rules and guest
  access as §10.15. `me` for **any signed-in caller** (rank null with 0 tickets). `LiveRankings.board` echoes the board.
- **The switch:** `LiveConfig.gamesEnabled` (env `LIVE_GAMES_ENABLED`, default **false**) — true once at least one game is
  on. The app shows the «مجنون اللعب» tab **only** while it is true (the same rule as D305's games strip: nothing about
  games shows before a game exists); the API answers the board either way (empty).
- **App:** the tabs «ترتيب الشعبية» · «الأغنى» (greyed «قريبًا» until D320, §10.124) · «مجنون اللعب»; the three shrink to fit
  (360 pt, Arabic, large text). On «مجنون اللعب» each player shows the ticket (D182 art `KabsoArt.ticket`) and the count
  (`liveRankTickets` "{n} tickets" / «{n} تذكرة» for screen readers); the caller's own row pinned at the bottom; empty:
  «لا تذاكر مُنفقة في الألعاب بعد في هذه الفترة.» / "No game tickets spent yet in this period."

### 10.121 Lucky wins in the chat «المكاسب في التكست» *(v1.89-live, DRAFT — D318)*

Owner (2026-11-08): «عند لعب محظوظ تظهر مكاسب صغيرة في التكست فيمتلئ؛ أريد أن لا يظهر في التكست إلا المكسب x250 وx500 وx1000».

- **Rule:** a lucky win (`lucky-win` to its own room, D178, or the sender's own `luckyResult`) writes its line in the live
  chat only when its multiplier is **≥ `luckyChatMinMultiplier`** (default **250**: ×250, ×500, ×1000 with the default
  `LUCKY_GIFT_MULTIPLIERS`). A smaller win keeps everything else it has: the sender's coins, the win banner / combo
  («لحظة الحظ» frame), the sender's own result. The server still sends every `lucky-win` (the banner needs it); only the
  app's chat line is held back. The cross-live «لحظة الحظ» ticker (`lucky-ticker`, ≥ `LUCKY_GIFT_BIG_WIN_MULTIPLIER`)
  writes no chat line and is unchanged.
- **Setting:** `LUCKY_CHAT_MIN_MULTIPLIER` (env, default 250; must be one of `LUCKY_GIFT_MULTIPLIERS` or the server refuses
  to start); the OWNER's value wins: the panel «إعدادات الموقع» → «شريطا الهدايا والألعاب» (the same `site_settings`
  row `globalStrips`, field `luckyChatMinMultiplier`; `GET /admin/global-strips` also answers `luckyMultipliers`, the
  choices; `PUT` takes it optionally — absent: unchanged — and refuses a value that is not a multiplier, 400
  `luckyChatMinMultiplier` / `invalid_value`; audited with the strips). A stored value that is no longer a multiplier
  reads as the configuration's. Read through a 30 s cache.
- **Delivery:** `GiftCatalogue.luckyChatMinMultiplier` (the app's catalogue; a change changes `version`, so the app
  reloads it). Absent from an older server: every win keeps its line (D178).

### 10.122 A full-screen SVGA gift fills the screen *(app only, D317)*

Owner (2026-11-08, from a device: the 500 000-coin «الملاك المحارب» `angel_warrior`, an SVGA, showed the room's header
above it and looked cropped): «the full-screen gift must appear filling the whole screen».

- *(D324, owner «نعم»: full screen **only** with the badge — the shape rule below is withdrawn.)* A gift's SVGA effect
  is **full screen** when, and only when, the gift carries the «شاشة كاملة» badge (`FULLSCREEN`, D289, running), set by
  the admin in the panel. A portrait canvas without the badge (D317 also counted any canvas ≥ 1.5 : 1, e.g.
  `angel_warrior`'s 750 × 1624) keeps the normal fit. The panel's `looksFullscreen` (§10.102.3) still only
  **pre-selects** the badge on upload («تلقائي»); the admin decides and saves it. A **plain** MP4 (`alpha` NONE) is
  unchanged: it is always full screen by D207's owner answer («played full screen as is», §10.66, D309). Its own
  canvas (`viewBoxWidth` × `viewBoxHeight`) is then scaled to **cover** the whole live screen, centred, its aspect kept —
  a canvas of another shape loses equal strips at two opposite edges, never leaves a band of the room — on the effects
  layer above the header and the chat; what the movie leaves transparent stays transparent. The same rule as D309's
  plain MP4 (§10.66). Every other SVGA keeps D145d's fit (its drawn area full width, standing on the bottom edge).
  No contract change.

### 10.123 Data messages through a short LiveKit outage *(server only, D319)*

Seen on staging (2026-11-08): LiveKit closed a room for a few seconds («closing idle room … departure timeout», the
host's connection had dropped) while it was still LIVE here; the gift and the gift-ticker `SendData` answered **503**
«no response from servers» and `UpdateRoomMetadata` **404**; minutes later the room existed again.

- Every server → room data message (`broadcastData`: gifts, the global strips, lucky wins, the level ticker, chat,
  bullets, boosts, kicks, PK, programs, stickers …) sends once as before; a **503 unavailable** or **404 not found** is
  **retried in the background** after 0.5 s, 1 s, 2 s, 3 s and 5 s (≈ 11.5 s in all), then dropped with a warning. The
  caller is answered after the first attempt — no HTTP response and no gift send waits for a retry (they already send
  after the commit). Any other error is not retried and reaches the caller as before (logged and ignored). The global
  strips send to each room on its own: a room still missing after the retries is skipped, the others get the strip.
  Retries waiting at shutdown are dropped. Room metadata is not retried (the next change sends it whole).

### 10.124 «الأغنى» — the Richest board *(v1.90-live, DRAFT — D320)*

Owner (2026-11-08): the ranking page's «الأغنى» tab, until now a greyed «قريبًا», ranks users by the **coins they SENT as
gifts**, the same five periods (§10.119), «والأيقونة التي بجانب أرقامهم كوينز».

- **What counts:** the coin value (`total_coins`: unit price × quantity × recipients) of **every** gift send — a live
  (to the host or seated guests), a direct conversation, a CP gift; **lucky** sends too (what was sent, never what was
  won back), custom gifts (§10.118), and bag sends at their coin value; free quips (0 coins) do not. Exactly the sum of
  the two medal metrics `GIFTS_SENT_COINS` + `LUCKY_GIFTS_SENT_COINS` (§10.104.7, §10.104.9), written at the same place,
  once per send, in the send's own transaction (`addGiftCoinsSentIn`). A **reversed** send (`reverseGiftCherriesIn`,
  `economy-admin reverse-gift`; live and direct-conversation sends — CP gifts are not reversible) is taken back from the
  sender's hour and month of the **send** (never below 0, once). The medals are unchanged (they never subtract).
- **Storage:** `gift_coins_sent_hourly` (user, UTC hour; 15 days) and `gift_coins_sent_monthly` (user, local month in
  `LIVE_RANKINGS_TIME_ZONE`; 400 days), read exactly like the other boards (HOUR / DAY / WEEK from the hourly rows, MONTH /
  YEAR from the monthly ones). Migration `20270408090600_live_rich_board` fills them from the sends kept (`live_gifts` not
  reversed, `cp_gifts`): hourly for the last 15 days, monthly for the last 400 days, months in UTC (DEPLOYMENT §5.96).
- **API:** `GET /live/rankings?board=RICH&period=…`: the **top 20** ACTIVE users with coins sent in the window, highest first
  (ties by user id), the usual block rules and guest access; `host` is the sender, `points` the coins; `me` for any
  signed-in caller (rank null with 0).
- **App:** the tab is a normal tab now (no «قريبًا»), the podium and rows like the other boards, the **coin** art (D182
  `KabsoArt.coin`) beside every number, `liveRankCoins` «{n} كوينز» / "{n} coins" for screen readers, the caller's own row
  pinned; empty: «لم يُرسل أحد هدايا بعد في هذه الفترة.» / "No gifts sent yet in this period."

### 10.125 The entry car: the whole screen, the whole length *(app only, D331)*

Owner (2026-11-09, from a device): «سيارة الدخلة لا تُعرض بشاشة كاملة، بالإضافة لا تُعرض كاملة، يتم اقتصاص من
وقتها». It applies to every entry car (`ENTRY_EFFECT`: a VIP tier's perk, a worn store item, §10.98, and the Kabso
Team's car, §10.96.10), SVGA or MP4.

- **Its whole length.** The car plays its file's own length (an SVGA's frames ÷ fps, an MP4's duration) from the moment
  it **starts** (D272: once it can play), then leaves with the file's end. The layer's safety cap is **15.5 s** — the
  panel's upload limit for an animated entrance (MP4 ≤ 15 s + the 0.5 s tolerance, §10.98.5; an SVGA has no length check
  there and is cut at the cap). It was 10 s, which cut every longer car, and an **MP4** car's 10 s counted from the
  `join`, so its download ate into its length; an MP4 now starts its clock when it starts playing, like an SVGA (8 s to
  get ready, else skipped, as D272). An MP4 car's end now draws a frame by itself (it stayed on its last frame until
  something else drew).
- **Queue, never cut.** Entrances play one after another; the next waits until the one playing has ended (car and
  banner). At most **5 wait**; a burst beyond that drops the newest (five cars already hold over a minute). The layer
  keeps its own key in the live screen's stack, so another layer coming or going never builds it anew (which dropped
  the car playing, never played again).
- **The whole screen.** The entrance layer is over the whole live screen, above the header, the chat and the gift
  effects. A **portrait or square** car canvas (an SVGA's view box, an MP4's picture, the still's panel size) is scaled to
  **cover** it, its aspect kept — equal strips cut at the two sides, or its top — with its drawn bottom on the screen's
  bottom (D280: the rows it never draws below the art left out); never a band of the room left above it. A **landscape**
  (banner-shaped) canvas keeps D280's full width on the bottom edge (covering would cut most of its art away). What the
  art leaves transparent stays transparent. Arabic and English alike (the art is never mirrored).
- Unchanged: once per join (D280), «إخفاء تأثيرات الدخول» (D225), the sound (D272), reduced motion (the car does not
  play, no sound). No contract change.

### 10.127 Events v2 «الفعاليات» — one events system *(v1.101-social, DRAFT — D325)*

> *v1.102-social (D334):* the owner's answers of 2026-11-09 change §10.127.4 (free pieces), .5 (the number shown), .7
> (the banner), .8 (the HOSTS audience) and .10 (the festival's names) — see **§10.127.11**.

Owner (2026-11-08 / 11-09): the D303 events «لم تكن مضبوطة»; one events system in the panel section «الفعاليات», built
step by step; phase A (server + panel) now, the app page later (phase B). Decisions marked *(owner)*; the rest are CTO
defaults the owner may change (PP-71). It **extends §10.114** (every D303 rule holds unless changed here). Excluded by the
owner: a points shop and daily missions.

#### 10.127.1 One system, drafts and publishing

- Every new event is a gift event (`metric = EVENT_GIFTS`) made in the panel's «الفعاليات» (the D166 create —
  `createAdminEvent`, `event-admin create` — stays for existing tools but the panel no longer offers it). D166 metric
  events and D303 gift events **keep working to their end under their rules** (migration: every existing row is
  `PUBLISHED`, recurrence NONE, scoring MULTIPLIER — D303's whole `points_per_coin` keep their value as a multiplier —,
  counted EVENT_GIFTS, already announced; frozen events get their `event_periods` row).
- `status` **DRAFT** *(owner: «prepare now, set dates at launch»)*: dates may be null, gifts and boards empty; never shown
  in the app (404), never scored, notified or swept. **PUBLISHED**: every rule (a start; an end unless `permanent`; 1–12
  gifts unless every gift counts; 1–5 boards). A published body without gifts or boards stays a 400 (D303's shape); a
  missing date → 409 with the message.
- Commands (OWNER, `events.manage`, reason, audited): `publishAdminEvent` (a draft through every rule; then its first
  period, its Live home banner and, at its start, the notification), `unpublishAdminEvent` (a published event that has
  not started back to a draft; its banner removed), `discardAdminEvent` (a draft and its own gifts and items, refused
  once any is used or held); `changeStaffEvent` takes the same three. Editing (`PUT`) as §10.114.7, plus: once running,
  recurrence, scoring, counted gifts, milestones and `permanent` are locked too.

#### 10.127.2 Scoring *(owner: per event — points = coins, or custom points per gift; «method 2»: a multiplier)*

- `scoring` **COINS**: each counted recipient row scores its coins. **MULTIPLIER**: an event gift scores
  `floor(coins × points_per_coin) + quantity × points_per_gift` — `points_per_coin` is a decimal multiplier (0–1000, two
  decimals: ×1, ×1.2, ×1.5) — and a gift not listed (ALL_GIFTS only) its coins × 1.
- `countedGifts` **EVENT_GIFTS** (only the listed gifts) or **ALL_GIFTS** (every gift). Every D303 exclusion stays (no
  send to oneself; the sender ACTIVE; reversed sends out). New: the event's **own** exclusive gift sent **from the bag**
  never scores (a prize must not become points).
- `EventGift.multiplier` (the decimal), `pointsEach = floor(price × multiplier) + pointsPerGift`; `pointsPerCoin` stays the
  whole part for older apps.

#### 10.127.3 Recurrence *(owner: optional per event)*

- `recurrence` NONE / **WEEKLY** / **MONTHLY**: periods of 7 days / one calendar month **in the event's zone** from
  `startsAt` (`(start AT TIME ZONE zone + n) AT TIME ZONE zone`; 31 January + 1 month = 28 / 29 February). `endsAt` ends
  the series (the last period is cut there) or `permanent` (no end; `end` stops it). A recurring event lasts at least one
  whole period; the 92-day limit is for NONE.
- The current period is on the row (`period`, `period_starts_at`, `period_ends_at`). When it ends the sweeper (once, row
  locked) gives its last milestones, **freezes its boards** (`event_results.period`, an `event_periods` row), makes it due
  (paid in the same pass unless held) and starts the next period (the boards start again from 0). The last period is frozen
  like a D303 event (`frozen_at`). A held payout keeps every period's results PENDING; `release` pays them all.
- `getEventLeaderboard?period=previous`: the last frozen period before the current one (`final: true`, `period.previous`),
  `period` null when none; `EventDetail.period` {index, startsAt, endsAt, hasPrevious}. On a D166 event → 400.

#### 10.127.4 Gifts and prizes uploaded inside the event *(owner)*

- **Event gifts** (`createAdminGift` with `eventId`, the D207 uploads and checks — picture, SVGA / MP4 effect, MP3, the
  badges incl. «شاشة كاملة», a price): plain gifts (never lucky, a quip, custom or a PK booster; CHECK
  `gifts_event_plain`), in an ordinary tab. While the published event runs **everyone may buy and send them** (the usual
  65 % host / 70 % creator share) and they score; before and after they are **not listed and not bought** (409
  `GIFT_UNAVAILABLE`); afterwards the winners send the **free pieces** won as prizes from the bag *(owner 1b)*.
- **Prize items** (`createAdminStoreItem` with `eventId`, the D270 art uploads): a frame, an entrance (vehicle), an entry
  banner, a chat bubble, a profile card «خلفية الملف» — a bag catalogue item that is **never sold**: no prices, always off
  and hidden from the store (CHECK `store_items_event_exclusive`; enable / restore → 409), listed with its event only
  (`listAdminStoreItems?eventId=`, `getAdminEventOptions?eventId=`); another event never uses it. The existing grant path
  gives it (source EVENT, not transferable, days or permanent).
- **Prize types** (every board; the board's money as §10.114.3): COINS, CHERRIES, CP_MONEY, BAG_ITEM (days 1–365 or
  permanent), VIP (days), BADGE (an event medal on the winner's profile; days or permanent), and new **GIFT_PIECES**
  `{giftCode, count 1–100 000}` — pieces of one of **this event's own** gifts added to the winner's gift bag
  (`user_gift_stock`; a full bag is listed `skipped: bag_full`). Each item may carry `displayKey`, its **display picture**
  on the event page (`uploadAdminEventMedia` kind `prize`, 512 × 512 PNG / JPEG / WebP ≤ 1 MB); `EventPrizeItem.displayUrl`,
  and for an event item its hosted `stillUrl` / `animationUrl`.

#### 10.127.5 Boards *(owner: one or more per event; top 20 shown)*

The five D303 kinds, each with its minimum and prize lines (ranks 1–100 frozen as before). A gift event's board **shows
its top 20** (`data` ≤ 20) and `me` the caller's place whatever it is (the sticky «مركزي»). *(D334: the number is set
per board, §10.127.11.)*

#### 10.127.6 Milestones «مراحل» *(owner: optional)*

`milestones` (0–10): `{board, points, prizes}` — every entrant of that board (CP: both partners; AGENCIES: the owner)
whose points in the period reach `points` gets the bundle **once per milestone, person and period**
(`event_milestone_grants_once`), only ACTIVE accounts (others FORFEITED), with `EVENT_PRIZE_WON`. Given by the sweeper
within a pass of being reached, and once more for the final scores at each freeze; **not while the payout is held**
(given at the release for the frozen periods). `getEventMilestones`: each milestone with the caller's score, `reached`,
`granted`.

#### 10.127.7 Design *(owner: uploaded per event, previewed before publishing)*

The §10.114.9 specs, extended: the **title** may be a still or **animated** WebP / GIF (≤ 3 MB, ≤ 10 s) or a **Lottie** JSON
(≤ 1 MB, the 9 : 4 canvas, ≤ 10 s); the **overlay** may also be an **alpha MP4** (side-by-side alpha, H.264 / HEVC, ≤ 8 MB,
≤ 10 s); a **prize** picture (above). `EventDetail.art.titleFormat` (IMAGE / ANIMATED / LOTTIE), overlay `format` MP4. The
**banner** (1 500 × 300, `bannerMediaId`) becomes, at publish, a HOME banner opening the event, shown from its start to
its end (EVERYONE events — the Live home is the same for everyone; other audiences find it in «الفعاليات»). *(D334:
every audience, listed to that audience only — §10.127.11.)*

#### 10.127.8 Shown and announced *(owner: Live home, inside lives, Event Center, a notification)*

- Live home: the banner above. Event Center: `listEvents` / `getEvent` (published only; the audience below).
  Inside lives: `getRunningEvents` — the published gift events running now that the caller may see, with their gift
  codes (the app's strip and gift panel, phase B).
- **Audience** (`EventAudience`): EVERYONE; HOSTS (not shown to content creators, D295 — *D334: creators count as hosts
  on the events made after it, §10.127.11*); CREATORS (creator members);
  **AGENCIES** (owners and active member hosts of an open agency); **CP** (people in a couple now). It decides who sees
  the event in the lists and who is notified; the boards still rank by their kind.
- At the start the sweeper sends **`EVENT_STARTED`** (system, target EVENT, pushed «بدأت فعالية جديدة، شارك الآن») to
  every ACTIVE account of the audience and regions — one `INSERT … SELECT`, once per person and event
  (`notifications_event_started_once`), the event marked announced in the same transaction; pushed through the outbox
  (§11.12: within its 10-minute window).

#### 10.127.9 The end *(D303 kept)*

Results frozen, prizes paid automatically by the sweeper — once per result and winner (`event_prize_payouts_once`),
milestones once per key, so a pass run again pays nothing — the hold / release, the winner notification, the panel's
results (per period). Drafts are never swept.

#### 10.127.10 «مهرجان انطلاقة Kabso» — the launch festival as a draft *(owner)*

Nothing is seeded. The team makes it when it wants: the panel's «قالب مهرجان الانطلاقة» (`createAdminLaunchFestival`) or
`event-admin festival-draft --reason …`. It is a **DRAFT** without dates: the four exclusive gifts *(owner)* «شعلة
الانطلاق» 50 000 ×1, «صاروخ Kabso» 250 000 ×1, «تاج الافتتاح» 1 000 000 ×1.2, «ليلة المهرجان» 3 000 000 ×1.5 (tab EVENT, no
art yet), boards SENDERS / RECEIVERS / CREATORS and four SENDERS milestones — the **prize table and milestones are a
CTO proposal** (coins for supporters, cherries for hosts and creators, festival gift pieces on every rank) for the owner
to change in the panel. The owner uploads the art, sets the dates and publishes. *(D334: the owner did not approve the
names — the template uses «هدية المهرجان 1…4» and marks gifts 3 and 4 «شاشة كاملة»; §10.127.11.)*

#### 10.127.11 Follow-ups *(v1.102-social, DRAFT — D334; owner answers 2026-11-09)*

1. **Content creators count as hosts; hosts are not creators** *(owner: «صناع المحتوى يعتبرون مضيفين … والمضيفون ليسوا
   صناع محتوى»)*. `events.creators_as_hosts` — **false for every event that existed before migration
   `20270409090200_events_v2_followups`** (D303 / D166 / D325 rows: D295's rule kept to their end), **true for every event
   made after it** (any path: the panel, the app's staff tool, `event-admin`, the launch festival). On such an event:
   - **HOSTS audience** (`event-audience.ts`): shown to content-creator members too (`listEvents`, `getRunningEvents`,
     the Live home banner) — D295 already showed HOSTS events to every non-creator — and the start notification
     `EVENT_STARTED` goes to every approved host (`live_hosts`, any source) **and** every creator member (was: hosts whose
     permission is not a creator's, creators excluded).
   - **A D166 HOSTS board** (a metric event with audience HOSTS) ranks creator members and every approved host.
   - **Gift-event boards are unchanged:** RECEIVERS already counted hosts and creator members (the D303 follow-up) —
     on old and new events alike; **CREATORS** (board and audience) stays creator members only: a host is never on it.
   - `AdminGiftEvent.creatorsAsHosts` (read-only) lets the panel mark an older HOSTS event («فعالية قديمة … بدون صناع
     المحتوى»).
   - `getEvent` by id stays open to any signed-in caller (a shared link), as before; the audience decides the lists,
     the banner and the notification.
2. **A banner for any audience** *(owner: «أي فعالية يمكن أن يكون لها بانر … يظهر لجمهورها»)*. `bannerMediaId` makes the
   HOME banner at publish for **every** audience (was EVERYONE only). `GET /home/banners` lists a banner that opens an
   event (`home_banners.event_id`) only while the event is PUBLISHED and only to its audience — the same rule as the
   Event Center lists (item 1 included); a caller without a token (`placement=room`) sees only EVERYONE events' banners;
   a banner without an event is everyone's. Older apps sign in, so they get the same per-user list. The event's regions
   do not filter its banner (as before). The panel offers the banner on every audience.
3. **Free event gift pieces give the recipient nothing** *(owner: «لا تصله على محفظته»)*. A send whose source is BAG of a
   gift that is an event's own (`gifts.event_id` set — its pieces only come from that event's `GIFT_PIECES` prizes and
   milestones; the gift is never sold once the event ends) is stored with `live_gifts.host_share_bps = 0`: **no
   cherries** (`GIFT_RECEIVED`), **no agency or parent commission**, nothing in the agency month, the room's or the
   host pill's cherries, nor in what the host targets / recruits / data center count as earned — in a live and in a
   direct conversation. **Everything else follows the existing bag rules** (a bag send counts as a gift send): the
   live score and the host's popularity points, the recipients' charm and the sender's support levels, «ملوك الثروة» /
   «الأغنى» and the PK points move at the gift's coin value; it never scores on any event (§10.127.2). Coin sends of an
   event gift while the event runs keep the usual 65 % / 70 % share; every other bag gift keeps its share.
4. **«عدد المعروضين» per board** *(owner: top 20 by default, set per event / board in the panel)*. `event_boards.shown`
   1–100 (CHECK `event_boards_shown`; default 20 — every existing board, D303's included, keeps 20).
   `GiftEventForm.boards[].shown` (absent: 20 on a new board, kept on an edit); a display setting, so it **may change
   while the event runs** (the rest of the board stays locked). `getEventLeaderboard` lists that many (`data`,
   `shown`), `me` the caller's place whatever it is; `EventDetail.boards[].shown`. The frozen top 100 and its prizes are
   unchanged.
5. **Festival template** *(owner: names not approved; «شاشة كاملة» on the 1 000 000 and 3 000 000 gifts)*: the four gifts are
   «هدية المهرجان 1…4» / “Festival gift 1…4” (`kabso_festival_gift_1` … `_4`, the same prices and multipliers ×1 / ×1 /
   ×1.2 / ×1.5); gifts 3 and 4 carry the FULLSCREEN badge (the D324 full-screen effect when their art is uploaded). The
   prize table and milestones remain placeholders the owner sets (answer 1).
6. **Milestones held with the payout** *(owner: yes)*: not given while held; given at the release (once per key) with
   the board prizes. Fix: a held event whose boards pay nothing but which has milestones is no longer settled at its
   freeze — it stays due until the release gives the milestones.

### 10.130 The default avatar *(app + panel, D337)*

Owner (2026-11-09, with his own Kabso mascot art): «اجعل هذه الصورة التلقائية لأي حساب». §10.130 was chosen to keep
§10.128–§10.129 free for the profile (D335) and messages (D336) branches; those landed as §10.73.7 and §11.13.1, so
§10.128–§10.129 are unused (integration int19). No contract change: an account without a photo
still has `avatarUrl: null` on the wire; the picture is drawn by the clients.

- **Where.** Every picture of a person that showed their **initial** when there was no photo — or when the photo failed to
  load — shows the owner's default picture instead: `KAvatar` (so every avatar built on it: profile headers and their
  frames, live seats, chat, the DM list and conversations, comments, rankings, the person card, stories, notifications,

  host photo, the go-live cover picture, the rankings sheet's square pictures and the caption «@» suggestions. Rings,

- **The art.** The main mascot cropped from the owner's scene so its head and both headphones sit inside the circle
  (checked at 24, 40, 64 and 120 dp): `assets/avatar/kabso_default_avatar_192.webp` up to 192 physical pixels (64 dp at
  3×), `kabso_default_avatar_512.webp` above and for pictures that fill a card (`KDefaultAvatarArt.assetFor`).
  Provenance in `assets/avatar/PROVENANCE.md`; the full-resolution source is not kept.
- **Panel.** The panel's `Avatar` (user lists, user cells, the live and search lists, the signed-in admin's menu) shows

### 10.131 «حذف» of a gift *(v1.103-social, DRAFT — D338)*

Owner (2026-11-09): «أريد زر لإزالتهم وليس فقط إيقافهم» — a delete button for a gift, not only on / off. Gifts are named by
their code everywhere history lives (sends and their ledgers, bags, events, lucky draws, PK boosts, wish lists, tasks,
prizes), so a used gift is never removed. §10.131 follows §10.130 (D337); §10.128–§10.129 are left for D335 / D336.

- **One rule** (`removeGiftByAdminIn`, shared by the panel's `deleteAdminGift` — `DELETE /admin/gifts/{code}`,
  catalog.manage: OWNER, CSRF, reason — and `gift-admin delete <code>`), in the gift's transaction after locking its row.
  It counts what points at the gift (`GiftUsage`): by foreign key `live_gifts` (live and direct sends), `user_gift_stock`
  (any bag row, also an emptied one), `event_gifts`, `pk_boosts`; by code only `lucky_gift_draws`,
  `live_rooms.wish_gifts`, `task_assignments.subject`, `host_target_assignments.subject`, and `giftCode` at any depth of
  the prize JSON (`events.prizes`, `event_boards.prizes`, `event_milestones.prizes`, `event_results.prize`,
  `event_prize_payouts.granted`, `event_milestone_grants.granted`). Audit rows (text) do not count.
  - **nobody holds a piece and no history → DELETED** for real (an emptied bag row, quantity 0, is not history by
    itself and goes with it; audit `gift.delete` with the gift before); after the commit its uploaded files (image,
    effect, sound) that no other gift names are removed from storage — best effort, a failure is logged and only leaves
    the files (`filesDeleted` says how many went). Its code can be used again.
  - **otherwise → ARCHIVED**: `archived_at` set and `enabled` false (CHECK `gifts_archived_off`; audit `gift.archive` with
    the usage and whether it was on). It is off, so everything that already filters on `enabled` leaves it out: the app's
    catalogue, wish lists, PK boosters, host targets and daily tasks; buying it (a send with coins) answers 409
    `GIFT_UNAVAILABLE`. It also leaves the panel's normal list (shown under «المحذوفة (N)»), the event picker
    (`getAdminEventOptions`, except for an event that lists it already) and event edits (an archived gift is not added to
    an event; one already listed stays), and `gift-admin grant` refuses it. History keeps the row: earnings, ledgers,
    sends, results and reports still show its name and art. Archived already: 200 ARCHIVED, nothing written.
- **Bag pieces of an archived gift** (owner, 2026-11-09: «مخفية الا ان تنتهي من حقيبة المستخدمين ثم تحذف»): the pieces
  already in bags **stay listed** (`getMyGiftBag`) **and sendable** (`source: BAG`, live and direct) until they run out;
  no new piece is bought or granted (`gift-admin grant` refuses it; an event prize already owed still pays its pieces).
  When nobody holds a piece any more the gift is **finished** (`finishArchivedGiftIn`): with no history at all it is
  DELETED like above (audit `gift.delete`, `case: finished`, `via: system` or `cli`; its unused files removed), otherwise
  it stays archived for history only. The check runs right after a bag send of an archived gift, on every events sweep
  (`EVENTS_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS`, the `GiftFinishService`) for pieces that left without a send (a deleted account's
  bag), and with `gift-admin finish [<code>]`. A gift whose pieces were sent has history (the sends), so in practice it
  stays in «المحذوفة» with `pieces` 0.
- **«استعادة»** (`restoreAdminGift`, `gift-admin restore <code>`): `archived_at` cleared and the gift switched on (audit
  `gift.restore`), also while pieces are still out (they are untouched); not archived: `changed` false; finished and
  deleted: 404. `enableAdminGift` / `gift-admin enable` refuse an archived gift (409
  `ADMIN_ACTION_REFUSED`: restore it first).
- **The panel** («الهدايا»): «حذف» on each gift card; one confirm dialog that says which case applies, from the list's
  `inUse` / `sends` / `holders` / `pieces` («ستُحذف نهائياً …», or «ستُنقل إلى «المحذوفة» لأن لها سجلاً (أُرسلت N مرة) …»
  and, with pieces out, «ستختفي من المتجر، وتبقى N قطعة في حقائب M مستخدمين حتى تُستخدم …»), the reason
  required; the toast names what happened. «المحذوفة (N)» shows only archived gifts (badge «محذوفة» with the date, «تبقى N قطعة في حقائب M
  مستخدمين حتى تُستخدم» or «نفدت القطع؛ باقية للسجل فقط») with «استعادة». `AdminGift.archivedAt`, `inUse`, `holders`,
  `pieces`; `AdminGiftDeleted`, `AdminGiftRestored`.
- Migration `20270410090000_gift_archive` (the column and the CHECK). The apps need no change (the bag already lists
  what the server returns).

### 10.134 An event's final result and its full-screen announcements *(v1.105-social, DRAFT — D340)*

Owner (2026-11-09): after an event ends its page still said «باقي 600 نقطة للتأهل» as if it ran; a board with no minimum
showed «لم تدخل الترتيب بعد · 0 نقطة»; and «نعم» to a full-screen announcement when an event starts and when someone
wins. It **extends §10.127** (every rule there holds).

#### 10.134.1 The final result on the event page *(app + `getEventLeaderboard`)*

- **Server.** On a final board (`final: true`: the event, or the recurring period shown, is frozen) `me` is the caller's
  **final place whatever it is**: from `event_results` (the frozen top 100) when the caller is there, else computed over
  the frozen period's window with the board's own ranking (`boardRankedSql`, the same exclusions) — `rank` may be above
  100, `qualified` is `score ≥ minPoints`, no prize (prizes stop at rank 100). `rank` null and `score` 0: the caller did
  not take part. `me.prizeStatus` (final boards of gift events): **NONE** (no prize for this place), **PENDING** (frozen,
  not paid: held or due in the next pass), **PAID**, **FORFEITED** (not ACTIVE at payout). A live board is unchanged.
- **App** (`EventDetailScreen`, the board's «مركزي» card and the sticky bar). Once the event has **ended** (its status,
  or the board is final) the page never shows the points still missing; it shows the result:
  - qualified with a prize: «مركزك النهائي: N» and «فزت بـ …» with the bundle (PENDING: «تُسلَّم بعد المراجعة»);
  - qualified without a prize: «مركزك النهائي: N»;
  - on the board but below the minimum: «مركزك النهائي: N» and «لم تتأهل»;
  - not on the board (score 0): «لم تشارك».
  Between the end and the sweeper's freeze (≤ one pass) the scores can no longer move (nothing after `endsAt` counts),
  so the page already shows them as the result, marked «النتائج النهائية قيد الاعتماد».
- **Zero minimum.** A board whose `minPoints` is 0 shows no «الحد الأدنى للتأهل» line and never «باقي N نقطة للتأهل»;
  a caller not on it yet reads «لم تدخل الترتيب بعد» (no «· 0 نقطة»); the sticky bar «مركزي: N · X نقطة» with the
  points to the next place, as before.

#### 10.134.2 Full-screen announcements *(`getEventAnnouncements`, `markEventAnnouncementSeen`)*

- **`EVENT_START`** «بدأت فعالية»: a published gift event (`metric = EVENT_GIFTS`) running now (`startsAt ≤ now`, not
  frozen, before its end), whose start was announced by the sweeper (`start_notified_at`: the `EVENT_STARTED`
  notification of §10.127.8 went out), with **`announce_fullscreen`** on, that is the caller's to join — listed to them
  by the Event Center (`eventAudienceWhere`: the audience incl. D334's `creators_as_hosts`; the event's regions against
  the caller's country) **and** inside the start notification's audience (`audienceSql`: a HOSTS event, browsable by
  every non-creator under D295, interrupts its hosts only) — checked when asked, so a person who joins the audience
  later sees it too — and that the caller has not seen (`event_start_announcements` (event, user), once). The event's
  title, dates, art (`titleUrl`, `backgroundUrl` — a still or animated WebP, or a video's poster; else `bannerUrl`; else
  Kabso's own artwork in the app), and the key prize: the first board's rank-1 bundle. «شارك الآن» opens the event page,
  «لاحقاً» closes it; both mark it seen.
- **`EVENT_WIN`** «مبروك»: each `event_prize_payouts` row of the caller with status **PAID** (the payout that wrote
  `EVENT_PRIZE_WON`; a CP result: each partner's own payout) whose `announced_at` is null — the board, the final rank and
  the bundle won (`event_results.prize`). **Always on** (no switch). «عرض النتائج» opens the event page. A held payout is
  announced only once paid; a FORFEITED one never. Rows paid before migration `20270412090000_event_announcements` are
  marked announced by the migration (no burst of old wins after the deploy). D166 metric events (coins only, no payout
  rows) are not announced.
- **Who.** A caller whose account is not ACTIVE gets an empty list (a suspended account cannot sign in anyway). A
  person outside the event's audience never sees its start (and `markEventAnnouncementSeen` → 404 for it). Blocks
  between people do not apply: an announcement names no other person.
- **Order and size.** Wins first (oldest payout first), then starts (newest start first); at most 10 per call.
- **Seen.** `POST /events/announcements/{id}/seen` — `start_<eventId>` inserts `(event, user)` `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`;
  `win_<payoutId>` sets `announced_at` where null and the payout is the caller's. Idempotent (204 again, nothing
  written); unknown, malformed or someone else's → 404.
- **Admin.** `events.announce_fullscreen` «إعلان بملء الشاشة عند البدء» — `GiftEventForm.announceFullscreen`, in the
  panel's design step: **true by default** for every event made from now on (any path: panel, the app's staff tool,
  `event-admin`, the launch festival); **false for every event that existed before the migration** (an event running at
  the deploy is not suddenly announced to everyone); absent on an edit: kept; a display setting, so it may change while
  the event runs (switching it on for a running event announces it from then on). Audited with the edit.
- **App.** A gate above the router (`EventAnnouncementGate`) asks `getEventAnnouncements` once signed in, on each return
  to the foreground and when a live is left; it never shows while the person hosts a live (the go-live screen or its
  minimized window) or watches one (a live room, or its minimized window) — the announcements wait until they leave.
  One at a time, full screen, dismissible (the back button and «لاحقاً» close it; each shown one is marked seen when
  closed). Animated entrance (fade + scale, the event art drifting) — **none when the system asks for reduced motion**
  (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations`). Arabic RTL / English LTR, light / dark, 360 × 800 and text scale 1.3 (the content
  scrolls). Kabso's own artwork only when the event has no art (the owner's gift box `assets/art/kabso_gift_box.webp` for a
  start, Kabso's rank shields `assets/leaderboard/rank_shield_1…3.webp` for a win): never third-party art.

### 10.140 The direct share «تفعّل من خلالنا دون وكيل» *(v1.106-social, DRAFT — D341)*

Owner (2026-11-09): «لو مضيف تفعل من خلالنا دون وكيل تصبح نسبته ٧٢٪ — ولو صانع المحتوى تفعل من خلالنا تصبح نسبته ٧٥٪»,
then corrected: a direct host **70 %** (not 72 %), a direct content creator **75 %**. §10.140 follows §10.131; §10.132–§10.139
were left for D339 / D340, which landed as §10.132–§10.134, so §10.135–§10.139 are unused (integration int20).

- **Who is direct.** A recipient is *direct* when, at the moment of the send, they hold the hosting permission
  (`live_hosts`, any source: an admin's grant, the team's approval «كن مضيفاً مع الإدارة», an agency owner's activation, a
  creator membership) **and** have no ACTIVE agency membership (`agency_hosts.status = ACTIVE`). The rule reads the
  membership, not who once activated the person: the permission's `source` does not tell a host the team activated for
  an agency (before D295 agency hosts got the permission as `ADMIN`) from a direct one, and a host who **left** their
  agency (or was released by the team, or whose agency was closed) is served by Kabso alone from then on (no agency
  commission is paid on them). A host or creator who joins an agency stops being direct at their next send.
- **The share** (`liveShareBpsOf`, stored per send in `live_gifts.host_share_bps`, D154): a **normal** gift (any category
  but `QUIPS`, `LUCKY` and `CUSTOM` — `POPULAR`, `EVENT`, `FUN` and any category added in the panel) sent in a live, when
  **every** recipient is direct:
  - a host's live, or any send that is not a D295 creator send: `GIFT_DIRECT_HOST_SHARE_PERCENT` (default **70**) instead
    of the category share (`GIFT_HOST_SHARE_PERCENTS`, 65): 1 000 000 coins → **7 000 000** cherries (1 coin = 10 cherries).
    A direct creator seated in a host's live is paid as a direct host there (as D295 pays creators the host share
    outside their own lives);
  - a D295 creator send (a creator's live, every recipient a creator member): `GIFT_DIRECT_CREATOR_SHARE_PERCENT` (default
    **75**) instead of `GIFT_CREATOR_SHARE_PERCENT` (70): 1 000 000 coins → **7 500 000** cherries;
  - never below the share it replaces (`max`), so a category configured above the direct rate keeps its own.
- **One share per send.** The share is stored per send, not per recipient, so a send that also reaches an agency member
  or a seated guest without the hosting permission keeps the ordinary share for every recipient (as §10.108.5: a higher
  rate is never paid through a shared send). A send to several direct recipients (the host and seated direct hosts; a PK
  booster goes to the host alone) takes the direct share.
- **Unchanged:** agency members keep 65 % (creators 70 %) and the agency's commission (15 % / 16 %) and its parent's (3 %)
  stay **on top**, from the platform's part (§10.46): 1 000 000 coins to an agency host → 6 500 000 cherries + 975 000
  commission. Quips keep 50 % (a creator's 60 %), lucky gifts `LUCKY_GIFT_HOST_SHARE_PERCENT`, custom gifts
  `GIFT_CUSTOM_SHARE_PERCENT` (60 %), direct-conversation gifts `GIFT_DM_RECIPIENT_SHARE_PERCENT` (50 %), CP gifts their own
  rule, an event's prize pieces 0 (D334). Sends made before D341 keep their stored share.
- **Where it shows.** Everything that reads the stored share follows by itself: the cherry ledger and agency earnings,
  the gift history's `shareBps` (the app's cherry and wallet tabs show it per gift), the data center, the host cherries
  pill, the D281 targets' and D285 recruits' actual profit. No screen shows a fixed percentage. The D281 / D285 cautious
  estimates keep the highest *category* share (an owner decision to confirm).
- **Config:** `GIFT_DIRECT_HOST_SHARE_PERCENT` (70), `GIFT_DIRECT_CREATOR_SHARE_PERCENT` (75) — a percentage 0–100 with at
  most two decimals (else the API refuses to start). Read once at the send, before its transaction (like the D295 creator
  check): a membership change racing a send applies from the next send.
